--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/auth/unsubscribe/page.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useState, Suspense } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';

function UnsubscribeContent() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const emailParam = searchParams.get('email');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState(() => emailParam ?? '');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'loading' | 'done' | 'error'>('idle');
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const toSubmit = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!toSubmit || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(toSubmit)) {
      setMessage('Please enter a valid email address.');
      setStatus('error');
      return;
    }
    setStatus('loading');
    setMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/unsubscribe', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: toSubmit }),
      });
      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (res.ok && data?.ok) {
        setStatus('done');
      } else {
        setStatus('error');
        setMessage(data?.error ?? 'Something went wrong. Please try again.');
      }
    } catch {
      setStatus('error');
      setMessage('Something went wrong. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (status === 'done') {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-[#F8F7F5] p-4">
        <Card className="w-full max-w-[420px] shadow-md rounded-xl border border-border bg-card">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="text-xl">Unsubscribed</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              You will no longer receive student invite emails from this platform. You can still sign in or sign up via your college&apos;s student login page.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-[#F8F7F5] p-4">
      <Card className="w-full max-w-[420px] shadow-md rounded-xl border border-border bg-card">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="text-xl">Unsubscribe from invite emails</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Enter your email to stop receiving student invite emails. Your account and access are not affected.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-3">
            <Input
              type="email"
              placeholder="you@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              disabled={status === 'loading'}
              className="h-11"
            />
            {message && (
              <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{message}</p>
            )}
            <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-11" disabled={status === 'loading'}>
              {status === 'loading' ? 'Unsubscribing…' : 'Unsubscribe'}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function UnsubscribePage() {
  return (
    <Suspense
      fallback={
        <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-[#F8F7F5] p-4">
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Loading…</p>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <UnsubscribeContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/_components/mini-calendar.tsx ---
'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';

export function MiniCalendar() {
    const now = new Date();
    const year = now.getFullYear();
    const month = now.getMonth();
    const today = now.getDate();
    const monthName = now.toLocaleString('default', { month: 'long' });

    const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1).getDay();
    const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
    const daysInPrevMonth = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();

    const days: { num: number; current: boolean; faded: boolean }[] = [];

    for (let i = firstDay - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        days.push({ num: daysInPrevMonth - i, current: false, faded: true });
    }
    for (let i = 1; i <= daysInMonth; i++) {
        days.push({ num: i, current: i === today, faded: false });
    }
    const remaining = 35 - days.length;
    if (remaining > 0) {
        for (let i = 1; i <= remaining; i++) {
            days.push({ num: i, current: false, faded: true });
        }
    }

    return (
        <Card className="border-border/50 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm shadow-sm">
            <CardContent className="p-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                    <button className="p-0.5 rounded-md hover:bg-accent transition-colors">
                        <ChevronLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                    </button>
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-primary">
                        {monthName} {year}
                    </span>
                    <button className="p-0.5 rounded-md hover:bg-accent transition-colors">
                        <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                    </button>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-px text-center mb-0.5">
                    {['S', 'M', 'T', 'W', 'T', 'F', 'S'].map((d, i) => (
                        <span key={i} className="text-[9px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground py-0.5">
                            {d}
                        </span>
                    ))}
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-px text-center">
                    {days.map((d, i) => (
                        <span
                            key={i}
                            className={`text-[11px] py-1 rounded transition-colors ${d.current
                                    ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-bold shadow-sm'
                                    : d.faded
                                        ? 'text-muted-foreground/40'
                                        : 'text-foreground hover:bg-accent cursor-pointer'
                                }`}
                        >
                            {d.num}
                        </span>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </CardContent>
        </Card>
    );
}

              </div>
              
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed">
                {course.short_description || course.description || 'No description available.'}
              </p>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-y-2 gap-x-4 pt-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                  <BookOpen className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary/60" />
                  <span>{course.module_count} Modules</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                  <Video className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary/60" />
                  <span>{course.video_count} Lessons</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-6 flex items-center gap-4">
              <div className="flex-1 h-1.5 bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden hidden md:block">
                <Progress value={course.progress_percentage} className="h-full" />
              </div>
              
              <Button asChild size="sm" className="rounded-full bg-gradient-orange hover:opacity-90 shadow-lg shadow-primary/20 shrink-0">
                <Link href={`/c/${collegeSlug}/student/learn/${course.id}`}>
                  {course.progress_percentage > 0 ? 'Continue' : 'Start Course'}
                  <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 ml-1.5" />
                </Link>
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/_components/student-activity-feed.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  PlayCircle,
  FileCheck,
  Award,
  Flame,
  TrendingUp,
  Trophy,
  Medal,
  Crown,
  Calendar,
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { ActivityEventRow } from '@/lib/activity/queries';

/* ── types ── */
type ViewMode = 'weekly' | 'monthly';

/* ── Helpers ── */

function getMonthLabels(): string[] {
  return ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
}

function getDayLabels(): string[] {
  return ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
}

/* Build 52-week heatmap grid from activity events */
function buildHeatmapData(events: ActivityEventRow[]) {
  const now = new Date();
  const yearAgo = new Date(now);
  yearAgo.setFullYear(yearAgo.getFullYear() - 1);

  // Count events per day
  const dayCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const e of events) {
    const d = new Date(e.created_at).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    dayCounts[d] = (dayCounts[d] || 0) + 1;
  }

  // Build 53 weeks × 7 days grid
  const weeks: { date: string; count: number; month: number }[][] = [];
  const startDay = new Date(yearAgo);
  startDay.setDate(startDay.getDate() - startDay.getDay() + 1); // Start from Monday

  let currentWeek: { date: string; count: number; month: number }[] = [];
  const d = new Date(startDay);

  while (d <= now) {
    const dateStr = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    currentWeek.push({ date: dateStr, count: dayCounts[dateStr] || 0, month: d.getMonth() });
    if (currentWeek.length === 7) {
      weeks.push(currentWeek);
      currentWeek = [];
    }
    d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1);
  }
  if (currentWeek.length > 0) weeks.push(currentWeek);

  const maxCount = Math.max(1, ...Object.values(dayCounts));

  return { weeks, maxCount, totalEvents: events.length };
}

function getHeatmapColor(count: number, maxCount: number): string {
  if (count === 0) return 'bg-accent/30 dark:bg-accent/20';
  const ratio = count / maxCount;
  if (ratio <= 0.25) return 'bg-primary/20 dark:bg-primary/25';
  if (ratio <= 0.5) return 'bg-primary/40 dark:bg-primary/45';
  if (ratio <= 0.75) return 'bg-primary/60 dark:bg-primary/65';
  return 'bg-primary/80 dark:bg-primary/85';
}

/* ── Weekly/Monthly Activity Bar Chart ── */

function ActivityBarChart({ events, mode }: { events: ActivityEventRow[]; mode: ViewMode }) {
  const bars = useMemo(() => {
    const now = new Date();

    if (mode === 'weekly') {
      const dayBuckets = Array(7).fill(0);
      const weekAgo = new Date(now);
      weekAgo.setDate(weekAgo.getDate() - 7);

      for (const e of events) {
        const d = new Date(e.created_at);
        if (d >= weekAgo && d <= now) {
          const dayIndex = (d.getDay() + 6) % 7; // Mon=0
          dayBuckets[dayIndex]++;
        }
      }
      return getDayLabels().map((label, i) => ({ label, value: dayBuckets[i] }));
    } else {
      const monthBuckets = Array(12).fill(0);
      const yearAgo = new Date(now);
      yearAgo.setFullYear(yearAgo.getFullYear() - 1);

      for (const e of events) {
        const d = new Date(e.created_at);
        if (d >= yearAgo && d <= now) {
          monthBuckets[d.getMonth()]++;
        }
      }
      return getMonthLabels().map((label, i) => ({ label, value: monthBuckets[i] }));
    }
  }, [events, mode]);

  const maxVal = Math.max(1, ...bars.map((b) => b.value));

  return (
    <div className="flex items-end gap-1 h-36">
      {bars.map((bar, i) => (
        <div key={i} className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center gap-1 h-full justify-end">
          {bar.value > 0 && (
            <span className="text-[9px] font-semibold text-primary">{bar.value}</span>
          )}
          <div
            className="w-full rounded-t-sm bg-primary/60 dark:bg-primary/70 transition-all duration-500 hover:bg-primary min-h-[2px]"
            style={{ height: `${Math.max(2, (bar.value / maxVal) * 100)}%` }}
          />
          <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">{bar.label}</span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ── Heatmap ── */

function YearlyHeatmap({ events }: { events: ActivityEventRow[] }) {
  const { weeks, maxCount, totalEvents } = useMemo(() => buildHeatmapData(events), [events]);
  const months = getMonthLabels();

  // Which months appear at which week index
  const monthHeaders: { label: string; colStart: number }[] = [];
  let lastMonth = -1;
  weeks.forEach((week, wi) => {
    const firstDayMonth = week[0]?.month ?? -1;
    if (firstDayMonth !== lastMonth) {
      monthHeaders.push({ label: months[firstDayMonth], colStart: wi });
      lastMonth = firstDayMonth;
    }
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      {/* Month labels */}
      <div className="flex gap-px ml-8 overflow-hidden">
        {monthHeaders.map((m, i) => {
          const nextCol = monthHeaders[i + 1]?.colStart ?? weeks.length;
          const colSpan = nextCol - m.colStart;
          return (
            <span
              key={i}
              className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground shrink-0"
              style={{ width: `${colSpan * 9}px` }}
            >
              {m.label}
            </span>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Grid */}
      <div className="flex gap-0">
        {/* Day labels */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-px mr-1 shrink-0">
          {['', 'Mon', '', 'Wed', '', 'Fri', ''].map((label, i) => (
            <span key={i} className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground h-[8px] sm:h-[11px] leading-[8px] sm:leading-[11px] w-6 text-right pr-1">
              {label}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Heatmap grid */}
        <div className="flex gap-px flex-1 overflow-x-auto">
          {weeks.map((week, wi) => (
            <div key={wi} className="flex flex-col gap-px">
              {week.map((day, di) => (
                <div
                  key={di}
                  className={`w-[8px] h-[8px] sm:w-[11px] sm:h-[11px] rounded-[2px] ${getHeatmapColor(day.count, maxCount)} transition-colors`}
                  title={`${day.date}: ${day.count} activities`}
                />
              ))}
              {/* Pad if week < 7 days */}
              {week.length < 7 && Array.from({ length: 7 - week.length }).map((_, i) => (
                <div key={`pad-${i}`} className="w-[8px] h-[8px] sm:w-[11px] sm:h-[11px]" />
              ))}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Legend */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-1">
        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{totalEvents} activities in the last year</span>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">Less</span>
          <div className="w-[8px] h-[8px] sm:w-[11px] sm:h-[11px] rounded-[2px] bg-accent/30 dark:bg-accent/20" />
          <div className="w-[8px] h-[8px] sm:w-[11px] sm:h-[11px] rounded-[2px] bg-primary/20" />
          <div className="w-[8px] h-[8px] sm:w-[11px] sm:h-[11px] rounded-[2px] bg-primary/40" />
          <div className="w-[8px] h-[8px] sm:w-[11px] sm:h-[11px] rounded-[2px] bg-primary/60" />
          <div className="w-[8px] h-[8px] sm:w-[11px] sm:h-[11px] rounded-[2px] bg-primary/80" />
          <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">More</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ── Main Activity Dashboard ── */

export function StudentActivityDashboard({
  initialEvents,
}: {
  initialEvents: ActivityEventRow[];
}) {
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<ViewMode>('weekly');

  // Derive stats from events
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const videoEvents = initialEvents.filter((e) =>
      e.event_name.toLowerCase().includes('video') || e.event_name.toLowerCase().includes('watch') || e.event_name.toLowerCase().includes('lecture')
    );
    const assignmentEvents = initialEvents.filter((e) =>
      e.event_name.toLowerCase().includes('assignment') || e.event_name.toLowerCase().includes('quiz') || e.event_name.toLowerCase().includes('submit')
    );

    // Calculate streak
    let streak = 0;
    const today = new Date();
    const daySet = new Set(initialEvents.map((e) => new Date(e.created_at).toISOString().slice(0, 10)));
    const check = new Date(today);
    while (daySet.has(check.toISOString().slice(0, 10))) {
      streak++;
      check.setDate(check.getDate() - 1);
    }

    return {
      videosWatched: videoEvents.length,
      assignmentsCompleted: assignmentEvents.length,
      totalPoints: initialEvents.length * 10,
      dayStreak: streak,
      totalEvents: initialEvents.length,
    };
  }, [initialEvents]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">My Activity</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
          Track your learning journey, hours spent, and achievements.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* ── Stats Cards ── */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <StatCard icon={PlayCircle} label="Videos Watched" value={stats.videosWatched} color="text-blue-500 dark:text-blue-400" />
        <StatCard icon={FileCheck} label="Assignments" value={stats.assignmentsCompleted} color="text-emerald-500 dark:text-emerald-400" />
        <StatCard icon={Award} label="Total Points" value={stats.totalPoints} color="text-amber-500 dark:text-amber-400" />
        <StatCard icon={Flame} label="Day Streak" value={stats.dayStreak} color="text-primary" />
      </div>

      {/* ── Hours Graph ── */}
      <Card className="border-border/50 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm shadow-sm">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
              <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> Activity Hours
            </CardTitle>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-accent/50 dark:bg-accent/20 rounded-lg p-0.5">
              <Button
                variant={viewMode === 'weekly' ? 'default' : 'ghost'}
                size="sm"
                className="h-7 text-xs px-3 rounded-md"
                onClick={() => setViewMode('weekly')}
              >
                Weekly
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant={viewMode === 'monthly' ? 'default' : 'ghost'}
                size="sm"
                className="h-7 text-xs px-3 rounded-md"
                onClick={() => setViewMode('monthly')}
              >
                Monthly
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <ActivityBarChart events={initialEvents} mode={viewMode} />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* ── Row: Heatmap + Leaderboard ── */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {/* Yearly Heatmap */}
        <Card className="lg:col-span-2 border-border/50 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm shadow-sm">
          <CardHeader className="pb-3">
            <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
              <Calendar className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> Yearly Activity
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <YearlyHeatmap events={initialEvents} />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Leaderboard */}
        <Card className="border-border/50 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm shadow-sm">
          <CardHeader className="pb-3">
            <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
              <Trophy className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> Leaderboard
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <Leaderboard />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* ── Recent Activity Feed ── */}
      <Card className="border-border/50 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm shadow-sm">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <CardTitle className="text-base">Recent Activity</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {initialEvents.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-10 text-center">
              <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-primary/10 dark:bg-primary/20 flex items-center justify-center mb-3">
                <TrendingUp className="h-7 w-7 text-primary/50" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground">No activity yet</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/70 mt-1">
                Watch videos, complete assignments, and start earning points!
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-2 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto">
              {initialEvents.slice(0, 20).map((row) => (
                <div
                  key={row.id}
                  className="flex items-center gap-3 p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-accent/50 transition-colors"
                >
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    <Flame className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">

                    <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{row.event_category}</p>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground shrink-0">
                    {new Date(row.created_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/_components/todo-widget.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { CheckCircle2, Circle, Plus, Trash2, X } from 'lucide-react';

interface TodoItem {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    done: boolean;
}

export function TodoWidget() {
    const [todos, setTodos] = useState<TodoItem[]>([]);
    const [newTask, setNewTask] = useState('');
    const [showInput, setShowInput] = useState(false);

    const addTask = () => {
        const text = newTask.trim();
        if (!text) return;
        setTodos((prev) => [
            { id: Date.now().toString(), label: text, done: false },
            ...prev,
        ]);
        setNewTask('');
        setShowInput(false);
    };

    const toggleTask = (id: string) => {
        setTodos((prev) =>
            prev.map((t) => (t.id === id ? { ...t, done: !t.done } : t))
        );
    };

    const deleteTask = (id: string) => {
        setTodos((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
    };

    const completedCount = todos.filter((t) => t.done).length;

    return (
        <Card className="border-border/50 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm shadow-sm">
            <CardHeader className="pb-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground tracking-wide">
                        To do List
                    </CardTitle>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        {todos.length > 0 && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                                {completedCount}/{todos.length}
                            </span>
                        )}
                        <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="icon"
                            className="h-6 w-6 rounded-md"
                            onClick={() => setShowInput(!showInput)}
                        >
                            {showInput ? (
                                <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                            ) : (
                                <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                            )}
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-1.5">
                {/* Add task input */}
                {showInput && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-1">
                        <Input
                            placeholder="Add a new task..."
                            value={newTask}
                            onChange={(e) => setNewTask(e.target.value)}
                            onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && addTask()}
                            className="h-8 text-sm"
                            autoFocus
                        />
                        <Button size="sm" className="h-8 px-3 text-xs" onClick={addTask}>
                            Add
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                )}

                {/* Empty state */}
                {todos.length === 0 && !showInput && (
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-6 text-center">
                        <Circle className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground/30 mb-2" />
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No tasks yet</p>
                        <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="mt-2 text-xs text-primary h-7"
                            onClick={() => setShowInput(true)}
                        >
                            <Plus className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" /> Create your first task
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                )}

                {/* Task list */}
                {todos.map((item) => (
                    <div
                        key={item.id}
                        className="flex items-center gap-2.5 group rounded-lg px-1 py-1.5 hover:bg-accent/50 transition-colors"
                    >
                        <button
                            onClick={() => toggleTask(item.id)}
                            className="shrink-0 transition-transform hover:scale-110"
                        >
                            {item.done ? (
                                <CheckCircle2 className="h-4.5 w-4.5 text-primary" />
                            ) : (
                                <Circle className="h-4.5 w-4.5 text-muted-foreground/40 group-hover:text-muted-foreground" />
                            )}
                        </button>
                        <span
                            className={`flex-1 text-sm truncate transition-all ${item.done
                                    ? 'line-through text-muted-foreground'
                                    : 'text-foreground'
                                }`}
                        >
                            {item.label}
                        </span>
                        <button
                            onClick={() => deleteTask(item.id)}
                            className="shrink-0 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive"
                        >
                            <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </button>
                    </div>
                ))}
            </CardContent>
        </Card>
    );
}

--- END FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/_components/todo-widget.tsx ---

            <CardHeader className="pb-3 flex flex-row items-center justify-between">

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/activity/page.tsx ---
import { Suspense } from 'react';
import { requireStudent } from '@/lib/auth/require-student';
import StudentActivityDeferred from './student-activity-deferred';

function ActivityFallback() {
  return (
    <div className='space-y-3 animate-pulse'>
      <div className='h-16 rounded-xl bg-muted/50 border border-border' />
      <div className='h-16 rounded-xl bg-muted/50 border border-border' />
      <div className='h-16 rounded-xl bg-muted/50 border border-border' />
    </div>
  );
}

export default async function StudentActivityRoute({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug } = await params;
  const { user, tenant } = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const eventName = typeof sp.eventName === 'string' ? sp.eventName : null;
  const eventCategory = typeof sp.eventCategory === 'string' ? sp.eventCategory : null;
  let from: string | null = typeof sp.from === 'string' ? sp.from : null;
  let to: string | null = typeof sp.to === 'string' ? sp.to : null;
  if (from && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(from)) from = `${from}T00:00:00.000Z`;
  if (to && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(to)) to = `${to}T23:59:59.999Z`;

  return (
    <div className='space-y-4'>
      <div>
        <h1 className='text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight'>Activity</h1>
        <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>Recent learning and account events.</p>
      </div>
      <Suspense fallback={<ActivityFallback />}>
        <StudentActivityDeferred
          tenantId={tenant.id}
          userId={user.id}
          eventName={eventName ?? undefined}
          eventCategory={eventCategory ?? undefined}
          from={from ?? undefined}
          to={to ?? undefined}
        />
      </Suspense>
    </div>
  );
}

import { listActivityEvents } from '@/lib/activity/queries';
import { StudentActivityDashboard } from '@/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/_components/student-activity-feed';

export default async function StudentActivityDeferred({
  tenantId,
  userId,
  eventName,
  eventCategory,
  from,
  to,
}: {
  tenantId: string;
  userId: string;
  eventName?: string;
  eventCategory?: string;
  from?: string;
  to?: string;
}) {
  const events = await listActivityEvents({
    tenantId,
    userId,
    eventName,
    eventCategory,
    from,
    to,
    limit: 100,
  });

  return <StudentActivityDashboard initialEvents={events} />;
}

'use client';

import React, { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import gsap from 'gsap';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import {
  ChartContainer,
  ChartTooltip,
  ChartTooltipContent,
  type ChartConfig,
} from '@/components/ui/chart';
import {
  AreaChart, Area,
  PieChart, Pie, Cell,
  XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid,
} from 'recharts';
import {
  Clock, BookOpen, Flame, Award,
  CheckCircle2, Trophy, Target,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import Link from 'next/link';

/* ── KPI Card ── */

function KpiCard({
  label, value, suffix = '', icon: Icon, color,
}: {
  label: string; value: number; suffix?: string;
  icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>; color: string;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ref.current) return;
    const ctx = gsap.context(() => {
      const obj = { val: 0 };
      gsap.to(obj, {
        val: value, duration: 1.6, ease: 'power2.out',
        onUpdate: () => {
          if (ref.current) {
            const v = value >= 100 ? Math.round(obj.val) : parseFloat(obj.val.toFixed(1));
            ref.current.textContent = `${v.toLocaleString()}${suffix}`;
          }
        },
      });
    });
    return () => ctx.revert();
  }, [value, suffix]);

  return (
    <div className="glass-card rounded-xl p-4 group hover:border-primary/20 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/5 transition-all duration-300">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-2">
        <p className="text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
        <div className={cn('w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center', color)}>
          <Icon className="h-4 w-4 text-white" />
        </div>
      </div>
      <span ref={ref} className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground font-mono">0{suffix}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ── Section Header ── */

function SectionHeader({ title, subtitle }: { title: string; subtitle?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-border/30">
      <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">{title}</h3>
      {subtitle && <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{subtitle}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ── Main Component ── */

const PIE_COLORS = ['oklch(0.7 0.19 45)', 'oklch(0.55 0.02 260)', 'oklch(0.65 0.2 45)', 'oklch(0.75 0.15 85)', 'oklch(0.5 0.15 145)'];

  course: string;
  progress: number;
  totalHours: number;
  completedLectures: number;
  totalLectures: number;

  date: string;
  hours: number;

  learningHours: LearningHoursDatum[];
}

export function AnalyticsContent({ collegeSlug: _collegeSlug, kpis, courseProgress, learningHours }: AnalyticsContentProps) {
  const cardsRef = useRef<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const ctx = gsap.context(() => {
      gsap.from(cardsRef.current.filter(Boolean), {
        opacity: 0, y: 30, duration: 0.6, stagger: 0.06, ease: 'power2.out', delay: 0.2,
      });
    });
    return () => ctx.revert();
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {/* Hero Strip */}
      <div className="glass-card-strong rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 bg-gradient-orange-soft">

          <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary animate-pulse" />

          {kpis.riskStatus && (
            <div className={cn(
              "ml-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border shadow-sm transition-all duration-500",
              kpis.riskStatus === 'On Track' 
                ? "bg-emerald-500/5 border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-500" 
                : "bg-rose-500/5 border-rose-500/20 text-rose-500 animate-pulse"
            )}>
              <div className={cn("w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full", kpis.riskStatus === 'On Track' ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-rose-500")} />
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider leading-none">{kpis.riskStatus}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground">Learning Analytics</h1>

            >
              Resume Learning
            </Link>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/analytics/page.tsx ---
import { requireStudent } from '@/lib/auth/require-student';
import { AnalyticsContent } from './_components/analytics-content';
import { StudentProgressService } from '@/lib/lms/analytics/services/progress';
import { Suspense } from 'react';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';

export default async function StudentAnalyticsPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string }>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug } = await params;
  const { studentId } = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);

  // Parallel fetching of real student data
  const [
    overview,
    streak,
    courseProgress,
    hoursTrend,
    riskProfile
  ] = await Promise.all([
    StudentProgressService.getOverview(studentId),
    StudentProgressService.getLearningStreak(studentId),
    StudentProgressService.getCourseCompletionSummaries(studentId),
    StudentProgressService.getLearningHoursTrend(studentId),
    StudentProgressService.getStudentRiskProfile(studentId)
  ]);

  const kpis = {
    totalHours: Math.round(overview.totalWatchSeconds / 3600 * 10) / 10,
    coursesActive: courseProgress.length,
    learningStreak: streak.activeDaysCount,
    certificates: 0, // Logic for certificates could be added later
    quizzesPassed: overview.completedLessons, // Lessons as proxy for now
    totalXP: overview.completedLessons * 100, // Simple XP calculation
    riskStatus: riskProfile.risk_status,
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <Suspense fallback={<AnalyticsSkeleton />}>
        <AnalyticsContent 
          collegeSlug={collegeSlug}
          kpis={kpis}
          courseProgress={courseProgress.map(cp => ({
            course: cp.course_title,
            progress: Math.round((Number(cp.completed_items) / Number(cp.total_items)) * 100),
            totalHours: Math.round(Number(cp.hours_invested) * 10) / 10,
            completedLectures: Number(cp.completed_items),
            totalLectures: Number(cp.total_items)
          }))}
          learningHours={hoursTrend.map(h => ({
            date: new Date(h.report_date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }),
            hours: Number(h.hours_logged)
          }))}
        />
      </Suspense>
    </div>
  );
}

function AnalyticsSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <Skeleton className="h-[200px] w-full rounded-2xl bg-white/5" />
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4">
        {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
          <Skeleton key={i} className="h-24 w-full rounded-xl bg-white/5" />
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        <Skeleton className="h-[300px] w-full rounded-xl bg-white/5" />
        <Skeleton className="h-[300px] w-full rounded-xl bg-white/5" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/assessments/[id]/attempt/attempt-client.tsx ---
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardFooter } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from '@/components/ui/radio-group';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Clock, Save, ChevronRight, ChevronLeft, Send, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import type { AttemptStateView } from '@/lib/services/assessments';
import type { AssessmentOptionRow } from '@/types/database';

type SectionWithQuestions = AttemptStateView['assessment']['sections'][number];

export function AttemptClient({ initialState, collegeSlug }: { initialState: AttemptStateView; collegeSlug: string }) {
    const router = useRouter();
    const assessment = initialState.assessment;

    const allQuestions = assessment.sections.flatMap((s: SectionWithQuestions) => s.questions);

    const [currentQIndex, setCurrentQIndex] = useState(0);
    const [, setResponses] = useState<Record<string, string | string[]>>({});
    const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState<number | null>(null);
    const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
    const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
    void setResponses;
    void setIsSaving;

    const submitFinal = useCallback(async () => {
        setIsSubmitting(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
            toast.success('Assessment Submitted Successfully!');
            router.push(`/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/student/assessments/${initialState.assignment_id}/result`);
        }, 1500);
    }, [initialState.assignment_id, collegeSlug, router]);

    const handleAutoSubmit = useCallback(async () => {
        toast.error('Time expired. Auto-submitting assessment.');
        submitFinal();
    }, [submitFinal]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!assessment.time_limit_minutes) return;

        const startTime = new Date(initialState.start_time).getTime();
        const endTime = startTime + assessment.time_limit_minutes * 60000;

        const interval = setInterval(() => {
            const now = new Date().getTime();
            const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.floor((endTime - now) / 1000));
            setTimeLeft(remaining);

            if (remaining <= 0) {
                clearInterval(interval);
                handleAutoSubmit();
            }
        }, 1000);

        return () => clearInterval(interval);
    }, [assessment.time_limit_minutes, initialState.start_time, handleAutoSubmit]);

    const formatTime = (seconds: number) => {
        const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
        const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
        const s = seconds % 60;
        return `${h > 0 ? h + ':' : ''}${m.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    };

    const activeQuestion = allQuestions[currentQIndex];

    return (
        <div className="space-y-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto pb-12">
            {/* Header / Meta */}
            <div className="bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm">
                <div>
                    <h1 className="font-bold text-lg">{assessment.title}</h1>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Question {currentQIndex + 1} of {allQuestions.length}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                    {isSaving && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center"><Save className="w-3 h-3 mr-1 animate-pulse"/> Saving...</span>}
                    {timeLeft !== null && (
                        <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-lg font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border ${timeLeft < 300 ? 'text-destructive border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 animate-pulse' : 'bg-muted'}`}>
                            <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />
                            {formatTime(timeLeft)}
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Main Question Card */}
            {activeQuestion ? (
                <Card className="min-h-[400px] flex flex-col shadow-md border-border/60">
                    <CardHeader className="bg-muted/30 border-b">
                        <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
                            <CardTitle className="leading-relaxed font-semibold text-lg max-w-[75%] sm:max-w-[85%]">{activeQuestion.text}</CardTitle>
                            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground shrink-0">{activeQuestion.points} points</span>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground pt-1 uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">
                            {activeQuestion.type.replace('_', ' ')}
                        </p>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent className="flex-1 py-8">
                        {activeQuestion.type === 'single_select' && (
                            <RadioGroup className="space-y-3">
                                {(activeQuestion.options ?? []).map((opt: AssessmentOptionRow) => (
                                    <div key={opt.id} className="flex items-center space-x-3 border p-4 rounded-lg hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer">
                                        <RadioGroupItem value={opt.id} id={opt.id} />
                                        <Label htmlFor={opt.id} className="cursor-pointer flex-1 font-normal text-base">{opt.text}</Label>
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                            </RadioGroup>
                        )}

                        {activeQuestion.type === 'multi_select' && (
                            <div className="space-y-3">
                                {(activeQuestion.options ?? []).map((opt: AssessmentOptionRow) => (
                                    <div key={opt.id} className="flex items-center space-x-3 border p-4 rounded-lg hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer">
                                        <Checkbox id={opt.id} />
                                        <Label htmlFor={opt.id} className="cursor-pointer flex-1 font-normal text-base">{opt.text}</Label>
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                        )}

                        {(activeQuestion.type === 'short_answer' || activeQuestion.type === 'subjective' || activeQuestion.type === 'coding_ready') && (
                            <Textarea 
                                placeholder="Type your answer here..." 
                                className="min-h-[200px] text-base resize-y"
                            />
                        )}
                    </CardContent>
                    <CardFooter className="flex justify-between border-t bg-muted/10 p-4">
                        <Button 
                            variant="outline" 
                            disabled={currentQIndex === 0}
                            onClick={() => setCurrentQIndex(prev => prev - 1)}
                        >
                            <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" /> Previous
                        </Button>

                        {currentQIndex === allQuestions.length - 1 ? (
                            <Button onClick={submitFinal} disabled={isSubmitting} className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
                                {isSubmitting ? 'Submitting...' : <><Send className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" /> Submit Test</>}
                            </Button>
                        ) : (
                            <Button onClick={() => setCurrentQIndex(prev => prev + 1)}>
                                Next <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />
                            </Button>
                        )}
                    </CardFooter>
                </Card>
            ) : (
                <div className="py-20 text-center">
                    <AlertCircle className="w-10 h-10 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-4" />
                    <h3 className="text-xl font-bold">No Questions Found</h3>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-2">This assessment currently has no questions configured.</p>
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/assessments/[id]/attempt/page.tsx ---
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { startAttempt, getAttemptState } from '@/lib/services/assessments';
import { AttemptClient } from './attempt-client';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export default async function AssessmentAttemptPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string; id: string }>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug, id: assessmentId } = await params;
  let attemptId = '';

  try {
    const attempt = await startAttempt(assessmentId);
    if (!attempt) redirect(`/c/${collegeSlug}/student/assessments?error=attempt`);
    attemptId = attempt.id;
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.error('[assessment-attempt] startAttempt failed', { assessmentId, error: msg });
    redirect(`/c/${collegeSlug}/student/assessments?error=attempt`);
  }

  const state = await getAttemptState(attemptId);
  if (!state) redirect(`/c/${collegeSlug}/student/assessments`);

  return <AttemptClient initialState={state} collegeSlug={collegeSlug} />;
}

import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { requireStudent } from '@/lib/auth/require-student';
import type { AssessmentResultRow } from '@/types/database';
import { ArrowLeft, CheckCircle2, XCircle, AlertCircle, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';

export default async function AssessmentResultPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string; id: string }>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug, id: assignmentId } = await params;
  
  await requireStudent(collegeSlug);
  
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const assessmentsPath = `/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/student/assessments`;

  // Fetch the assignment to ensure the student has access
  const { data: assignment } = await supabase
    .from('assessment_assignments')
    .select('*, assessment:assessments(*)')
    .eq('id', assignmentId)
    .single();

  if (!assignment) redirect(assessmentsPath);

  // Fetch the latest attempt + result
  const { data: attempt } = await supabase
    .from('assessment_attempts')
    .select('*, result:assessment_results(*)')
    .eq('assignment_id', assignmentId)
    .order('start_time', { ascending: false })
    .limit(1)
    .single();

  if (!attempt) redirect(assessmentsPath);

  const result: AssessmentResultRow | null = attempt.result && Array.isArray(attempt.result) && attempt.result.length > 0
    ? (attempt.result[0] as AssessmentResultRow)
    : null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto pb-12">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" asChild className="mb-2 -ml-3 text-muted-foreground">
            <Link href={assessmentsPath}>
              <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" /> Back to Dashboard
            </Link>
          </Button>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black tracking-tight">{assignment.assessment.title} - Results</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">Review your score and performance analytics.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {!result && attempt.status === 'in_progress' && (
         <Card className="border-warning/50 bg-warning/10 text-warning-foreground">
             <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-center py-12">
                 <RefreshCw className="h-10 w-10 animate-spin mb-4" />
                 <h2 className="text-xl font-bold">Attempt In Progress</h2>
                 <p className="text-sm mt-2 max-w-sm text-center">You have not finalized your submission yet. Please return to the attempt and submit.</p>
                 <Button asChild className="mt-6">
                    <Link href={`/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/student/assessments/${assignment.id}/attempt`}>Resume Attempt</Link>
                 </Button>
             </CardContent>
         </Card>
      )}

      {result && result.status === 'pending_manual_eval' && (
          <Card className="border-info/50 bg-info/10 text-info-foreground">
              <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-center py-12">
                  <AlertCircle className="h-10 w-10 mb-4" />
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-bold">Pending Manual Evaluation</h2>
                  <p className="text-sm mt-2 max-w-sm text-center text-muted-foreground">Your subjective answers are currently being reviewed by a mentor. Final scores will be released soon.</p>
              </CardContent>
          </Card>
      )}

      {result && (result.status === 'evaluated' || result.status === 'released') && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
              <Card className={`border-t-4 ${result.is_passing ? 'border-t-success' : 'border-t-destructive'} bg-card/60 backdrop-blur-sm shadow-md transition-all duration-300`}>
                  <CardHeader className="text-center pb-2">
                       <div className="mx-auto w-fit p-4 rounded-full bg-muted/50 mb-2">
                          {result.is_passing ? <CheckCircle2 className="w-12 h-12 text-success" /> : <XCircle className="w-12 h-12 text-destructive" />}
                       </div>
                      <CardTitle className="text-4xl font-black">
                          {result.score} <span className="text-lg text-muted-foreground font-normal">pts</span>
                      </CardTitle>
                      <CardDescription className="text-sm font-medium pt-1">
                          Passing score: {assignment.assessment.passing_score ?? 0}
                      </CardDescription>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent className="text-center pt-4">
                      <Badge variant={result.is_passing ? 'success' : 'destructive'} className="text-sm px-4 py-1.5 uppercase tracking-widest">
                          {result.is_passing ? 'Passed' : 'Failed'}
                      </Badge>
                  </CardContent>
              </Card>

              {/* Detailed Breakdown block goes here (Phase 10) */}
          </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
}

import Link from 'next/link';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { getAssignedAssessments } from '@/lib/services/assessments';
import { FileText, PlayCircle, CheckCircle, Clock } from 'lucide-react';

export default async function StudentAssessmentsPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string }>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug } = await params;
  const assignments = await getAssignedAssessments();

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-5xl mx-auto pb-12">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black tracking-tight">My Assessments</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">Complete your assigned quizzes, coding tests, and subjective evaluations.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <FileText className="h-5 w-5" /> Assigned to You ({assignments.length})
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {assignments.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-12 bg-card/50 rounded-xl border-dashed border-2">
               <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">You have no pending assessments at this time.</p>
               <CheckCircle className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground mx-auto opacity-50" />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <ul className="space-y-4">
              {assignments.map((assignment) => {
                  const hasAttempts = assignment.attempts?.length > 0;
                  const latestAttempt = hasAttempts ? assignment.attempts[assignment.attempts.length - 1] : null;
                  const isCompleted = latestAttempt?.status === 'submitted' || latestAttempt?.status === 'time_expired' || latestAttempt?.status === 'auto_submitted';
                  const isInProgress = latestAttempt?.status === 'in_progress';
                  const attemptsCount = assignment.attempts?.length || 0;
                  const maxAttempts = assignment.assessment.max_attempts;
                  const canAttempt = attemptsCount < maxAttempts;

                  return (
                    <li key={assignment.id}>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-xl border p-5 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300">
                        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap mb-1.5">
                            <h3 className="font-bold text-foreground truncate text-lg">
                                {assignment.assessment.title}
                            </h3>
                            {isCompleted ? (
                                <Badge variant="success"><CheckCircle className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" /> Completed</Badge>
                            ) : isInProgress ? (
                                <Badge variant="default" className="bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700">In Progress</Badge>
                            ) : (
                                <Badge variant="secondary">Pending</Badge>
                            )}
                            {assignment.assessment.time_limit_minutes && (
                                <Badge variant="outline" className="shrink-0 text-muted-foreground">
                                    <Clock className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" /> {assignment.assessment.time_limit_minutes}m limit
                                </Badge>
                            )}
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground truncate">{assignment.assessment.description || 'No description provided'}</p>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mt-3 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground bg-muted/30 w-fit px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md">
                            <span>Attempts used: {attemptsCount} / {maxAttempts}</span>
                            {assignment.due_date && <span>• Due: {new Date(assignment.due_date).toLocaleDateString()}</span>}
                        </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 shrink-0">
                            {isCompleted ? (
                                <Button variant="outline" size="sm" asChild>
                                    <Link href={`/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/student/assessments/${assignment.id}/result`}>
                                        View Results
                                    </Link>
                                </Button>
                            ) : (
                                <Button size="sm" asChild disabled={!canAttempt && !isInProgress}>
                                    <Link href={`/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/student/assessments/${assignment.id}/attempt`}>
                                        <PlayCircle className="h-4 w-4 mr-1.5" /> 
                                        {isInProgress ? 'Resume Attempt' : 'Start Assessment'}
                                    </Link>
                                </Button>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    </li>
                  )
              })}
            </ul>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useLayoutEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { LastViewedProvider } from '@/contexts/last-viewed';
import { Sidebar, MobileSidebar } from '@/components/sidebar';
import { Header } from '@/components/header';
import { Breadcrumbs } from '@/components/shared/breadcrumbs';
import { TooltipProvider } from '@/components/ui/tooltip';
import { SidebarProvider, SidebarInset, SidebarTrigger } from '@/components/ui/sidebar';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import type { MasterCoursePillarsRow } from '@/types/database';

/** Course library listing and …/courses/[courseId]. */
function isStudentCoursesRoute(pathname: string | null): boolean {
  return /^\/c\/[^/]+\/student\/courses(?:\/|$)/.test(pathname ?? '');
}

/** Full-bleed YouTube theater (no padded main chrome). */
function isStudentYouTubeWatchRoute(pathname: string | null): boolean {
  return /^\/c\/[^/]+\/student\/courses\/youtube\/[^/?#]+$/.test(pathname ?? '');
}

/** In-player learn flow: …/learn/[courseId] and nested lesson URLs. */
function isStudentLearnRoute(pathname: string | null): boolean {
  return /^\/c\/[^/]+\/student\/learn(?:\/|$)/.test(pathname ?? '');
}

function shouldCollapseSidebarForCoursePages(pathname: string | null): boolean {
  return isStudentCoursesRoute(pathname) || isStudentLearnRoute(pathname);
}

export function AuthenticatedClientLayout({
    children,
    tenantName,
    visiblePillars = [],
}: {
    children: React.ReactNode;
    tenantName?: string;
    visiblePillars?: MasterCoursePillarsRow[];
}) {
    const pathname = usePathname();
    const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useState(false);
    const [sidebarOpen, setSidebarOpen] = useState(true);
    const onCoursesSection = isStudentCoursesRoute(pathname);
    const youtubeWatch = isStudentYouTubeWatchRoute(pathname);

    useLayoutEffect(() => {
      const collapsed = shouldCollapseSidebarForCoursePages(pathname);
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        setSidebarOpen(collapsed ? false : true);
      });
    }, [pathname]);

    const hideSidebar = pathname.includes('/student/courses/') && pathname.includes('/lectures/');
    const backHref = hideSidebar
        ? pathname.replace(/\/lectures\/[^/]+$/, '')
        : '';

    return (
        <TooltipProvider>
            <LastViewedProvider>
                <SidebarProvider open={sidebarOpen} onOpenChange={setSidebarOpen}>
                    {!hideSidebar && (
                        <>
                            <Sidebar tenantName={tenantName} visiblePillars={visiblePillars} />
                            <MobileSidebar open={mobileOpen} onOpenChange={setMobileOpen} tenantName={tenantName} visiblePillars={visiblePillars} />
                        </>
                    )}
                    <SidebarInset className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <div className="flex flex-col min-h-screen">
                            {!hideSidebar && (
                                <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 flex h-16 items-center gap-4 border-b border-border/40 bg-background/70 backdrop-blur-2xl px-4 lg:px-8">
                                    <SidebarTrigger className="lg:hidden" />
                                    <div className="flex-1">
                                        <Header
                                            onMobileMenuOpen={() => setMobileOpen(true)}
                                            sidebarOpen={false}
                                            onSidebarToggle={() => {}}
                                            hideControls={hideSidebar}
                                            backHref={backHref}
                                            tenantName={tenantName}
                                        />
                                    </div>
                                </header>
                            )}
                            <main
                                className={cn(
                                    'flex-1',
                                    youtubeWatch
                                        ? 'flex min-h-0 flex-col overflow-hidden p-0'
                                        : 'overflow-y-auto',
                                    hideSidebar
                                        ? 'bg-gradient-to-b from-background via-primary/[0.035] to-muted/50 p-0 dark:via-primary/[0.06] dark:to-background'
                                        : youtubeWatch
                                          ? 'bg-background'
                                          : onCoursesSection
                                            ? 'px-4 py-8 sm:px-6 sm:py-10 lg:px-10 lg:py-12'
                                            : 'p-4 lg:p-6'
                                )}
                            >
                                {!hideSidebar && !youtubeWatch && (
                                  <div className={cn(
                                    "mb-4",
                                    onCoursesSection ? "" : "px-0"
                                  )}>
                                    <Breadcrumbs />
                                  </div>
                                )}
                                {children}
                            </main>
                        </div>
                    </SidebarInset>
                </SidebarProvider>
            </LastViewedProvider>
        </TooltipProvider>
    );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/courses/[courseId]/page.tsx ---
import { notFound, redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { requireStudent } from '@/lib/auth/require-student';
import { createAdminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

export default async function LegacyCourseDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string; courseId: string }>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug, courseId } = await params;
  await requireStudent(collegeSlug);

  const sb = createAdminClient();

  const { data: course } = await sb
    .from('master_courses')
    .select('pillar_id')
    .eq('id', courseId)
    .single();

  if (!course?.pillar_id) {
    notFound();
  }

  const { data: pillar } = await sb
    .from('master_course_pillars')
    .select('slug')
    .eq('id', course.pillar_id)
    .single();

  if (!pillar) {
    notFound();
  }

  // Redirect to the new pillar-based course detail route
  redirect(`/c/${collegeSlug}/student/pillars/${pillar.slug}/courses/${courseId}`);
}

'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Lock, ChevronRight, BookOpen, Video, PlayCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import type { GlobalDiscoverableCourse } from '@/lib/services/global-courses';

interface GlobalCourseCardProps {
  course: GlobalDiscoverableCourse;
  collegeSlug: string;
}

export function GlobalCourseCard({ course, collegeSlug }: GlobalCourseCardProps) {
  const primaryHref = course.entitled
    ? `/c/${collegeSlug}/student/learn/${course.id}`
    : `/c/${collegeSlug}/student/courses/${course.id}`;

  return (
    <Card className="group border-border/50 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm">
      <CardContent className="p-6 space-y-5">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-2 min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold truncate">{course.title}</h3>
              <Badge variant={course.entitled ? 'success' : 'secondary'}>
                {course.entitled ? 'Access granted' : 'Locked'}
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{course.code}</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground line-clamp-3">
              {course.short_description || course.description || 'No description available.'}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-primary/10 text-primary">
            {course.entitled ? <PlayCircle className="h-6 w-6" /> : <Lock className="h-5 w-5" />}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <BookOpen className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary/70" />
            <span>{course.module_count} Modules</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Video className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary/70" />
            <span>{course.video_count} Lessons</span>
          </div>
          {course.entitled && course.progress_percentage !== null && (
            <Badge variant="outline">{course.progress_percentage}% complete</Badge>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          {!course.entitled && (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Visibility is not enrollment.</p>
          )}
          <Button asChild className="ml-auto rounded-full">
            <Link href={primaryHref}>
              {course.entitled ? 'Continue' : 'View details'}
              <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />
            </Link>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/courses/_components/global-courses-grid.tsx ---
'use client';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Separator } from '@/components/ui/separator';
import { Search, Layers } from 'lucide-react';
import type { GlobalDiscoverablePillarGroup } from '@/lib/services/global-courses';
import { GlobalCourseCard } from './global-course-card';

interface GlobalCoursesGridProps {
  pillarGroups: GlobalDiscoverablePillarGroup[];
  collegeSlug: string;
}

export function GlobalCoursesGrid({ pillarGroups, collegeSlug }: GlobalCoursesGridProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');

  const filteredGroups = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return pillarGroups;

    return pillarGroups
      .map((group) => ({
        ...group,
        courses: group.courses.filter((course) =>
          course.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          course.code.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (course.description?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ?? false) ||
          (course.short_description?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ?? false)
        ),
      }))
      .filter((group) => group.courses.length > 0);
  }, [pillarGroups, query]);

  const totalCourses = filteredGroups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.courses.length, 0);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-10">
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-4">
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="absolute left-4 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input
            value={query}
            onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search global courses..."
            className="pl-11 h-12 rounded-xl"
          />
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
          {totalCourses} courses available
        </p>
      </div>

      {filteredGroups.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="border-dashed">
          <CardContent className="py-16 text-center space-y-2">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold">No courses are available right now.</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Try a different search term later.</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-12">
          {filteredGroups.map((group, index) => (
            <section key={group.pillar.id} className="space-y-5">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <div className="mt-0.5 flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-primary/10 text-primary">
                  <Layers className="h-5 w-5" />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-bold">{group.pillar.title}</h2>
                  {(group.pillar.short_description || group.pillar.description) && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      {group.pillar.short_description || group.pillar.description}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                {group.courses.map((course) => (
                  <GlobalCourseCard key={course.id} course={course} collegeSlug={collegeSlug} />
                ))}
              </div>

              {index < filteredGroups.length - 1 && <Separator />}
            </section>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/courses/youtube/[playlistId]/page.tsx ---
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';

import { YouTubePlaylistPlayer } from '@/components/student/youtube-playlist-player';
import { getYouTubeCoursesCatalog } from '@/lib/actions/youtube';
import { requireStudent } from '@/lib/auth/require-student';

export default async function YouTubePlaylistWatchPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string; playlistId: string }>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug, playlistId: playlistParam } = await params;
  await requireStudent(collegeSlug);

  const playlistId = decodeURIComponent(playlistParam);
  const catalog = await getYouTubeCoursesCatalog();
  const course = catalog.find((c) => c.playlistId === playlistId);
  if (!course) notFound();

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col">
      <YouTubePlaylistPlayer
        key={course.playlistId}
        collegeSlug={collegeSlug}
        playlistId={course.playlistId}
        initialTitle={course.title}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

export default function StudentError({
  error,
  reset,
}: {
  error: Error & { digest?: string };
  reset: () => void;
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    console.error('[error]', error.message || error.digest || 'Unknown error');
  }, [error]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[200px] gap-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/20 p-8">
      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-destructive">Something went wrong.</p>
      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={reset}>
        Try again
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/layout.tsx ---
import { requireStudent } from '@/lib/auth/require-student';
import { getStudentModuleAccess } from '@/lib/modules/get-student-module-access.server';
import { listVisiblePillarsForStudent } from '@/lib/services/student-courses';
import { StudentAuthProvider } from '@/providers/student-auth-provider';
import { AuthenticatedClientLayout } from './client-layout';
import { StudentModuleProvider } from './student-module-provider';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

/**
 * Authenticated layout - runs AFTER auth is confirmed.
 * 
 * PERFORMANCE: Module access is fetched here, not in the shared layout.
 * This avoids unnecessary DB queries for public pages (login, forgot-password).
 */
export default async function StudentAuthenticatedLayout({
  children,
  params,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string }>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug } = await params;
  const { user, tenant } = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);
  
  const [studentModuleAccess, visiblePillars] = await Promise.all([
    getStudentModuleAccess(tenant.id),
    listVisiblePillarsForStudent(collegeSlug)
  ]);
  
  return (
    <StudentAuthProvider
      initialUser={{
        id: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        fullName: user.fullName,
        isActive: user.isActive,
      }}
    >
      <StudentModuleProvider initialModuleAccess={studentModuleAccess}>
        <AuthenticatedClientLayout tenantName={tenant.name} visiblePillars={visiblePillars}>
          {children}
        </AuthenticatedClientLayout>
      </StudentModuleProvider>
    </StudentAuthProvider>
  );
}
