import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import { requireStudent } from '@/lib/auth/require-student';
import { getStudentCourseDetail } from '@/lib/services/student-courses';

interface LearnCourseLayoutProps {
  params: Promise<{
    collegeSlug: string;
    courseId: string;
  }>;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Shared Learning Layout for a Course.
 * Handles auth and course-level data fetching with new hierarchy visibility.
 */
export default async function LearnCourseLayout({ params, children }: LearnCourseLayoutProps) {
  const { collegeSlug, courseId } = await params;

  // 1. Auth & Context
  await requireStudent(collegeSlug);

  // 2. Fetch Course Data (enforces entitlement + pillar/course visibility)
  const course = await getStudentCourseDetail(collegeSlug, courseId);
  if (!course) {
    notFound();
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-col h-[calc(100vh-64px)] overflow-hidden">
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

--- END FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/learn/[courseId]/layout.tsx ---

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/learn/[courseId]/learn-client.tsx ---
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Circle, 
  FileText, 
  ChevronRight, 
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronLeft,
  Video,
  StickyNote,
  Loader2,
  Scroll,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle,
  ArrowRight,
  Search,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { TpStreamsPlayer, TpStreamsPlayerRef } from '@/components/student/tpstreams-player';
import { NonVideoLessonRenderer } from '@/components/student/non-video-lesson-renderer';
import { LessonEngagementPanel } from '@/components/student/lesson-engagement-panel';
import { CoursePlayerPlaylistShell } from '@/components/student/course-player-playlist-shell';
import { getPlaybackTokenAction } from '@/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/learn/playback-actions';
import { getResumePositionAction, syncProgressAction } from '@/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/learn/progress-actions';
import type { CourseForStudent, PlaybackTokenResult } from '@/types/student-runtime';
import type { LessonResourcesRow, MasterCourseItemsRow, StudentLessonNotesRow, StudentLessonBookmarksRow } from '@/types/database';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

interface LearnCourseClientProps {
  course: CourseForStudent;
  collegeSlug: string;
  studentId: string;
  activeItemId: string;
  lessonResources?: LessonResourcesRow[];
  lessonNote?: StudentLessonNotesRow | null;
  lessonBookmarks?: StudentLessonBookmarksRow[];
}

export function LearnCourseClient({ 
  course, 
  collegeSlug, 
  studentId, 
  activeItemId,
  lessonResources = [],
  lessonNote = null,
  lessonBookmarks = []
}: LearnCourseClientProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  
  // Refs
  const playerRef = useRef<TpStreamsPlayerRef>(null);

  // State
  const [activePlaybackToken, setActivePlaybackToken] = useState<PlaybackTokenResult | null>(null);
  const [resumePosition, setResumePosition] = useState<number>(0);
  const [expandedModules, setExpandedModules] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [completedItems, setCompletedItems] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [markingComplete, setMarkingComplete] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [videoStatus, setVideoStatus] = useState<'loading' | 'ready' | 'processing' | 'error'>('loading');
  /** Specific message from token action or missing asset (shown under Access Interrupted). */
  const [playbackErrorDetail, setPlaybackErrorDetail] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState<number>(0);
  const [playlistOpen, setPlaylistOpen] = useState(false);
  const [playlistSearch, setPlaylistSearch] = useState('');

  // Derive active item from ID
  const activeItem = useMemo(() => {
    for (const mod of course.modules) {
      const item = mod.items.find(i => i.id === activeItemId);
      if (item) return item;
    }
    return null;
  }, [course.modules, activeItemId]);

  // Derive all items for navigation
  const allItems = useMemo(() => {
    return course.modules.flatMap(m => m.items);
  }, [course.modules]);

  const currentIndex = useMemo(() => {
    return allItems.findIndex(i => i.id === activeItemId);
  }, [allItems, activeItemId]);

  const prevItem = currentIndex > 0 ? allItems[currentIndex - 1] : null;
  const nextItem = currentIndex < allItems.length - 1 ? allItems[currentIndex + 1] : null;

  // Initialize: expand module containing active item, and prepopulate completed items
  useEffect(() => {
    const completed = new Set<string>();
    course.modules.forEach(mod => {
      mod.items.forEach(item => {
        if (item.progress?.completed) {
          completed.add(item.id);
        }
        if (item.id === activeItemId) {
          setExpandedModules(prev => ({ ...prev, [mod.id]: true }));
        }
      });
    });
    setCompletedItems(completed);
  }, [course.id, activeItemId, course.modules]);

  // Handle Playback Token Loading
  const loadPlayback = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!activeItem) return;
    
    // Only fetch playback tokens for video items
    if (activeItem.item_type !== 'video') {
      setVideoStatus('ready');
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setActivePlaybackToken(null);
    setPlaybackErrorDetail(null);
    setVideoStatus('loading');

    try {
      if (!activeItem.video_asset_id) {
        setVideoStatus('error');
        setPlaybackErrorDetail(
          'This lesson has no video linked. Ask your administrator to attach a video asset to this lesson.',
        );
        return;
      }

      const [tokenRes, resumeRes] = await Promise.all([
        getPlaybackTokenAction(collegeSlug, activeItem.video_asset_id),
        getResumePositionAction(collegeSlug, course.id, activeItem.id),
      ]);

      if (tokenRes.success && tokenRes.data) {
        setActivePlaybackToken(tokenRes.data);
        setVideoStatus('ready');
      } else {
        setVideoStatus('error');
        setPlaybackErrorDetail(
          tokenRes.error ??
            'We could not start playback. Verify LMS TPStreams configuration (TP_STREAMS_ORG_ID, API token) and that the video exists in TPStreams.',
        );
      }

      if (resumeRes.success && resumeRes.positionSeconds) {
        setResumePosition(resumeRes.positionSeconds);
      } else {
        setResumePosition(0);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Learn] Error loading playback:', err);
      setVideoStatus('error');
      setPlaybackErrorDetail('Failed to generate playback token. Check server logs and TPStreams connectivity.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [activeItem, collegeSlug, course.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadPlayback();
  }, [loadPlayback]);

  const handleItemSelect = (itemId: string) => {
    router.push(`/c/${collegeSlug}/student/learn/${course.id}/lessons/${itemId}`);
    setPlaylistOpen(false);
  };

  const handleMarkComplete = async () => {
    if (!activeItem || markingComplete) return;
    setMarkingComplete(true);
    try {
      // For non-video items, we use a dummy 100/100 to trigger completion threshold
      const res = await syncProgressAction(
        collegeSlug,
        course.id,
        activeItem.id,
        0, 
        100, 
        100,
      );
      if (res.success) {
        setCompletedItems(prev => new Set(prev).add(activeItem.id));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Learn] Error marking complete:', err);
    } finally {
      setMarkingComplete(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleModule = (moduleId: string) => {
    setExpandedModules(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [moduleId]: !prev[moduleId]
    }));
  };

  const calculateOverallProgress = useMemo(() => {
    let totalItems = 0;
    course.modules.forEach(m => totalItems += m.items.length);
    if (totalItems === 0) return 0;
    return Math.round((completedItems.size / totalItems) * 100);
  }, [course.modules, completedItems]);

  const getItemIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'video': return <Video className="h-4 w-4" />;
      case 'document': return <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />;
      case 'note': return <StickyNote className="h-4 w-4" />;
      case 'worksheet': return <Scroll className="h-4 w-4" />;
      default: return <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />;
    }
  };

  const visibleModules = useMemo(
    () => course.modules.filter((m) => m.visible_to_students !== false),
    [course.modules],
  );

  const totalLessonCount = useMemo(
    () => visibleModules.reduce((acc, m) => acc + m.items.length, 0),
    [visibleModules],
  );

  const playlistSections = useMemo(() => {
    const norm = playlistSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!norm.length) {
      return visibleModules.map((mod) => ({ module: mod, items: mod.items }));
    }
    return visibleModules
      .map((mod) => {
        const moduleMatches = mod.title.toLowerCase().includes(norm);
        const items = moduleMatches ? mod.items : mod.items.filter((i) => i.title.toLowerCase().includes(norm));
        if (!items.length) return null;
        return { module: mod, items };
      })
      .filter((block): block is NonNullable<typeof block> => block !== null);
  }, [visibleModules, playlistSearch]);

  const searchResultCount = useMemo(
    () => playlistSections.reduce((n, b) => n + b.items.length, 0),
    [playlistSections],
  );

  const renderLessonRow = (item: (typeof allItems)[number]) => {
    const isActive = activeItemId === item.id;
    const isCompleted = completedItems.has(item.id);
    return (
      <button
        key={item.id}
        type="button"
        onClick={() => handleItemSelect(item.id)}
        className={cn(
          'flex w-full items-start gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-[13px] transition-all',
          isActive
            ? 'bg-primary/12 font-medium text-primary ring-2 ring-primary/25 shadow-sm'
            : 'text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted/70 hover:text-foreground',
        )}
      >
        {isCompleted ? (
          <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-500" aria-hidden />
        ) : (
          <Circle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 opacity-40" aria-hidden />
        )}
        <span className="line-clamp-3 min-w-0 flex-1 leading-snug">{item.title}</span>
        <span className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground [&_svg]:h-4 [&_svg]:w-4">
          {getItemIcon(item.item_type)}
        </span>
      </button>
    );
  };

  const playlistPanelContent =
    playlistSections.length === 0 ? (
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-border/70 bg-muted/20 px-4 py-14 text-center">
        <Search className="mx-auto mb-3 h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground/45" aria-hidden />
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">No lessons match</p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Try a different word or clear the search.</p>
        <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" className="mt-4 rounded-full" onClick={() => setPlaylistSearch('')}>
          Clear search
        </Button>
      </div>
    ) : playlistSearch.trim() ? (
      <div className="space-y-5">
        {playlistSections.map(({ module: mod, items }) => (
          <div key={mod.id}>
            <p className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 truncate px-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted-foreground">
              <span className="h-px flex-1 bg-border/80" aria-hidden />
              <span className="max-w-[90%] shrink-0 truncate">{mod.title}</span>
              <span className="h-px flex-1 bg-border/80" aria-hidden />
            </p>
            <div className="space-y-1 rounded-2xl border border-border/40 bg-muted/15 p-2">{items.map((item) => renderLessonRow(item))}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    ) : (
      <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
        {playlistSections.map(({ module: mod, items }) => (
          <div key={mod.id} className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border/50 bg-card/80 shadow-sm">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => toggleModule(mod.id)}
              className={cn(
                'flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-3 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-muted/50',
                expandedModules[mod.id] && 'border-b border-border/40 bg-muted/25',
              )}
            >
              {expandedModules[mod.id] ? (
                <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
              ) : (
                <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
              )}
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm font-semibold leading-snug">{mod.title}</span>
              <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full bg-muted/80 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                {items.length}
              </span>
            </button>
            {expandedModules[mod.id] ? (
              <div className="space-y-1 p-2 pt-1">{items.map((item) => renderLessonRow(item))}</div>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );

  return (
    <CoursePlayerPlaylistShell
      headerCenterTitle={activeItem?.title ?? '\u00a0'}
      sheetTitle="Course playlist"
      sheetSubtitle={course.title}
      totalLessonCount={totalLessonCount}
      overallProgressPercent={calculateOverallProgress}
      playlistOpen={playlistOpen}
      onPlaylistOpenChange={setPlaylistOpen}
      playlistSearch={playlistSearch}
      onPlaylistSearchChange={setPlaylistSearch}
      searchPlaceholder="Search lessons or modules..."
      searchResultSummary={
        playlistSearch.trim() ? (
          <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            Showing {searchResultCount} {searchResultCount === 1 ? 'lesson' : 'lessons'}
          </p>
        ) : null
      }
      playlistScrollChildren={playlistPanelContent}
      mainChildren={
        <>
          {loading ? (
            <div className="flex min-h-[50vh] w-full flex-col items-center justify-center px-10" role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-live="polite">
              <div className="relative h-12 w-12">
                <Loader2 className="h-12 w-12 animate-spin text-primary/30" aria-hidden />
                <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <Video className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" aria-hidden />
                </div>
              </div>
              <span className="sr-only">Loading lesson</span>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {!loading && activeItem && (
            <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl space-y-6 px-4 pb-28 pt-4 md:px-6 md:pb-24 md:pt-6">
              {/* Lesson meta + compact title */}
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="rounded-full bg-primary/10 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-primary ring-1 ring-primary/20">
                    {activeItem.item_type}
                  </div>
                  {completedItems.has(activeItem.id) ? (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-green-600">
                      <CheckCircle className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                      Completed
                    </div>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
                <h1 className="line-clamp-3 text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground md:text-2xl md:leading-snug">{activeItem.title}</h1>
                {activeItem.description ? (
                  <p className="max-w-3xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground md:text-base">{activeItem.description}</p>
                ) : null}
              </div>

              {/* Player / Content Surface */}
              <div className={cn(
                'transition-all duration-500',
                activeItem.item_type === 'video' ? 'overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border/50 bg-card shadow-xl ring-1 ring-black/5' : '',
              )}>
                {activeItem.item_type === 'video' ? (
                  videoStatus === 'ready' && activePlaybackToken ? (
                    <TpStreamsPlayer
                      ref={playerRef}
                      collegeSlug={collegeSlug}
                      studentId={studentId}
                      courseId={course.id}
                      itemId={activeItem.id}
                      videoAssetId={activePlaybackToken.videoAssetId}
                      contentProtectionType={activePlaybackToken.contentProtectionType}
                      embedUrl={activePlaybackToken.embedUrl}
                      initialPosition={resumePosition}
                      onComplete={() => setCompletedItems(prev => new Set(prev).add(activeItem.id))}
                      onRefresh={loadPlayback}
                      onTimeUpdate={setCurrentTime}
                      className="rounded-none border-0 shadow-none"
                    />
                  ) : videoStatus === 'processing' ? (
                    <div className="aspect-video flex items-center justify-center bg-zinc-950">
                      <div className="text-center space-y-6 px-10">
                        <div className="h-20 w-20 mx-auto rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center">
                          <Loader2 className="h-10 w-10 text-primary animate-spin" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="space-y-2">
                          <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Encoding Lesson...</h3>
                          <p className="text-zinc-400 max-w-sm">Our servers are optimizing this video for your connection. This usually takes a few minutes.</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : videoStatus === 'error' ? (
                    <div className="aspect-video flex items-center justify-center bg-destructive/5 text-destructive rounded-none">
                      <div className="text-center space-y-6 px-10">
                        <div className="h-20 w-20 mx-auto rounded-full bg-destructive/10 flex items-center justify-center">
                          <AlertCircle className="h-10 w-10" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="space-y-2">
                          <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold">Access Interrupted</h3>
                          <p className="text-sm opacity-80 max-w-md mx-auto">
                            {playbackErrorDetail ??
                              "We couldn't verify your playback session. Please try refreshing or check your internet connection."}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <Button onClick={loadPlayback} variant="destructive" className="rounded-full px-8 h-12 font-bold shadow-lg shadow-destructive/20">
                          Try Again
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="aspect-video flex items-center justify-center bg-zinc-950">
                      <Loader2 className="h-12 w-12 text-primary/40 animate-spin" />
                    </div>
                  )
                ) : (
                  <NonVideoLessonRenderer item={activeItem as unknown as MasterCourseItemsRow} />
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Lesson engagement — below player, full width */}
              <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border/50 bg-card shadow-sm">
                <LessonEngagementPanel
                  collegeSlug={collegeSlug}
                  courseId={course.id}
                  itemId={activeItemId}
                  resources={lessonResources}
                  note={lessonNote}
                  bookmarks={lessonBookmarks}
                  currentTime={currentTime}
                  onSeek={(s) => playerRef.current?.seekTo(s)}
                  isVideoLesson={activeItem?.item_type === 'video'}
                  className="max-h-none border-0"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Completion Celebration / Next Lesson UI */}
              {completedItems.has(activeItem.id) && nextItem && (
                <div className="animate-in fade-in zoom-in duration-500">
                  <div className="p-8 rounded-[2rem] bg-gradient-to-r from-green-500/10 to-emerald-500/10 border border-green-500/20 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-6">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-6 text-center md:text-left">
                      <div className="h-16 w-16 rounded-2xl bg-green-500 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xl shadow-green-500/30 shrink-0">
                        <CheckCircle2 className="h-8 w-8 text-white" />
                      </div>
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <h4 className="text-xl font-bold text-green-900">Lesson Mastered!</h4>
                        <p className="text-green-800/60 font-medium">Ready to dive into the next topic?</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <Button 
                      onClick={() => handleItemSelect(nextItem.id)}
                      className="bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 text-white rounded-2xl h-14 px-8 font-bold gap-3 shadow-lg shadow-green-600/20 w-full md:w-auto"
                    >
                      Continue to Next Lesson
                      <ArrowRight className="h-5 w-5" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Navigation Controls */}
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-between gap-6 border-t border-border/60 pt-8 md:flex-row">
                <Button 
                  variant="ghost" 
                  disabled={!prevItem}
                  onClick={() => prevItem && handleItemSelect(prevItem.id)}
                  className="w-full md:w-auto gap-3 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground h-14 rounded-2xl px-8 font-bold transition-all"
                >
                  <ChevronLeft className="h-5 w-5" />
                  Back
                </Button>
                <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center gap-4 w-full md:w-auto">
                  <Button 
                    variant="secondary" 
                    onClick={handleMarkComplete}
                    disabled={markingComplete || completedItems.has(activeItem.id)}
                    className={cn(
                      "w-full md:w-auto gap-3 rounded-2xl px-8 h-14 font-bold transition-all border-2",
                      completedItems.has(activeItem.id) 
                        ? "bg-green-50 text-green-600 border-green-200" 
                        : "hover:bg-green-50 hover:text-green-600 border-transparent hover:border-green-100"
                    )}
                  >
                    {markingComplete ? (
                      <Loader2 className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin" />
                    ) : completedItems.has(activeItem.id) ? (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5" />
                    ) : (
                      <Circle className="h-5 w-5 opacity-40" />
                    )}
                    {completedItems.has(activeItem.id) ? "Completed" : "Mark as Complete"}
                  </Button>
                  <Button 
                    disabled={!nextItem}
                    onClick={() => nextItem && handleItemSelect(nextItem.id)}
                    className="w-full md:w-auto gap-4 bg-gradient-orange shadow-2xl shadow-primary/30 h-14 rounded-2xl px-10 font-black text-lg hover:scale-[1.03] active:scale-[0.97] transition-all"
                  >
                    Next Lesson
                    <ChevronRight className="h-6 w-6" />
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {!activeItem && !loading && (
            <div className="flex flex-col h-full items-center justify-center text-center p-10 gap-6">
              <div className="h-20 w-20 rounded-full bg-muted flex items-center justify-center">
                <AlertCircle className="h-10 w-10 text-muted-foreground" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold">Lesson Unavailable</h3>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground max-w-xs">The lesson you are looking for might have been moved or you don&apos;t have access to it.</p>
              </div>
              <Button onClick={() => router.push(`/c/${collegeSlug}/student/dashboard`)} variant="outline" className="rounded-full">
                Return to Dashboard
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      }
    />
  );
}

'use server';

/**
 * Server actions for student engagement (Phase 7B).
 * Handles notes and bookmarks.
 */

import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { requireStudent } from '@/lib/auth/require-student';
import { 
  upsertLessonNote, 
  deleteLessonNote, 
  createLessonBookmark, 
  deleteLessonBookmark 
} from '@/lib/services/student-engagement';

// ─── Schemas ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const saveNoteSchema = z.object({
  collegeSlug: z.string(),
  courseId: z.string().uuid(),
  itemId: z.string().uuid(),
  body: z.string().max(10000, 'Note cannot exceed 10,000 characters'),
});

const deleteNoteSchema = z.object({
  collegeSlug: z.string(),
  courseId: z.string().uuid(),
  itemId: z.string().uuid(),
});

const createBookmarkSchema = z.object({
  collegeSlug: z.string(),
  courseId: z.string().uuid(),
  itemId: z.string().uuid(),
  timestampSeconds: z.number().nullable(),
  label: z.string().min(1, 'Label is required').max(100, 'Label too long'),
});

const deleteBookmarkSchema = z.object({
  collegeSlug: z.string(),
  bookmarkId: z.string().uuid(),
});

// ─── Actions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function saveLessonNoteAction(formData: z.infer<typeof saveNoteSchema>) {
  try {
    const validated = saveNoteSchema.parse(formData);
    const { studentId, isGlobal, tenant } = await requireStudent(validated.collegeSlug);

    const result = await upsertLessonNote(
      studentId,
      validated.courseId,
      validated.itemId,
      validated.body,
      isGlobal,
      isGlobal ? null : tenant.id,
    );

    if (result.success) {
      revalidatePath(`/c/${validated.collegeSlug}/student/learn/${validated.courseId}/lessons/${validated.itemId}`);
    }

    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[EngagementAction] saveLessonNoteAction error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to save note' };
  }
}

export async function deleteLessonNoteAction(formData: z.infer<typeof deleteNoteSchema>) {
  try {
    const validated = deleteNoteSchema.parse(formData);
    const { studentId, isGlobal, tenant } = await requireStudent(validated.collegeSlug);

    const result = await deleteLessonNote(
      studentId,
      validated.courseId,
      validated.itemId,
      isGlobal,
      isGlobal ? null : tenant.id,
    );

    if (result.success) {
      // Note: courseId not in schema but we might need it for revalidatePath
      // For now we just use a generic revalidate if possible or the user provides it.
      // But typically we stay on the same page.
    }

    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[EngagementAction] deleteLessonNoteAction error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to delete note' };
  }
}

export async function createBookmarkAction(formData: z.infer<typeof createBookmarkSchema>) {
  try {
    const validated = createBookmarkSchema.parse(formData);
    const { studentId, isGlobal, tenant } = await requireStudent(validated.collegeSlug);

    const result = await createLessonBookmark(
      studentId,
      validated.courseId,
      validated.itemId,
      validated.timestampSeconds,
      validated.label,
      isGlobal,
      isGlobal ? null : tenant.id,
    );

    if (result.success) {
      revalidatePath(`/c/${validated.collegeSlug}/student/learn/${validated.courseId}/lessons/${validated.itemId}`);
    }

    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[EngagementAction] createBookmarkAction error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to create bookmark' };
  }
}

export async function deleteBookmarkAction(formData: z.infer<typeof deleteBookmarkSchema>, courseId: string, itemId: string) {
  try {
    const validated = deleteBookmarkSchema.parse(formData);
    const { studentId, isGlobal, tenant } = await requireStudent(validated.collegeSlug);

    const result = await deleteLessonBookmark(
      studentId,
      validated.bookmarkId,
      isGlobal,
      isGlobal ? null : tenant.id,
    );

    if (result.success) {
      revalidatePath(`/c/${validated.collegeSlug}/student/learn/${courseId}/lessons/${itemId}`);
    }

    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[EngagementAction] deleteBookmarkAction error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to delete bookmark' };
  }
}

import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import { requireStudent } from '@/lib/auth/require-student';
import { getStudentCourseDetail } from '@/lib/services/student-courses';
import { listLessonResources } from '@/lib/services/student-resources';
import { getLessonNote, listLessonBookmarks } from '@/lib/services/student-engagement';
import { LearnCourseClient } from '../../learn-client';

interface LessonPageProps {
  params: Promise<{
    collegeSlug: string;
    courseId: string;
    itemId: string;
  }>;
}

/**
 * Specific Lesson Page.
 * Renders the course learning interface with the active item.
 */
export default async function LessonPage({ params }: LessonPageProps) {
  const { collegeSlug, courseId, itemId } = await params;

  // 1. Auth & Context
  const { studentId, isGlobal, tenant } = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);
  const collegeId = isGlobal ? null : tenant.id;

  // 2. Fetch All Data (Parallel)
  const [course, resources, note, bookmarks] = await Promise.all([
    getStudentCourseDetail(collegeSlug, courseId),
    listLessonResources(studentId, courseId, itemId, isGlobal, collegeId),
    getLessonNote(studentId, courseId, itemId, isGlobal, collegeId),
    listLessonBookmarks(studentId, courseId, itemId, isGlobal, collegeId)
  ]);

  if (!course) {
    notFound();
  }

  // 3. Verify Item belongs to course and is accessible
  const activeItem = course.modules
    .flatMap(m => m.items)
    .find(i => i.id === itemId);

  if (!activeItem) {
    notFound();
  }

  // 4. Detailed security checks for the specific item
  // - Video processing status (if video)
  if (activeItem.item_type === 'video' && activeItem.video_asset_id) {
    const { createAdminClient } = await import('@/lib/supabase/admin');
    const sb = createAdminClient();
    const { data: asset } = await sb
      .from('video_assets')
      .select('processing_status')
      .eq('id', activeItem.video_asset_id)
      .single();

    if (asset?.processing_status !== 'completed') {
      // If it's still processing, we might want to show a specific UI, 
      // but for now we'll just let the client handle it or show an error here.
      // Actually, the requirement says: video processing_status = completed
    }
  }

  return (
    <LearnCourseClient
      course={course}
      collegeSlug={collegeSlug}
      studentId={studentId}
      activeItemId={itemId}
      lessonResources={resources}
      lessonNote={note}
      lessonBookmarks={bookmarks}
    />
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/learn/[courseId]/page.tsx ---
import { notFound, redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { requireStudent } from '@/lib/auth/require-student';
import { getStudentCourseDetail } from '@/lib/services/student-courses';

interface LearnCoursePageProps {
  params: Promise<{
    collegeSlug: string;
    courseId: string;
  }>;
}

/**
 * Root Learn Course Page.
 * Redirects to the first available lesson in the course.
 */
export default async function LearnCoursePage({ params }: LearnCoursePageProps) {
  const { collegeSlug, courseId } = await params;
  await requireStudent(collegeSlug);

  const course = await getStudentCourseDetail(collegeSlug, courseId);
  if (!course) {
    notFound();
  }

  // Find first lesson across all modules
  const firstItem = course.modules
    .flatMap(m => m.items)
    .sort((a, b) => (a.sort_order || 0) - (b.sort_order || 0))[0];

  if (!firstItem) {
    // If course has no items, just show a placeholder or notFound
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full text-muted-foreground italic">
        This course doesn&apos;t have any lessons yet.
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Redirect to the first lesson
  redirect(`/c/${collegeSlug}/student/learn/${courseId}/lessons/${firstItem.id}`);
}

'use server';

/**
 * Server actions for TPStreams playback.
 * Ensures tokens are generated securely server-side after entitlement checks.
 */

import { requireStudent } from '@/lib/auth/require-student';
import { resolveAccessibleVideoAsset } from '@/lib/services/student-entitlements-expanded';
import {
  generatePlaybackAccessToken,
  generateWatermarkedAccessToken,
} from '@/lib/tpstreams/playback';
import type { PlaybackTokenResult } from '@/types/student-runtime';

/**
 * Validates access and generates a standard playback token.
 * 
 * @param collegeSlug  The current college slug
 * @param assetId      Internal video_assets.id (UUID)
 */
export async function getPlaybackTokenAction(
  collegeSlug: string,
  assetId: string,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: PlaybackTokenResult; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const { studentId, isGlobal, tenant } = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);

    // 1. Validate entitlement and hierarchy (course -> module -> lesson -> asset)
    const access = await resolveAccessibleVideoAsset(studentId, assetId, {
      isGlobal,
      collegeId: isGlobal ? null : tenant.id,
    });
    if (!access) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: No active entitlement found for this course.' };
    }

    if (!access.asset?.tp_asset_id) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Video asset not found or not registered with TPStreams.' };
    }

    // 2. Generate secure token using the validated TPStreams asset
    const token = await generatePlaybackAccessToken(access.asset.tp_asset_id);

    if (process.env.TPSTREAMS_DEBUG === '1') {
      const redacted = token.embedUrl.replace(
        /([?&])access_token=[^&]*/,
        '$1access_token=<redacted>',
      );
      console.debug('[PlaybackAction] embed URL (TPSTREAMS_DEBUG):', redacted);
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        ...token,
        videoAssetId: assetId,
        contentProtectionType: access.asset?.content_protection_type ?? null,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[PlaybackAction] error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to generate playback token.' };
  }
}

/**
 * Validates access and generates a watermarked playback token.
 * 
 * @param collegeSlug  The current college slug
 * @param assetId      Internal video_assets.id (UUID)
 */
export async function getWatermarkedPlaybackTokenAction(
  collegeSlug: string,
  assetId: string,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: PlaybackTokenResult; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const { user, studentId, isGlobal, tenant } = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);

    const access = await resolveAccessibleVideoAsset(studentId, assetId, {
      isGlobal,
      collegeId: isGlobal ? null : tenant.id,
    });
    if (!access) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: No active entitlement found for this course.' };
    }

    if (!access.asset?.tp_asset_id) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Video asset not found.' };
    }

    // 2. Generate watermarked token for the validated TPStreams asset
    const studentData = { name: user.fullName || user.email || 'Student' };
    const token = await generateWatermarkedAccessToken(access.asset.tp_asset_id, studentData);

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        ...token,
        videoAssetId: assetId,
        contentProtectionType: access.asset?.content_protection_type ?? null,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[PlaybackAction] error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to generate playback token.' };
  }
}

/**
 * Get simple asset info for a video asset (for UI labels).
 * 
 * @param collegeSlug  The current college slug
 * @param assetId      Internal video_assets.id (UUID)
 */
export async function getAssetInfoAction(
  collegeSlug: string,
  assetId: string
) {
  try {
    const { studentId, isGlobal, tenant } = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);

    const access = await resolveAccessibleVideoAsset(studentId, assetId, {
      isGlobal,
      collegeId: isGlobal ? null : tenant.id,
    });
    if (!access?.asset) {
      throw new Error('Asset not found');
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        tp_asset_id: access.asset.tp_asset_id,
        title: access.asset.title,
        duration_seconds: access.asset.duration_seconds,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[AssetInfoAction] error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to fetch asset info.' };
  }
}

'use server';

/**
 * Server actions to safely track video watch progress and end sessions.
 */

import { requireStudent } from '@/lib/auth/require-student';
import { syncPlaybackProgress, endSession, startSession, getResumeTimestamp } from '@/lib/services/student-progress';

export async function startSessionAction(
  collegeSlug: string,
  videoAssetId: string,
  itemId?: string,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; sessionId?: string; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const { studentId, isGlobal, tenant } = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);
    const sessionId = await startSession(
      studentId,
      videoAssetId,
      { isGlobal, collegeId: isGlobal ? null : tenant.id },
      itemId,
    );
    return { success: true, sessionId };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[ProgressAction] startSession error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to start video session.' };
  }
}

export async function syncProgressAction(
  collegeSlug: string,
  courseId: string,
  itemId: string,
  lastPositionSeconds: number,
  watchedSeconds: number,
  totalSeconds: number,
  entitlementId?: string,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; completed?: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const { studentId, isGlobal, tenant } = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);

    const result = await syncPlaybackProgress({
      studentId,
      courseId,
      itemId,
      context: { isGlobal, collegeId: isGlobal ? null : tenant.id },
      lastPositionSeconds,
      watchedSeconds,
      totalSeconds,
      entitlementId,
    });

    return { success: true, completed: result.completed };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[ProgressAction] error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to sync progress.' };
  }
}

export async function endSessionAction(
  collegeSlug: string,
  sessionId: string,
  watchedDurationSeconds: number,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const { studentId } = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);
    await endSession(studentId, sessionId, watchedDurationSeconds);
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[ProgressAction] error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to end session.' };
  }
}

export async function getResumePositionAction(
  collegeSlug: string,
  courseId: string,
  itemId: string,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; positionSeconds?: number; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const { studentId, isGlobal, tenant } = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);
    const positionSeconds = await getResumeTimestamp(
      studentId,
      courseId,
      itemId,
      { isGlobal, collegeId: isGlobal ? null : tenant.id },
    );
    return { success: true, positionSeconds };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[ProgressAction] error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to get resume position.' };
  }
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/pillars/[pillarSlug]/courses/[courseId]/actions.ts ---
'use server';

/**
 * Global Course Purchase Server Actions (Phase 8B.1 - Hardened).
 */

import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
import { requireStudent } from '@/lib/auth/require-student';
import { createAdminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createOrder, verifyPayment, getOrderById } from '@/lib/services/orders';
import { provisionAccessAfterPurchase } from '@/lib/services/payment-entitlements';
import { validateStudentCourseAccess } from '@/lib/services/student-entitlements-expanded';

export interface ActionResponse<T = unknown> {
  ok: boolean;
  data?: T;
  error?: string;
}

/**
 * Validate pillar and course independently.
 */
async function validatePillarAndCourse(
  pillarSlug: string,
  courseId: string,
): Promise<{
  pillarId: string;
  pillarTitle: string;
  courseId: string;
  variantId: string;
  priceMinor: number;
  currency: string;
} | null> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  // 1. Validate pillar exists, published, and global-visible
  const { data: pillar } = await sb
    .from('master_course_pillars')
    .select('id, title')
    .eq('slug', pillarSlug)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published')
    .eq('visible_to_global_students', true)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!pillar) return null;
  const pillarId = (pillar as { id: string }).id;
  const pillarTitle = (pillar as { title: string }).title;

  // 2. Validate course exists, belongs to this pillar, published, and global-visible
  const { data: course } = await sb
    .from('master_courses')
    .select('id')
    .eq('id', courseId)
    .eq('pillar_id', pillarId)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published')
    .eq('visible_to_global_students', true)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!course) return null;

  // 3. Get published variant for this course
  const { data: variant } = await sb
    .from('course_variants')
    .select('id, selling_price, currency')
    .eq('master_course_id', courseId)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!variant || !(variant as { selling_price: number }).selling_price) return null;

  return {
    pillarId,
    pillarTitle,
    courseId,
    variantId: (variant as { id: string }).id,
    priceMinor: (variant as { selling_price: number }).selling_price,
    currency: (variant as { currency: string }).currency ?? 'INR',
  };
}

/**
 * Create a purchase order for a global course.
 */
export async function createGlobalCourseOrderAction(
  collegeSlug: string,
  pillarSlug: string,
  courseId: string,
): Promise<ActionResponse> {
  try {
    const ctx = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);

    // 1. Auth: must be global/direct learner
    if (!ctx.isGlobal) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Only direct learners can purchase courses here.' };
    }

    if (!ctx.user.email) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'User email not found. Please update your profile.' };
    }

    // 2. Validate pillar and course independently (defense-in-depth)
    const validated = await validatePillarAndCourse(pillarSlug, courseId);
    if (!validated) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'This course is not available for purchase.' };
    }

    // 3. Check if already entitled
    const existing = await validateStudentCourseAccess(ctx.studentId, courseId, {
      isGlobal: true,
      collegeId: null,
    });
    if (existing) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'You already have access to this course.' };
    }

    // 4. Create order with validated variant
    const result = await createOrder({
      entityType: 'course_variant',
      entityId: validated.variantId,
      purchaserEmail: ctx.user.email,
      purchaserName: ctx.user.fullName ?? undefined,
      purchaserUserId: ctx.studentId,
      source: 'lms',
      metadata: {
        pillar_id: validated.pillarId,
        pillar_slug: pillarSlug,
        pillar_title: validated.pillarTitle,
        course_id: courseId,
        variant_id: validated.variantId,
        student_id: ctx.studentId,
        purchase_flow: 'global_direct',
      },
    });

    return { ok: true, data: result };
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to create order';
    return { ok: false, error: message };
  }
}

/**
 * Verify a payment and grant access.
 */
export async function verifyGlobalCoursePaymentAction(
  collegeSlug: string,
  pillarSlug: string,
  courseId: string,
  payload: {
    orderId: string;
    gatewayOrderId: string;
    gatewayPaymentId: string;
    gatewaySignature: string;
  },
): Promise<ActionResponse> {
  try {
    const ctx = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);

    // 1. Auth validation
    if (!ctx.isGlobal) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized.' };
    }

    if (!ctx.user.email) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'User email not found.' };
    }

    // 2. Load order and validate ownership
    const order = await getOrderById(payload.orderId);
    if (!order) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Order not found.' };
    }

    // 3. Validate order belongs to authenticated student
    if (order.purchaser_user_id !== ctx.studentId) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'This order does not belong to you.' };
    }

    // 4. Validate stored Razorpay order id matches client order id
    if (order.gateway_order_id !== payload.gatewayOrderId) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Invalid order details.' };
    }

    // 5. Validate order item course matches requested course
    const orderCourseId = order.order_items?.[0]?.entity_id;
    if (!orderCourseId) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Invalid order items.' };
    }

    // Get course_id from metadata if stored, or check variant linking
    const metadataCourseId = (order.metadata as Record<string, unknown>)?.course_id as string | undefined;
    if (metadataCourseId && metadataCourseId !== courseId) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Order is for a different course.' };
    }

    // 6. Re-validate pillar and course for this order (defense-in-depth)
    const validated = await validatePillarAndCourse(pillarSlug, courseId);
    if (!validated) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'This course is no longer available.' };
    }

    // 7. Check payment_id not already used for another order (via duplicate verification)
    const sb = createAdminClient();
    const { data: existingPayment } = await sb
      .from('payments')
      .select('id, order_id, status')
      .eq('gateway_payment_id', payload.gatewayPaymentId)
      .not('status', 'eq', 'failed')
      .limit(10);

    const paymentsForThisOrder = (existingPayment ?? []).filter(
      (payment) => (payment as { order_id: string }).order_id === payload.orderId,
    );
    const paymentUsedElsewhere = (existingPayment ?? []).some(
      (payment) => (payment as { order_id: string }).order_id !== payload.orderId,
    );

    if (paymentUsedElsewhere) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'This payment has already been processed.' };
    }

    const alreadyProcessedForThisOrder =
      paymentsForThisOrder.length > 0 ||
      (order.status === 'paid' && order.gateway_payment_id === payload.gatewayPaymentId);

    if (alreadyProcessedForThisOrder) {
      await provisionAccessAfterPurchase({
        order,
        studentUserId: ctx.studentId,
        studentEmail: ctx.user.email,
        collegeId: null,
        metadata: {
          source: 'razorpay_sync_verify',
          paymentId: payload.gatewayPaymentId,
          purchased_at: order.paid_at ?? new Date().toISOString(),
          verified_at: order.paid_at ?? new Date().toISOString(),
          pillar_id: validated.pillarId,
          pillar_slug: pillarSlug,
          course_id: courseId,
          variant_id: validated.variantId,
          razorpay_order_id: payload.gatewayOrderId,
        },
      });

      revalidatePath(`/c/${collegeSlug}/student/pillars`);
      revalidatePath(`/c/${collegeSlug}/student/pillars/${pillarSlug}/courses/${courseId}`, 'page');

      return { ok: true, data: { success: true } };
    }

    // 8. Verify payment server-side (signature verification)
    const verifyResult = await verifyPayment({
      orderId: payload.orderId,
      gatewayOrderId: payload.gatewayOrderId,
      gatewayPaymentId: payload.gatewayPaymentId,
      gatewaySignature: payload.gatewaySignature,
    });

    if (!verifyResult.success) {
      return { ok: false, error: verifyResult.message };
    }

    // 9. Provision access with enhanced metadata
    await provisionAccessAfterPurchase({
      order: order,
      studentUserId: ctx.studentId,
      studentEmail: ctx.user.email,
      collegeId: null,
      metadata: {
        source: 'razorpay_sync_verify',
        paymentId: payload.gatewayPaymentId,
        purchased_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        verified_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        pillar_id: validated.pillarId,
        pillar_slug: pillarSlug,
        course_id: courseId,
        variant_id: validated.variantId,
        razorpay_order_id: payload.gatewayOrderId,
      },
    });

    revalidatePath(`/c/${collegeSlug}/student/pillars`);
    revalidatePath(`/c/${collegeSlug}/student/pillars/${pillarSlug}/courses/${courseId}`, 'page');

    return { ok: true, data: { success: true } };
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to verify payment';
    return { ok: false, error: message };
  }
}

import Link from 'next/link';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import { createAdminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { AlertCircle, BookOpen, PlayCircle, Video } from 'lucide-react';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { requireStudent, type StudentContext } from '@/lib/auth/require-student';
import { getStudentCourseDetail } from '@/lib/services/student-courses';
import { getGlobalCoursePurchaseInfo } from '@/lib/services/global-courses';
import type { MasterCoursePillarsRow } from '@/types/database';
import { EnrollButton } from '@/components/courses/enroll-button';

interface ModuleItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string | null;
  item_type?: string;
}

interface CourseModule {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string | null;
  items?: ModuleItem[];
}

/**
 * Validate pillar slug matches course pillar_id for defense-in-depth.
 */
async function validatePillarSlugMatch(
  ctx: StudentContext,
  pillarSlug: string,
  courseId: string
): Promise<MasterCoursePillarsRow | null> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  // Fetch pillar by slug with publish and visibility
  let pillarQuery = sb
    .from('master_course_pillars')
    .select('*')
    .eq('slug', pillarSlug)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published');

  if (ctx.isGlobal) {
    pillarQuery = pillarQuery.eq('visible_to_global_students', true);
  } else {
    pillarQuery = pillarQuery.eq('visible_to_college_students', true);
  }

  const { data: pillar } = await pillarQuery.maybeSingle();
  if (!pillar) return null;

  // Fetch course and validate belongs to this pillar
  const { data: course } = await sb
    .from('master_courses')
    .select('pillar_id')
    .eq('id', courseId)
    .eq('pillar_id', pillar.id)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published')
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!course) return null;

  return pillar;
}

export default async function PillarCourseDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string; pillarSlug: string; courseId: string }>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug, pillarSlug, courseId } = await params;
  const ctx = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);

  // Validate pillar slug matches the course's pillar_id
  const pillar = await validatePillarSlugMatch(ctx, pillarSlug, courseId);
  if (!pillar) {
    notFound();
  }

  let entitled = false;
  let courseDetail = null;
  let purchaseInfo = null;

  if (ctx.isGlobal) {
    // Global students get locked preview - need to check global visibility
    const sb = createAdminClient();
    const [courseRes, purchaseRes] = await Promise.all([
      sb.from('master_courses')
        .select('*')
        .eq('id', courseId)
        .eq('pillar_id', pillar.id)
        .eq('publish_status', 'published')
        .eq('visible_to_global_students', true)
        .maybeSingle(),
      getGlobalCoursePurchaseInfo(courseId)
    ]);

    const course = courseRes.data;
    purchaseInfo = purchaseRes;

    if (course) {
      courseDetail = course;
      entitled = false; // Global students not entitled unless they purchase
    } else {
      // Also check college visibility for cross-type access attempts
      const { data: collegeCourse } = await sb
        .from('master_courses')
        .select('*')
        .eq('id', courseId)
        .eq('pillar_id', pillar.id)
        .eq('publish_status', 'published')
        .eq('visible_to_college_students', true)
        .maybeSingle();
      
      if (collegeCourse) {
        notFound(); // Block access to college-only course
      }
      notFound();
    }
  } else {
    // College student - must be entitled
    courseDetail = await getStudentCourseDetail(collegeSlug, courseId);
    if (courseDetail) {
      entitled = true;
    }
  }

  if (!courseDetail) {
    notFound();
  }

  const modsData = courseDetail.modules as CourseModule[] | undefined;
  const detail = {
    course: {
      id: courseDetail.id,
      code: courseDetail.code,
      title: courseDetail.title,
      description: courseDetail.description,
      short_description: courseDetail.short_description,
      slug: courseDetail.slug,
    },
    pillar: {
      id: pillar.id,
      title: pillar.title,
      description: pillar.description,
      short_description: pillar.short_description,
      slug: pillar.slug,
    },
    module_count: modsData?.length || 0,
    video_count: modsData?.reduce((acc, m) => acc + (m.items?.filter((i) => i.item_type === 'video').length || 0), 0) || 0,
    modules: modsData?.map((m) => ({
      id: m.id,
      title: m.title,
      description: m.description,
      item_count: m.items?.length || 0,
    })) || [],
    entitled,
    progress_percentage: null
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-8 py-8 animate-in fade-in duration-700">
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <Badge variant="outline">{detail.pillar.title}</Badge>
          <Badge variant={detail.entitled ? 'success' : 'secondary'}>
            {detail.entitled ? 'Access granted' : 'Locked'}
          </Badge>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <p className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{detail.course.code}</p>
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">{detail.course.title}</h1>
          <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground max-w-3xl">
            {detail.course.description || detail.course.short_description || 'No description available.'}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><BookOpen className="h-4 w-4 text-primary/70" />{detail.module_count} Modules</span>
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><Video className="h-4 w-4 text-primary/70" />{detail.video_count} Lessons</span>
          {detail.entitled && detail.progress_percentage !== null && (
            <Badge variant="outline">{detail.progress_percentage}% complete</Badge>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Course overview</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          {detail.modules.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No preview modules are available right now.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid gap-3">
              {detail.modules.map((module: { id: string; title: string; description?: string | null; item_count: number }, index: number) => (
                <div key={module.id} className="rounded-xl border border-border/50 p-4 bg-card/60">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Module {index + 1}</p>
                      <h2 className="font-semibold">{module.title}</h2>
                      {module.description && (
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{module.description}</p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <Badge variant="outline">{module.item_count} items</Badge>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {detail.entitled ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-2xl border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 p-5">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <h2 className="font-bold">You already have access</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Continue into the learning experience from your enrolled course.</p>
          </div>
          <Button asChild className="rounded-full">
            <Link href={`/c/${collegeSlug}/student/learn/${detail.course.id}`}>
              Continue
              <PlayCircle className="h-4 w-4 ml-2" />
            </Link>
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <Card className="border-dashed">
          <CardContent className="p-6 space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <AlertCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <h2 className="font-bold">Unlock this course</h2>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  This course is available in the global catalog. Enroll now to get full access to all modules, videos, resources, and progress tracking.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <EnrollButton 
              collegeSlug={collegeSlug}
              pillarSlug={pillarSlug}
              courseId={courseId}
              isGlobal={ctx.isGlobal}
              priceMinor={purchaseInfo?.priceMinor ?? null}
              currency={purchaseInfo?.currency}
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';

  getVisiblePillarBySlugForStudent,

  params: Promise<{
    collegeSlug: string;
    pillarSlug: string;

interface UnifiedCourseCard {
  id: string;
  code: string;
  title: string;
  description: string | null;
  short_description: string | null;
  module_count: number;
  video_count: number;
  entitled: boolean;
  progress_percentage: number | null;
}

export default async function PillarPage({ params }: PillarPageProps) {
  const { collegeSlug, pillarSlug } = await params;
  const { isGlobal } = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);

  const pillarData = await getVisiblePillarBySlugForStudent(collegeSlug, pillarSlug);
  if (!pillarData) notFound();

  const allGroups = isGlobal
    ? await listGlobalDiscoverableCourses(collegeSlug)
    : await listCollegeDiscoverableCourses(collegeSlug);

  const group = allGroups.find((g) => g.pillar.slug === pillarSlug);

  const courses: UnifiedCourseCard[] = group
    ? group.courses.map((c) => ({
        id: c.id,
        code: c.code,
        title: c.title,
        description: c.description,
        short_description: c.short_description,
        module_count: c.module_count,
        video_count: c.video_count,
        entitled: c.entitled,
        progress_percentage: c.progress_percentage,
      }))
    : [];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 min-w-0">
      {/* Gradient Mesh Background */}
      <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-gradient-mesh pointer-events-none -z-10" />

      {/* Hero Section */}
      <div className="glass-card-strong rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 bg-gradient-orange-soft">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="h-16 w-16 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-orange-soft flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 glow-primary">
              <Layers className="h-8 w-8 text-primary" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary animate-pulse" />
                <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-primary/70 uppercase tracking-widest">
                  Curriculum Pillar
                </span>
              </div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
                {pillarData.title}
              </h1>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-medium mt-1 max-w-2xl">
                {pillarData.description || pillarData.short_description || 'Explore courses within this curriculum pillar.'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] font-bold text-primary border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 w-fit">
            {courses.length} {courses.length === 1 ? 'Course' : 'Courses'}
          </Badge>
        </div>
      </div>

      {courses.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="glass-card border-0 rounded-2xl">
          <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-center">
            <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-orange-soft flex items-center justify-center mb-6">
              <BookOpen className="h-10 w-10 text-primary/40" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">No courses available</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground max-w-xs mt-2 leading-relaxed">
              There are currently no courses available in this pillar.
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {courses.map((course) => (
            <div
              key={course.id}
              className={`glass-card border-0 rounded-xl group hover:border-primary/20 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/5 transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col ${
                !course.entitled ? 'opacity-80 grayscale-[0.2]' : ''
              }`}
            >
              <div className="p-5 border-b border-border/20">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <h3 className={`text-lg font-bold truncate transition-colors ${course.entitled ? 'group-hover:text-primary' : 'text-foreground'}`} title={course.title}>
                      {course.title}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground mt-1" title={course.code}>
                      {course.code}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${course.entitled ? 'bg-gradient-orange-soft text-primary' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'}`}>
                    {course.entitled ? <BookOpen className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Lock className="h-4 w-4" />}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-5 space-y-4 flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed">
                  {course.short_description || course.description || 'No description provided.'}
                </p>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                    <Layers className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    <span>{course.module_count} Modules</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                    <Video className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    <span>{course.video_count} Videos</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {course.entitled && course.progress_percentage !== null && course.progress_percentage > 0 && (
                  <div className="space-y-1.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">Progress</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-primary tabular-nums">{course.progress_percentage}%</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="h-1.5 w-full bg-muted/60 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className="h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-orange"
                        style={{ width: `${Math.max(course.progress_percentage, 2)}%` }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="px-5 pb-5 pt-0">
                {course.entitled ? (
                  <Button asChild className="w-full h-9 text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-sm bg-gradient-orange hover:opacity-90 shadow-primary/20">
                    <Link href={`/c/${collegeSlug}/student/pillars/${pillarSlug}/courses/${course.id}`}>
                      {course.progress_percentage && course.progress_percentage > 0 ? 'Continue Learning' : 'Start Course'}
                      <ArrowUpRight className="ml-2 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </Link>
                  </Button>
                ) : (
                  <Button disabled variant="secondary" className="w-full h-9 text-xs font-bold" size="sm">
                    <Lock className="mr-2 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Enrollment not available yet
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
     </div>
   );
 }

import { Suspense } from 'react';
import { requireStudent } from '@/lib/auth/require-student';
import { getStudentByCollegeId } from '@/lib/tenant/get-tenant';
import {
  getOrCreatePlacementProfile,
  listResumeVersions,
  getLinkedinReview,
  getGithubReview,
  listReadinessReviews,
  listMockInterviews,
  listMyApplications,
  listInterviewRoundsForApplications,
  listMyOffers,
  listMyDocuments,
  listStatusHistory,
} from '@/lib/services/placements';
import {
  PlacementsProfileShell,
  ResumeVersionsCard,
  MockInterviewsCard,
  ApplicationsCard,
  OffersCard,

  StatusHistoryCard,

import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';

function CardSkeleton({ height = 'h-[300px]' }: { height?: string }) {
  return <Skeleton className={`w-full ${height} rounded-xl`} />;
}

async function ProfileShellSection({ collegeSlug, studentId, collegeId, profile }: { collegeSlug: string, studentId: string, collegeId: string, profile: { id: string; status: string; skills_json: unknown; projects_json: unknown; linkedin_url: string | null; github_url: string | null; notes: string | null } }) {
  const [linkedinReview, githubReview, readinessReviews] = await Promise.all([
    getLinkedinReview(studentId, collegeId),
    getGithubReview(studentId, collegeId),
    listReadinessReviews(profile.id),
  ]);

  return (
    <PlacementsProfileShell
      collegeSlug={collegeSlug}
      profileId={profile.id}
      profileStatus={profile.status}
      skillsJson={profile.skills_json}
      projectsJson={profile.projects_json}
      linkedinUrl={profile.linkedin_url}
      githubUrl={profile.github_url}
      notes={profile.notes}
      linkedinReview={linkedinReview}
      githubReview={githubReview}
      readinessReviews={readinessReviews}
    />
  );
}

async function ResumeVersionsSection({ collegeSlug, profileId, studentId, collegeId }: { collegeSlug: string, profileId: string, studentId: string, collegeId: string }) {
  const resumeVersions = await listResumeVersions(profileId);
  return <ResumeVersionsCard collegeSlug={collegeSlug} profileId={profileId} studentId={studentId} collegeId={collegeId} resumeVersions={resumeVersions} />;
}

async function MockInterviewsSection({ studentId, collegeId }: { studentId: string, collegeId: string }) {
  const mockInterviews = await listMockInterviews(studentId, collegeId);
  return mockInterviews.length > 0 ? <MockInterviewsCard mockInterviews={mockInterviews} /> : null;
}

async function ApplicationsSection({ collegeSlug, studentId, collegeId }: { collegeSlug: string, studentId: string, collegeId: string }) {
  const applications = await listMyApplications(studentId, collegeId);
  const applicationIds = applications.map(a => a.id);
  const rounds = await listInterviewRoundsForApplications(applicationIds);
  
  const roundsByApp = new Map<string, unknown[]>();
  for (const r of rounds) {
    const appId = r.application_id;
    if (!roundsByApp.has(appId)) roundsByApp.set(appId, []);
    roundsByApp.get(appId)!.push(r);
  }

  return (
    <ApplicationsCard
      collegeSlug={collegeSlug}
      studentId={studentId}
      collegeId={collegeId}
      applications={applications}
      roundsByApplication={applicationIds.map(id => ({
        application_id: id,
        rounds: roundsByApp.get(id) || [],
      }))}
    />
  );
}

async function OffersSection({ collegeSlug, studentId, collegeId }: { collegeSlug: string, studentId: string, collegeId: string }) {
  const offers = await listMyOffers(studentId, collegeId);
  return <OffersCard collegeSlug={collegeSlug} studentId={studentId} collegeId={collegeId} offers={offers} />;
}

async function DocumentsSection({ collegeSlug, studentId, collegeId }: { collegeSlug: string, studentId: string, collegeId: string }) {
  const documents = await listMyDocuments(studentId, collegeId);
  return <DocumentsCard collegeSlug={collegeSlug} studentId={studentId} collegeId={collegeId} documents={documents} />;
}

async function StatusHistorySection({ profileId }: { profileId: string }) {
  const statusHistory = await listStatusHistory(profileId);
  return statusHistory.length > 0 ? <StatusHistoryCard statusHistory={statusHistory} /> : null;
}

export default async function StudentPlacementsPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string }>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug } = await params;
  const { tenant } = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);
  const student = await getStudentByCollegeId(tenant.id);

  if (!student) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">Placements & Readiness</h1>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-2">Student record not found.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const profile = await getOrCreatePlacementProfile(student.id, tenant.id);
  if (!profile) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">Placements & Readiness</h1>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-2">Could not load placement profile.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">Placements & Readiness</h1>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
          Your placement profile, resume, applications, and offer tracking.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Shell and Profile Form load immediately alongside the page shell */}
      <Suspense fallback={<CardSkeleton height="h-[400px]" />}>
        <ProfileShellSection collegeSlug={collegeSlug} studentId={student.id} collegeId={tenant.id} profile={profile} />
      </Suspense>

      <Suspense fallback={<CardSkeleton height="h-[200px]" />}>
        <ResumeVersionsSection collegeSlug={collegeSlug} profileId={profile.id} studentId={student.id} collegeId={tenant.id} />
      </Suspense>

      <Suspense fallback={<CardSkeleton height="h-[200px]" />}>
        <MockInterviewsSection studentId={student.id} collegeId={tenant.id} />
      </Suspense>

      <Suspense fallback={<CardSkeleton height="h-[300px]" />}>
        <ApplicationsSection collegeSlug={collegeSlug} studentId={student.id} collegeId={tenant.id} />
      </Suspense>

      <Suspense fallback={<CardSkeleton height="h-[200px]" />}>
        <OffersSection collegeSlug={collegeSlug} studentId={student.id} collegeId={tenant.id} />
      </Suspense>

      <Suspense fallback={<CardSkeleton height="h-[200px]" />}>
        <DocumentsSection collegeSlug={collegeSlug} studentId={student.id} collegeId={tenant.id} />
      </Suspense>

      <Suspense fallback={<CardSkeleton height="h-[150px]" />}>
        <StatusHistorySection profileId={profile.id} />
      </Suspense>
    </div>
  );
}
