'use client';

import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { updatePlacementProfileAction, createApplicationAction, createOfferAction, uploadResumeVersionAction, uploadPlacementDocumentAction } from '@/lib/actions/placements';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';

function placementDocHref(fileUrl: string): string {
  return fileUrl.startsWith('http') ? fileUrl : `/api/placement-doc?path=${encodeURIComponent(fileUrl)}`;
}

const statusLabels: Record<string, string> = {
  not_ready: 'Not Ready',
  needs_improvement: 'Needs Improvement',
  interview_ready: 'Interview Ready',
  placed: 'Placed',
  pending: 'Pending',
  approved: 'Approved',
  rejected: 'Rejected',
};

// ============================================================================
// Shell / Profile Forms
// ============================================================================
export function PlacementsProfileShell({
  collegeSlug,
  profileId,
  profileStatus,
  skillsJson,
  projectsJson,
  linkedinUrl,
  githubUrl,
  notes,
  linkedinReview,
  githubReview,
  readinessReviews,
}: {
  collegeSlug: string;
  profileId: string;
  profileStatus: string;
  skillsJson: unknown;
  projectsJson: unknown;
  linkedinUrl: string | null;
  githubUrl: string | null;
  notes: string | null;
  linkedinReview: { status: string; feedback: string | null } | null;
  githubReview: { status: string; feedback: string | null } | null;
  readinessReviews: { overall_status: string; feedback: string | null; reviewed_at: string }[];
}) {
  return (
    <>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Your readiness status</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <Badge variant={profileStatus === 'placed' ? 'default' : 'secondary'} className="text-sm">
            {statusLabels[profileStatus] ?? profileStatus}
          </Badge>
          {readinessReviews.length > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">Latest feedback</p>
              {readinessReviews[0].feedback && (
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{readinessReviews[0].feedback}</p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Placement profile</CardTitle>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Update your skills, projects, and links. Add LinkedIn and GitHub to request review.</p>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <form
            action={async (formData) => {
              const linkedin_url = (formData.get('linkedin_url') as string)?.trim() || null;
              const github_url = (formData.get('github_url') as string)?.trim() || null;
              const notes = (formData.get('notes') as string)?.trim() || null;
              const skillsStr = (formData.get('skills_json') as string)?.trim();
              const projectsStr = (formData.get('projects_json') as string)?.trim();
              let skills_json: unknown = [];
              let projects_json: unknown = [];
              try { if (skillsStr) skills_json = JSON.parse(skillsStr); } catch {}
              try { if (projectsStr) projects_json = JSON.parse(projectsStr); } catch {}
              await updatePlacementProfileAction(profileId, {
                linkedin_url,
                github_url,
                notes,
                skills_json,
                projects_json,
              }, collegeSlug);
            }}
            className="space-y-4"
          >
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="linkedin_url">LinkedIn URL</Label>
              <Input id="linkedin_url" name="linkedin_url" type="url" placeholder="https://linkedin.com/in/..." defaultValue={linkedinUrl ?? ''} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="github_url">GitHub URL</Label>
              <Input id="github_url" name="github_url" type="url" placeholder="https://github.com/..." defaultValue={githubUrl ?? ''} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="skills_json">Skills (JSON array)</Label>
              <Textarea id="skills_json" name="skills_json" rows={2} placeholder='["Skill 1", "Skill 2"]' defaultValue={typeof skillsJson === 'string' ? skillsJson : JSON.stringify(skillsJson ?? [], null, 2)} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="projects_json">Projects (JSON array of objects with name, description, url)</Label>
              <Textarea id="projects_json" name="projects_json" rows={3} placeholder='[{"name":"Project","description":"...","url":"..."}]' defaultValue={typeof projectsJson === 'string' ? projectsJson : JSON.stringify(projectsJson ?? [], null, 2)} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="notes">Notes (for your reference)</Label>
              <Textarea id="notes" name="notes" rows={2} defaultValue={notes ?? ''} />
            </div>
            <Button type="submit">Save profile</Button>
          </form>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader><CardTitle>LinkedIn review</CardTitle></CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {linkedinReview ? (
              <>
                <Badge variant={linkedinReview.status === 'approved' ? 'default' : 'secondary'}>{linkedinReview.status}</Badge>
                {linkedinReview.feedback && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-2">{linkedinReview.feedback}</p>}
              </>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Add your LinkedIn URL above and save to request review.</p>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader><CardTitle>GitHub review</CardTitle></CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {githubReview ? (
              <>
                <Badge variant={githubReview.status === 'approved' ? 'default' : 'secondary'}>{githubReview.status}</Badge>
                {githubReview.feedback && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-2">{githubReview.feedback}</p>}
              </>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Add your GitHub URL above and save to request review.</p>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

// ============================================================================
// Resume Versions
// ============================================================================
export function ResumeVersionsCard({
  collegeSlug,
  profileId,
  studentId,
  collegeId,
  resumeVersions,
}: {
  collegeSlug: string;
  profileId: string;
  studentId: string;
  collegeId: string;
  resumeVersions: { id: string; file_url: string; version_number: number; status: string; feedback: string | null; created_at: string }[];
}) {
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Resume versions</CardTitle>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Upload a resume for review. PDF or image (JPEG, PNG, WebP).</p>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <form
          action={async (formData) => {
            const result = await uploadResumeVersionAction(profileId, collegeId, studentId, formData, collegeSlug);
            if (!result.success) alert(result.error ?? 'Upload failed');
          }}
          className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-4 mb-4"
        >
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="resume-file">Upload resume</Label>
            <Input id="resume-file" name="file" type="file" accept=".pdf,image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" required />
          </div>
          <Button type="submit">Upload resume</Button>
        </form>
        {resumeVersions.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No resume uploaded yet.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {resumeVersions.map((rv) => (
              <div key={rv.id} className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-3 text-sm">
                <div>
                  <span className="font-medium">Version {rv.version_number}</span>
                  <Badge variant={rv.status === 'approved' ? 'default' : rv.status === 'rejected' ? 'destructive' : 'secondary'} className="ml-2">
                    {rv.status}
                  </Badge>
                  {rv.feedback && <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">{rv.feedback}</p>}
                </div>
                <a href={placementDocHref(rv.file_url)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-primary hover:underline text-xs">
                  View
                </a>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

// ============================================================================
// Mock Interviews
// ============================================================================
export function MockInterviewsCard({
  mockInterviews,
}: {
  mockInterviews: { scheduled_at: string | null; outcome: string | null; feedback: string | null }[];
}) {
  if (mockInterviews.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader><CardTitle>Mock interviews</CardTitle></CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {mockInterviews.map((m, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="rounded border p-3 text-sm">
              <Badge variant="secondary">{m.outcome ?? 'Scheduled'}</Badge>
              {m.scheduled_at && <span className="ml-2 text-muted-foreground">{new Date(m.scheduled_at).toLocaleString()}</span>}
              {m.feedback && <p className="mt-1">{m.feedback}</p>}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

// ============================================================================
// Applications
// ============================================================================
export function ApplicationsCard({
  collegeSlug,
  studentId,
  collegeId,
  applications,
  roundsByApplication,
}: {
  collegeSlug: string;
  studentId: string;
  collegeId: string;
  applications: { id: string; company_name: string; role: string | null; status: string; applied_at: string | null; notes: string | null }[];
  roundsByApplication: { application_id: string; rounds: unknown[] }[];
}) {
  const roundsByApp = new Map(roundsByApplication.map((r) => [r.application_id, r.rounds]));

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader><CardTitle>My applications</CardTitle></CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <form
          action={async (formData) => {
            const company_name = (formData.get('company_name') as string)?.trim();
            const role = (formData.get('role') as string)?.trim() || undefined;
            const applied_at = (formData.get('applied_at') as string)?.trim() || undefined;
            const notes = (formData.get('notes') as string)?.trim() || undefined;
            if (company_name) await createApplicationAction(studentId, collegeId, { company_name, role, applied_at, notes }, collegeSlug);
          }}
          className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 mb-4"
        >
          <Input name="company_name" placeholder="Company name" required className="w-full sm:w-auto sm:min-w-[180px]" />
          <Input name="role" placeholder="Role (optional)" className="w-full sm:w-auto sm:min-w-[140px]" />
          <Input name="applied_at" type="date" placeholder="Applied date" className="w-full sm:w-auto" />
          <Input name="notes" placeholder="Notes (optional)" className="w-full sm:w-auto sm:min-w-[200px]" />
          <Button type="submit" className="w-full sm:w-auto">Add application</Button>
        </form>
        {applications.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No applications yet.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {applications.map((app) => (
              <div key={app.id} className="rounded border p-4">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="font-medium">{app.company_name}</span>
                  <Badge variant="secondary">{app.status}</Badge>
                </div>
                {app.role && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{app.role}</p>}
                {app.applied_at && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Applied: {app.applied_at}</p>}
                {app.notes && <p className="text-sm mt-1">{app.notes}</p>}
                {(roundsByApp.get(app.id)?.length ?? 0) > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-2 pl-4 border-l text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {(roundsByApp.get(app.id) as { round_number: number; outcome: string | null }[])?.map((r, i) => (
                      <div key={i}>Round {r.round_number}: {r.outcome ?? '—'}</div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function DocumentsCard({
  collegeSlug,

  collegeId,
  documents,
}: {
  collegeSlug: string;
  studentId: string;
  collegeId: string;
  documents: { id: string; document_type: string; file_url: string; file_name: string | null; verified_at: string | null }[];
}) {
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Placement documents</CardTitle>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Upload offer letters or placement proof.</p>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <form
          action={async (formData) => {
            const documentType = formData.get('documentType') as 'offer_letter' | 'placement_proof' | 'other';

            if (!result.success) alert(result.error ?? 'Upload failed');
          }}
          className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3 mb-4"
        >
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Type</Label>
            <Select name="documentType" required>
              <SelectTrigger className="w-full sm:w-[160px]"><SelectValue placeholder="Type" /></SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="offer_letter">Offer letter</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="placement_proof">Placement proof</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="other">Other</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          <Input name="file" type="file" accept=".pdf,image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" required className="w-full sm:w-auto sm:max-w-[220px]" />
          <Button type="submit" className="w-full sm:w-auto">Upload</Button>
        </form>
        {documents.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No documents uploaded yet.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {documents.map((d) => (
              <div key={d.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded border p-3 text-sm">
                <a href={placementDocHref(d.file_url)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-primary hover:underline">
                  {d.file_name ?? d.document_type}
                </a>
                <Badge variant="secondary">{d.document_type}</Badge>
                {d.verified_at && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Verified</span>}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

// ============================================================================

export function StatusHistoryCard({
  statusHistory,
}: {
  statusHistory: { from_status: string | null; to_status: string; changed_at: string; notes: string | null }[];
}) {
  if (statusHistory.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader><CardTitle>Status history</CardTitle></CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {statusHistory.map((h, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="rounded border p-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {h.from_status ?? '—'} → <span className="text-foreground font-medium">{h.to_status}</span>
              <span className="ml-2">{new Date(h.changed_at).toLocaleString()}</span>
              {h.notes && <p className="mt-1">{h.notes}</p>}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/profile/b2c-self-reported-college-section.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { updateNonPartneredStudentCollege } from '@/lib/actions/update-non-partnered-student-college';
import { School, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

export function B2cSelfReportedCollegeSection({
  collegeSlug,
  initialSelfReported,
}: {
  collegeSlug: string;
  initialSelfReported: string | null;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [collegeName, setCollegeName] = useState(initialSelfReported ?? '');
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    const v = collegeName.trim();
    if (!v) {
      toast.error('Enter your college or university name.');
      return;
    }
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await updateNonPartneredStudentCollege(collegeSlug, v);
      if (result?.error) {
        toast.error(result.error);
        return;
      }
      toast.success('Saved. Your learning account stays on the direct learner portal.');
      router.refresh();
    });
  };

  return (
    <Card
      id='b2c-self-reported-college'
      className='border border-primary/20 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm shadow-sm'
    >
      <CardHeader className='pb-3'>
        <CardTitle className='text-base flex items-center gap-2'>
          <School className='h-4 w-4 text-primary' />
          Tell us your college
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          This helps us understand where you study. It is saved for our team and does{' '}
          <span className='font-medium text-foreground'>not</span> change your account type
          automatically, move you to a different login page, or enroll you at a partnered
          institution.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className='space-y-4'>
        <div className='space-y-2 max-w-lg'>
          <Label htmlFor='b2c-college-name'>College or university name</Label>
          <Input
            id='b2c-college-name'
            value={collegeName}
            onChange={(e) => setCollegeName(e.target.value)}
            placeholder='e.g. Indian Institute of Technology Delhi'
            className='w-full'
            disabled={pending}
            autoComplete='organization'
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter') handleSubmit();
            }}
          />
          <p className='text-[11px] text-muted-foreground'>
            You can update this anytime. Use the name you usually use for your school.
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button
          type='button'
          onClick={handleSubmit}
          disabled={pending || !collegeName.trim()}
          className='gap-2'
        >
          {pending ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className='h-4 w-4 animate-spin' />
              Saving…
            </>
          ) : (
            'Save'
          )}
        </Button>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/profile/change-college-section.tsx ---
"use client";

import React, { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { changeCollegeFromUnknown } from "@/lib/actions/change-college-from-unknown";
import { Building2, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

export function ChangeCollegeSection() {
  const [collegeName, setCollegeName] = useState("");
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    const v = collegeName.trim();
    if (!v) {
      toast.error("Enter your college name.");
      return;
    }
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await changeCollegeFromUnknown(v);
      if (result?.error) {
        toast.error(result.error);
      }
      /* redirect throws on success */
    });
  };

  return (
    <Card
      id="change-college"
      className="border-border/50 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm shadow-sm border-amber-200/60 dark:border-amber-900/40"
    >
      <CardHeader className="pb-3">
        <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
          <Building2 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
          Move to your institution&apos;s portal
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          You are on the legacy <span className="font-medium text-foreground">unknown</span>{" "}
          tenant. Enter your school&apos;s{" "}
          <span className="font-medium text-foreground">full official name</span> as registered
          with NextGen CTO — we&apos;ll try to match an existing partner and move your account to
          that college&apos;s login portal. New direct learner accounts use a different flow on
          the profile page.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        <div className="space-y-2 max-w-lg">
          <Label htmlFor="target-college-name">College name</Label>
          <Input
            id="target-college-name"
            value={collegeName}
            onChange={(e) => setCollegeName(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="e.g. Indian Institute of Technology Delhi"
            className="w-full"
            disabled={pending}
            autoComplete="organization"
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === "Enter") handleSubmit();
            }}
          />
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            If several colleges match, use the exact full name. If nothing
            matches, contact support.
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleSubmit}
          disabled={pending || !collegeName.trim()}
          className="gap-2"
        >
          {pending ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
              Updating…
            </>
          ) : (
            'Match college and switch portal'
          )}
        </Button>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/profile/EditableProfileSection.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Edit2, Check, X, Loader2, Upload, Paperclip, HelpCircle, User, Mail, GraduationCap, Calendar, MapPin, Shield, Github, Linkedin, FileText, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { updateStudentProfile, uploadStudentResume } from '@/lib/actions/profile';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

const IconMap: Record<string, React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>> = {
    User,
    Mail,
    GraduationCap,
    Calendar,
    MapPin,
    Shield,
    Github,
    Linkedin,
    FileText,
};

function IconRenderer({ name, className }: { name: string; className?: string }) {
    const Icon = IconMap[name] || HelpCircle;
    return <Icon className={className} />;
}

interface Field {
    label: string;
    key: string;
    value: string | null;
    icon: string;
    editable?: boolean;
    type?: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    capitalize?: boolean;
    isLink?: boolean;
    isFileInput?: boolean;
    accept?: string;
}

interface EditableProfileSectionProps {
    title: string;
    icon: string;
    fields: Field[];
    collegeId: string;
    collegeSlug: string;
}

export function EditableProfileSection({ title, icon, fields, collegeId, collegeSlug }: EditableProfileSectionProps) {
    const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
    const [isPending, setIsPending] = useState(false);
    const [resumeFile, setResumeFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
    const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

    // Initialize form data from fields
    const getInitialData = useCallback(() => {
        const initial: Record<string, string> = {};
        fields.forEach(f => {
            if (f.editable) {
                initial[f.key] = f.value || '';
            }
        });
        return initial;
    }, [fields]);

    const [formData, setFormData] = useState<Record<string, string>>(getInitialData);

    // Sync form data if fields change (after revalidation)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (!isEditing) {
            setFormData(getInitialData());
            setResumeFile(null);
        }
    }, [getInitialData, isEditing]);

    const normalizeUrl = (url: string) => {
        if (!url) return '';
        const trimmed = url.trim();
        if (trimmed && !/^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) {
            return `https://${trimmed}`;
        }
        return trimmed;
    };

    const handleSave = async () => {
        setIsPending(true);
        try {
            const currentData = { ...formData };

            // 1. Handle URL validation for links
            fields.forEach(f => {
                if (f.editable && f.isLink && !f.isFileInput) {
                    currentData[f.key] = normalizeUrl(currentData[f.key]);
                }
            });

            // 2. Handle Resume upload if a file is selected
            if (resumeFile) {
                const uploadFormData = new FormData();
                uploadFormData.append('resume', resumeFile);

                const uploadResult = await uploadStudentResume(collegeId, uploadFormData);
                if (uploadResult.error) {
                    toast.error(uploadResult.error);
                    setIsPending(false);
                    return;
                }
                if (uploadResult.url) {
                    currentData.resume_url = uploadResult.url;
                }
            }

            // 3. Update student profile
            const result = await updateStudentProfile(collegeId, { ...currentData, collegeSlug });
            if (result.error) {
                toast.error(result.error);
            } else {
                toast.success('Updated successfully!');
                setIsEditing(false);
                setResumeFile(null);
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('[EditableProfileSection] Error:', error);
            toast.error('Something went wrong');
        } finally {
            setIsPending(false);
        }
    };

    const handleCancel = () => {
        setFormData(getInitialData());
        setResumeFile(null);
        setIsEditing(false);
    };

    return (
        <Card className="border-border/50 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm shadow-sm transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-md h-full">
            <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
                        <IconRenderer name={icon} className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> {title}
                    </CardTitle>
                    {!isEditing ? (
                        <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            onClick={() => setIsEditing(true)}
                            className="h-8 px-2 text-primary hover:text-primary/80 hover:bg-primary/10 transition-colors"
                        >
                            <Edit2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1" /> Edit
                        </Button>
                    ) : (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <Button
                                variant="ghost"
                                size="sm"
                                onClick={handleCancel}
                                disabled={isPending}
                                className="h-8 w-8 p-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                            >
                                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                            </Button>
                            <Button
                                variant="ghost"
                                size="sm"
                                onClick={handleSave}
                                disabled={isPending}
                                className="h-8 w-8 p-0 text-primary hover:text-primary/80 hover:bg-primary/10"
                            >
                                {isPending ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Check className="h-4 w-4" />}
                            </Button>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                {fields.map((field) => (
                    <div key={field.label} className="flex items-start gap-3">
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 dark:bg-primary/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                            <IconRenderer name={field.icon} className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                            <Label className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">{field.label}</Label>
                            {isEditing && field.editable ? (
                                field.isFileInput ? (
                                    <div className="mt-1 space-y-2">
                                        <input
                                            type="file"
                                            ref={fileInputRef}
                                            accept={field.accept || '*/*'}
                                            onChange={(e) => setResumeFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
                                            className="hidden"
                                        />
                                        <Button
                                            variant="outline"
                                            size="sm"
                                            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                                            className="w-full h-8 text-xs gap-2 border-dashed bg-background/30"
                                            type="button"
                                            disabled={isPending}
                                        >
                                            {resumeFile ? (
                                                <><Paperclip className="h-3 w-3" /> {resumeFile.name}</>
                                            ) : (
                                                <><Upload className="h-3 w-3" /> Upload PDF</>
                                            )}
                                        </Button>
                                    </div>
                                ) : (
                                    <Input
                                        value={formData[field.key]}
                                        onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, [field.key]: e.target.value })}
                                        placeholder={field.placeholder || `Enter ${field.label}`}
                                        className="h-8 text-sm bg-background/50 mt-1"
                                        disabled={isPending}
                                    />
                                )
                            ) : (
                                <div className="mt-0.5 group">
                                    {field.isLink && field.value ? (
                                        <a
                                            href={field.value}
                                            target="_blank"
                                            rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                            className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground hover:text-primary transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5"
                                        >
                                            <span className="truncate">{field.value}</span>
                                            <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" />
                                        </a>
                                    ) : (
                                        <p className={`text-sm font-medium text-foreground truncate ${field.capitalize ? 'capitalize' : ''} ${!field.value ? 'text-muted-foreground/60 italic' : ''}`}>
                                            {field.value || field.placeholder || '-'}
                                        </p>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                ))}
            </CardContent>
        </Card>
    );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { requireStudent } from "@/lib/auth/require-student";
import { getStudentByCollegeId } from "@/lib/tenant/get-tenant";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { isDirectLearnerCollegeSlug } from "@/lib/tenant/direct-learner-slug";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";
import { EditableProfileSection } from "./EditableProfileSection";
import { ChangeCollegeSection } from "./change-college-section";
import { B2cSelfReportedCollegeSection } from "./b2c-self-reported-college-section";
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@/components/ui/avatar";

/**
 * Profile UX is split by tenant slug:
 * - **Legacy `unknown`:** `ChangeCollegeSection` — match an existing partner college and migrate membership.
 * - **B2C `direct-learners` / `direct-learner`:** `B2cSelfReportedCollegeSection` — optional school label only.
 * These sections are mutually exclusive (`isUnknownCollege` vs `isB2cDirectLearner`).
 */

function formatDate(value: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "-";
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "-";
  return date.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", {
    year: "numeric",
    month: "long",
    day: "numeric",
  });
}

export default async function StudentProfilePage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string }>;
  searchParams?: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug } = await params;
  const sp = searchParams ? await searchParams : {};
  const collegeUpdated = sp.college_updated === "1";
  const { tenant, user, membership } = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);
  const student = await getStudentByCollegeId(tenant.id);
  const isUnknownCollege = tenant.slug === "unknown";
  const isB2cDirectLearner = isDirectLearnerCollegeSlug(tenant.slug);

  let selfReportedCollegeName: string | null = null;
  if (isB2cDirectLearner) {
    const supabase = await createClient();
    const { data: nps } = await supabase
      .from("non_partnered_students")
      .select("self_reported_college_name")
      .eq("user_id", user.id)
      .maybeSingle();
    selfReportedCollegeName = nps?.self_reported_college_name ?? null;
  }

  const profileCheckFields = [
    {
      label: "Student Code",
      value: student?.student_code,
      filled: Boolean(student?.student_code),
    },
    {
      label: "GitHub URL",
      value: student?.github_url,
      filled: Boolean(student?.github_url),
    },
    {
      label: "LinkedIn URL",
      value: student?.linkedin_url,
      filled: Boolean(student?.linkedin_url),
    },
    {
      label: "Resume URL",
      value: student?.resume_url,
      filled: Boolean(student?.resume_url),
    },
    {
      label: "Year / Semester",
      value: student?.year_or_semester,
      filled: Boolean(student?.year_or_semester),
    },
  ];
  const completedItems = profileCheckFields.filter((f) => f.filled).length;
  const completionPercent = Math.round(
    (completedItems / profileCheckFields.length) * 100,
  );

  const initials = user.fullName
    ? user.fullName
        .split(" ")
        .map((n: string) => n[0])
        .join("")
        .toUpperCase()
        .slice(0, 2)
    : (user.email?.[0] ?? "S").toUpperCase();

  const personalInfoFields = [
    {
      label: "Full Name",
      key: "full_name",
      value: user.fullName,
      icon: "User",
      editable: false,
    },
    {
      label: "Email",
      key: "email",
      value: user.email,
      icon: "Mail",
      editable: false,
    },
    {
      label: "Student Code",
      key: "student_code",
      value: student?.student_code || null,
      icon: "GraduationCap",
      editable: true,
      placeholder: "Enter Student Code",
    },
    {
      label: "Semester / Year",
      key: "year_or_semester",
      value: student?.year_or_semester || null,
      icon: "Calendar",
      editable: true,
      placeholder: "e.g. 3rd Year / 6th Sem",
    },
    {
      label: "College",
      key: "college",
      value: isB2cDirectLearner
        ? selfReportedCollegeName
          ? `${tenant.name} — ${selfReportedCollegeName}`
          : tenant.name
        : tenant.name,
      icon: "MapPin",
      editable: false,
    },
    {
      label: "Placement Status",
      key: "placement_status",
      value: student?.placement_ready_status || null,
      icon: "Shield",
      editable: false,
      capitalize: true,
    },
  ];

  const externalLinksFields = [
    {
      label: "GitHub",
      key: "github_url",
      value: student?.github_url || null,
      icon: "Github",
      editable: true,
      isLink: true,
      placeholder: "Not linked yet",
    },
    {
      label: "LinkedIn",
      key: "linkedin_url",
      value: student?.linkedin_url || null,
      icon: "Linkedin",
      editable: true,
      isLink: true,
      placeholder: "Not linked yet",
    },
    {
      label: "Resume",
      key: "resume_url",
      value: student?.resume_url || null,
      icon: "FileText",
      editable: true,
      isLink: true,
      isFileInput: true,
      accept: "application/pdf",
      placeholder: "Not uploaded yet",
    },
    {
      label: "Account Created",
      key: "created_at",
      value: formatDate(student?.created_at ?? null),
      icon: "Calendar",
      editable: false,
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto">
      {collegeUpdated && isUnknownCollege && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-100">
          Your college was updated. You are now on the correct institution portal.
        </div>
      )}
      {/* Breadcrumb */}
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <Link
          href={`/c/${collegeSlug}/student`}
          className="hover:text-primary transition-colors"
        >
          Home
        </Link>
        <span className="text-muted-foreground/50">&gt;</span>
        <span className="text-foreground font-medium">Student Profile</span>
      </p>

      {/* ── Profile Header ── */}
      <Card className="border-border/50 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        {/* Banner */}
        <div className="h-28 bg-gradient-to-r from-primary/20 via-primary/10 to-primary/5 dark:from-primary/30 dark:via-primary/15 dark:to-primary/5 relative">
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top_right,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-primary/10 to-transparent" />
        </div>

        <CardContent className="relative px-6 pb-6">
          {/* Avatar */}
          <div className="-mt-12 mb-4 flex items-end justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-end gap-4">
              <Avatar className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl shadow-lg border-4 border-card">
                <AvatarFallback className="bg-gradient-to-br from-primary to-primary/70 text-primary-foreground text-2xl font-bold">
                  {initials}
                </AvatarFallback>
              </Avatar>
              <div className="pb-1">
                <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">
                  {user.fullName ?? "Student"}
                </h1>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  {user.email ?? ""}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <Badge variant="outline" className="capitalize mb-1">
              {membership.status}
            </Badge>
          </div>

          {/* Profile Completion */}
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/50 bg-accent/20 dark:bg-accent/10 p-4 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
              <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                Profile Completion
              </span>
              <span className="font-bold text-primary">
                {completionPercent}%
              </span>
            </div>
            <Progress value={completionPercent} className="h-2" />
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {completedItems}/{profileCheckFields.length} fields completed.
              Keep your profile updated!
            </p>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {isUnknownCollege && <ChangeCollegeSection />}
      {isB2cDirectLearner && (
        <B2cSelfReportedCollegeSection
          collegeSlug={tenant.slug}
          initialSelfReported={selfReportedCollegeName}
        />
      )}

      {/* ── Details Grid ── */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <EditableProfileSection
          title="Personal Information"
          icon="User"
          fields={personalInfoFields}
          collegeId={tenant.id}
          collegeSlug={collegeSlug}
        />

        <EditableProfileSection
          title="External Links & Documents"
          icon="FileText"
          fields={externalLinksFields}
          collegeId={tenant.id}
          collegeSlug={collegeSlug}
        />
      </div>

      {/* ── Account Status ── */}
      <Card className="border-border/50 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm shadow-sm">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3 text-center">
          <CardTitle className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">
            Account Status
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-3">
            <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] font-bold">
              ACTIVE: {user.isActive ? "YES" : "NO"}
            </Badge>
            <Badge
              variant="outline"
              className="text-[10px] font-bold capitalize"
            >
              COLLEGE: {tenant.slug}
            </Badge>
            <Badge
              variant="outline"
              className="text-[10px] font-bold capitalize"
            >
              MEMBERSHIP: {membership.status}
            </Badge>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useTenant } from '@/providers/tenant-provider';
import type { StudentModuleAccessMap } from '@/lib/modules/get-student-module-access';

interface StudentModuleProviderProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  initialModuleAccess: StudentModuleAccessMap;
}

/**
 * Provides module access data to authenticated student routes.
 * Updates the tenant context with the module access map fetched after auth.
 */
export function StudentModuleProvider({
  children,
  initialModuleAccess,
}: StudentModuleProviderProps) {
  const { setStudentModuleAccess } = useTenant();

  useEffect(() => {
    setStudentModuleAccess(initialModuleAccess);
  }, [initialModuleAccess, setStudentModuleAccess]);

  return <>{children}</>;
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/auth/callback/route.ts ---
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { getPortalBaseUrl } from "@/lib/auth/app-url";
import { oauthExchangeFailureCode } from "@/lib/auth/oauth-exchange-error";
import { syncProfile } from "@/lib/auth/profile-sync";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/**
 * Auth callback for college-specific student login.
 * Validates user + student membership, redirects to student home.
 * Supabase session is the only source of truth - no custom JWT needed.
 *
 * PERFORMANCE: All DB queries run in parallel where possible.
 */
export async function GET(
  request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string }> },
) {
  const startTime = performance.now();
  const { collegeSlug } = await params;
  const base = new URL(request.url).origin;
  const normalizedSlug = collegeSlug.trim().toLowerCase();
  const loginUrl = `/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/student/login`;

  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  const code = searchParams.get("code");

  const supabase = await createClient();

  if (code) {
    const { error: exchangeError } =
      await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);
    if (exchangeError) {
      console.error("[auth/callback] Exchange error:", exchangeError?.message ?? 'unknown');
      const code = oauthExchangeFailureCode(exchangeError);
      return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(`${loginUrl}?error=${code}`, base));
    }

    // If a 'next' param is provided (e.g. password recovery flow),
    // redirect there instead of doing the full login routing below.
    const next = searchParams.get('next');
    if (next && next.startsWith('/')) {
      return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(next, base));
    }
  }

  // Rotate session tokens to invalidate any previously issued tokens
  const { error: refreshError } = await supabase.auth.refreshSession();
  if (refreshError) {
    console.warn("[auth/callback] Session rotation failed:", refreshError.message);
  }

  const {
    data: { user },
    error: userError,
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (userError || !user) {
    console.error("[auth/callback] getUser failed:", userError?.message);
    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(`${loginUrl}?error=session`, base));
  }

  // Run college lookup, student auth context RPC, and profile check in parallel.
  // The RPC replaces 3 separate queries (membership, profile active, student record).
  const [
    tenantResult,
    resolvedResult,
    profileResult,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from("colleges")
      .select("id, slug")
      .ilike("slug", normalizedSlug)
      .eq("status", "active")
      .maybeSingle(),
    supabase
      .rpc('resolve_student_auth_context', {
        p_user_id: user.id,
        p_slug: normalizedSlug,
      })
      .single(),
    supabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("global_role")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .maybeSingle(),
  ]);

  const tenant = tenantResult.data;
  if (!tenant) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(`${loginUrl}?error=tenant`, base));
  }

  if (profileResult.data?.global_role === "superadmin") {
    const superadminBase = getPortalBaseUrl("superadmin", base);
    return NextResponse.redirect(`${superadminBase}/dashboard`);
  }

  const resolved = resolvedResult.data as {
    allowed: boolean;
    error_code: string | null;
    membership_id: string | null;
    membership_status: string | null;
    student_id: string | null;
  } | null;

  if (resolved?.allowed && resolved.membership_id) {
    // Student has a valid membership — ensure student record exists and upsert profile
    if (!resolved.student_id) {
      await supabase.from("students").insert({
        user_id: user.id,
        college_id: tenant.id,
      });
    }

    await syncProfile(user);

    // Note: 'invited' membership activation is handled by the requireStudent guard,
    // not here. This ensures a single source of truth for both email and OAuth flows.

    const duration = performance.now() - startTime;
    if (duration > 200) {
      console.warn(
        "[auth/callback] Student callback took",
        Math.round(duration),
        "ms",
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.redirect(
      `${base}/c/${encodeURIComponent(tenant.slug)}/student`,
    );
  }

  // No student membership — check if user has an admin/faculty membership as fallback
  if (resolved?.error_code === 'account_disabled') {
    return NextResponse.redirect(
      new URL(`${loginUrl}?error=account_disabled`, base),
    );
  }

  const { data: adminMemberships } = await supabase
    .from("college_memberships")
    .select("id, college_id, status, role")
    .eq("user_id", user.id)
    .in("role", ["college_admin", "faculty_spoc", "mentor"])
    .in("status", ["active", "invited"])
    .limit(10);
  const adminMembership =
    adminMemberships?.find((m) => m.college_id === tenant.id) ??
    adminMemberships?.[0];
  if (adminMembership) {
    if (adminMembership.status === "invited") {
      await supabase
        .from("college_memberships")
        .update({ status: "active" })
        .eq("id", adminMembership.id)
        .eq("user_id", user.id)
        .eq("status", "invited");
    }
    const { data: adminCollege } = await supabase
      .from("colleges")
      .select("slug")
      .eq("id", adminMembership.college_id)
      .eq("status", "active")
      .maybeSingle();
    if (adminCollege?.slug) {
      const collegeBase = getPortalBaseUrl("college_admin", base);
      return NextResponse.redirect(
        `${collegeBase}/c/${encodeURIComponent(adminCollege.slug)}/admin/dashboard`,
      );
    }
  }
  return NextResponse.redirect(
    new URL(`${loginUrl}?error=no_access&redirected=1`, base),
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/forgot-password/page.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client';
import { useTenant } from '@/providers/tenant-provider';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';

export default function StudentForgotPasswordPage() {
  const params = useParams();
  const { branding } = useTenant();
  const collegeSlug = typeof params?.collegeSlug === 'string' ? params.collegeSlug : '';
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const loginHref = useMemo(() => `/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/student/login`, [collegeSlug]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSent(false);
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await fetch('/api/student/auth-events', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ event: 'password_reset_requested', slug: collegeSlug, email }),
      }).catch(() => undefined);

      const supabase = createClient();
      const baseUrl = window.location.origin;
      const redirectTo = `${baseUrl}/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/student/auth/callback?next=/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/student/reset-password`;
      const { error: resetError } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, { redirectTo });
      if (resetError) {
        setError(resetError.message);
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      setSent(true);
    } catch {
      setError('Something went wrong. Try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/30 p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm space-y-6 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-8 shadow-lg">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Reset password</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Student Portal · {branding.name}</p>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="email" className="text-sm font-medium">Email</label>
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(ev) => setEmail(ev.target.value)}
              required
              autoComplete="email"
              placeholder="you@college.edu"
              className="h-10 rounded-xl"
            />
          </div>

          {error && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}
          {sent && (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              If that email exists, a reset link has been sent. Please check your inbox.
            </p>
          )}

          <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-10 rounded-xl" disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? 'Sending…' : 'Send reset link'}
          </Button>
        </form>

        <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <Link href={loginHref} className="underline-offset-4 hover:underline">Back to sign in</Link>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/layout.tsx ---
import React from 'react';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import { getTenantBranding } from '@/lib/tenant/get-tenant-branding-server';
import { RootClientLayout } from './root-client-layout';

/**
 * Shared layout for all /c/[collegeSlug]/student/* routes.
 * 
 * PERFORMANCE: Only fetches tenant branding here - needed for login page styling.
 * Module access is fetched in the authenticated layout AFTER auth is confirmed,
 * avoiding unnecessary DB queries for public pages (login, forgot-password).
 */
export default async function StudentLayout({
  children,
  params,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string }>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug } = await params;
  const branding = await getTenantBranding(collegeSlug);

  if (!branding) {
    notFound();
  }

  return (
    <RootClientLayout collegeSlug={collegeSlug} initialBranding={branding}>
      {children}
    </RootClientLayout>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/reset-password/page.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client';
import { useTenant } from '@/providers/tenant-provider';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';

export default function StudentResetPasswordPage() {
  const params = useParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { branding } = useTenant();
  const collegeSlug = typeof params?.collegeSlug === 'string' ? params.collegeSlug : '';
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const [noSession, setNoSession] = useState(false);

  const loginHref = useMemo(() => `/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/student/login`, [collegeSlug]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function checkSession() {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const { data, error: userError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
      if (cancelled) return;

      if (userError || !data?.user) {
        setNoSession(true);
      }
      setReady(true);
    }

    checkSession();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    if (password.length < 8) {
      setError('Password must be at least 8 characters.');
      return;
    }
    if (password !== confirm) {
      setError('Passwords do not match.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const { error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password });
      if (updateError) {
        setError(updateError.message);
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      router.push(`/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/student`);
    } catch {
      setError('Something went wrong. Try again.');
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!ready) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/30 p-4">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Preparing…</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (noSession) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/30 p-4">
        <div className="w-full max-w-sm space-y-6 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-8 shadow-lg">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Invalid Link</h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Student Portal · {branding.name}</p>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-destructive">This reset link is invalid or expired. Please request a new one.</p>
          <Button variant="outline" className="w-full h-10 rounded-xl" onClick={() => router.push(loginHref)}>
            Go to sign in
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/30 p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm space-y-6 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-8 shadow-lg">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Set a new password</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Student Portal · {branding.name}</p>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="password" className="text-sm font-medium">New password</label>
            <Input
              id="password"
              type="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(ev) => setPassword(ev.target.value)}
              required
              autoComplete="new-password"
              minLength={8}
              className="h-10 rounded-xl"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="confirm" className="text-sm font-medium">Confirm password</label>
            <Input
              id="confirm"
              type="password"
              value={confirm}
              onChange={(ev) => setConfirm(ev.target.value)}
              required
              autoComplete="new-password"
              minLength={8}
              className="h-10 rounded-xl"
            />
          </div>

          {error && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}

          <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-10 rounded-xl" disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? 'Saving…' : 'Update password'}
          </Button>
        </form>

        <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <Link href={loginHref} className="underline-offset-4 hover:underline">Back to sign in</Link>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';

export default function StudentRootForgotPasswordPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const loginHref = useMemo(() => '/login', []);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSent(false);
    setLoading(true);

    const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();

    try {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const baseUrl = window.location.origin;
      const redirectTo = `${baseUrl}/auth/callback?next=/reset-password`;

      const { error: resetError } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(normalizedEmail, { redirectTo });
      if (resetError) {
        setError(resetError.message);
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      setSent(true);
    } catch {
      setError('Something went wrong. Try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/30 p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm space-y-6 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-8 shadow-lg">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Reset password</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Student Portal</p>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="email" className="text-sm font-medium">Email</label>
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(ev) => setEmail(ev.target.value)}
              required
              autoComplete="email"
              placeholder="you@college.edu"
              className="h-10 rounded-xl"
            />
          </div>

          {error && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}
          {sent && (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              If that email exists, a reset link has been sent. Please check your inbox.
            </p>
          )}

          <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-10 rounded-xl" disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? 'Sending…' : 'Send reset link'}
          </Button>
        </form>

        <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <Link href={loginHref} className="underline-offset-4 hover:underline">Back to sign in</Link>
          {' '}
          ·
          {' '}
          <button
            type="button"
            className="underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
            onClick={() => router.back()}
          >
            Go back
          </button>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/page.tsx ---
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { getSession } from '@/lib/auth/session';
import { redirectToStudentTenant } from '@/lib/auth/redirects';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

/**
 * Root page — acts as the entry point for the LMS.
 *
 * Authenticated users are redirected to their student tenant.
 * Unauthenticated users are sent to login.
 *
 * This replaces the legacy (dashboard)/layout.tsx redirect shell
 * with an explicit root page so `/` resolves cleanly.
 */
export default async function RootPage() {
  const { session } = await getSession();

  if (!session?.user) {
    redirect('/login');
  }

  // Authenticated — route to the correct student tenant.
  // redirectToStudentTenant checks membership and provisions B2C direct-learner
  // tenants when no existing membership is found.
  await redirectToStudentTenant();
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/reset-password/page.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState, Suspense } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';

function ResetPasswordContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const [noSession, setNoSession] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function checkSession() {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const { data, error: userError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
      if (cancelled) return;

      if (userError || !data?.user) {
        setNoSession(true);
      }
      setReady(true);
    }

    checkSession();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    if (password.length < 8) {
      setError('Password must be at least 8 characters.');
      return;
    }
    if (password !== confirm) {
      setError('Passwords do not match.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const { error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password });
      if (updateError) {
        setError(updateError.message);
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      // Password updated successfully — redirect to login
      router.push('/login');
    } catch {
      setError('Something went wrong. Try again.');
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!ready) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/30 p-4">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Preparing…</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (noSession) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/30 p-4">
        <div className="w-full max-w-sm space-y-6 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-8 shadow-lg">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Invalid Link</h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Student Portal</p>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-destructive">This reset link is invalid or expired. Please request a new one.</p>
          <Button variant="outline" className="w-full h-10 rounded-xl" onClick={() => router.push('/forgot-password')}>
            Request new link
          </Button>
          <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <Link href="/login" className="underline-offset-4 hover:underline">Back to sign in</Link>
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/30 p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm space-y-6 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-8 shadow-lg">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Set a new password</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Student Portal</p>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="password" className="text-sm font-medium">New password</label>
            <Input
              id="password"
              type="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(ev) => setPassword(ev.target.value)}
              required
              autoComplete="new-password"
              minLength={8}
              className="h-10 rounded-xl"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="confirm" className="text-sm font-medium">Confirm password</label>
            <Input
              id="confirm"
              type="password"
              value={confirm}
              onChange={(ev) => setConfirm(ev.target.value)}
              required
              autoComplete="new-password"
              minLength={8}
              className="h-10 rounded-xl"
            />
          </div>

          {error && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}

          <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-10 rounded-xl" disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? 'Saving…' : 'Update password'}
          </Button>
        </form>

        <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <Link href="/login" className="underline-offset-4 hover:underline">Back to sign in</Link>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function ResetPasswordPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense
      fallback={
        <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/30 p-4">
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Loading…</p>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <ResetPasswordContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/app/unauthorized/page.tsx ---
import Link from "next/link";
import { ShieldAlert, ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";

export default function UnauthorizedPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: { reason?: string } }) {
    const reason = searchParams.reason;

    let message = "You do not have permission to access this area.";
    if (reason === "no_student_membership") {
        message = "You are logged in, but you do not have an active Student role.";
    } else if (reason === "invalid_tenant") {
        message = "Your student account is associated with a college that could not be found or is inactive.";
    }

    return (
        <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-background p-4">
            <div className="max-w-md w-full text-center space-y-6">
                <div className="mx-auto w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-destructive/10 flex items-center justify-center">
                    <ShieldAlert className="w-8 h-8 text-destructive" />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                    <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">Access Denied</h1>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">{message}</p>
                </div>

                <div className="pt-4 flex justify-center">
                    <Link
                        href="/login"
                        className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 border border-input bg-background shadow-sm hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2"
                    >
                        <ArrowLeft className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                        Return to Login
                    </Link>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/components/analytics/charts.tsx ---
'use client'

import * as React from 'react'
import {
  LineChart,
  Line,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  CartesianGrid,
  Tooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer
} from 'recharts'
import { PremiumCard } from './premium-card'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

interface ChartWrapperProps {
  title: string
  subtitle?: string
  children: React.ReactNode
  className?: string
}

interface LineChartProps {
  data: Record<string, unknown>[]
  xKey: string
  yKey: string
  title: string
  valueFormatter?: (value: number) => string
}

export function ChartWrapper({ title, subtitle, children, className }: ChartWrapperProps) {
  return (
    <PremiumCard className={cn('flex flex-col', className)}>
      <div className="border-b border-white/5 px-6 py-5">
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">{title}</h3>
        {subtitle && <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400 mt-1">{subtitle}</p>}
      </div>
      <div className="flex-1 p-6">
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
          {children as React.ReactElement}
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>
    </PremiumCard>
  )
}

export function AnalyticsLineChart({ data, xKey, yKey, title, valueFormatter }: LineChartProps) {
  const tooltipFormatter = (value: string | number | ReadonlyArray<string | number> | undefined) => {
    if (!valueFormatter) return value ?? ''

    const normalizedValue = Array.isArray(value) ? Number(value[0] ?? 0) : Number(value ?? 0)
    return valueFormatter(normalizedValue)
  }

  return (
    <ChartWrapper title={title} className="min-h-[350px]">
      <LineChart data={data} margin={{ top: 10, right: 10, left: 0, bottom: 0 }}>
        <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.05)" vertical={false} />
        <XAxis dataKey={xKey} stroke="#71717a" fontSize={12} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} dy={10} />
        <YAxis stroke="#71717a" fontSize={12} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} dx={-10} tickFormatter={valueFormatter} />
        <Tooltip
          contentStyle={{ backgroundColor: '#0a0a0a', borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)', borderRadius: '8px', color: '#fff' }}
          itemStyle={{ color: '#fff' }}
          formatter={tooltipFormatter}
        />
        <Line type="monotone" dataKey={yKey} stroke="#3b82f6" strokeWidth={3} dot={false} activeDot={{ r: 6, fill: '#3b82f6', stroke: '#fff', strokeWidth: 2 }} />
      </LineChart>
    </ChartWrapper>
  )
}

import * as React from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

interface PremiumCardProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  glow?: boolean
  elevated?: boolean
}

export function PremiumCard({
  className,
  glow = false,
  elevated = false,
  children,
  ...props
}: PremiumCardProps) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        'relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-white/5 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl transition-all duration-300',
        elevated && 'shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)]',
        glow && 'hover:border-primary/50 hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(var(--primary),0.15)]',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/10 to-transparent" />
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}

export function ProgressWidget({
  title,
  value,
  subtitle,
  progress,
  icon: Icon,
  className
}: {
  title: string
  value: string | number
  subtitle?: string
  progress?: number
  icon: React.ElementType
  className?: string
}) {
  return (
    <PremiumCard glow className={cn('p-6', className)}>
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
        <div className="w-full">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400">{title}</p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white">{value}</p>
          
          {subtitle && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">{subtitle}</p>}
          
          {progress !== undefined && (
            <div className="mt-4 w-full bg-white/5 rounded-full h-1.5 overflow-hidden">
              <div 
                className="bg-primary h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500" 
                style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} 
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="ml-4 rounded-full bg-white/5 p-3 text-zinc-300">
          <Icon className="h-5 w-5" />
        </div>
      </div>
    </PremiumCard>
  )
}

"use client";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/** Single trust line on the login screen (no live API). */
export function LoginYouTubeStats({ isDark }: { isDark: boolean }) {

const AUTH_THEME_KEY = "auth-page-theme";

let authThemeHydrated = false;

function subscribeAuthPageTheme(onStoreChange: () => void) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return () => { };
  const sync = () => {
    authThemeHydrated = true;
    onStoreChange();
  };
  queueMicrotask(sync);
  const onStorage = () => sync();
  window.addEventListener("storage", onStorage);
  window.addEventListener("auth-page-theme", onStorage);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener("storage", onStorage);
    window.removeEventListener("auth-page-theme", onStorage);
  };
}

function getAuthPageThemeSnapshot(): "light" | "dark" {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "dark";
  if (!authThemeHydrated) return "dark";
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(AUTH_THEME_KEY) as
      | "light"
      | "dark"
      | null;
    if (stored === "light" || stored === "dark") return stored;
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
  return "dark";
}

function getAuthPageThemeServerSnapshot(): "light" | "dark" {
  return "dark";
}

export type UnifiedAuthMode = "global" | "tenant";

function getTenantUrlErrorMessage(err: string | null): string | null {
  if (err === "forbidden" || err === "wrong_portal") {
    return "This account does not have student access for this institution. Use the Student Portal only with credentials created by your college admin.";
  }
  if (err === "tenant") {
    return "This institution is not found. Check the URL or contact your admin.";
  }
  if (err === "account_disabled") return "This account is disabled.";
  if (err === "no_student_profile") {
    return "Account exists but no student profile found. Contact your college admin.";
  }
  return null;
}

/** OAuth callback / redirect query errors shared by global and tenant login. */
function getSharedAuthUrlErrorMessage(err: string | null): string | null {
  if (err === "network") {
    return "Could not reach the sign-in service (connection timed out). Check your internet, VPN, or firewall, then try Google sign-in again.";
  }
  if (err === "session") {
    return "Your sign-in session could not be completed. Please try again.";
  }
  return null;
}
