export function UnifiedAuthScreen({ mode, searchParams = {} }: { mode: UnifiedAuthMode, searchParams?: Record<string, string | string[] | undefined> }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useParams();
  const getQuery = (k: string) => { const v = searchParams[k]; return Array.isArray(v) ? v[0] : v ?? null; };
  const message = getQuery("message");

  const collegeSlug =
    mode === "tenant" && typeof params?.collegeSlug === "string"
      ? params.collegeSlug
      : "";
  const qErr = getQuery("error");
  const sharedUrlError = getSharedAuthUrlErrorMessage(qErr);
  const tenantUrlError =
    mode === "tenant" ? getTenantUrlErrorMessage(qErr) : null;

  const theme = useSyncExternalStore(
    subscribeAuthPageTheme,
    getAuthPageThemeSnapshot,
    getAuthPageThemeServerSnapshot,
  );

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("login");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showLoginPassword, setShowLoginPassword] = useState(false);
  const [loginEmail, setLoginEmail] = useState("");
  const [loginPassword, setLoginPassword] = useState("");

  // Signup state (tenant mode only)
  const [signupFullName, setSignupFullName] = useState("");
  const [signupEmail, setSignupEmail] = useState("");
  const [signupPassword, setSignupPassword] = useState("");
  const [signupConfirmPassword, setSignupConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [showSignupPassword, setShowSignupPassword] = useState(false);
  const [showSignupConfirmPassword, setShowSignupConfirmPassword] = useState(false);
  const [signupSuccess, setSignupSuccess] = useState(false);

  // Supabase invite flow redirects to Site URL (/login) with hash tokens.
  // Establish session here, then navigate to /auth/set-password.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const hash = window.location.hash;
    if (!hash || (!hash.includes('type=invite') && !hash.includes('type=recovery'))) return;

    const handleInviteRedirect = async () => {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const params = new URLSearchParams(hash.slice(1));
      const access_token = params.get('access_token');
      const refresh_token = params.get('refresh_token');
      if (access_token && refresh_token) {
        const { error: sessionErr } = await supabase.auth.setSession({ access_token, refresh_token });
        if (!sessionErr) {
          // Clear hash so this doesn't re-trigger
          window.history.replaceState({}, '', window.location.pathname);
          router.replace('/auth/set-password');
          return;
        }
      }
    };
    handleInviteRedirect();
  }, [router]);

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    const next = theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(AUTH_THEME_KEY, next);
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
    authThemeHydrated = true;
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("auth-page-theme"));
  };

  const isDark = theme === "dark";

  const logFailedLogin = async (reason: string) => {
    if (mode !== "tenant" || !collegeSlug) return;
    await fetch("/api/student/auth-events", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        event: "failed_login",
        slug: collegeSlug,
        email: loginEmail.trim().toLowerCase(),
        reason,
      }),
    }).catch(() => undefined);
  };

  const handleLogin = async (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const email = loginEmail.trim().toLowerCase();
      const { error: signInError } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
        email,
        password: loginPassword,
      });

      if (signInError) {
        if (mode === "tenant") {
          await logFailedLogin("invalid_credentials");
        }
        setError(
          mode === "tenant"
            ? "Invalid email or password."
            : signInError.message,
        );
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      if (mode === "tenant") {
        router.refresh();
        router.push(
          `/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/student/auth/callback`,
        );
        return;
      }

      const response = await fetch("/api/my-student-tenant", {
        method: "GET",
        credentials: "same-origin",
      });
      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok || !data?.slug) {
        await supabase.auth.signOut();
        setError(data?.error ?? "You do not have student access.");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      router.refresh();
      router.push(`/c/${encodeURIComponent(data.slug)}/student/auth/callback`);
    } catch {
      setError("Something went wrong. Try again.");
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // --- Signup handler (tenant mode only) ---
  const handleSignup = useCallback(async (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSignupSuccess(false);

    if (signupPassword !== signupConfirmPassword) {
      setError("Passwords do not match.");
      return;
    }
    if (signupPassword.length < 6) {
      setError("Password must be at least 6 characters.");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const email = signupEmail.trim().toLowerCase();
      const { error: signUpError } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
        email,
        password: signupPassword,
        options: {
          data: {
            full_name: signupFullName.trim(),
            display_name: signupFullName.trim(),
          },
        },
      });

      if (signUpError) {
        setError(signUpError.message);
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      setSignupSuccess(true);
      setLoading(false);
    } catch {
      setError("Something went wrong. Try again.");
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [signupEmail, signupPassword, signupConfirmPassword, signupFullName]);


  const oauthRedirect = () => {
    const origin = getClientBaseUrl();
    return getAuthRedirectUrl("student", origin);
  };

  const handleGoogleContinue = async () => {
    setError(null);
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const redirectTo = oauthRedirect();
      if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
        console.info("[auth/oauth] redirectTo:", redirectTo);
      }
      const { error: oauthError } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
        provider: "google",
        options: { redirectTo },
      });
      if (oauthError) {
        setError(oauthError.message);
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      setError("Something went wrong. Try again.");
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const displayError = error ?? sharedUrlError ?? tenantUrlError;

  const iconMuted = isDark ? "text-orange-200/50" : "text-orange-900/45";
  const mutedText = isDark ? "text-zinc-400" : "text-zinc-600";
  const headingText = isDark ? "text-white" : "text-zinc-900";
  const bgPage = isDark ? "bg-[#030303]" : "bg-[#fffbf7]";

  const forgotHref =
    mode === "tenant" && collegeSlug
      ? `/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/student/forgot-password`
      : "/forgot-password";

  /* ─── TENANT MODE: College Admin–style layout ─── */
  if (mode === "tenant") {
    return (
      <div className="relative h-screen flex flex-col lg:flex-row overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-[#4d5662] to-[#3a4149] text-zinc-50">
        {/* LEFT PANEL: Campus Hero Image */}
        <div className="hidden lg:block lg:w-[60%] flex-none relative overflow-hidden">
          <Image
            src='/assets/amrita-campus-hero.jpg'
            alt="Amrita Campus"
            fill
            className="object-cover"
            priority
          />
          {/* Dark overlay for depth */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-black/30 via-transparent to-[#4d5662]/80 z-10" />
          {/* Amrita Logo + Name */}
          <div className="absolute top-5 left-6 z-20 flex items-center gap-3 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-4 duration-700">
            <Image
              src='/assets/amrita-logo.png'
              alt="Amrita Logo"
              width={38}
              height={38}
              className="rounded-full drop-shadow-lg"
            />
            <span className="text-white text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide drop-shadow-md">
              Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* RIGHT PANEL: Auth Form */}
        <div className="flex-1 relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-6 lg:px-12">


        <div className="w-full max-w-md relative z-20 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-8 duration-1000">
          {/* Dark Slate Form Card (College Admin Style) */}
          <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#3e4650]/95 p-8 shadow-2xl shadow-black/25 backdrop-blur-md">
            <div className="space-y-5">
              {/* Header */}
              <div className="space-y-1 text-center">
                <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-50">
                  {activeTab === "signup" ? "Create Account" : "Welcome"}
                </h1>
                <p className="text-sm text-zinc-300">
                  {activeTab === "signup" ? "Sign up to begin your learning journey" : "Sign in to continue your leadership journey"}
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Feedback Messages */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {message && !displayError && (
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/10 p-2 text-center text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-200 animate-in zoom-in-95">
                    {message}
                  </div>
                )}
                {displayError && (
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-500/20 bg-red-950/20 p-2 text-center text-[11px] font-semibold text-red-400 animate-in shake-1">
                    {displayError}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Form */}
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <Tabs defaultValue="login" value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab} className="w-full">
                  <TabsList className="sr-only">
                    <TabsTrigger value="login">Sign in</TabsTrigger>
                    <TabsTrigger value="signup">Sign up</TabsTrigger>
                  </TabsList>

                  {/* ── LOGIN TAB ── */}
                  <TabsContent value="login" className="mt-0 outline-none">
                    <form onSubmit={handleLogin} className="space-y-4">
                      <div className="space-y-3">
                        <div className="space-y-1.5 text-left">
                          <label htmlFor="login-email" className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-200 px-0.5">Email</label>
                          <div className="relative">
                            <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-zinc-400" />
                            <Input
                              id="login-email"
                              type="email"
                              value={loginEmail}
                              onChange={(e) => setLoginEmail(e.target.value)}
                              required
                              placeholder="xyz@gmail.com"
                              className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-[#5c6672] bg-[#383f48] pl-10 pr-3 text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-500 transition-all focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[#b87a4a]/50 focus-visible:border-[#b87a4a]"
                              autoComplete="email"
                            />
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="space-y-1.5 text-left">
                          <label htmlFor="login-password" className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-200 px-0.5">Password</label>
                          <div className="relative">
                            <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-zinc-400" />
                            <Input
                              id="login-password"
                              type={showLoginPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                              value={loginPassword}
                              onChange={(e) => setLoginPassword(e.target.value)}
                              required
                              placeholder="Password"
                              className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-[#5c6672] bg-[#383f48] pl-10 pr-10 text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-500 transition-all focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[#b87a4a]/50 focus-visible:border-[#b87a4a]"
                              autoComplete="current-password"
                            />
                            <button type="button" className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400 hover:text-[#e8c4a8] transition-colors" onClick={() => setShowLoginPassword((v) => !v)}>
                              {showLoginPassword ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <Link href={forgotHref} className="text-xs font-medium text-[#e8c4a8] hover:text-white transition-all">
                          Forgot password?
                        </Link>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => { setActiveTab("signup"); setError(null); }} className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#e8c4a8] hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer">
                          Sign Up
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      <Button type="submit" disabled={loading} className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-[#b87a4a] hover:bg-[#a66d42] text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md transition-all active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-50">
                        {loading ? "Authenticating..." : "Sign In"}
                      </Button>
                    </form>
                  </TabsContent>

                  {/* ── SIGNUP TAB ── */}
                  <TabsContent value="signup" className="mt-0 outline-none">
                    {signupSuccess ? (
                      <div className="space-y-4 text-center py-4">
                        <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-green-900/30">
                          <svg className="h-7 w-7 text-green-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" /></svg>
                        </div>
                        <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-50">Check your email</h3>
                        <p className="text-xs text-zinc-300 leading-relaxed">We&apos;ve sent a confirmation link to <strong>{signupEmail}</strong>.</p>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => { setActiveTab("login"); setSignupSuccess(false); setError(null); }} className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#e8c4a8] hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer">← Back to Sign In</button>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <form onSubmit={handleSignup} className="space-y-4">
                        <div className="space-y-3">
                          <div className="space-y-1.5 text-left">
                            <label htmlFor="signup-name" className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-200 px-0.5">Full Name</label>
                            <div className="relative">
                              <UserPlus className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-zinc-400" />
                              <Input id="signup-name" type="text" value={signupFullName} onChange={(e) => setSignupFullName(e.target.value)} required placeholder="Your full name" className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-[#5c6672] bg-[#383f48] pl-10 pr-3 text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-500 transition-all focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[#b87a4a]/50" autoComplete="name" />
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div className="space-y-1.5 text-left">
                            <label htmlFor="signup-email" className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-200 px-0.5">Email</label>
                            <div className="relative">
                              <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-zinc-400" />
                              <Input id="signup-email" type="email" value={signupEmail} onChange={(e) => setSignupEmail(e.target.value)} required placeholder="xyz@gmail.com" className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-[#5c6672] bg-[#383f48] pl-10 pr-3 text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-500 transition-all focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[#b87a4a]/50" autoComplete="email" />
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div className="space-y-1.5 text-left">
                            <label htmlFor="signup-password" className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-200 px-0.5">Password</label>
                            <div className="relative">
                              <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-zinc-400" />
                              <Input id="signup-password" type={showSignupPassword ? "text" : "password"} value={signupPassword} onChange={(e) => setSignupPassword(e.target.value)} required placeholder="Min 6 characters" className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-[#5c6672] bg-[#383f48] pl-10 pr-10 text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-500 transition-all focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[#b87a4a]/50" autoComplete="new-password" />
                              <button type="button" className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400 hover:text-[#e8c4a8] transition-colors" onClick={() => setShowSignupPassword((v) => !v)}>{showSignupPassword ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}</button>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div className="space-y-1.5 text-left">
                            <label htmlFor="signup-confirm-password" className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-200 px-0.5">Confirm Password</label>
                            <div className="relative">
                              <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-zinc-400" />
                              <Input id="signup-confirm-password" type={showSignupConfirmPassword ? "text" : "password"} value={signupConfirmPassword} onChange={(e) => setSignupConfirmPassword(e.target.value)} required placeholder="Repeat password" className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-[#5c6672] bg-[#383f48] pl-10 pr-10 text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-500 transition-all focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[#b87a4a]/50" autoComplete="new-password" />
                              <button type="button" className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400 hover:text-[#e8c4a8] transition-colors" onClick={() => setShowSignupConfirmPassword((v) => !v)}>{showSignupConfirmPassword ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}</button>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <Button type="submit" disabled={loading} className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-[#b87a4a] hover:bg-[#a66d42] text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md transition-all active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-50">
                          {loading ? "Creating Account..." : "Sign Up"}
                        </Button>
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <button type="button" onClick={() => { setActiveTab("login"); setError(null); }} className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#e8c4a8] hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer">
                            Already have an account? <span className="underline">Sign In</span>
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </form>
                    )}
                  </TabsContent>
                </Tabs>

                {/* Divider */}
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="relative">
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center"><span className="w-full border-t border-[#5c6672]" /></div>
                    <div className="relative flex justify-center text-[10px] font-medium uppercase text-zinc-400">
                      <span className="px-3 bg-[#3e4650]">OR</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <Button type="button" variant="outline" className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[#5c6672] bg-[#343b43] font-medium text-zinc-100 transition-all hover:bg-[#3e4650]" disabled={loading} onClick={handleGoogleContinue}>
                    <GoogleIcon className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                    <span className="text-sm">Sign in with Google</span>
                  </Button>
                </div>

                {/* Powered by */}
                <p className="text-center text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400 pt-1">
                  Powered by <span className="text-[#E8541A] font-bold">NextGen CTO</span>
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  /* ─── GLOBAL MODE: original founder + circuit board layout ─── */
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "relative h-screen flex flex-col lg:flex-row overflow-hidden",
        bgPage,
        isDark ? "text-zinc-100" : "text-zinc-900",
      )}
    >
      {/* LEFT PANEL: HERO (Hidden on mobile) */}
      <div className={cn(
        "hidden lg:flex lg:w-[55%] flex-none relative overflow-hidden border-r",
        isDark ? "bg-[#0c0c0c] border-white/5" : "bg-gradient-to-br from-[#fdf6ee] via-[#fff9f2] to-[#fdf1e1] border-orange-100/50"
      )}>
        <div className="absolute left-[10%] top-[20%] z-0 h-[300px] w-[300px] rounded-full bg-orange-200/10 blur-[80px]" />
        <div className="absolute right-[10%] bottom-[20%] z-0 h-[300px] w-[300px] rounded-full bg-orange-200/10 blur-[80px]" />
        <svg className="absolute inset-0 z-0 h-full w-full opacity-[0.55]" viewBox="0 0 800 800" fill="none">
          <defs><linearGradient id="line-grad-g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0%" stopColor="#e0ac81" stopOpacity="0.9" /><stop offset="100%" stopColor="#ca8c64" stopOpacity="1" /></linearGradient></defs>
          <path d="M0 350 H224 V304" stroke="url(#line-grad-g)" strokeWidth="2.5" />
          <path d="M800 350 H576 V304" stroke="url(#line-grad-g)" strokeWidth="2.5" />
          <path d="M0 500 H176 V624" stroke="url(#line-grad-g)" strokeWidth="2.5" />
          <path d="M800 500 H704 V400" stroke="url(#line-grad-g)" strokeWidth="2.5" />
          <path d="M224 304 V450 H176" stroke="url(#line-grad-g)" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeDasharray="6 4" />
          <path d="M576 304 V400 H704" stroke="url(#line-grad-g)" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeDasharray="6 4" />
          <path d="M704 400 V560 H624" stroke="url(#line-grad-g)" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeDasharray="6 4" />
          <path d="M624 560 V624 H480" stroke="url(#line-grad-g)" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeDasharray="6 4" />
          <path d="M320 624 H480" stroke="url(#line-grad-g)" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeDasharray="6 4" />
          <path d="M176 624 H320" stroke="url(#line-grad-g)" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeDasharray="6 4" />
          <circle cx="224" cy="304" r="4" fill="#ca8c64" /><circle cx="176" cy="624" r="4" fill="#ca8c64" /><circle cx="576" cy="304" r="4" fill="#ca8c64" /><circle cx="704" cy="400" r="4" fill="#ca8c64" /><circle cx="624" cy="560" r="4" fill="#ca8c64" /><circle cx="320" cy="624" r="4" fill="#ca8c64" /><circle cx="480" cy="624" r="4" fill="#ca8c64" />
        </svg>
        <div className="absolute inset-0 z-10 pointer-events-none">
          <div className="absolute top-[38%] left-[28%] z-30 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"><div className={cn("flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full border shadow-lg backdrop-blur-md transition-transform hover:scale-110", isDark ? "border-[#E8541A]/40 bg-[#1a1a1a]/80 shadow-[#E8541A]/20" : "border-white/50 bg-[#fff9f2]/60")}><div className="relative"><User className={cn("h-6 w-6", isDark ? "text-[#E8541A]" : "text-[#ca8c64]")} /><Settings className={cn("absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 h-3 w-3 animate-spin-slow", isDark ? "text-orange-400" : "text-orange-800")} /></div></div></div>
          <div className="absolute top-[38%] left-[72%] z-30 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"><div className={cn("flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full border shadow-lg backdrop-blur-md transition-transform hover:scale-110", isDark ? "border-[#E8541A]/40 bg-[#1a1a1a]/80 shadow-[#E8541A]/20" : "border-white/50 bg-[#fff9f2]/60")}><BarChart3 className={cn("h-6 w-6", isDark ? "text-[#E8541A]" : "text-[#ca8c64]")} /></div></div>
          <div className="absolute top-[50%] left-[88%] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"><div className={cn("flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full border shadow-lg backdrop-blur-md", isDark ? "text-[#E8541A] fill-[#E8541A]/20" : "text-[#ca8c64] fill-[#ca8c64]/20")} /></div></div>
          <div className="absolute top-[70%] left-[78%] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"><div className={cn("flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full border shadow-lg backdrop-blur-md", isDark ? "border-[#E8541A]/40 bg-[#1a1a1a]/80 shadow-[#E8541A]/20" : "border-white/50 bg-[#fff9f2]/60")}><BookOpen className={cn("h-6 w-6", isDark ? "text-[#E8541A]" : "text-[#ca8c64]")} /></div></div>
        </div>
        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-[65%] flex items-end justify-center z-20"><Image src='/assets/founder.png' alt="Founder" fill className="object-contain object-bottom origin-bottom transition-all duration-700" priority /></div>
        <div className="absolute top-4 left-6 z-30 flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-4 duration-700">
          <Image src='/assets/nextgen-logo.png' alt="NextGen Logo" width={42} height={42} className="drop-shadow-md transition-transform hover:scale-110 duration-500" />
          <h2 className={cn("text-base font-bold tracking-tight", isDark ? "text-white" : "text-black")}>NextGen <span className={cn("font-black", isDark ? "text-[#E8541A]" : "text-black")}>CTO</span></h2>
        </div>
        <div className="absolute top-[10%] left-0 right-0 z-30 flex flex-col items-center text-center px-12">
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-[2.2rem] xl:text-[2.8rem] font-black leading-none tracking-tight uppercase"><span className="text-[#E8541A] drop-shadow-sm">LEARN FROM LEADERS.</span></h3>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-10">
              <div className="h-[1px] w-24 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-[#ca8c64]/40 to-transparent" />
              <h3 className={cn("text-[2rem] xl:text-[2.4rem] font-black leading-none tracking-tight uppercase", isDark ? "text-white/80" : "text-black/80")}>SHAPE THE FUTURE.</h3>
              <div className="h-[1px] w-24 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-[#ca8c64]/40 to-transparent" />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* RIGHT PANEL: AUTH FORM */}
      <div className="flex-1 relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center -mt-8">
        <AuthBackground isDark={isDark} />

          {isDark ? <Sun className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Moon className="h-4 w-4" />}

        <div className="w-full max-w-[380px] relative z-20 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-8 duration-1000">
          <div className={cn("relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-xl transition-all duration-500", isDark ? "bg-[#0c0c0c] border border-white/5 shadow-black/40" : "bg-white border border-slate-100 shadow-slate-200/50")}>
            <div className="space-y-6">
              <div className="space-y-1 text-center">
                <h1 className={cn("text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight", headingText)}>Welcome Future CTO</h1>
                <p className={cn("text-[13px] font-medium opacity-60", mutedText)}>Sign in to continue your leadership journey</p>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {message && !displayError && (<div className="rounded-lg border border-[#E8541A]/20 bg-[#E8541A]/0.05 p-2 text-center text-[10px] font-semibold text-[#c2410c] dark:text-[#ffb38a] animate-in zoom-in-95">{message}</div>)}
                {displayError && (<div className={cn("rounded-lg p-2 text-center text-[10px] font-semibold animate-in shake-1", isDark ? "border-red-500/20 bg-red-950/10 text-red-400" : "border-red-100 bg-red-50 text-red-600")}>{displayError}</div>)}
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <form onSubmit={handleLogin} className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    <div className="space-y-1.5 text-left">
                      <label htmlFor="login-email" className={cn("text-xs font-semibold px-0.5", headingText)}>Email</label>
                      <Input id="login-email" type="email" value={loginEmail} onChange={(e) => setLoginEmail(e.target.value)} required placeholder="xyz@gmail.com" className={cn("h-11 rounded-lg border px-3 transition-all placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:ring-1", isDark ? "border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-white" : "border-orange-100 bg-[#fcf8f1] text-zinc-900")} autoComplete="email" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1.5 text-left">
                      <label htmlFor="login-password" className={cn("text-xs font-semibold px-0.5", headingText)}>Password</label>
                      <div className="relative group">
                        <Input id="login-password" type={showLoginPassword ? "text" : "password"} value={loginPassword} onChange={(e) => setLoginPassword(e.target.value)} required placeholder="Password" className={cn("h-11 rounded-lg border px-3 transition-all placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:ring-1", isDark ? "border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-white" : "border-orange-100 bg-[#fcf8f1] text-zinc-900")} autoComplete="current-password" />
                        <button type="button" className={cn("absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2", iconMuted, "hover:text-[#E8541A] transition-colors")} onClick={() => setShowLoginPassword((v) => !v)}>{showLoginPassword ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}</button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-end">
                    <Link href={forgotHref} className="text-xs font-medium text-orange-800/80 hover:text-[#E8541A] transition-all">Forgot password?</Link>
                  </div>
                  <Button type="submit" disabled={loading} className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-[#c2541a] hover:bg-[#a84414] text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md transition-all active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-50">{loading ? "Authenticating..." : "Sign In"}</Button>
                </form>
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="relative">
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center"><span className="w-full border-t border-slate-100" /></div>
                    <div className="relative flex justify-center text-[10px] font-medium uppercase text-zinc-400"><span className="px-3 bg-white">OR</span></div>
                  </div>
                  <Button type="button" variant="outline" className={cn("h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 font-medium transition-all hover:bg-slate-50", isDark && "border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-white hover:bg-white/10")} disabled={loading} onClick={handleGoogleContinue}>
                    <GoogleIcon className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" /><span className="text-sm">Sign in with Google</span>
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client'

import * as React from 'react'
import { useState } from 'react'
import Image from 'next/image'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { Eye, EyeOff, Loader2, Mail, Lock, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'

export type PortalType = 'superadmin' | 'college' | 'student'

export interface UnifiedLoginFormProps {
  portalType: PortalType
  title: string
  subtitle: string
  tenantLabel?: string
  heroTitle: string
  heroSubtitle: string
  heroImage?: string
  badgeLabel: string
  forgotPasswordHref?: string
  showGoogleAuth?: boolean
  onGoogleAuth?: () => void
  isLoading?: boolean
  error?: string | null
  onSubmit?: (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => void
  emailValue?: string
  onEmailChange?: (v: string) => void
  passwordValue?: string
  onPasswordChange?: (v: string) => void
  children?: React.ReactNode
}

export function UnifiedLoginForm({
  portalType,
  title,
  subtitle,
  tenantLabel,
  heroTitle,
  heroSubtitle,
  heroImage = '/assets/amrita-campus-hero.jpg',
  badgeLabel,
  forgotPasswordHref = '/forgot-password',
  showGoogleAuth = true,
  onGoogleAuth,
  isLoading = false,
  error = null,
  onSubmit,
  emailValue,
  onEmailChange,
  passwordValue,
  onPasswordChange,
  children
}: UnifiedLoginFormProps) {
  const [localShowPassword, setLocalShowPassword] = useState(false)
  const isSuperAdmin = portalType === 'superadmin'

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen w-full flex flex-col lg:flex-row bg-background dark:bg-slate-950 text-foreground transition-colors duration-300">
      {/* LEFT SIDE - BRANDING / VALUE SECTION */}
      <div className="hidden lg:flex flex-1 relative bg-slate-900 border-r border-border/50 overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-950/70 z-10" />
        {heroImage && (
          <Image
            src={heroImage}
            alt="Login background"
            fill
            className="object-cover mix-blend-overlay opacity-50"
            priority
          />
        )}
        
        <div className="absolute inset-0 z-20 flex flex-col justify-between p-12 lg:p-16 text-white">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className={`h-10 w-10 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg font-bold text-lg shadow-lg ${isSuperAdmin ? 'bg-slate-800 text-white' : 'bg-orange-600 shadow-orange-900/20'}`}>
              N
            </div>
            <span className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">NextGen CTO</span>
          </div>
          
          <div className="space-y-6 max-w-xl mb-8">
            {tenantLabel && (
              <div className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1 text-sm font-medium backdrop-blur-md">
                {tenantLabel}
              </div>
            )}
            <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl xl:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white leading-[1.1]">
              {heroTitle}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-lg text-slate-300 font-medium max-w-md">
              {heroSubtitle}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* RIGHT SIDE - LOGIN FORM */}
      <div className="flex-[1.2] lg:flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 sm:p-12 lg:p-24 relative bg-surface dark:bg-slate-900/50">
        <div className="lg:hidden absolute top-6 left-6 flex items-center space-x-2">
          <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded-md bg-orange-600 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-white text-sm shadow-sm">
            N
          </div>
          <span className="font-bold tracking-tight">NextGen CTO</span>
        </div>

        <div className="w-full max-w-sm xl:max-w-md space-y-8 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-500 fill-mode-both">
          {/* Form Header */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
              <div className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 dark:bg-orange-500/10 dark:border-orange-500/20 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400">
                {badgeLabel}
              </div>
              {tenantLabel && (
                <div className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:border-slate-700 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                  {tenantLabel}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight">{title}</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-medium">
              {subtitle}
            </p>
          </div>

          {error && (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive rounded-md bg-destructive/10 px-3 py-2 border border-destructive/20 animate-in fade-in">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}

          {children ? (
            children
          ) : (
            <>
              <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-6">
                <div className="space-y-5">
                  <div className="space-y-2 group">
                    <label htmlFor="email" className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground/80 flex items-center gap-2 px-0.5">
                      <Mail className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> EMAIL ADDRESS
                    </label>
                    <Input 
                      id="email"
                      name="email"
                      type="email" 
                      placeholder="name@example.com" 
                      autoComplete="username"
                      required
                      value={emailValue}
                      onChange={(e) => onEmailChange?.(e.target.value)}
                      className="h-14 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/50 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 focus-visible:ring-orange-500/30 focus-visible:border-orange-500 transition-all shadow-sm text-base rounded-xl"
                      disabled={isLoading}
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-2 group">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-0.5">
                      <label htmlFor="password" className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground/80 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> PASSWORD
                      </label>
                      {forgotPasswordHref && (
                        <Link href={forgotPasswordHref} className="text-sm font-bold text-orange-600 hover:text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-500 dark:hover:text-orange-400 transition-colors">
                          Forgot?
                        </Link>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="relative">
                      <Input 
                        id="password"
                        name="password"
                        type={localShowPassword ? "text" : "password"} 
                        placeholder="••••••••" 
                        autoComplete="current-password"
                        required
                        value={passwordValue}
                        onChange={(e) => onPasswordChange?.(e.target.value)}
                        className="h-14 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/50 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 focus-visible:ring-orange-500/30 focus-visible:border-orange-500 transition-all pr-12 shadow-sm text-base rounded-xl"
                        disabled={isLoading}
                      />
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setLocalShowPassword(!localShowPassword)}
                        className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors focus:outline-none p-1 rounded-md"
                        aria-label={localShowPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
                      >
                        {localShowPassword ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <Button 
                  type="submit" 
                  className={`w-full h-14 text-lg font-bold text-white shadow-lg transition-all rounded-xl active:scale-[0.98] ${
                    isSuperAdmin 
                      ? 'bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 shadow-slate-900/20' 
                      : 'bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-700 shadow-orange-600/30'
                    }`}
                  disabled={isLoading}
                >
                  {isLoading ? (
                    <>
                      <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-5 w-5 animate-spin" />
                      Authenticating...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                      Sign In <ArrowRight className="w-5 h-5 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" />
                    </span>
                  )}
                </Button>
              </form>

              {showGoogleAuth && (
                <>
                  <div className="relative pt-2">
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center pt-2">
                      <span className="w-full border-t border-border" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="relative flex justify-center text-xs uppercase">
                      <span className="bg-surface dark:bg-slate-900/50 px-3 text-muted-foreground tracking-wider font-semibold">
                        Or continue with
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <Button 
                    variant="outline" 
                    type="button" 
                    disabled={isLoading}
                    className="w-full h-14 text-lg font-bold shadow-sm border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/80 transition-all rounded-xl hover:scale-[1.01] active:scale-[0.99] flex items-center justify-center gap-3"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (onGoogleAuth) onGoogleAuth()
                      else window.location.href = '/api/auth/google'
                    }}
                  >
                    <svg className="h-6 w-6" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                      <path d="M22.56 12.25c0-.78-.07-1.53-.2-2.25H12v4.26h5.92c-.26 1.37-1.04 2.53-2.21 3.31v2.77h3.57c2.08-1.92 3.28-4.74 3.28-8.09z" fill="#4285F4"/>
                      <path d="M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.57-2.77c-.98.66-2.23 1.06-3.71 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84C3.99 20.53 7.7 23 12 23z" fill="#34A853"/>
                      <path d="M5.84 14.09c-.22-.66-.35-1.36-.35-2.09s.13-1.43.35-2.09V7.07H2.18C1.43 8.55 1 10.22 1 12s.43 3.45 1.18 4.93l3.66-2.84z" fill="#FBBC05"/>
                      <path d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06 0.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.07l3.66 2.84c0.87-2.6 3.3-4.53 6.16-4.53z" fill="#EA4335"/>
                    </svg>
                    Continue with Google
                  </Button>

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/components/courses/enroll-button.tsx ---
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { CreditCard, Loader2, Lock } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  createGlobalCourseOrderAction,
  verifyGlobalCoursePaymentAction,
} from '@/app/c/[collegeSlug]/student/(authenticated)/pillars/[pillarSlug]/courses/[courseId]/actions';

interface EnrollButtonProps {
  collegeSlug: string;
  pillarSlug: string;
  courseId: string;
  priceMinor: number | null;
  currency?: string;
  isGlobal: boolean;
}

interface RazorpayResponse {
  razorpay_order_id: string;
  razorpay_payment_id: string;
  razorpay_signature: string;
}

declare global {
  interface Window {
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    Razorpay: any;
  }
}

export function EnrollButton({
  collegeSlug,
  pillarSlug,
  courseId,
  priceMinor,
  currency = 'INR',
  isGlobal,
}: EnrollButtonProps) {
  const [isPending, setIsPending] = useState(false);
  const [isRazorpayLoaded, setIsRazorpayLoaded] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();

  // Load Razorpay script
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    if (window.Razorpay) {
      setIsRazorpayLoaded(true);
      return;
    }

    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = 'https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js';
    script.async = true;
    script.onload = () => setIsRazorpayLoaded(true);
    document.body.appendChild(script);
  }, []);

  async function handleEnroll() {
    if (!isGlobal) {
      toast.error('This course is available through your college if assigned.');
      return;
    }

    if (!isRazorpayLoaded) {
      toast.error('Payment gateway is loading. Please try again in a moment.');
      return;
    }

    setIsPending(true);

    try {
      // 1. Create order
      const orderRes = await createGlobalCourseOrderAction(collegeSlug, pillarSlug, courseId);
      if (!orderRes.ok || !orderRes.data) {
        toast.error(orderRes.error ?? 'Failed to initiate enrollment');
        return;
      }

      const { order, gatewayOrder, razorpayKey } = orderRes.data as {
        order: { id: string; purchaser_email: string; purchaser_name: string | null };
        gatewayOrder: { amount_minor: number; currency: string; gateway_order_id: string };
        razorpayKey: string;
      };

      // 2. Open Razorpay Checkout
      const options = {
        key: razorpayKey,
        amount: gatewayOrder.amount_minor,
        currency: gatewayOrder.currency,
        name: 'Avesh LMS',
        description: `Enrollment for course`,
        order_id: gatewayOrder.gateway_order_id,
        handler: async (response: RazorpayResponse) => {
          setIsPending(true);
          try {
            // 3. Verify payment
            const verifyRes = await verifyGlobalCoursePaymentAction(collegeSlug, pillarSlug, courseId, {
              orderId: order.id,
              gatewayOrderId: response.razorpay_order_id,
              gatewayPaymentId: response.razorpay_payment_id,
              gatewaySignature: response.razorpay_signature,
            });

            if (verifyRes.ok) {
              toast.success('Enrollment successful! Redirecting...');
              router.refresh();
            } else {
              toast.error(verifyRes.error ?? 'Payment verification failed');
            }
          } catch {
            toast.error('Failed to verify payment');
          } finally {
            setIsPending(false);
          }
        },
        prefill: {
          email: order.purchaser_email,
          name: order.purchaser_name || '',
        },
        theme: {
          color: '#0f172a',
        },
        modal: {
          ondismiss: () => {
            setIsPending(false);
          },
        },
      };

      const rzp = new window.Razorpay(options);
      rzp.open();
    } catch {
      toast.error('An unexpected error occurred');
      setIsPending(false);
    }
  }

  if (!isGlobal) {
    return (
      <Button disabled className="rounded-full w-full sm:w-auto">
        <Lock className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
        Available through your college
      </Button>
    );
  }

  if (priceMinor === null) {
    return (
      <Button disabled className="rounded-full w-full sm:w-auto">
        <Lock className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
        Enrollment not available yet
      </Button>
    );
  }

  const priceDisplay = (priceMinor / 100).toLocaleString('en-IN', {
    style: 'currency',
    currency,
  });

  return (
    <Button
      onClick={handleEnroll}
      disabled={isPending}
      className="rounded-full w-full sm:w-auto font-bold px-8 h-12 text-lg shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all"
    >
      {isPending ? (
        <>
          <Loader2 className="h-5 w-5 mr-2 animate-spin" />
          Processing...
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <CreditCard className="h-5 w-5 mr-2" />
          Enroll Now — {priceDisplay}
        </>
      )}
    </Button>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/components/locked-pillar-appeal-modal.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { submitStudentModuleAppeal } from '@/lib/actions/module-appeal';
import type { StudentPillarModuleKey } from '@/lib/modules/get-student-module-access';

const MODULE_LABELS: Record<StudentPillarModuleKey, string> = {
  technical_bootcamp: 'CS Bootcamp',
  ai_modern_development: 'AI & Modern Development',
  behavioral_skills: 'Behavioral Skills',
  resume_interview: 'Resume & Interview',
  github_monitoring: 'GitHub Optimization',
  linkedin_optimization: 'LinkedIn Optimization',
};

export interface LockedPillarAppealModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  moduleKey: StudentPillarModuleKey;
  collegeSlug: string;
}

export function LockedPillarAppealModal({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  moduleKey,
  collegeSlug,
}: LockedPillarAppealModalProps) {
  const [subject, setSubject] = useState('');
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);

  const label = MODULE_LABELS[moduleKey];

  if (!open) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await submitStudentModuleAppeal(collegeSlug, moduleKey, subject.trim(), message.trim());
      if (result.ok) {
        setSuccess(true);
        setSubject('');
        setMessage('');
        setTimeout(() => {
          onOpenChange(false);
          setSuccess(false);
        }, 1500);
      } else {
        setError(result.error ?? 'Submission failed');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleOpenChange = (next: boolean) => {
    if (!next && !loading) {
      setError(null);
      setSuccess(false);
      setSubject('');
      setMessage('');
    }
    onOpenChange(next);
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Request access: {label}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            This section is not available for your account. You can request access and an administrator will review your request.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        {success ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-green-600 dark:text-green-400">Request submitted. We will review it shortly.</p>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            {error && (
              <p className="text-sm text-destructive" role="alert">
                {error}
              </p>
            )}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="appeal-subject">Subject</Label>
              <Input
                id="appeal-subject"
                value={subject}
                onChange={(e) => setSubject(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Short reason for request"
                required
                minLength={3}
                maxLength={200}
                disabled={loading}
                className="w-full"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="appeal-message">Message</Label>
              <textarea
                id="appeal-message"
                value={message}
                onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Describe why you need access..."
                required
                minLength={10}
                maxLength={2000}
                rows={4}
                disabled={loading}
                className="flex w-full resize-none rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
              />
            </div>
            <DialogFooter>
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => handleOpenChange(false)} disabled={loading}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={loading}>
                {loading ? 'Submitting…' : 'Submit request'}
              </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </form>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/components/shared/breadcrumbs.tsx ---
'use client';

import React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { Home } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Breadcrumb,
  BreadcrumbItem,
  BreadcrumbLink,
  BreadcrumbList,
  BreadcrumbPage,
  BreadcrumbSeparator,
} from '@/components/ui/breadcrumb';

/**
 * Configuration for "Dead-End" or "Redirect" routes in breadcrumbs.
 * - 'disabled': The segment shows as text but isn't clickable.
 * - 'redirect': Clicking the segment takes you to a specific child page.
 */
const ROUTE_CONFIG: Record<string, { mode: 'disabled' | 'redirect', to?: string }> = {
  'c': { mode: 'disabled' }, // /c is structural
  'student': { mode: 'redirect', to: '/courses' }, // clicking /student goes to /student/courses
};

export function Breadcrumbs() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const pathSegments = pathname.split('/').filter((segment) => segment !== '');
  
  return (
    <Breadcrumb className="mb-4">
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink asChild>
            <Link href="/" className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Home className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span className="sr-only">Home</span>
            </Link>
          </BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        
        {pathSegments.length > 0 && <BreadcrumbSeparator />}

        {pathSegments.map((segment, index) => {
          const href = `/${pathSegments.slice(0, index + 1).join('/')}`;
          const isLast = index === pathSegments.length - 1;
          
          const isCollegeSlug = index > 0 && pathSegments[index-1] === 'c';
          
          const config = ROUTE_CONFIG[segment.toLowerCase()];
          const isDisabled = config?.mode === 'disabled' || isCollegeSlug;
          
          let finalHref = href;
          if (config?.mode === 'redirect' && config.to) {
            finalHref = `${href}${config.to}`;
          }

          const label = segment
            .split('-')
            .map((word) => word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1))
            .join(' ');

          return (
            <React.Fragment key={href}>
              <BreadcrumbItem>
                {isLast || isDisabled ? (
                  <BreadcrumbPage className={isDisabled ? "text-muted-foreground/60 cursor-default" : ""}>
                    {label}
                  </BreadcrumbPage>
                ) : (
                  <BreadcrumbLink asChild>
                    <Link href={finalHref}>{label}</Link>
                  </BreadcrumbLink>
                )}
              </BreadcrumbItem>
              {!isLast && <BreadcrumbSeparator />}
            </React.Fragment>
          );
        })}
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}

import React from 'react';

interface PageHeaderProps {
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  actions?: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Standardized page header with title, optional description, and action slot.
 * Mobile: stacked. Desktop: row layout with actions pushed right.
 */
export function PageHeader({
  title,
  description,
  actions,
  className,
}: PageHeaderProps) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4",
        className
      )}

      <div className="space-y-1 min-w-0">

          {title}
        </h1>

          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>
        )}
      </div>
      {actions && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/components/sidebar.tsx ---
"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { useTenant } from "@/providers/tenant-provider";
import {
    LayoutDashboard,
    BookOpen,
    FolderKanban,
    Users,
    ShieldCheck,
    Activity,
    ChevronRight,
    Monitor,
    MessageSquare,
    FileText,
    Github,
    Linkedin,
    Library,
    Briefcase,
    Lock,
    BarChart3,
    Sparkles,
} from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { sidebarTokens } from "@/components/sidebar-styles";
import { Sheet, SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetTitle } from "@/components/ui/sheet";
import {
    Sidebar as ShadcnSidebar,
    SidebarContent,
    SidebarHeader,
    SidebarGroup,
    SidebarMenu,
    SidebarMenuButton,
    SidebarMenuItem,
    SidebarMenuSub,
    SidebarMenuSubItem,
    SidebarMenuSubButton,
    SidebarRail,
    useSidebar,
} from "@/components/ui/sidebar";
import { LockedPillarAppealModal } from "@/components/locked-pillar-appeal-modal";
import {
    type StudentPillarModuleKey,
    getModuleKeyFromPillarHref,
} from "@/lib/modules/get-student-module-access";

import type { MasterCoursePillarsRow } from "@/types/database";

// ── LMS Student Nav Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────
// This is the SINGLE source of truth for student navigation.
// Both desktop (SidebarContentUnified) and mobile (MobileSidebarContent)
// derive their items from these arrays.  Do NOT duplicate them.
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Default pillar icons mapping
const DEFAULT_PILLAR_ICONS: Record<string, React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>> = {
    "technical-bootcamp": Monitor,
    "ai-modern-development": Sparkles,
    "github-monitoring": Github,
    "linkedin-optimization": Linkedin,
    "resume-interview": FileText,
    "behavioral-skills": MessageSquare,
};

type PillarNavItem = {
    name: string;
    href: string;
    icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
    moduleKey: StudentPillarModuleKey | null;
    subline: string | null;
};

// Helper to map DB pillars to sidebar format
function getDynamicPillars(dbPillars: MasterCoursePillarsRow[]): PillarNavItem[] {
    return dbPillars.map((p) => ({
        name: p.title,
        href: `/pillars/${p.slug}`,
        icon: DEFAULT_PILLAR_ICONS[p.slug] || BookOpen,
        moduleKey: getModuleKeyFromPillarHref(p.slug),
        subline: p.short_description?.trim() || null,
    }));
}

// Main nav items (approved structure)
const navItems = [
    { name: "Courses", href: "/courses", icon: Library },
    { name: "Projects & Portfolio", href: "/projects", icon: FolderKanban },
    { name: "Placements", href: "/placements", icon: Briefcase },
    { name: "Readiness", href: "/readiness", icon: ShieldCheck },
    { name: "Mentorship", href: "/mentorship", icon: Users },
];

const insightsItems = [
    { name: "Analytics", href: "/analytics", icon: BarChart3 },
    { name: "Activity", href: "/activity", icon: Activity },
];

// Locked pillar nav item
function LockedPillarNavItem({
    item,
    basePath,
    pathname,
    onLockedClick,
}: {
    item: PillarNavItem;
    basePath: string;
    pathname: string;
    onLockedClick: (moduleKey: StudentPillarModuleKey) => void;
}) {
    const Icon = item.icon;
    const href = basePath ? `${basePath}${item.href}` : item.href;
    const { studentModuleAccess } = useTenant();
    const locked =
        item.moduleKey !== null && studentModuleAccess[item.moduleKey] === false;

    const labelBlock = (
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-start gap-0 text-left">
            <span className="truncate w-full">{item.name}</span>
            {item.subline ? (
                <span
                    className="truncate max-w-[11rem] text-[10px] leading-tight text-sidebar-foreground/50 font-normal"
                    title={item.subline}
                >
                    {item.subline}
                </span>
            ) : null}
        </div>
    );

    if (locked && item.moduleKey !== null) {
        return (
            <SidebarMenuSubItem>
                <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onLockedClick(item.moduleKey!)}
                    className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-sm text-sidebar-foreground/70 hover:text-sidebar-foreground cursor-pointer"
                >
                    <Icon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 self-start mt-0.5" />
                    {labelBlock}
                    <Lock className="h-3 w-3 ml-auto shrink-0 self-start mt-1 text-sidebar-foreground/40" />
                </button>
            </SidebarMenuSubItem>
        );
    }

    const isActive = pathname === href;

    return (
        <SidebarMenuSubItem>
            <SidebarMenuSubButton asChild isActive={isActive}>
                <Link href={href} title={item.subline || undefined}>
                    <Icon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 self-start mt-0.5" />
                    {labelBlock}
                </Link>
            </SidebarMenuSubButton>
        </SidebarMenuSubItem>
    );
}

// Pillars collapsible group
function PillarsGroup({
    basePath,
    pathname,
    onLockedClick,
    visiblePillars = [],
}: {
    basePath: string;
    pathname: string;
    onLockedClick: (moduleKey: StudentPillarModuleKey) => void;
    visiblePillars?: MasterCoursePillarsRow[];
}) {
    const { state } = useSidebar();
    const isCollapsed = state === "collapsed";
    const pillars = getDynamicPillars(visiblePillars);

    const isAnyActive = pillars.some((p) => {
        const href = basePath ? `${basePath}${p.href}` : p.href;
        return pathname === href;
    });
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(isAnyActive);

    if (pillars.length === 0) return null;

    return (
        <SidebarMenuItem>
            <SidebarMenuButton
                onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
                tooltip="Pillars"
                isActive={isAnyActive}
                className={cn(sidebarTokens.navItem.base, isAnyActive ? sidebarTokens.navItem.active : sidebarTokens.navItem.inactive, isCollapsed && sidebarTokens.navItem.collapsed)}
            >
                <div
                    className={cn(sidebarTokens.iconBox.base, isAnyActive ? sidebarTokens.iconBox.active : sidebarTokens.iconBox.inactive)}
                >
                    <BookOpen className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                </div>
                <span className={cn("text-sm font-medium truncate", isAnyActive && "text-primary", isCollapsed && "hidden")}>Pillars</span>
                <ChevronRight
                    className={cn(
                        "ml-auto h-3.5 w-3.5 transition-transform duration-200",
                        isOpen && "rotate-90",
                        isCollapsed && "hidden"
                    )}
                />
            </SidebarMenuButton>
            {isOpen && !isCollapsed && (
                <SidebarMenuSub className="ml-2 border-l-0 pl-2">
                    {pillars.map((p) => (
                        <LockedPillarNavItem
                            key={p.href}
                            item={p}
                            basePath={basePath}
                            pathname={pathname}
                            onLockedClick={onLockedClick}
                        />
                    ))}
                </SidebarMenuSub>
            )}
        </SidebarMenuItem>
    );
}

// Regular nav link with unified active state
function UnifiedNavLink({
    href,
    icon: Icon,
    label,
    active,
}: {
    href: string;
    icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
    label: string;
    active: boolean;
}) {
    const { state } = useSidebar();
    const isCollapsed = state === "collapsed";

    return (
        <SidebarMenuItem>
            <SidebarMenuButton
                asChild
                isActive={active}
                tooltip={label}
                className={cn(sidebarTokens.navItem.base, active ? sidebarTokens.navItem.active : sidebarTokens.navItem.inactive, isCollapsed && sidebarTokens.navItem.collapsed)}
            >
                <Link href={href}>
                    {active && (
                        <div className="absolute left-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[3px] h-5 bg-gradient-to-b from-primary to-primary/60 rounded-r-full" />
                    )}
                    <div
                        className={cn(sidebarTokens.iconBox.base, active ? sidebarTokens.iconBox.active : sidebarTokens.iconBox.inactive)}
                    >
                        <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </div>
                    <span className={cn("text-sm font-medium truncate", active && "text-primary", isCollapsed && "hidden")}>{label}</span>
                </Link>
            </SidebarMenuButton>
        </SidebarMenuItem>
    );
}

function SidebarContentUnified({
    tenantName,
    visiblePillars = [],
}: {
    tenantName?: string;
    visiblePillars?: MasterCoursePillarsRow[];
}) {
    const pathname = usePathname();
    const { branding, slug } = useTenant();
    const { state } = useSidebar();
    const isCollapsed = state === "collapsed";
    const basePath = slug ? `/c/${slug}/student` : "";
    const [appealModalModule, setAppealModalModule] = useState<StudentPillarModuleKey | null>(null);

    const currentPath = basePath || "/";
    const isDashboardActive = pathname === currentPath;

    return (
        <>
            <ShadcnSidebar collapsible="icon" className="border-r border-sidebar-border/50 bg-sidebar/60 backdrop-blur-2xl">
                <SidebarHeader className="border-b border-sidebar-border/40 py-3 px-2 sm:px-3">
                    <div className={cn("flex items-center gap-2.5 px-2", isCollapsed && "justify-center px-0")}>
                        <div className={sidebarTokens.brandIcon.base}>
                            <BookOpen className="h-5 w-5" />
                        </div>
                        <div className={cn("min-w-0 flex-1 transition-opacity duration-200", isCollapsed && "opacity-0 hidden")}>
                            <div className="font-bold text-sm leading-tight truncate">{tenantName || branding.name}</div>
                            <div className="text-xs text-sidebar-foreground/60 truncate">{branding.shortName ?? "Student portal"}</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </SidebarHeader>

                <SidebarContent className="px-2 sm:px-3 py-1.5 sm:py-2 scrollbar-hide">
                    <SidebarGroup className="p-0">
                        <SidebarMenu className="gap-1.5">
                            <UnifiedNavLink
                                href={basePath || "/"}
                                icon={LayoutDashboard}
                                label="Dashboard"
                                active={isDashboardActive}
                            />
                            <PillarsGroup
                                key={pathname}
                                basePath={basePath}
                                pathname={pathname}
                                onLockedClick={setAppealModalModule}
                                visiblePillars={visiblePillars}
                            />
                            {navItems.map((item) => {
                                const href = basePath ? `${basePath}${item.href}` : item.href;
                                const isActive = pathname === href;
                                return (
                                    <UnifiedNavLink
                                        key={item.href}
                                        href={href}
                                        icon={item.icon}
                                        label={item.name}
                                        active={isActive}
                                    />
                                );
                            })}
                            {insightsItems.map((item) => {
                                const href = basePath ? `${basePath}${item.href}` : item.href;
                                const isActive = pathname === href;
                                return (
                                    <UnifiedNavLink
                                        key={item.href}
                                        href={href}
                                        icon={item.icon}
                                        label={item.name}
                                        active={isActive}
                                    />
                                );
                            })}
                        </SidebarMenu>
                    </SidebarGroup>
                </SidebarContent>

                <SidebarRail />
            </ShadcnSidebar>

            {appealModalModule && slug && (
                <LockedPillarAppealModal
                    open={!!appealModalModule}
                    onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setAppealModalModule(null)}
                    moduleKey={appealModalModule}
                    collegeSlug={slug}
                />
            )}
        </>
    );
}

// Mobile sidebar content
function MobileSidebarContent({
    tenantName,
    basePath,
    pathname,
    onLockedClick,
    visiblePillars = [],
}: {
    tenantName?: string;
    basePath: string;
    pathname: string;
    onLockedClick: (moduleKey: StudentPillarModuleKey) => void;
    visiblePillars?: MasterCoursePillarsRow[];
}) {
    const { branding, studentModuleAccess } = useTenant();
    const [pillarsOpen, setPillarsOpen] = useState(
        basePath && pathname.startsWith(`${basePath}/pillars`)
    );
    const pillars = getDynamicPillars(visiblePillars);

    return (
        <div className="flex h-full flex-col p-3">
            {/* Brand */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-2 border-b border-sidebar-border/40 py-3 sm:px-3 mb-3">
                <div className={sidebarTokens.brandIcon.base}>
                    <BookOpen className="h-5 w-5" />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="font-bold text-sm leading-tight truncate">{tenantName || branding.name}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-sidebar-foreground/60 truncate">{branding.shortName ?? "Student portal"}</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Nav */}
            <div className="flex-1 space-y-1.5 overflow-y-auto">
                {/* Dashboard */}
                <MobileNavLink
                    href={basePath || "/"}
                    icon={LayoutDashboard}
                    label="Dashboard"
                    active={pathname === (basePath || "/")}
                />

                {/* Pillars */}
                {pillars.length > 0 && (
                    <>
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setPillarsOpen(!pillarsOpen)}
                            className={cn(sidebarTokens.navItem.base, (basePath && pathname.startsWith(`${basePath}/pillars`)) ? sidebarTokens.navItem.active : sidebarTokens.navItem.inactive)}
                        >
                            <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 bg-sidebar-accent/60 border border-sidebar-border/50">
                                <BookOpen className="h-4 w-4" />
                            </div>
                            <span className="flex-1 truncate text-left">Pillars</span>
                            <ChevronRight className={cn("h-3.5 w-3.5 transition-transform duration-200", pillarsOpen && "rotate-90")} />
                        </button>

                        {pillarsOpen && (
                            <div className="space-y-1.5 pl-4">
                                {pillars.map((p) => {
                                    const href = basePath ? `${basePath}${p.href}` : p.href;
                                    const locked =
                                        p.moduleKey !== null &&
                                        studentModuleAccess[p.moduleKey] === false;
                                    const isActive = pathname === href;
                                    const Icon = p.icon;
                                    if (locked && p.moduleKey !== null) {
                                        return (
                                            <button
                                                key={p.href}
                                                type="button"
                                                onClick={() => onLockedClick(p.moduleKey!)}
                                                className="flex w-full gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-sm text-sidebar-foreground/70 hover:text-sidebar-foreground cursor-pointer"
                                            >
                                                <Icon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 self-start mt-0.5" />
                                                <span className="flex-1 min-w-0 flex flex-col items-start text-left">
                                                    <span className="truncate w-full">{p.name}</span>
                                                    {p.subline ? (
                                                        <span
                                                            className="truncate w-full text-[10px] text-sidebar-foreground/50 mt-0.5"
                                                            title={p.subline}
                                                        >
                                                            {p.subline}
                                                        </span>
                                                    ) : null}
                                                </span>
                                                <Lock className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0 self-start mt-1 text-sidebar-foreground/40" />
                                            </button>
                                        );
                                    }
                                    return (
                                        <MobileNavLink
                                            key={p.href}
                                            href={href}
                                            icon={Icon}
                                            label={p.name}
                                            pillarSubline={p.subline}
                                            active={isActive}
                                            indent
                                        />
                                    );
                                })}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </>
                )}

                {/* Career items */}
                {navItems.map((item) => {
                    const href = basePath ? `${basePath}${item.href}` : item.href;
                    return (
                        <MobileNavLink
                            key={item.href}
                            href={href}
                            icon={item.icon}
                            label={item.name}
                            active={pathname === href}
                        />
                    );
                })}

                {/* Insights */}
                {insightsItems.map((item) => {
                    const href = basePath ? `${basePath}${item.href}` : item.href;
                    return (
                        <MobileNavLink
                            key={item.href}
                            href={href}
                            icon={item.icon}
                            label={item.name}
                            active={pathname === href}
                        />
                    );
                })}
            </div>

        </div>
    );
}

function MobileNavLink({
    href,
    icon: Icon,
    label,
    active,
    indent = false,
    pillarSubline = null,
}: {
    href: string;
    icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
    label: string;
    active: boolean;
    indent?: boolean;
    pillarSubline?: string | null;
}) {
    return (
        <Link
            href={href}
            title={pillarSubline || undefined}
            className={cn(sidebarTokens.navItem.base, indent && "pl-7", active ? sidebarTokens.navItem.active : sidebarTokens.navItem.inactive)}
        >
            {active && (
                <div className="absolute left-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[3px] h-5 bg-gradient-to-b from-primary to-primary/60 rounded-r-full" />
            )}
            <div className={cn(sidebarTokens.iconBox.base, active ? sidebarTokens.iconBox.active : sidebarTokens.iconBox.inactive)}>
                <Icon className="h-4 w-4" />
            </div>
            <span className="flex flex-col items-start gap-0 min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span className={cn("truncate text-sm font-medium", active && "text-primary")}>{label}</span>
                {pillarSubline ? (
                    <span className="truncate text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-normal">{pillarSubline}</span>
                ) : null}
            </span>
        </Link>
    );
}

// Export the main sidebar
export function Sidebar({ tenantName, visiblePillars = [] }: { tenantName?: string; visiblePillars?: MasterCoursePillarsRow[] }) {
    return <SidebarContentUnified tenantName={tenantName} visiblePillars={visiblePillars} />;
}
