/**
 * Extract LmsPageId from pathname using exact prefix matching.
 */
export function getLmsPageIdFromPath(pathname: string): LmsPageId {
    if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/dashboard' || pathname.endsWith('/student') || pathname.endsWith('/student/')) return 'dashboard';
    if (pathname.includes('/courses')) return 'courses';
    if (pathname.startsWith('/pillars') || pathname.includes('/pillars/')) return 'pillars';
    if (pathname.includes('/projects')) return 'projects';
    if (pathname.includes('/placements')) return 'placements';
    if (pathname.includes('/readiness')) return 'readiness';
    if (pathname.includes('/mentorship')) return 'mentorship';
    if (pathname.includes('/analytics')) return 'analytics';
    if (pathname.includes('/activity')) return 'activity';
    if (pathname.includes('/profile')) return 'profile';

    return 'dashboard';
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/docs/email-adapter.md ---
# Email Adapter (LMS)

## Purpose

This adapter provides a provider-agnostic email foundation so future transactional emails can use a single internal `sendEmail(input)` API.

## Current Phase Status

Adapter exists, but existing auth/invite/reset callers are not migrated in this phase.

## Important Boundary

Supabase Auth invite/password reset emails are still controlled by Supabase SMTP.

## Environment Variables

- `EMAIL_PROVIDER` (`sendgrid` or `resend`, defaults to `sendgrid`)
- `EMAIL_FROM`
- `EMAIL_REPLY_TO` (optional)
- `SENDGRID_API_KEY`
- `RESEND_API_KEY`
- `EMAIL_DRY_RUN`
- `SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL` (fallback sender when `EMAIL_FROM` is not set)

## Provider Switch Checklist

For Resend:

- `EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend`
- `RESEND_API_KEY=...`
- `EMAIL_FROM=...`
- Verify DNS/domain in Resend
- Submit test invite/transaction path only in controlled environment
- Run `npm run email:test -- --to someone@example.com`

For SendGrid:

- `EMAIL_PROVIDER=sendgrid`
- `SENDGRID_API_KEY=...`
- `EMAIL_FROM=...` (or `SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL=...`)
- Verify sender/domain authentication in SendGrid
- Submit test invite/transaction path only in controlled environment
- Run `npm run email:test -- --to someone@example.com`

## Dry Run

Set `EMAIL_DRY_RUN=true` to skip real provider calls. Adapter returns success with `messageId=dry_run`.

## CLI Test

```bash
npm run email:test -- --to someone@example.com
```

## Rollback

Set `EMAIL_PROVIDER=sendgrid` and redeploy.

## Provider SDK Import Boundary

Direct SDK imports must remain only in:

- `lib/email/providers/sendgrid.ts`
- `lib/email/providers/resend.ts`

--- END FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/docs/email-adapter.md ---

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/EMAIL_ADAPTER.md ---
# Email Adapter (LMS)

## Purpose

This adapter provides a provider-agnostic email foundation so future transactional emails can use a single internal `sendEmail(input)` API.

## Current Phase Status

Adapter exists, but auth/invite/reset callers are not migrated.

## Supabase Boundary

Supabase Auth invite/password reset emails are still controlled by Supabase SMTP.

## Supabase Auth Email Boundary

- Student invite emails are controlled by Supabase Auth templates.
- Password reset emails are controlled by Supabase Auth templates.
- These flows are intentionally not migrated to the app email adapter.
- The app email adapter is only for future app-owned transactional emails.
- Do not create duplicate student invite emails from the adapter unless explicitly approved.

## Environment Variables

- `EMAIL_PROVIDER`
- `EMAIL_FROM`
- `EMAIL_REPLY_TO`
- `SENDGRID_API_KEY`
- `RESEND_API_KEY`
- `EMAIL_DRY_RUN`
- `SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL` (fallback sender when `EMAIL_FROM` is not set)

## Dry Run Commands

```bash
EMAIL_DRY_RUN=true EMAIL_PROVIDER=sendgrid EMAIL_FROM="NextGen CTO <no-reply@example.com>" npm run email:test -- --to test@example.com
EMAIL_DRY_RUN=true EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend EMAIL_FROM="NextGen CTO <no-reply@example.com>" npm run email:test -- --to test@example.com
```

## Rollback

Set `EMAIL_PROVIDER=sendgrid` and redeploy.

## Provider SDK Import Boundary

- `@sendgrid/mail` only inside `lib/email/providers/sendgrid.ts`
- `resend` only inside `lib/email/providers/resend.ts`

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/hooks/use-mobile.ts ---
import * as React from 'react'

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768

const QUERY = `(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`

/**
 * Hydration-safe mobile detection: server + first hydrate pass assume desktop (`false`).
 * After hydration, resolves to viewport `matchMedia` so Sidebar can switch Sheet vs rail
 * without changing Radix subtree order mid-hydrate (which breaks `useId` / Dropdown ids).
 */
export function useIsMobile() {
  const subscribe = React.useCallback((onStoreChange: () => void) => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia(QUERY)
    mq.addEventListener('change', onStoreChange)
    return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', onStoreChange)
  }, [])

  const getSnapshot = React.useCallback(() => window.matchMedia(QUERY).matches, [])

  const getServerSnapshot = React.useCallback(() => false, [])

  return React.useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getServerSnapshot)
}

--- END FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/hooks/use-mobile.ts ---

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/actions/change-college-from-unknown.ts ---
"use server";

/**
 * Legacy **unknown-college** migration only (`colleges.slug = 'unknown'`).
 *
 * - Moves the student from the internal `unknown` tenant to a **real partner** `colleges` row by name match;
 *   this is not the same as B2C **direct learner** provisioning (`direct-learners` / `non_partnered_students`).
 * - New B2C signups must **never** rely on this path; they use `ensureDirectLearnerStudent` and self-reported
 *   school metadata only (no new `colleges` rows from student typing).
 *
 * For B2C self-reported school (metadata only), see `updateNonPartneredStudentCollege`.
 */

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { getSession } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { requireStudentAction } from "@/lib/auth/require-student-action";
import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { consumeRateLimit } from "@/lib/security/rate-limit";

/** Strip characters that would act as SQL LIKE wildcards in ilike patterns. */
function sanitizeForLikePattern(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/[%_\\]/g, "").trim();
}

/**
 * Move the current user from the **legacy unknown** tenant to another **existing partner** college,
 * resolved by **name** (typed manually). Prefers an exact case-insensitive name match; if several
 * rows match a partial search, the user must enter the full official name.
 */
export async function changeCollegeFromUnknown(collegeName: string) {
  const { session } = await getSession();
  if (!session?.user) {
    return { error: "Not authenticated" };
  }

  const authContext = await requireStudentAction('unknown');
  if (!authContext) {
    return { error: "You do not have access to the unknown college." };
  }

  const trimmed = collegeName.trim();
  if (trimmed.length < 2) {
    return { error: "Enter your full college name." };
  }

  const limited = await consumeRateLimit({
    key: `change-college:${session.user.id}`,
    limit: 5,
    windowMs: 60 * 60 * 1000,
    failClosed: true,
  });
  if (!limited.ok) return { error: `Too many requests. Retry in ${limited.retryAfterSeconds}s.` };

  console.log(`[change-college] User ${session.user.id.slice(0, 8)}… attempting college change`);

  const admin = createAdminClient();

  const { data: unknownCollege, error: unknownErr } = await admin
    .from("colleges")
    .select("id")
    .eq("slug", "unknown")
    .eq("status", "active")
    .maybeSingle();

  if (unknownErr || !unknownCollege?.id) {
    console.error('[change-college] Unknown college fetch failed:', unknownErr?.code ?? 'not found');
    return { error: "Unknown college is not configured." };
  }

  const safePattern = sanitizeForLikePattern(trimmed);
  if (safePattern.length < 2) {
    return { error: "Enter a valid college name." };
  }

  const { data: rows, error: listErr } = await admin
    .from("colleges")
    .select("id, slug, name")
    .eq("status", "active")
    .neq("slug", "unknown")
    .ilike("name", `%${safePattern}%`);

  if (listErr) {
    console.error(`[change-college] list by name error:`, listErr.code ?? 'unknown');
    return { error: "Could not look up colleges. Try again." };
  }

  const candidates = rows ?? [];

  const exact = candidates.find(
    (c) => c.name.toLowerCase() === trimmed.toLowerCase(),
  );
  let targetCollege: { id: string; slug: string; name: string } | null = null;
  
  if (exact) {
    targetCollege = exact;
  } else if (candidates.length === 1) {
    targetCollege = candidates[0];
  }

  // If we found a real tenant, execute the tenant migration
  if (targetCollege) {
    if (targetCollege.id === unknownCollege.id) {
      return { error: "Choose a different college." };
    }

    const { data: membership } = await admin
      .from("college_memberships")
      .select("id, role, status")
      .eq("user_id", session.user.id)
      .eq("college_id", unknownCollege.id)
      .eq("role", "student")
      .in("status", ["active", "invited"])
      .maybeSingle();

    if (!membership?.id) {
      console.log(`[change-college] Membership not found for user ${session.user.id.slice(0, 8)}…`);
      return { error: "You are not registered under Unknown college." };
    }

    const { error: memUpsertErr } = await admin.from("college_memberships").upsert(
      {
        user_id: session.user.id,
        college_id: targetCollege.id,
        role: membership.role || 'student',
        status: membership.status || 'active',
      },
      { onConflict: "user_id,college_id" }
    );

    if (memUpsertErr) {
      console.error("[change-college] membership upsert failed", memUpsertErr.code ?? 'unknown');
      return { error: "Could not update your college membership." };
    }

    await admin
      .from("college_memberships")
      .delete()
      .eq("id", membership.id);

    const { error: stuUpsertErr } = await admin.from("students").upsert(
      {
        user_id: session.user.id,
        college_id: targetCollege.id,
      },
      { onConflict: "user_id,college_id" }
    );

    if (stuUpsertErr) {
      console.error("[change-college] student upsert failed", stuUpsertErr.code ?? 'unknown');
      return { error: "Could not provision your student record in the new college." };
    }

    const { error: stuDelErr } = await admin
      .from("students")
      .delete()
      .eq("user_id", session.user.id)
      .eq("college_id", unknownCollege.id);

    if (stuDelErr) {
      console.warn("[change-college] could not delete old unknown student record", stuDelErr.code ?? 'unknown');
    }

    revalidatePath(`/c/unknown`, "layout");
    revalidatePath(`/c/${encodeURIComponent(targetCollege.slug)}`, "layout");
    redirect(`/c/${encodeURIComponent(targetCollege.slug)}/student/profile?college_updated=1`);
  } 
  
  // Custom fallback: Save the entered string as a custom college name
  const { error: customUpdateErr } = await admin
    .from("students")
    .upsert(
      { 
        user_id: session.user.id,
        college_id: unknownCollege.id,
        custom_college_name: trimmed 
      },
      { onConflict: "user_id,college_id" }
    );
    
  if (customUpdateErr) {
    console.error("[change-college] Failed to save custom college name", customUpdateErr.code ?? 'unknown');
    return { error: "Could not save your custom college name." };
  }
  
  // Custom names stay in the unknown college tenant
  revalidatePath(`/c/unknown`, "layout");
  redirect(`/c/unknown/student/profile?college_updated=1`);
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/actions/module-appeal.ts ---
'use server';

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { requireStudentAction } from '@/lib/auth/require-student-action';
import { PILLAR_MODULE_KEYS, type StudentPillarModuleKey } from '@/lib/modules/get-student-module-access';

export type SubmitAppealResult = { ok: true } | { ok: false; error: string };

const VALID_MODULE_KEYS = new Set(PILLAR_MODULE_KEYS);

export async function submitStudentModuleAppeal(
  collegeSlug: string,
  moduleKey: string,
  subject: string,
  message: string
): Promise<SubmitAppealResult> {
  const context = await requireStudentAction(collegeSlug);
  if (!context) return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized or invalid tenant' };

  if (!VALID_MODULE_KEYS.has(moduleKey as StudentPillarModuleKey)) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Invalid module' };
  }

  const { user, tenant, membership } = context;

  if (membership.role !== 'student') {
    return { ok: false, error: 'You are not a student at this college.' };
  }

  const sub = (subject ?? '').trim();
  const msg = (message ?? '').trim();
  if (!sub || sub.length < 3) return { ok: false, error: 'Subject must be at least 3 characters.' };
  if (!msg || msg.length < 10) return { ok: false, error: 'Message must be at least 10 characters.' };

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { error } = await supabase.from('module_access_appeals').insert({
    college_id: tenant.id,
    module_key: moduleKey,
    requester_user_id: user.id,
    requester_role: 'student',
    subject: sub,
    message: msg,
    status: 'pending',
  });

  if (error) return { ok: false, error: error.message ?? 'Failed to submit request.' };
  return { ok: true };
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/actions/placements.ts ---
'use server';

import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
import { z } from 'zod';
import {
  updatePlacementProfile,
  createApplication,
  createOffer,
  uploadPlacementFile,
  createResumeVersion,
  createPlacementDocument,
} from '@/lib/services/placements';
import { consumeRateLimit } from '@/lib/security/rate-limit';

function getPlacementsPath(collegeSlug: string | null) {
  return collegeSlug ? `/c/${collegeSlug}/student/placements` : '/placements';
}

import { requireStudentAction } from '@/lib/auth/require-student-action';

const optionalUrlSchema = z.union([z.literal(''), z.string().trim().url('Invalid URL.')]).transform((value) => value || null);
const optionalTextSchema = (max: number) =>
  z.string().trim().max(max, `Must be at most ${max} characters.`).optional().transform((value) => value || undefined);
const placementProfileSchema = z.object({
  profileId: z.string().uuid('Invalid profile id.'),
  skills_json: z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(100)).max(50).optional(),
  projects_json: z.array(z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())).max(20).optional(),
  linkedin_url: optionalUrlSchema.optional(),
  github_url: optionalUrlSchema.optional(),
  notes: z.string().trim().max(2000, 'Notes are too long.').optional().transform((value) => value || null),
});

const createApplicationSchema = z.object({
  studentId: z.string().uuid('Invalid student id.'),
  collegeId: z.string().uuid('Invalid college id.'),
  company_name: z.string().trim().min(1, 'Company name is required.').max(120),
  role: optionalTextSchema(120),
  applied_at: z.string().datetime({ offset: true }).optional(),
  source: optionalTextSchema(120),
  notes: optionalTextSchema(2000),
});

const createOfferSchema = z.object({
  studentId: z.string().uuid('Invalid student id.'),
  collegeId: z.string().uuid('Invalid college id.'),
  company_name: z.string().trim().min(1, 'Company name is required.').max(120),
  role: optionalTextSchema(120),
  amount: z.number().finite().min(0).max(100000000).optional(),
  application_id: z.string().uuid('Invalid application id.').optional(),
});

const documentTypeSchema = z.enum(['offer_letter', 'placement_proof', 'other']);
const placementFileSchema = z.object({
  profileId: z.string().uuid('Invalid profile id.').optional(),
  studentId: z.string().uuid('Invalid student id.'),
  collegeId: z.string().uuid('Invalid college id.'),
});

const ALLOWED_PLACEMENT_FILE_TYPES = new Set(['application/pdf', 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp']);
const MAX_PLACEMENT_FILE_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;

async function consumeStudentWriteLimit(userId: string, scope: string, limit: number, windowMs: number) {
  return consumeRateLimit({
    key: `student-write:${scope}:${userId}`,
    limit,
    windowMs,
  });
}

function validatePlacementFile(file: File | null): string | null {
  if (!(file instanceof File) || file.size <= 0) return 'No file';
  if (file.size > MAX_PLACEMENT_FILE_BYTES) return 'File must be 8 MB or smaller.';
  if (!ALLOWED_PLACEMENT_FILE_TYPES.has(file.type)) return 'Unsupported file type.';
  if (file.name.trim().length === 0 || file.name.length > 120) return 'Invalid file name.';
  return null;
}

async function requireStudentForAction(expectedCollegeId?: string, expectedStudentId?: string, collegeSlug?: string | null): Promise<{ userId: string; studentId: string; collegeId: string } | null> {
  if (!collegeSlug) {
    console.warn('[auth/action] requireStudentForAction missing collegeSlug parameter');
    return null;
  }
  
  const context = await requireStudentAction(collegeSlug);
  if (!context) return null;

  if (expectedCollegeId && expectedCollegeId !== context.tenant.id) {
    return null;
  }

  if (expectedStudentId && expectedStudentId !== context.studentId) {
    return null;
  }

  return { userId: context.user.id, studentId: context.studentId, collegeId: context.tenant.id };
}

export async function updatePlacementProfileAction(
  profileId: string,
  data: {
    skills_json?: unknown;
    projects_json?: unknown;
    linkedin_url?: string | null;
    github_url?: string | null;
    notes?: string | null;
  },
  collegeSlug?: string | null
) {
  const auth = await requireStudentForAction(undefined, undefined, collegeSlug);
  if (!auth) return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };

  const limited = await consumeStudentWriteLimit(auth.userId, 'placement-profile', 15, 5 * 60 * 1000);
  if (!limited.ok) return { success: false, error: `Too many requests. Retry in ${limited.retryAfterSeconds}s.` };

  const parsed = placementProfileSchema.safeParse({ profileId, ...data });
  if (!parsed.success) return { success: false, error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Invalid input.' };
  
  const ok = await updatePlacementProfile(parsed.data.profileId, {
    skills_json: parsed.data.skills_json,
    projects_json: parsed.data.projects_json,
    linkedin_url: parsed.data.linkedin_url,
    github_url: parsed.data.github_url,
    notes: parsed.data.notes,
  });
  if (ok) revalidatePath(getPlacementsPath(collegeSlug ?? null));
  return { success: ok };
}

export async function createApplicationAction(
  studentId: string,
  collegeId: string,
  input: { company_name: string; role?: string; applied_at?: string; source?: string; notes?: string },
  collegeSlug?: string | null
) {
  const auth = await requireStudentForAction(collegeId, studentId, collegeSlug);
  if (!auth) return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };

  const limited = await consumeStudentWriteLimit(auth.userId, 'placement-application', 20, 10 * 60 * 1000);
  if (!limited.ok) return { success: false, error: `Too many requests. Retry in ${limited.retryAfterSeconds}s.` };

  const parsed = createApplicationSchema.safeParse({ studentId, collegeId, ...input });
  if (!parsed.success) return { success: false, error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Invalid input.' };
  
  const ok = await createApplication(auth.studentId, auth.collegeId, {
    company_name: parsed.data.company_name,
    role: parsed.data.role,
    applied_at: parsed.data.applied_at,
    source: parsed.data.source,
    notes: parsed.data.notes,
  });
  if (ok) revalidatePath(getPlacementsPath(collegeSlug ?? null));
  return { success: ok };
}

export async function uploadResumeVersionAction(
  profileId: string,
  collegeId: string,
  studentId: string,
  formData: FormData,
  collegeSlug?: string | null
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  const auth = await requireStudentForAction(collegeId, studentId, collegeSlug);
  if (!auth) return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };

  const limited = await consumeStudentWriteLimit(auth.userId, 'placement-resume-upload', 10, 10 * 60 * 1000);
  if (!limited.ok) return { success: false, error: `Too many requests. Retry in ${limited.retryAfterSeconds}s.` };

  const parsed = placementFileSchema.safeParse({ profileId, studentId, collegeId });
  if (!parsed.success) return { success: false, error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Invalid input.' };
  
  const file = formData.get('file') as File | null;
  const fileError = validatePlacementFile(file);
  if (fileError) return { success: false, error: fileError };
  const validatedFile = file as File;
  const path = await uploadPlacementFile(auth.collegeId, auth.studentId, 'resume', validatedFile);
  if (!path) return { success: false, error: 'Upload failed' };
  const ok = await createResumeVersion(parsed.data.profileId!, path);
  if (ok) revalidatePath(getPlacementsPath(collegeSlug ?? null));
  return { success: ok };
}

export async function uploadPlacementDocumentAction(
  studentId: string,
  collegeId: string,
  documentType: 'offer_letter' | 'placement_proof' | 'other',
  formData: FormData,
  collegeSlug?: string | null
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  const auth = await requireStudentForAction(collegeId, studentId, collegeSlug);
  if (!auth) return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };

  const limited = await consumeStudentWriteLimit(auth.userId, 'placement-document-upload', 10, 10 * 60 * 1000);
  if (!limited.ok) return { success: false, error: `Too many requests. Retry in ${limited.retryAfterSeconds}s.` };

  const parsed = placementFileSchema.extend({ documentType: documentTypeSchema }).safeParse({
    studentId,
    collegeId,
    documentType,
  });
  if (!parsed.success) return { success: false, error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Invalid input.' };
  
  const file = formData.get('file') as File | null;
  const fileError = validatePlacementFile(file);
  if (fileError) return { success: false, error: fileError };
  const validatedFile = file as File;
  const path = await uploadPlacementFile(auth.collegeId, auth.studentId, parsed.data.documentType, validatedFile);
  if (!path) return { success: false, error: 'Upload failed' };
  const ok = await createPlacementDocument(auth.studentId, auth.collegeId, {
    document_type: parsed.data.documentType,
    file_url: path,
    file_name: validatedFile.name.trim(),
  });
  if (ok) revalidatePath(getPlacementsPath(collegeSlug ?? null));
  return { success: ok };
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/actions/profile.ts ---
'use server';

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { getSession } from '@/lib/auth/session';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
import { consumeRateLimit } from '@/lib/security/rate-limit';
import { z } from 'zod';

const urlFieldSchema = z
  .union([z.literal(''), z.string().trim().url('Invalid URL.')])
  .transform((value) => (value ? value : null));

const profileUpdateSchema = z.object({
  github_url: urlFieldSchema.optional(),
  linkedin_url: urlFieldSchema.optional(),
  resume_url: urlFieldSchema.optional(),
  year_or_semester: z.string().trim().max(50, 'Year or semester is too long.').optional().transform((value) => value || null),
  student_code: z.string().trim().max(50, 'Student code is too long.').optional().transform((value) => value || null),
  collegeSlug: z.string().trim().max(120).optional(),
});

const resumeUploadSchema = z.object({
  collegeId: z.string().uuid('Invalid college id.'),
});

const ALLOWED_RESUME_TYPES = new Set(['application/pdf']);
const MAX_RESUME_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

async function validateStudentMembership(supabase: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createClient>>, userId: string, collegeId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const { data: membership } = await supabase
    .from('college_memberships')
    .select('id')
    .eq('user_id', userId)
    .eq('college_id', collegeId)
    .in('role', ['student'])
    .in('status', ['active', 'invited'])
    .maybeSingle();
  return !!membership;
}

export async function updateStudentProfile(collegeId: string, data: {
    github_url?: string;
    linkedin_url?: string;
    resume_url?: string;
    year_or_semester?: string;
    student_code?: string;
    collegeSlug?: string;
}) {
    const { session } = await getSession();
    if (!session?.user) {
        return { error: 'Not authenticated' };
    }

    const limited = await consumeRateLimit({
        key: `student-profile-update:${session.user.id}`,
        limit: 20,
        windowMs: 5 * 60 * 1000,
    });
    if (!limited.ok) {
        return { error: `Too many requests. Retry in ${limited.retryAfterSeconds}s.` };
    }

    const collegeParsed = resumeUploadSchema.safeParse({ collegeId });
    if (!collegeParsed.success) {
        return { error: collegeParsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Invalid college id.' };
    }

    const parsed = profileUpdateSchema.safeParse(data);
    if (!parsed.success) {
        return { error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Invalid input.' };
    }

    const supabase = await createClient();

    const isMember = await validateStudentMembership(supabase, session.user.id, collegeParsed.data.collegeId);
    if (!isMember) {
        return { error: 'Access denied: not a member of this college' };
    }

    const updatePayload: Record<string, string | null> = {};
    if (parsed.data.github_url !== undefined) updatePayload.github_url = parsed.data.github_url;
    if (parsed.data.linkedin_url !== undefined) updatePayload.linkedin_url = parsed.data.linkedin_url;
    if (parsed.data.resume_url !== undefined) updatePayload.resume_url = parsed.data.resume_url;
    if (parsed.data.year_or_semester !== undefined) updatePayload.year_or_semester = parsed.data.year_or_semester;
    if (parsed.data.student_code !== undefined) updatePayload.student_code = parsed.data.student_code;

    if (Object.keys(updatePayload).length === 0) {
        return { success: true };
    }

    const { error } = await supabase
        .from('students')
        .update(updatePayload)
        .eq('user_id', session.user.id)
        .eq('college_id', collegeParsed.data.collegeId);

    if (error) {
        console.error('[profile] updateStudentProfile error:', error?.code ?? 'unknown');
        return { error: 'Failed to update profile' };
    }

    if (parsed.data.collegeSlug) {
        revalidatePath(`/c/${parsed.data.collegeSlug}/student/profile`, 'page');
    } else {
        revalidatePath(`/c/[collegeSlug]/student/profile`, 'page');
    }
    return { success: true };
}
export async function uploadStudentResume(collegeId: string, formData: FormData) {
    const { session } = await getSession();
    if (!session?.user) {
        return { error: 'Not authenticated' };
    }

    const limited = await consumeRateLimit({
        key: `student-resume-upload:${session.user.id}`,
        limit: 10,
        windowMs: 10 * 60 * 1000,
    });
    if (!limited.ok) {
        return { error: `Too many requests. Retry in ${limited.retryAfterSeconds}s.` };
    }

    const collegeParsed = resumeUploadSchema.safeParse({ collegeId });
    if (!collegeParsed.success) {
        return { error: collegeParsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Invalid college id.' };
    }

    const file = formData.get('resume');
    if (!(file instanceof File)) {
        return { error: 'No file provided' };
    }
    if (file.size <= 0 || file.size > MAX_RESUME_BYTES) {
        return { error: 'Resume must be a PDF up to 5 MB.' };
    }
    if (!ALLOWED_RESUME_TYPES.has(file.type)) {
        return { error: 'Resume must be a PDF.' };
    }

    const supabase = await createClient();

    const isMember = await validateStudentMembership(supabase, session.user.id, collegeParsed.data.collegeId);
    if (!isMember) {
        return { error: 'Access denied: not a member of this college' };
    }

    // 1. Get student ID
    const { data: student, error: studentError } = await supabase
        .from('students')
        .select('id')
        .eq('user_id', session.user.id)
        .eq('college_id', collegeParsed.data.collegeId)
        .maybeSingle();

    if (studentError || !student) {
        console.error('[profile] uploadStudentResume student search error:', studentError?.code ?? 'unknown');
        return { error: 'Student record not found' };
    }

    // 2. Upload with overwrite
    const fileExt = 'pdf';
    const filePath = `${collegeParsed.data.collegeId}/${student.id}/resume.${fileExt}`;

    const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
        .from('resumes')
        .upload(filePath, file, {
            upsert: true,
            contentType: 'application/pdf',
        });

    if (uploadError) {
        console.error('[profile] uploadStudentResume upload error:', uploadError?.message ?? 'unknown');
        return { error: 'Failed to upload resume to storage' };
    }

    // 3. Get public URL
    const { data: { publicUrl } } = supabase.storage
        .from('resumes')
        .getPublicUrl(filePath);

    return { success: true, url: publicUrl };
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/actions/update-non-partnered-student-college.ts ---
'use server';

import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { getSession } from '@/lib/auth/session';
import { requireStudentAction } from '@/lib/auth/require-student-action';
import { createAdminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { consumeRateLimit } from '@/lib/security/rate-limit';
import { isDirectLearnerCollegeSlug } from '@/lib/tenant/direct-learner-slug';

const selfReportedCollegeNameSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .min(2, 'Enter at least 2 characters.')
  .max(200, 'College name is too long (max 200 characters).')
  .refine((v) => !/[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f]/.test(v), {
    message: 'Remove invalid characters from the college name.',
  });

function normalizeCollegeName(raw: string): string {
  return raw.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

/**
 * Save self-reported school name for B2C / direct-learner students (`non_partnered_students`).
 * **Metadata only:** does not create `colleges` rows, does not change B2B/B2C catalog visibility
 * (visibility is assignment-driven for B2B and `global_courses.audience_scope` for B2C), and does not
 * change which login portal the user uses.
 */
export async function updateNonPartneredStudentCollege(
  collegeSlug: string,
  selfReportedCollegeName: string
): Promise<{ ok?: true; error?: string }> {
  const { session } = await getSession();
  if (!session?.user) {
    return { error: 'Not authenticated' };
  }

  const slug = collegeSlug.trim();
  if (!isDirectLearnerCollegeSlug(slug)) {
    return { error: 'This action is only available on the direct learner account.' };
  }

  const ctx = await requireStudentAction(slug);
  if (!ctx) {
    return { error: 'You do not have access to this student account.' };
  }

  const parsed = selfReportedCollegeNameSchema.safeParse(selfReportedCollegeName);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return { error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Invalid college name.' };
  }

  const name = normalizeCollegeName(parsed.data);
  if (name.length < 2) {
    return { error: 'Enter at least 2 characters.' };
  }

  const limited = await consumeRateLimit({
    key: `b2c-college-name:${session.user.id}`,
    limit: 20,
    windowMs: 60 * 60 * 1000,
    failClosed: true,
  });
  if (!limited.ok) {
    return { error: `Too many updates. Retry in ${limited.retryAfterSeconds}s.` };
  }

  const admin = createAdminClient();
  const userId = ctx.user.id;
  const studentId = ctx.studentId;

  const { data: existing, error: selErr } = await admin
    .from('non_partnered_students')
    .select('id')
    .eq('user_id', userId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (selErr) {
    console.error('[b2c-college] select non_partnered_students', selErr.code);
    return { error: 'Could not save your college name. Try again.' };
  }

  if (!existing) {
    const { error: insErr } = await admin.from('non_partnered_students').insert({
      user_id: userId,
      student_id: studentId,
      status: 'active',
      self_reported_college_name: name,
    });
    if (insErr) {
      console.error('[b2c-college] insert non_partnered_students', insErr.code);
      return { error: 'Could not save your college name. Try again.' };
    }
  } else {
    const { error: upErr } = await admin
      .from('non_partnered_students')
      .update({ self_reported_college_name: name })
      .eq('user_id', userId);
    if (upErr) {
      console.error('[b2c-college] update non_partnered_students', upErr.code);
      return { error: 'Could not save your college name. Try again.' };
    }
  }

  revalidatePath(`/c/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/student`, 'layout');
  revalidatePath(`/c/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/student/profile`, 'page');
  return { ok: true };
}

'use server';

import { mockYouTubeCourses, type YouTubeCourse } from '@/lib/mock/youtube-courses';

export interface YouTubeVideo {
  id: string;
  videoId: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  thumbnail: string;
  position: number;
  duration?: string;
  views?: string;
}

function parseISO8601Duration(duration: string): string {
  const match = duration.match(/PT(?:(\d+)H)?(?:(\d+)M)?(?:(\d+)S)?/);
  if (!match) return "0:00";

  const parts = [
    match[1], // hours
    match[2] || "0", // minutes
    match[3] || "0", // seconds
  ];

  const formattedParts = parts
    .map((p, i) => {
      if (i === 0 && !p) return null; // Skip hours if 0
      return p.padStart(2, "0");
    })
    .filter(Boolean);

  // If only one part (seconds), add 00 for minutes
  if (formattedParts.length === 1) {
    return `00:${formattedParts[0]}`;
  }

  // If first part is minutes and it's < 10, remove leading zero
  if (formattedParts.length === 2 && formattedParts[0]!.startsWith("0")) {
    formattedParts[0] = formattedParts[0]!.substring(1);
  }

  return formattedParts.join(":");
}

function formatViews(views: string): string {
  const num = parseInt(views, 10);
  if (num >= 1000000) return (num / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M';
  if (num >= 1000) return (num / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'K';
  return views;
}

const PLAYLIST_API_CHUNK = 50;

export type YouTubePlaylistMeta = {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  thumbnail: string;
  videoCount?: number;
};

function pickPlaylistThumbnail(snippet: {
  thumbnails?: Record<string, { url?: string } | undefined>;
}): string {
  const t = snippet.thumbnails;
  if (!t) return '';
  return (
    t.maxres?.url ||
    t.standard?.url ||
    t.high?.url ||
    t.medium?.url ||
    t.default?.url ||
    ''
  );
}

/**
 * Fetches playlist titles, descriptions, thumbnails, and item counts from YouTube Data API v3 (playlists.list).
 * Batches up to 50 ids per request.
 */
export async function getPlaylistsMetadata(
  playlistIds: string[]
): Promise<Map<string, YouTubePlaylistMeta>> {
  const out = new Map<string, YouTubePlaylistMeta>();
  const apiKey = process.env.YOUTUBE_API_KEY;

  if (!apiKey || playlistIds.length === 0) {
    if (!apiKey) {
      console.error('YOUTUBE_API_KEY is missing from environment variables.');
    }
    return out;
  }

  const unique = [...new Set(playlistIds.filter(Boolean))];

  for (let i = 0; i < unique.length; i += PLAYLIST_API_CHUNK) {
    const chunk = unique.slice(i, i + PLAYLIST_API_CHUNK);
    const url = new URL('https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/playlists');
    url.searchParams.set('part', 'snippet,contentDetails');
    url.searchParams.set('id', chunk.join(','));
    url.searchParams.set('maxResults', String(PLAYLIST_API_CHUNK));
    url.searchParams.set('key', apiKey);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(url.toString(), { next: { revalidate: 3600 } });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const errText = await res.text();
        console.error('YouTube playlists.list error:', res.status, errText);
        continue;
      }

      const data = (await res.json()) as {
        items?: Array<{
          id: string;
          snippet?: {
            title?: string;
            description?: string;
            thumbnails?: Record<string, { url?: string }>;
          };
          contentDetails?: { itemCount?: string };
        }>;
      };

      for (const item of data.items ?? []) {
        const title = item.snippet?.title?.trim() || '';
        const description = item.snippet?.description?.trim() || '';
        const thumbnail = item.snippet ? pickPlaylistThumbnail(item.snippet) : '';
        const rawCount = item.contentDetails?.itemCount;
        const videoCount =
          rawCount !== undefined ? parseInt(rawCount, 10) : undefined;

        out.set(item.id, {
          title,
          description,
          thumbnail,
          videoCount: Number.isFinite(videoCount) ? videoCount : undefined,
        });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('getPlaylistsMetadata:', error);
    }
  }

  return out;
}

/**
 * Builds the courses catalog: same playlist ids as mock data, merged with live metadata from YouTube when the API key is set.
 */
export async function getYouTubeCoursesCatalog(): Promise<YouTubeCourse[]> {
  const meta = await getPlaylistsMetadata(mockYouTubeCourses.map((c) => c.playlistId));

  return mockYouTubeCourses.map((course) => {
    const m = meta.get(course.playlistId);
    if (!m) return course;

    return {
      ...course,
      title: m.title || course.title,
      description: m.description || course.description,
      thumbnail: m.thumbnail || course.thumbnail,
      videoCount: m.videoCount ?? course.videoCount,
    };
  });
}

type PlaylistItemApi = {
  id: string;
  contentDetails: { videoId: string };
  snippet: {
    title: string;
    description: string;
    position: number;
    thumbnails?: { medium?: { url?: string }; default?: { url?: string } };
  };
};

type PlaylistItemsApiResponse = {
  items?: PlaylistItemApi[];
};

type VideoItemApi = {
  id: string;
  contentDetails: { duration: string };
  statistics: { viewCount: string };
};

type VideosApiResponse = {
  items?: VideoItemApi[];
};

export async function getPlaylistVideos(playlistId: string): Promise<YouTubeVideo[]> {
  const apiKey = process.env.YOUTUBE_API_KEY;
  
  if (!apiKey) {
    console.error('YOUTUBE_API_KEY is missing from environment variables.');
    return [];
  }

  try {
    // 1. Fetch Playlist Items
    const playlistResponse = await fetch(
      `https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/playlistItems?part=snippet,contentDetails&maxResults=50&playlistId=${playlistId}&key=${apiKey}`
    );

    if (!playlistResponse.ok) {
      const errorData = await playlistResponse.json();
      console.error('YouTube Playlist API Error:', errorData);
      return [];
    }

    const playlistData = (await playlistResponse.json()) as PlaylistItemsApiResponse;
    const playlistItems = playlistData.items ?? [];
    const videoIds = playlistItems.map((item) => item.contentDetails.videoId).join(',');

    // 2. Fetch Video Details (Duration, Views)
    const videoResponse = await fetch(
      `https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/videos?part=contentDetails,statistics&id=${videoIds}&key=${apiKey}`
    );

    const videoDetailsMap: Record<string, { duration: string; views: string }> = {};
    if (videoResponse.ok) {
      const videoData = (await videoResponse.json()) as VideosApiResponse;
      for (const item of videoData.items ?? []) {
        videoDetailsMap[item.id] = {
          duration: parseISO8601Duration(item.contentDetails.duration),
          views: formatViews(item.statistics.viewCount),
        };
      }
    }

    // 3. Merge Data
    return playlistItems.map((item) => {
      const vId = item.contentDetails.videoId;
      return {
        id: item.id,
        videoId: vId,
        title: item.snippet.title,
        description: item.snippet.description,
        thumbnail:
          item.snippet.thumbnails?.medium?.url ||
          item.snippet.thumbnails?.default?.url ||
          (vId ? `https://img.youtube.com/vi/${vId}/mqdefault.jpg` : ''),
        position: item.snippet.position,
        duration: videoDetailsMap[vId]?.duration || '0:00',
        views: videoDetailsMap[vId]?.views || '0',
      };
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching YouTube playlist:', error);
    return [];
  }
}

import 'server-only';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import type { ActivityEventName } from '@/lib/activity/event-types';
import { EVENT_NAME_TO_CATEGORY } from '@/lib/activity/event-types';

export interface TrackActivityInput {
  tenantId: string | null;
  actorUserId: string | null;
  actorRole?: string | null;
  actorType?: string | null;
  eventName: ActivityEventName;
  eventCategory?: string | null;
  entityType?: string | null;
  entityId?: string | null;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  ipAddress?: string | null;
  userAgent?: string | null;
  sessionId?: string | null;
  requestId?: string | null;
}

export async function trackActivity(input: TrackActivityInput): Promise<string | null> {
  const category = input.eventCategory ?? EVENT_NAME_TO_CATEGORY[input.eventName] ?? 'user';
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('insert_activity_event', {
    p_tenant_id: input.tenantId,
    p_actor_user_id: input.actorUserId,
    p_actor_role: input.actorRole ?? null,
    p_actor_type: input.actorType ?? null,
    p_event_name: input.eventName,
    p_event_category: category,
    p_entity_type: input.entityType ?? null,
    p_entity_id: input.entityId ?? null,
    p_metadata: input.metadata ?? {},
    p_ip_address: input.ipAddress ?? null,
    p_user_agent: input.userAgent ?? null,
    p_session_id: input.sessionId ?? null,
    p_request_id: input.requestId ?? null,
  });
  if (error) {
    console.error('[activity] insert_activity_event failed', error.message);
    return null;
  }
  return data as string | null;
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/activity/queries.ts ---
import 'server-only';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

export interface ActivityEventRow {
  id: string;
  tenant_id: string | null;
  actor_user_id: string | null;
  actor_role: string | null;
  actor_type: string | null;
  event_name: string;
  event_category: string;
  entity_type: string | null;
  entity_id: string | null;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  ip_address: string | null;
  user_agent: string | null;
  session_id: string | null;
  request_id: string | null;
  created_at: string;
}

export interface ListActivityEventsParams {
  tenantId?: string | null;
  userId?: string | null;
  eventName?: string | null;
  eventCategory?: string | null;
  from?: string | null;
  to?: string | null;
  limit?: number;
}

export async function listActivityEvents(params: ListActivityEventsParams = {}): Promise<ActivityEventRow[]> {
  const { tenantId, userId, eventName, eventCategory, from, to, limit = 100 } = params;
  const supabase = await createClient();
  let q = supabase
    .from('activity_events')
    .select('id, tenant_id, actor_user_id, actor_role, actor_type, event_name, event_category, entity_type, entity_id, metadata, ip_address, user_agent, session_id, request_id, created_at')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(Math.min(limit, 500));
  if (tenantId) q = q.eq('tenant_id', tenantId);
  if (userId) q = q.eq('actor_user_id', userId);
  if (eventName) q = q.eq('event_name', eventName);
  if (eventCategory) q = q.eq('event_category', eventCategory);
  if (from) q = q.gte('created_at', from);
  if (to) q = q.lte('created_at', to);
  const { data, error } = await q;
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
  return (data ?? []).map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    tenant_id: row.tenant_id,
    actor_user_id: row.actor_user_id,
    actor_role: row.actor_role,
    actor_type: row.actor_type,
    event_name: row.event_name,
    event_category: row.event_category,
    entity_type: row.entity_type,
    entity_id: row.entity_id,
    metadata: (row.metadata ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>,
    ip_address: row.ip_address,
    user_agent: row.user_agent,
    session_id: row.session_id,
    request_id: row.request_id,
    created_at: row.created_at,
  }));
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/auth/app-url.ts ---
export type Portal = "student" | "college_admin" | "superadmin";

function cleanUrl(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!value) return null;
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;
  const withProtocol = /^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed)
    ? trimmed
    : `https://${trimmed}`;
  return withProtocol.replace(/\/+$/, "");
}

function getVercelUrl(): string | null {
  return cleanUrl(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_URL ?? process.env.VERCEL_URL ?? null,
  );
}

function getPortalEnvUrl(portal: Portal): string | null {
  if (portal === "student") {
    return cleanUrl(
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_LMS_URL ??
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_LMS_APP_URL ??
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ??
        getVercelUrl(),
    );
  }
  if (portal === "college_admin") {
    return cleanUrl(
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_COLLEGE_URL ??
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_COLLEGE_ADMIN_URL ??
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_COLLEGE_ADMIN_APP_URL ??
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ??
        getVercelUrl(),
    );
  }
  return cleanUrl(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPERADMIN_URL ??
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPERADMIN_APP_URL ??
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ??
      getVercelUrl(),
  );
}

export function getClientBaseUrl(): string {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.location?.origin) {
    return window.location.origin.replace(/\/+$/, "");
  }
  return getPortalEnvUrl("student") ?? "";
}

export function getPortalBaseUrl(
  portal: Portal,
  fallbackOrigin?: string,
): string {
  return (
    cleanUrl(fallbackOrigin) ?? getPortalEnvUrl(portal) ?? getClientBaseUrl()
  );
}

export function getAuthRedirectUrl(portal: Portal, origin?: string): string {
  const base = getPortalBaseUrl(portal, origin);
  return `${base}/auth/callback`;
}

/**
 * Structured auth logging for security monitoring.
 * 
 * All auth events are logged with consistent structure for:
 * - Security incident detection
 * - Audit trails
 * - Performance monitoring
 * - Alerting on suspicious activity
 */

export type AuthEventType = 
  | 'auth_success'
  | 'auth_failure'
  | 'auth_redirect'
  | 'auth_denied'
  | 'session_refresh'
  | 'session_expired'
  | 'logout'
  | 'role_check_failed'
  | 'tenant_check_failed'
  | 'inactive_account_blocked'
  | 'suspicious_activity'
  | 'api_unauthenticated'
  | 'api_inactive_user'
  | 'api_wrong_tenant'
  | 'api_wrong_role'
  | 'api_invalid_tenant'
  | 'api_rate_limited'
  | 'api_invalid_payload'
  | 'api_error'
  | 'student_b2c_bootstrap'
  | 'student_b2c_bootstrap_failed';

export interface AuthLogEvent {
  type: AuthEventType;
  timestamp: string;
  userId?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
  tenantSlug?: string | null;
  tenantId?: string | null;
  role?: string | null;
  reason?: string;
  redirectTo?: string;
  ip?: string;
  userAgent?: string;
  durationMs?: number;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

const AUTH_LOG_PREFIX = '[AUTH]';

/**
 * Log an auth event with structured format.
 * In production, this would send to a logging service (e.g., Datadog, Splunk).
 */
export function logAuthEvent(event: Omit<AuthLogEvent, 'timestamp'>) {
  const logEvent: AuthLogEvent = {
    ...event,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  const severity = getEventSeverity(event.type);
  const message = formatLogMessage(logEvent);

  switch (severity) {
    case 'error':
      console.error(AUTH_LOG_PREFIX, message);
      break;
    case 'warn':
      console.warn(AUTH_LOG_PREFIX, message);
      break;
    default:
      console.log(AUTH_LOG_PREFIX, message);
  }

  if (shouldAlert(event.type)) {
    triggerAlert(logEvent);
  }
}

function getEventSeverity(type: AuthEventType): 'error' | 'warn' | 'info' {
  switch (type) {
    case 'suspicious_activity':
      return 'error';
    case 'auth_denied':
    case 'role_check_failed':
    case 'tenant_check_failed':
    case 'inactive_account_blocked':
    case 'api_wrong_tenant':
    case 'api_wrong_role':
    case 'api_inactive_user':
    case 'api_rate_limited':
    case 'api_invalid_payload':
    case 'api_error':
      return 'warn';
    case 'api_unauthenticated':
    case 'api_invalid_tenant':
    case 'student_b2c_bootstrap':
      return 'info';
    case 'student_b2c_bootstrap_failed':
      return 'warn';
    default:
      return 'info';
  }
}

function formatLogMessage(event: AuthLogEvent): string {
  const parts: string[] = [event.type];
  
  if (event.userId) parts.push(`user=${event.userId}`);
  if (event.tenantSlug) parts.push(`tenant=${event.tenantSlug}`);
  if (event.role) parts.push(`role=${event.role}`);
  if (event.reason) parts.push(`reason=${event.reason}`);
  if (event.durationMs) parts.push(`duration=${event.durationMs}ms`);
  
  return parts.join(' ');
}

function shouldAlert(type: AuthEventType): boolean {
  return type === 'suspicious_activity' || 
         type === 'auth_denied' ||
         type === 'inactive_account_blocked';
}

function triggerAlert(event: AuthLogEvent) {
  const safe = {
    type: event.type,
    userId: event.userId ? event.userId.slice(0, 8) + '…' : null,
    tenantSlug: event.tenantSlug,
    reason: event.reason,
    timestamp: event.timestamp,
  };
  console.error(`${AUTH_LOG_PREFIX} [ALERT]`, JSON.stringify(safe));
}

/**
 * Security error codes for consistent error handling.
 */
export const AUTH_ERROR_CODES = {
  UNAUTHENTICATED: 'E_AUTH_001',
  SESSION_EXPIRED: 'E_AUTH_002',
  FORBIDDEN_ROLE: 'E_AUTH_003',
  FORBIDDEN_TENANT: 'E_AUTH_004',
  ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: 'E_AUTH_005',
  ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: 'E_AUTH_006',
  MEMBERSHIP_NOT_FOUND: 'E_AUTH_007',
  TENANT_NOT_FOUND: 'E_AUTH_008',
  INVALID_TOKEN: 'E_AUTH_009',
  RATE_LIMITED: 'E_AUTH_010',
} as const;

/**
 * Get human-readable message for error code.
 */
export function getAuthErrorMessage(code: keyof typeof AUTH_ERROR_CODES): string {
  const messages: Record<keyof typeof AUTH_ERROR_CODES, string> = {
    UNAUTHENTICATED: 'Authentication required. Please sign in.',
    SESSION_EXPIRED: 'Your session has expired. Please sign in again.',
    FORBIDDEN_ROLE: 'You do not have permission to access this resource.',
    FORBIDDEN_TENANT: 'You do not have access to this organization.',
    ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: 'Your account has been deactivated.',
    ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: 'Your account has been suspended.',
    MEMBERSHIP_NOT_FOUND: 'You are not a member of this organization.',
    TENANT_NOT_FOUND: 'Organization not found.',
    INVALID_TOKEN: 'Invalid authentication token.',
    RATE_LIMITED: 'Too many requests. Please try again later.',
  };
  return messages[code];
}

import 'server-only';
import { cache } from 'react';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { getSession } from '@/lib/auth/session';
import { consumeRateLimit } from '@/lib/security/rate-limit';

export interface StudentUser {
  id: string;
  email: string | null;
  fullName: string | null;
  isActive: boolean;
}

export interface StudentMembership {
  id: string;
  collegeId: string;
  role: 'student';
  status: string;
}

export interface StudentTenant {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
  shortName: string | null;
  logoUrl: string | null;
  primaryColor: string | null;
  secondaryColor: string | null;
}

export interface StudentAuthContext {
  user: StudentUser;
  membership: StudentMembership;
  studentId: string;
  tenant: StudentTenant;
}

interface StudentResolverRow {
  user_id: string;
  membership_id: string | null;
  college_id: string | null;
  student_id: string | null;
  college_slug: string | null;
  membership_status: string | null;
  profile_is_active: boolean | null;
  allowed: boolean;
  error_code: string | null;
  college_name: string | null;
  short_name: string | null;
  logo_url: string | null;
  primary_color: string | null;
  secondary_color: string | null;
  profile_email: string | null;
  profile_full_name: string | null;
}

/**
 * Build a complete auth context for Student routes.
 * Uses the resolve_student_auth_context RPC for a single DB round-trip.
 * Returns null if user is not authenticated or has no valid student membership.
 *
 * Accepts a pre-resolved userId to avoid calling getSession() inside this function.
 * This keeps cookies() outside any cache scope.
 *
 * Cached per request via React's cache() to deduplicate across layouts/pages.
 */
export const getStudentAuthContext = cache(
  async (collegeSlug: string, userId: string, userEmail?: string | null, userFullName?: string | null): Promise<StudentAuthContext | null> => {
    const startTime = performance.now();

    const limited = await consumeRateLimit({
      key: `auth-ctx:${userId}`,
      limit: 60,
      windowMs: 60 * 1000,
    });
    if (!limited.ok) {
      console.warn('[auth/context] Rate limited for user:', userId.slice(0, 8));
      return null;
    }

    const supabase = await createClient();
    const normalizedSlug = collegeSlug.trim();

    const { data: resolvedRaw, error: resolveError } = await supabase
      .rpc('resolve_student_auth_context', {
        p_user_id: userId,
        p_slug: normalizedSlug,
      })
      .single();
    const resolved = resolvedRaw as unknown as StudentResolverRow | null;

    const duration = performance.now() - startTime;
    if (duration > 200) {
      console.warn('[auth/context] Student context took', Math.round(duration), 'ms for slug:', normalizedSlug);
    }

    if (resolveError) {
      console.error('[auth/context] Student: resolver error:', resolveError.message);
      return null;
    }

    if (!resolved || resolved.allowed !== true) {
      return null;
    }

    const user: StudentUser = {
      id: userId,
      email: resolved.profile_email ?? userEmail ?? null,
      fullName: resolved.profile_full_name ?? userFullName ?? null,
      isActive: resolved.profile_is_active ?? true,
    };

    if (!user.isActive) {
      return null;
    }

    return {
      user,
      membership: {
        id: resolved.membership_id ?? '',
        collegeId: resolved.college_id ?? '',
        role: 'student',
        status: resolved.membership_status ?? 'active',
      },
      studentId: resolved.student_id ?? '',
      tenant: {
        id: resolved.college_id ?? '',
        name: resolved.college_name ?? '',
        slug: resolved.college_slug ?? normalizedSlug,
        shortName: resolved.short_name ?? null,
        logoUrl: resolved.logo_url ?? null,
        primaryColor: resolved.primary_color ?? null,
        secondaryColor: resolved.secondary_color ?? null,
      },
    };
  }
);

/**
 * Convenience wrapper that resolves the session first, then builds the auth context.
 * Use this when you don't already have a resolved session/user.
 */
export async function getStudentAuthContextWithSession(
  collegeSlug: string
): Promise<StudentAuthContext | null> {
  const { session } = await getSession();
  if (!session?.user) return null;
  return getStudentAuthContext(
    collegeSlug,
    session.user.id,
    session.user.email,
    session.user.user_metadata?.full_name as string | null
  );
}

/**
 * Check if user is authenticated (Supabase session exists).
 * Does not check membership or tenant - use for public-ish routes.
 */
export async function isAuthenticated(): Promise<boolean> {
  const { session } = await getSession();
  return session?.user != null;
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/auth/guards.ts ---
import 'server-only';
import { cache } from 'react';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { getStudentAuthContext, type StudentAuthContext } from '@/lib/auth/context';
import { getSession } from '@/lib/auth/session';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import type { RedirectReason } from '@/lib/auth/redirects';

export type { StudentAuthContext, StudentUser, StudentMembership, StudentTenant } from '@/lib/auth/context';

export class AuthError extends Error {
  status: number;
  code: RedirectReason;

  constructor(status: number, code: RedirectReason, message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.status = status;
    this.code = code;
  }
}

export function isAuthError(error: unknown): error is AuthError {
  return error instanceof AuthError;
}

interface GuardOptions {
  forApi?: boolean;
  redirectTo?: string;
}

function deny(options: GuardOptions & { status: number; code: RedirectReason; message: string }): never {
  if (options.forApi) {
    throw new AuthError(options.status, options.code, options.message);
  }
  redirect(options.redirectTo ?? '/login');
}

/**
 * Require authenticated Student user with valid membership for the given tenant.
 * Use in Server Components under /c/[collegeSlug]/student/* routes.
 * 
 * MEMBERSHIP POLICY:
 * - Accepts both 'active' and 'invited' memberships
 * - Auto-activates 'invited' memberships on first protected page access
 * - This is the ONLY place where auto-activation happens (not in redirects or callbacks)
 * 
 * Returns the complete auth context with user, membership, and tenant.
 * Redirects to login if not authenticated or not authorized.
 */
export const requireStudent = cache(async function requireStudent(
  collegeSlug: string,
  options?: GuardOptions
): Promise<StudentAuthContext> {
  const startTime = performance.now();
  const defaultRedirect = '/login';

  const { session } = await getSession();
  if (!session?.user) {
    deny({
      ...options,
      redirectTo: options?.redirectTo ?? defaultRedirect,
      status: 401,
      code: 'unauthenticated',
      message: 'Authentication required.',
    });
  }

  const context = await getStudentAuthContext(
    collegeSlug,
    session!.user.id,
    session!.user.email,
    session!.user.user_metadata?.full_name as string | null
  );

  if (!context) {
    deny({
      ...options,
      redirectTo: options?.redirectTo ?? defaultRedirect,
      status: 401,
      code: 'unauthenticated',
      message: 'Authentication required.',
    });
  }

  if (context.membership.status === 'invited') {
    const supabase = await createClient();
    await supabase
      .from('college_memberships')
      .update({ status: 'active' })
      .eq('id', context.membership.id)
      .eq('status', 'invited');
    context.membership.status = 'active';
  }

  const duration = performance.now() - startTime;
  if (duration > 200) {
    console.warn('[auth/guards] requireStudent took', Math.round(duration), 'ms for slug:', collegeSlug);
  }

  return context;
});

/**
 * Light-weight auth check for API routes.
 * Returns the auth context or throws AuthError.
 */
export async function requireStudentApi(collegeSlug: string): Promise<StudentAuthContext> {
  return requireStudent(collegeSlug, { forApi: true });
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/auth/oauth-exchange-error.ts ---
/**
 * Maps Supabase exchangeCodeForSession failures to a query param so the login UI
 * can show a specific message for network issues vs generic session errors.
 */
export function oauthExchangeFailureCode(
  err: { message?: string; name?: string } | null | undefined,
): "network" | "session" {
  if (!err) return "session";
  if (err.name === "AuthRetryableFetchError") return "network";
  const m = (err.message ?? "").toLowerCase();
  if (
    m.includes("fetch failed") ||
    m.includes("timeout") ||
    m.includes("network") ||
    m.includes("econnreset") ||
    m.includes("enotfound") ||
    m.includes("connect")
  ) {
    return "network";
  }
  return "session";
}

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

interface SyncProfileUser {
  id: string;
  email?: string | null;
  user_metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

/**
 * Upsert a profile row for the given user.
 * Uses onConflict: 'id' so it's safe to call from both tenant and global callbacks.
 */
export async function syncProfile(user: SyncProfileUser): Promise<void> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  await supabase.from('profiles').upsert(
    {
      id: user.id,
      email: user.email ?? undefined,
      full_name: (user.user_metadata?.full_name as string) ?? undefined,
    },
    { onConflict: 'id' }
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/auth/redirects.ts ---
import "server-only";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { getSession } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { resolveLoginRouteContext } from "@/lib/auth/login-route-context";
import { ensureDirectLearnerStudent } from "@/lib/services/direct-learners";

export type RedirectReason =
  | "unauthenticated"
  | "wrong_portal"
  | "no_membership"
  | "invalid_tenant"
  | "inactive_account"
  | "not_authorized";

/**
 * Redirect authenticated student to their first tenant dashboard.
 * Use on root page or when student needs to be routed to their college.
 *
 * Membership policy: Accepts both 'active' and 'invited' memberships.
 * Auto-activation happens in requireStudent() guard, NOT here - this is a redirect helper only.
 *
 * When there is no student membership, calls `ensureDirectLearnerStudent` to provision the B2C
 * direct-learner tenant + `non_partnered_students` (not the legacy `unknown` college).
 */
export async function redirectToStudentTenant(
  subPath: string = "",
): Promise<never> {
  const { session } = await getSession();

  if (!session?.user) {
    redirect("/login");
  }

  const context = await resolveLoginRouteContext(session.user.id);

  if (context?.profile_is_active === false) {
    redirect("/login");
  }

  if (context?.profile_global_role === 'superadmin' || context?.admin_college_slug) {
    redirect("/unauthorized?reason=wrong_portal");
  }

  if (context?.student_college_slug) {
    redirect(`/c/${context.student_college_slug}/student${subPath ? `/${subPath}` : ""}`);
  }

  if (!context?.student_membership_id) {
    try {
      const tenant = await ensureDirectLearnerStudent(session.user.id);
      redirect(`/c/${tenant.slug}/student${subPath ? `/${subPath}` : ""}`);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e && typeof e === "object" && "digest" in e) throw e;
      console.error("[redirects] auto-provision failed", e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    }
    redirect("/unauthorized?reason=no_membership");
  }
  redirect("/unauthorized?reason=invalid_tenant");
}

/**
 * Redirect to login with optional error code and return URL.
 */
export function redirectToLogin(options?: {
  collegeSlug?: string;
  error?: string;
  returnTo?: string;
}): never {
  const basePath = options?.collegeSlug
    ? `/c/${encodeURIComponent(options.collegeSlug)}/student/login`
    : "/login";

  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (options?.error) params.set("error", options.error);
  if (options?.returnTo) params.set("returnTo", options.returnTo);

  const query = params.toString();
  redirect(query ? `${basePath}?${query}` : basePath);
}

/**
 * Redirect to unauthorized page with reason.
 */
export function redirectUnauthorized(reason: string): never {
  redirect(`/unauthorized?reason=${encodeURIComponent(reason)}`);
}

import { requireStudent as requireStudentGuard, type StudentAuthContext } from '@/lib/auth/guards';

      role: context.membership.role,

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/auth/session.ts ---
import { cache } from 'react';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

export type Session = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getSession>>;

/**
 * Supabase auth is the single source of truth.
 * Uses getUser() for secure server-side validation (not just cookie reading).
 * 
 * Wrapped with React cache() to deduplicate calls within a single request.
 * This prevents multiple getUser() calls when nested layouts/pages all need auth.
 *
 * PERF: If getUser() latency exceeds 500ms consistently, investigate:
 * 1. Deploy LMS in the same region as Supabase project
 * 2. Check Supabase connection pooling settings
 * 3. Consider using getSession() (cookie-only, no network) for non-critical reads
 *    and getUser() (server-validated) only for security-sensitive operations
 */
export const getSession = cache(async () => {
  const startTime = performance.now();
  const supabase = await createClient();
  // Prefer getUser() over getSession(): it verifies the user by contacting
  // Supabase Auth instead of trusting cookie/storage data.
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  const duration = performance.now() - startTime;

  if (duration > 500) {
    console.warn('[auth/session] getUser took', Math.round(duration), 'ms — check Supabase region alignment');
  }

  if (error) return { session: null, error };

  return {
    // Keep downstream compatibility with `session?.user`.
    session: data?.user ? { user: data.user } : null,
    error: null,
  };
});

export async function getUser() {
  const { session } = await getSession();
  return session?.user ?? null;
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/email/config.ts ---
import { z } from 'zod';

import type { EmailProviderName } from './types';

type EmailConfig = {
  provider: EmailProviderName;
  fromEmail: string;
  replyTo?: string;
  sendgridApiKey?: string;
  resendApiKey?: string;
};

export type EmailConfigInspection = {
  selectedProvider: EmailProviderName;
  hasEmailFrom: boolean;
  hasReplyTo: boolean;
  hasSendGridKey: boolean;
  hasResendKey: boolean;
  fromSource: 'EMAIL_FROM' | 'SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL' | 'missing';
  dryRun: boolean;
  ready: boolean;
  issues: string[];
};

const providerSchema = z.enum(['sendgrid', 'resend']);
let cachedConfig: EmailConfig | null = null;

function normalizeProviderSafe(value: string | undefined): EmailProviderName {
  const provider = (value ?? 'sendgrid').trim().toLowerCase();
  const parsed = providerSchema.safeParse(provider);
  return parsed.success ? parsed.data : 'sendgrid';
}

function normalizeProvider(value: string | undefined): EmailProviderName {
  const provider = (value ?? 'sendgrid').trim().toLowerCase();
  const parsed = providerSchema.safeParse(provider);
  if (!parsed.success) throw new Error('[email] Invalid EMAIL_PROVIDER. Allowed values: sendgrid | resend.');
  return parsed.data;
}

export function inspectEmailConfig(): EmailConfigInspection {
  const selectedProvider = normalizeProviderSafe(process.env.EMAIL_PROVIDER);
  const hasEmailFrom = Boolean(process.env.EMAIL_FROM?.trim());
  const hasSendgridFromEmail = Boolean(process.env.SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL?.trim());
  const hasReplyTo = Boolean(process.env.EMAIL_REPLY_TO?.trim());
  const hasSendGridKey = Boolean(process.env.SENDGRID_API_KEY?.trim());
  const hasResendKey = Boolean(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY?.trim());
  const dryRun = String(process.env.EMAIL_DRY_RUN ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'true';
  const fromSource: 'EMAIL_FROM' | 'SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL' | 'missing' = hasEmailFrom
    ? 'EMAIL_FROM'
    : hasSendgridFromEmail
      ? 'SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL'
      : 'missing';

  const issues: string[] = [];
  if (fromSource === 'missing') issues.push('Missing sender address. Set EMAIL_FROM or SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL.');
  if (!dryRun && selectedProvider === 'sendgrid' && !hasSendGridKey) {
    issues.push('Missing SENDGRID_API_KEY for EMAIL_PROVIDER=sendgrid.');
  }
  if (!dryRun && selectedProvider === 'resend' && !hasResendKey) {
    issues.push('Missing RESEND_API_KEY for EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend.');
  }

  const hasFrom = hasEmailFrom || hasSendgridFromEmail;
  const ready = dryRun ? hasFrom : issues.length === 0;

  return {
    selectedProvider,
    hasEmailFrom: hasFrom,
    hasReplyTo,
    hasSendGridKey,
    hasResendKey,
    fromSource,
    dryRun,
    ready,
    issues,
  };
}

export function getEmailConfig(): EmailConfig {
  if (cachedConfig) return cachedConfig;

  const provider = normalizeProvider(process.env.EMAIL_PROVIDER);
  const fromEmail = (process.env.EMAIL_FROM ?? process.env.SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL ?? '').trim();
  const replyTo = process.env.EMAIL_REPLY_TO?.trim() || undefined;
  const sendgridApiKey = process.env.SENDGRID_API_KEY?.trim();
  const resendApiKey = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY?.trim();
  const dryRun = String(process.env.EMAIL_DRY_RUN ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'true';

  if (!fromEmail) throw new Error('[email] Missing sender address. Set EMAIL_FROM or SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL.');
  if (!dryRun && provider === 'sendgrid' && !sendgridApiKey) {
    throw new Error('[email] Missing SENDGRID_API_KEY for EMAIL_PROVIDER=sendgrid.');
  }
  if (!dryRun && provider === 'resend' && !resendApiKey) {
    throw new Error('[email] Missing RESEND_API_KEY for EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend.');
  }

  cachedConfig = {
    provider,
    fromEmail,
    replyTo,
    sendgridApiKey,
    resendApiKey,
  };
  return cachedConfig;
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/email/idempotency.ts ---
import crypto from 'crypto';

import { normalizeRecipients } from './providers/base';
import type { EmailCategory } from './types';

type IdempotencyInput = {
  category: EmailCategory;
  to: string | string[];
  subject: string;
  entityId?: string;
};

function hash(value: string): string {
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');
}

export function createEmailIdempotencyKey(input: IdempotencyInput): string {
  const recipients = normalizeRecipients(input.to).map((r) => r.toLowerCase()).sort();
  const payload = [input.category, hash(recipients.join(',')), hash(input.subject.trim().toLowerCase()), (input.entityId ?? '').trim()].join('|');
  return `email:${hash(payload)}`;
}

import type { EmailProviderName, SendEmailInput, SendEmailResult } from '../types';

export interface EmailProvider {
  name: EmailProviderName;
  send(input: SendEmailInput): Promise<SendEmailResult>;
}

export function normalizeRecipients(value: string | string[] | undefined): string[] {
  if (!value) return [];
  const items = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];
  return items.map((entry) => entry.trim()).filter((entry) => entry.length > 0);
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/email/providers/resend.ts ---
import { Resend } from 'resend';

import { getEmailConfig } from '../config';
import type { SendEmailInput, SendEmailResult } from '../types';
import { normalizeRecipients, type EmailProvider } from './base';

export class ResendProvider implements EmailProvider {
  name = 'resend' as const;

  async send(input: SendEmailInput): Promise<SendEmailResult> {
    const config = getEmailConfig();
    const apiKey = config.resendApiKey;
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error('[email] Missing RESEND_API_KEY for EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend.');

    const resend = new Resend(apiKey);
    const to = normalizeRecipients(input.to);
    const cc = normalizeRecipients(input.cc);
    const bcc = normalizeRecipients(input.bcc);
    const from = (input.from ?? config.fromEmail).trim();
    const replyTo = (input.replyTo ?? config.replyTo)?.trim();
    const htmlBody = input.html ?? (input.text ? `<pre>${input.text}</pre>` : '');

    try {
      const raw = await resend.emails.send({
        to,
        ...(cc.length > 0 ? { cc } : {}),
        ...(bcc.length > 0 ? { bcc } : {}),
        from,
        ...(replyTo ? { replyTo } : {}),
        subject: input.subject,
        html: htmlBody,
        ...(input.text ? { text: input.text } : {}),
      });

      if (raw.error) {
        return {
          ok: false,
          provider: this.name,
          errorCode: raw.error.name ?? 'resend_error',
          errorMessage: raw.error.message ?? 'Resend send failed.',
          raw,
        };
      }

      return {
        ok: true,
        provider: this.name,
        messageId: raw.data?.id,
        raw,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      const maybeError = error as { name?: string; message?: string };
      return {
        ok: false,
        provider: this.name,
        errorCode: maybeError.name ?? 'resend_error',
        errorMessage: maybeError.message ?? 'Resend send failed.',
      };
    }
  }
}

--- END FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/email/providers/resend.ts ---

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/email/providers/sendgrid.ts ---
import sgMail from '@sendgrid/mail';
import type { MailDataRequired } from '@sendgrid/mail';

import { getEmailConfig } from '../config';
import type { SendEmailInput, SendEmailResult } from '../types';
import { normalizeRecipients, type EmailProvider } from './base';

function pickMessageId(raw: unknown): string | undefined {
  if (!Array.isArray(raw) || raw.length === 0) return undefined;
  const first = raw[0] as { headers?: Record<string, string | string[] | undefined> } | undefined;
  const headers = first?.headers;
  if (!headers) return undefined;
  const value = headers['x-message-id'] ?? headers['X-Message-Id'];
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value[0];
  return value;
}

export class SendGridProvider implements EmailProvider {
  name = 'sendgrid' as const;

  async send(input: SendEmailInput): Promise<SendEmailResult> {
    const config = getEmailConfig();
    const apiKey = config.sendgridApiKey;
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error('[email] Missing SENDGRID_API_KEY for EMAIL_PROVIDER=sendgrid.');
    sgMail.setApiKey(apiKey);

    const to = normalizeRecipients(input.to);
    const cc = normalizeRecipients(input.cc);
    const bcc = normalizeRecipients(input.bcc);
    const from = (input.from ?? config.fromEmail).trim();
    const replyTo = (input.replyTo ?? config.replyTo)?.trim();
    const htmlBody = input.html ?? (input.text ? `<pre>${input.text}</pre>` : '');

    try {
      const payload: MailDataRequired = {
        to,
        ...(cc.length > 0 ? { cc } : {}),
        ...(bcc.length > 0 ? { bcc } : {}),
        from,
        ...(replyTo ? { replyTo } : {}),
        subject: input.subject,
        html: htmlBody,
        ...(input.text ? { text: input.text } : {}),
        ...(input.headers ? { headers: input.headers } : {}),
      };
      const raw = await sgMail.send(payload);
      return {
        ok: true,
        provider: this.name,
        messageId: pickMessageId(raw),
        raw,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      const maybeError = error as { code?: number | string; message?: string; response?: { statusCode?: number } };
      return {
        ok: false,
        provider: this.name,
        errorCode:
          (typeof maybeError.code === 'number' ? String(maybeError.code) : maybeError.code) ??
          (typeof maybeError.response?.statusCode === 'number' ? String(maybeError.response.statusCode) : undefined) ??
          'sendgrid_error',
        errorMessage: maybeError.message ?? 'SendGrid send failed.',
      };
    }
  }
}

--- END FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/email/providers/sendgrid.ts ---

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/email/send-email.ts ---
import { getEmailConfig, inspectEmailConfig } from './config';
import { ResendProvider } from './providers/resend';
import { SendGridProvider } from './providers/sendgrid';
import { normalizeRecipients, type EmailProvider } from './providers/base';
import type { SendEmailInput, SendEmailResult } from './types';

const KNOWN_CATEGORIES = new Set([
  'welcome',
  'password_reset',
  'student_invite',
  'student_invite_resend',
  'project_submission_confirmation',
  'resume_submission_confirmation',
  'mock_interview_scheduling',
  'mentorship_reminder',
  'feedback_available',
  'interview_ready_status_update',
  'announcement',
  'report_export_ready',
  'risk_alert',
  'college_admin_alert',
  'super_admin_alert',
  'test_email',
]);

function createProvider(): EmailProvider {
  const config = getEmailConfig();
  return config.provider === 'resend' ? new ResendProvider() : new SendGridProvider();
}

function buildInvalid(provider: 'sendgrid' | 'resend', message: string): SendEmailResult {
  return { ok: false, provider, errorCode: 'INVALID_EMAIL_INPUT', errorMessage: message };
}

export async function sendEmail(input: SendEmailInput): Promise<SendEmailResult> {
  const inspected = inspectEmailConfig();
  const providerName = inspected.selectedProvider;
  const to = normalizeRecipients(input.to);
  const cc = normalizeRecipients(input.cc);
  const bcc = normalizeRecipients(input.bcc);

  if (to.length === 0) return buildInvalid(providerName, 'At least one recipient is required.');
  if (input.cc !== undefined && cc.length === 0) return buildInvalid(providerName, 'When provided, cc must include at least one recipient.');
  if (input.bcc !== undefined && bcc.length === 0) return buildInvalid(providerName, 'When provided, bcc must include at least one recipient.');
  if (!input.subject?.trim()) return buildInvalid(providerName, 'Email subject is required.');
  if (!input.html?.trim() && !input.text?.trim()) return buildInvalid(providerName, 'Either html or text content is required.');
  if (!input.category?.trim()) return buildInvalid(providerName, 'Email category is required.');
  if (!KNOWN_CATEGORIES.has(input.category)) return buildInvalid(providerName, 'Invalid email category.');

  if (inspected.dryRun) {
    console.info(`[email] dry-run provider=${providerName} category=${input.category} toCount=${to.length}`);
    return { ok: true, provider: providerName, messageId: 'dry_run' };
  }

  const provider = createProvider();
  const result = await provider.send(input);
  if (result.ok) {
    console.info(`[email] sent provider=${provider.name} category=${input.category} toCount=${to.length}`);
    return result;
  }

  console.warn(`[email] failed provider=${provider.name} category=${input.category} errorCode=${result.errorCode ?? 'unknown'}`);
  return result;
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/features/has-feature.ts ---
import 'server-only';

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import type { FeatureKey } from '@/lib/features/feature-keys';

export async function hasFeature(collegeId: string, featureKey: FeatureKey): Promise<boolean> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('has_feature', {
    p_college_id: collegeId,
    p_feature_key: featureKey,
  });

  if (error) {
    console.error(`[features] has_feature RPC failed for college ${collegeId}:`, error.message);
    return false;
  }
  return Boolean(data);
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/hooks/use-gsap.ts ---
"use client";

import { useRef, useCallback } from "react";
import gsap from "gsap";

export function useGsapCountUp(target: React.RefObject<HTMLSpanElement | null>) {
  const animated = useRef(false);

  const animate = useCallback(() => {
    if (animated.current || !target.current) return;
    animated.current = true;

    const el = target.current;
    const end = parseFloat(el.dataset.value ?? "0");
    const isDecimal = el.dataset.decimal === "true";
    const suffix = el.dataset.suffix ?? "";

    const obj = { val: 0 };
    gsap.to(obj, {
      val: end,
      duration: 1.4,
      ease: "power2.out",
      onUpdate() {
        if (!el) return;
        el.textContent = isDecimal
          ? `${obj.val.toFixed(1)}${suffix}`
          : `${Math.round(obj.val)}${suffix}`;
      },
    });
  }, [target]);

  return { ref: target, animate };
}

export function useGsapProgress(barRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>) {
  const animated = useRef(false);

  const animate = useCallback(
    (width: number) => {
      if (animated.current || !barRef.current) return;
      animated.current = true;

      gsap.fromTo(
        barRef.current,
        { width: "0%" },
        { width: `${width}%`, duration: 1.2, ease: "power2.out" }
      );
    },
    [barRef]
  );

  return { ref: barRef, animate };
}
