const PLACEMENT_BUCKET = 'placement-docs';
const ALLOWED_TYPES = ['application/pdf', 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'];

/** Upload a file to placement-docs storage. Path: college_id/student_id/type/uuid.ext. Returns path or null. */
export async function uploadPlacementFile(
  collegeId: string,
  studentId: string,
  type: 'resume' | 'offer_letter' | 'placement_proof' | 'other',
  file: File
): Promise<string | null> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  if (!ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type)) return null;
  const ext = file.name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() || 'bin';
  const path = `${collegeId}/${studentId}/${type}/${crypto.randomUUID()}.${ext}`;
  const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();
  const { error } = await supabase.storage
    .from(PLACEMENT_BUCKET)
    .upload(path, buf, { contentType: file.type, upsert: false });
  if (error) return null;
  return path;
}

/** Create a signed URL for a placement doc path (for private bucket). */
export async function getPlacementDocSignedUrl(path: string, expiresIn = 3600): Promise<string | null> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.storage.from(PLACEMENT_BUCKET).createSignedUrl(path, expiresIn);
  if (error || !data?.signedUrl) return null;
  return data.signedUrl;
}

/** Consolidated placement dashboard data fetch to avoid repeated client/session setup and excess round trips. */
export async function getStudentPlacementDashboardData(
  studentId: string,
  collegeId: string,
  options: StudentPlacementDashboardOptions = {}
) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const profile = await getOrCreatePlacementProfile(studentId, collegeId);
  if (!profile) return null;

  const resumeLimit = options.resumeLimit ?? 5;
  const reviewLimit = options.reviewLimit ?? 3;
  const interviewLimit = options.interviewLimit ?? 5;
  const applicationLimit = options.applicationLimit ?? 10;
  const offerLimit = options.offerLimit ?? 10;
  const documentLimit = options.documentLimit ?? 10;
  const statusHistoryLimit = options.statusHistoryLimit ?? 10;

  const [
    resumeVersionsRes,
    linkedinReviewRes,
    githubReviewRes,
    readinessReviewsRes,
    mockInterviewsRes,
    applicationsRes,
    offersRes,
    documentsRes,
    statusHistoryRes,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from('resume_versions')
      .select('id, placement_profile_id, version_number, file_url, status, feedback, reviewed_at, reviewer_id, created_at')
      .eq('placement_profile_id', profile.id)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(resumeLimit),
    supabase
      .from('linkedin_reviews')
      .select('student_id, college_id, status, feedback, reviewed_at, reviewer_id')
      .eq('student_id', profile.student_id)
      .eq('college_id', profile.college_id)
      .maybeSingle(),
    supabase
      .from('github_reviews')
      .select('student_id, college_id, status, feedback, reviewed_at, reviewer_id')
      .eq('student_id', profile.student_id)
      .eq('college_id', profile.college_id)
      .maybeSingle(),
    supabase
      .from('placement_readiness_reviews')
      .select('id, placement_profile_id, reviewer_id, college_id, overall_status, feedback, reviewed_at')
      .eq('placement_profile_id', profile.id)
      .order('reviewed_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(reviewLimit),
    supabase
      .from('mock_interviews')
      .select('id, student_id, college_id, scheduled_at, conducted_at, outcome, feedback, interviewer_id')
      .eq('student_id', profile.student_id)
      .eq('college_id', profile.college_id)
      .order('scheduled_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(interviewLimit),
    supabase
      .from('student_applications')
      .select('id, student_id, college_id, company_name, role, status, applied_at, source, notes, updated_at')
      .eq('student_id', profile.student_id)
      .eq('college_id', profile.college_id)
      .order('updated_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(applicationLimit),
    supabase
      .from('offers')
      .select('id, student_id, college_id, application_id, company_name, role, amount, status, verified_at, created_at')
      .eq('student_id', profile.student_id)
      .eq('college_id', profile.college_id)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(offerLimit),
    supabase
      .from('placement_documents')
      .select('id, student_id, college_id, document_type, file_url, file_name, verified_at, created_at')
      .eq('student_id', profile.student_id)
      .eq('college_id', profile.college_id)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(documentLimit),
    supabase
      .from('placement_status_history')
      .select('id, placement_profile_id, from_status, to_status, changed_by, notes, changed_at')
      .eq('placement_profile_id', profile.id)
      .order('changed_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(statusHistoryLimit),
  ]);

  const applications = applicationsRes.data ?? [];
  const applicationIds = applications.map((app) => app.id as string);
  const roundsRes = applicationIds.length > 0
    ? await supabase
      .from('interview_rounds')
      .select('id, application_id, round_number, round_type, outcome, scheduled_at, notes')
      .in('application_id', applicationIds)
      .order('round_number')
    : { data: [] as Record<string, unknown>[] };

  return {
    profile,
    resumeVersions: (resumeVersionsRes.data ?? []).map(r => ({ ...r, file_name: (r as Record<string, unknown>).file_name ?? null })),
    linkedinReview: linkedinReviewRes.data ?? null,
    githubReview: githubReviewRes.data ?? null,
    readinessReviews: readinessReviewsRes.data ?? [],
    mockInterviews: mockInterviewsRes.data ?? [],
    applications: applicationsRes.data ?? [],
    interviewRoundsByApplication: [],
    rounds: roundsRes.data ?? [],
    offers: (offersRes.data ?? []).map(o => ({ ...o, verified_at: (o as Record<string, unknown>).verified_at ?? null })),
    documents: (documentsRes.data ?? []).map(d => ({ ...d, verified_at: (d as Record<string, unknown>).verified_at ?? null })),
    statusHistory: statusHistoryRes.data ?? [],
  };
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/services/razorpay-webhooks.ts ---
import 'server-only';

import { createAdminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { getOrderByGatewayOrderId, recordCouponUsageForOrder } from '@/lib/services/orders';
import { provisionAccessAfterPurchase } from '@/lib/services/payment-entitlements';
import type { OrderWithItems, RazorpayWebhookEvent } from '@/types/payments';

type WebhookResult = {
  handled: boolean;
  duplicate: boolean;
  message: string;
};

type RazorpayPaymentEntity = {
  id: string;
  order_id: string;
  amount: number;
  currency: string;
  status: string;
  method?: string;
  error_description?: string;
};

function getObject(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
    ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)
    : null;
}

function getString(value: unknown): string | null {
  return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0 ? value : null;
}

function getNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
}

function extractPaymentEntity(payload: Record<string, unknown>): RazorpayPaymentEntity | null {
  const event = payload as RazorpayWebhookEvent;
  const paymentEntity = getObject(event.payload?.payment?.entity);
  if (!paymentEntity) {
    return null;
  }

  const id = getString(paymentEntity.id);
  const orderId = getString(paymentEntity.order_id);
  const amount = getNumber(paymentEntity.amount);
  const currency = getString(paymentEntity.currency);
  const status = getString(paymentEntity.status);
  const method = getString(paymentEntity.method) ?? undefined;
  const errorDescription = getString(paymentEntity.error_description) ?? undefined;

  if (!id || !orderId || amount === null || !currency || !status) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    id,
    order_id: orderId,
    amount,
    currency,
    status,
    method,
    error_description: errorDescription,
  };
}

async function validateGlobalCourseOrder(
  order: OrderWithItems,
): Promise<{
  courseId: string;
  pillarId: string;
  variantId: string;
  studentId: string;
} | null> {
  if (order.entity_type !== 'course_variant') {
    return null;
  }

  const orderItem = order.order_items[0];
  if (!orderItem || orderItem.entity_type !== 'course_variant') {
    return null;
  }

  const metadata = getObject(order.metadata) ?? {};
  const courseId = getString(metadata.course_id);
  const pillarId = getString(metadata.pillar_id);
  const variantId = getString(metadata.variant_id) ?? order.entity_id;
  const studentId = getString(metadata.student_id) ?? order.purchaser_user_id;

  if (!courseId || !pillarId || !variantId || !studentId) {
    return null;
  }

  if (variantId !== order.entity_id || orderItem.entity_id !== variantId) {
    return null;
  }

  const admin = createAdminClient();
  const { data: pillar } = await admin
    .from('master_course_pillars')
    .select('id')
    .eq('id', pillarId)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published')
    .eq('visible_to_global_students', true)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!pillar) {
    return null;
  }

  const { data: course } = await admin
    .from('master_courses')
    .select('id')
    .eq('id', courseId)
    .eq('pillar_id', pillarId)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published')
    .eq('visible_to_global_students', true)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!course) {
    return null;
  }

  const { data: variant } = await admin
    .from('course_variants')
    .select('id')
    .eq('id', variantId)
    .eq('master_course_id', courseId)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published')
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!variant) {
    return null;
  }

  if (order.purchaser_user_id && order.purchaser_user_id !== studentId) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    courseId,
    pillarId,
    variantId,
    studentId,
  };
}

async function upsertCapturedPayment(params: {
  order: OrderWithItems;
  payment: RazorpayPaymentEntity;
  payload: Record<string, unknown>;
}): Promise<void> {
  const admin = createAdminClient();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  const { data: existingPayment } = await admin
    .from('payments')
    .select('id')
    .eq('order_id', params.order.id)
    .eq('gateway_payment_id', params.payment.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (existingPayment) {
    await admin
      .from('payments')
      .update({
        status: 'captured',
        amount_minor: params.payment.amount,
        currency: params.payment.currency,
        method: params.payment.method ?? null,
        captured_at: now,
        failure_reason: null,
        gateway_payload: params.payload,
      })
      .eq('id', (existingPayment as { id: string }).id);
    return;
  }

  const { data: initiatedPayment } = await admin
    .from('payments')
    .select('id')
    .eq('order_id', params.order.id)
    .eq('gateway_order_id', params.payment.order_id)
    .eq('status', 'initiated')
    .maybeSingle();

  if (initiatedPayment) {
    await admin
      .from('payments')
      .update({
        gateway_payment_id: params.payment.id,
        amount_minor: params.payment.amount,
        currency: params.payment.currency,
        status: 'captured',
        method: params.payment.method ?? null,
        captured_at: now,
        failure_reason: null,
        gateway_payload: params.payload,
      })
      .eq('id', (initiatedPayment as { id: string }).id);
    return;
  }

  await admin
    .from('payments')
    .insert({
      order_id: params.order.id,
      gateway_name: 'razorpay',
      gateway_order_id: params.payment.order_id,
      gateway_payment_id: params.payment.id,
      amount_minor: params.payment.amount,
      currency: params.payment.currency,
      status: 'captured',
      method: params.payment.method ?? null,
      captured_at: now,
      gateway_payload: params.payload,
    });
}

async function upsertFailedPayment(params: {
  order: OrderWithItems;
  payment: RazorpayPaymentEntity;
  payload: Record<string, unknown>;
}): Promise<void> {
  const admin = createAdminClient();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  const { data: existingPayment } = await admin
    .from('payments')
    .select('id, status')
    .eq('order_id', params.order.id)
    .eq('gateway_payment_id', params.payment.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (existingPayment) {
    const status = (existingPayment as { status: string }).status;
    if (status === 'captured' || status === 'authorized' || status === 'refunded') {
      return;
    }

    await admin
      .from('payments')
      .update({
        status: 'failed',
        amount_minor: params.payment.amount,
        currency: params.payment.currency,
        failure_reason: params.payment.error_description ?? 'Payment failed',
        failed_at: now,
        gateway_payload: params.payload,
      })
      .eq('id', (existingPayment as { id: string }).id);
    return;
  }

  const { data: initiatedPayment } = await admin
    .from('payments')
    .select('id')
    .eq('order_id', params.order.id)
    .eq('gateway_order_id', params.payment.order_id)
    .eq('status', 'initiated')
    .maybeSingle();

  if (initiatedPayment) {
    await admin
      .from('payments')
      .update({
        gateway_payment_id: params.payment.id,
        amount_minor: params.payment.amount,
        currency: params.payment.currency,
        status: 'failed',
        failure_reason: params.payment.error_description ?? 'Payment failed',
        failed_at: now,
        gateway_payload: params.payload,
      })
      .eq('id', (initiatedPayment as { id: string }).id);
    return;
  }

  await admin
    .from('payments')
    .insert({
      order_id: params.order.id,
      gateway_name: 'razorpay',
      gateway_order_id: params.payment.order_id,
      gateway_payment_id: params.payment.id,
      amount_minor: params.payment.amount,
      currency: params.payment.currency,
      status: 'failed',
      failure_reason: params.payment.error_description ?? 'Payment failed',
      failed_at: now,
      gateway_payload: params.payload,
    });
}

async function reconcileCapturedPayment(params: {
  eventId: string | null;
  payload: Record<string, unknown>;
}): Promise<WebhookResult> {
  const payment = extractPaymentEntity(params.payload);
  if (!payment) {
    return { handled: true, duplicate: false, message: 'Ignored malformed payment payload.' };
  }

  const order = await getOrderByGatewayOrderId(payment.order_id);
  if (!order) {
    return { handled: true, duplicate: false, message: 'Ignored unknown Razorpay order.' };
  }

  if (order.status === 'cancelled' || order.status === 'failed' || order.status === 'refunded') {
    return { handled: true, duplicate: false, message: 'Ignored non-payable order state.' };
  }

  if (order.total_amount_minor !== payment.amount) {
    return { handled: true, duplicate: false, message: 'Blocked amount mismatch.' };
  }

  if (order.currency && order.currency !== payment.currency) {
    return { handled: true, duplicate: false, message: 'Blocked currency mismatch.' };
  }

  const validatedOrder = await validateGlobalCourseOrder(order);
  if (!validatedOrder) {
    return { handled: true, duplicate: false, message: 'Blocked invalid course purchase context.' };
  }

  const admin = createAdminClient();
  const { data: paymentMatches } = await admin
    .from('payments')
    .select('order_id, status')
    .eq('gateway_payment_id', payment.id)
    .limit(10);

  const reuseAcrossOrders = (paymentMatches ?? []).some(
    (match) => (match as { order_id: string }).order_id !== order.id,
  );
  if (reuseAcrossOrders) {
    return { handled: true, duplicate: false, message: 'Blocked payment reuse across orders.' };
  }

  const isDuplicate =
    (paymentMatches ?? []).some(
      (match) =>
        (match as { order_id: string; status: string }).order_id === order.id &&
        ['authorized', 'captured', 'refunded'].includes(
          (match as { status: string }).status,
        ),
    ) ||
    (order.status === 'paid' && order.gateway_payment_id === payment.id);

  if (order.gateway_payment_id && order.gateway_payment_id !== payment.id && order.status === 'paid') {
    return { handled: true, duplicate: false, message: 'Blocked conflicting paid order payment id.' };
  }

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  if (order.status !== 'paid' || order.gateway_payment_id !== payment.id) {
    await admin
      .from('orders')
      .update({
        status: 'paid',
        gateway_payment_id: payment.id,
        paid_at: order.paid_at ?? now,
        metadata: {
          ...(getObject(order.metadata) ?? {}),
          payment_method: payment.method ?? null,
          verified_at: now,
          webhook_verified_at: now,
          webhook_event_id: params.eventId,
          webhook_event_type: 'payment.captured',
        },
      })
      .eq('id', order.id);
  }

  await upsertCapturedPayment({
    order,
    payment,
    payload: params.payload,
  });

  await recordCouponUsageForOrder(order);

  await provisionAccessAfterPurchase({
    order: {
      ...order,
      gateway_payment_id: payment.id,
      paid_at: order.paid_at ?? now,
    },
    studentUserId: validatedOrder.studentId,
    studentEmail: order.purchaser_email,
    collegeId: null,
    metadata: {
      source: 'razorpay_webhook',
      paymentId: payment.id,
      purchased_at: order.paid_at ?? now,
      verified_at: now,
      pillar_id: validatedOrder.pillarId,
      course_id: validatedOrder.courseId,
      variant_id: validatedOrder.variantId,
      razorpay_order_id: payment.order_id,
      webhook_event_id: params.eventId ?? undefined,
    },
  });

  return {
    handled: true,
    duplicate: isDuplicate,
    message: isDuplicate ? 'Handled duplicate captured payment.' : 'Captured payment reconciled.',
  };
}

async function reconcileFailedPayment(params: {
  payload: Record<string, unknown>;
}): Promise<WebhookResult> {
  const payment = extractPaymentEntity(params.payload);
  if (!payment) {
    return { handled: true, duplicate: false, message: 'Ignored malformed failed payment payload.' };
  }

  const order = await getOrderByGatewayOrderId(payment.order_id);
  if (!order) {
    return { handled: true, duplicate: false, message: 'Ignored unknown Razorpay order.' };
  }

  if (order.status === 'paid' || order.status === 'refunded' || order.status === 'cancelled') {
    return { handled: true, duplicate: false, message: 'Ignored failure after terminal paid state.' };
  }

  const admin = createAdminClient();
  const { data: successfulPayments } = await admin
    .from('payments')
    .select('id')
    .eq('order_id', order.id)
    .in('status', ['authorized', 'captured', 'refunded'])
    .limit(1);

  if ((successfulPayments ?? []).length > 0) {
    return { handled: true, duplicate: false, message: 'Ignored failure because success already recorded.' };
  }

  const { data: paymentMatches } = await admin
    .from('payments')
    .select('order_id')
    .eq('gateway_payment_id', payment.id)
    .limit(10);

  const reuseAcrossOrders = (paymentMatches ?? []).some(
    (match) => (match as { order_id: string }).order_id !== order.id,
  );
  if (reuseAcrossOrders) {
    return { handled: true, duplicate: false, message: 'Blocked failed payment reuse across orders.' };
  }

  await admin
    .from('orders')
    .update({
      status: 'failed',
      metadata: {
        ...(getObject(order.metadata) ?? {}),
        failed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        webhook_event_type: 'payment.failed',
      },
    })
    .eq('id', order.id)
    .eq('status', 'pending');

  await upsertFailedPayment({
    order,
    payment,
    payload: params.payload,
  });

  return { handled: true, duplicate: false, message: 'Failed payment recorded conservatively.' };
}

export async function handleRazorpayWebhookEvent(params: {
  eventId: string | null;
  eventType: string;
  payload: Record<string, unknown>;
}): Promise<WebhookResult> {
  if (params.eventType === 'payment.captured') {
    return reconcileCapturedPayment({
      eventId: params.eventId,
      payload: params.payload,
    });
  }

  if (params.eventType === 'payment.failed') {
    return reconcileFailedPayment({ payload: params.payload });
  }

  if (params.eventType === 'order.paid') {
    const payment = extractPaymentEntity(params.payload);
    if (!payment) {
      return { handled: true, duplicate: false, message: 'Ignored order.paid without payment entity.' };
    }

    return reconcileCapturedPayment({
      eventId: params.eventId,
      payload: params.payload,
    });
  }

  return { handled: true, duplicate: false, message: 'Ignored unrelated event.' };
}

import 'server-only';
import { createAdminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { requireStudent } from '@/lib/auth/require-student';
import { getCourseProgress, getItemProgressMap } from '@/lib/services/student-progress';
import type { 
  MasterCoursePillarsRow, 
  MasterCoursesRow, 
} from '@/types/database';
import type { CourseForStudent, CurriculumModule, CurriculumItem } from '@/types/student-runtime';

export interface StudentLearningContext {
  studentId: string;
  userId: string;
  collegeId: string | null;
  isGlobal: boolean;
  tenantSlug: string;
}

export interface EntitledCourseListItem extends MasterCoursesRow {
  module_count: number;
  video_count: number;
  progress_percentage: number;
}

export interface EntitledPillarGroup {
  pillar: MasterCoursePillarsRow;
  courses: EntitledCourseListItem[];
}

/**
 * Resolve learning context for the current student.
 */
export async function getStudentLearningContext(collegeSlug: string): Promise<StudentLearningContext> {
  const context = await requireStudent(collegeSlug);

  return {
    studentId: context.studentId,
    userId: context.user.id,
    collegeId: context.isGlobal ? null : context.tenant.id,
    isGlobal: context.isGlobal,
    tenantSlug: context.tenant.slug
  };
}

export type VisiblePillarForStudent = Pick<
  MasterCoursePillarsRow,
  'id' | 'title' | 'description' | 'short_description' | 'slug'
>;

/**
 * Pillar navigation and catalog must satisfy **both**:
 * - `publish_status === 'published'`
 * - Student audience visibility: `visible_to_global_students` (global LMS) **or**
 *   `visible_to_college_students` (tenant college LMS).
 *
 * Publishing alone without turning on the matching audience flag hides the pillar
 * from the student sidebar/listings even though admins may see it as "published".
 */
export async function listVisiblePillarsForStudent(_collegeSlug: string): Promise<MasterCoursePillarsRow[]> {
  void _collegeSlug;
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  const pillarQuery = sb
    .from('master_course_pillars')
    .select('*')
    .eq('publish_status', 'published');

  const { data: pillars, error } = await pillarQuery.order('sort_order', { ascending: true });
  if (error || !pillars) return [];

  // For college students, we just return the published and visible pillars.
  // There is no more entitlement check required.

  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && pillars.length === 0) {
    const { count: publishedOnly } = await sb
      .from('master_course_pillars')
      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('publish_status', 'published');
    if ((publishedOnly ?? 0) > 0) {
      console.info(
        '[LMS sidebar] Zero visible pillars for this audience: pillars may be publish_status=published but audience visibility flags are still off (visible_to_college_students / visible_to_global_students).',
      );
    }
  }

  return pillars;
}

/**
 * Load one pillar slug for pillar landing pages — same eligibility as the sidebar (`listVisiblePillarsForStudent`).
 * Returns metadata even when no discoverable courses exist yet (empty catalog state).
 */
export async function getVisiblePillarBySlugForStudent(
  collegeSlug: string,
  pillarSlug: string,
): Promise<VisiblePillarForStudent | null> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  const q = sb
    .from('master_course_pillars')
    .select('id, title, description, short_description, slug')
    .eq('slug', pillarSlug)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published');

  const { data: row } = await q.maybeSingle();
  return row ?? null;
}

/**
 * List all courses the current student is entitled to, grouped by Pillar.
 */
export async function listStudentEntitledCoursesGroupedByPillar(collegeSlug: string): Promise<EntitledPillarGroup[]> {
  const ctx = await getStudentLearningContext(collegeSlug);
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  // Fetch all published courses visible to this student audience
  const query = sb
    .from('master_courses')
    .select(`
      *,
      master_course_modules!left(id),
      video_assets!left(id)
    `)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published');

  const { data: courses, error: coursesError } = await query;
  if (coursesError || !courses?.length) return [];

  // 3. Aggregate stats and fetch pillars
  const enrichedCourses: EntitledCourseListItem[] = [];
  const pillarIds = new Set<string>();

  for (const c of courses) {
    const progress = await getCourseProgress(ctx.studentId, c.id);
    const modules = (c.master_course_modules || []) as unknown[];
    const videos = (c.video_assets || []) as unknown[];

    if (!c.pillar_id) {
      continue;
    }

    pillarIds.add(c.pillar_id);

    enrichedCourses.push({
      ...c,
      module_count: modules.length,
      video_count: videos.length,
      progress_percentage: progress.percentage
    });
  }

  // 4. Fetch pillars with visibility and publish status filters
  const pillarQuery = sb
    .from('master_course_pillars')
    .select('*')
    .in('id', Array.from(pillarIds))
    .eq('publish_status', 'published');

  const { data: pillars, error: pillarsError } = await pillarQuery.order('sort_order', { ascending: true });
  if (pillarsError || !pillars) return [];

  // 5. Group by pillar
  const groups: EntitledPillarGroup[] = [];
  for (const pillar of pillars) {
    const pillarCourses = enrichedCourses.filter(c => c.pillar_id === pillar.id);
    if (pillarCourses.length > 0) {
      groups.push({
        pillar,
        courses: pillarCourses.sort((a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title))
      });
    }
  }

  return groups;
}

/**
 * Get full details for a student course, including curriculum and progress.
 */
export async function getStudentCourseDetail(
  collegeSlug: string,
  courseId: string
): Promise<CourseForStudent | null> {
  const ctx = await getStudentLearningContext(collegeSlug);
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  // 1. Skip explicit entitlement check. Courses are accessible if published & visible.

  // 2. Fetch Course with visibility check
  const courseQuery = sb
    .from('master_courses')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', courseId)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published');

  const { data: course, error: courseError } = await courseQuery.maybeSingle();
  if (courseError || !course) return null;

  // 3. Fetch Pillar visibility check
  if (!course.pillar_id) return null;

  const pillarQuery = sb
    .from('master_course_pillars')
    .select('id')
    .eq('id', course.pillar_id)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published');

  const { data: pillar } = await pillarQuery.maybeSingle();
  if (!pillar) return null;

  // 4. Fetch Modules (published and student-visible)
  const { data: modules, error: modulesError } = await sb
    .from('master_course_modules')
    .select('*')
    .eq('master_course_id', courseId)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published')
    .order('sort_order', { ascending: true });

  if (modulesError) return null;

  // 5. Fetch Items and Progress
  const visibleModuleIds = new Set((modules || []).map((module) => module.id));

  const [itemsRes, progressMap] = await Promise.all([
    sb.from('master_course_items')
      .select('*')
      .eq('master_course_id', courseId)
      .eq('publish_status', 'published')
      .order('sort_order', { ascending: true }),
    getItemProgressMap(ctx.studentId, courseId)
  ]);

  const items = (itemsRes.data || []).filter((item) => visibleModuleIds.has(item.module_id)).map(item => ({
    ...item,
    progress: progressMap.get(item.id) || null
  })) as CurriculumItem[];

  const enrichedModules = (modules || []).map(mod => ({
    ...mod,
    items: items.filter(i => i.module_id === mod.id)
  })) as CurriculumModule[];

  return {
    ...course,
    modules: enrichedModules
  } as CourseForStudent;
}

import 'server-only';

/**
 * Student Engagement Service (Phase 7B).
 *
 * Handles student-authored notes and bookmarks for course lessons.
 * Enforces entitlement and ownership checks.
 */

import { createAdminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { resolveAccessibleLesson } from '@/lib/services/student-entitlements-expanded';
import type { StudentLessonNotesRow, StudentLessonBookmarksRow } from '@/types/database';

// ─── Lesson Notes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Get a student's note for a specific lesson.
 */
export async function getLessonNote(
  studentId: string,
  courseId: string,
  itemId: string,
  isGlobal: boolean,
  collegeId: string | null,
): Promise<StudentLessonNotesRow | null> {
  const access = await resolveAccessibleLesson(studentId, courseId, itemId, { isGlobal, collegeId });
  if (!access) return null;

  const sb = createAdminClient();
  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from('student_lesson_notes')
    .select('*')
    .eq('student_id', studentId)
    .eq('item_id', access.item.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (error) {
    console.error('[EngagementService] getLessonNote error:', error);
    return null;
  }
  return data;
}

/**
 * Upsert (create or update) a student's note for a lesson.
 */
export async function upsertLessonNote(
  studentId: string,
  courseId: string,
  itemId: string,
  body: string,
  isGlobal: boolean,
  collegeId: string | null,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: StudentLessonNotesRow; error?: string }> {
  const access = await resolveAccessibleLesson(studentId, courseId, itemId, { isGlobal, collegeId });
  if (!access) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: No active entitlement found.' };
  }

  const sb = createAdminClient();

  // 2. Upsert Note for the validated lesson
  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from('student_lesson_notes')
    .upsert(
      {
        student_id: studentId,
        master_course_id: access.course.id,
        item_id: access.item.id,
        body,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
      { onConflict: 'student_id,item_id' }
    )
    .select()
    .single();

  if (error) {
    console.error('[EngagementService] upsertLessonNote error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to save note.' };
  }

  return { success: true, data };
}

/**
 * Delete a student's note for a lesson.
 */
export async function deleteLessonNote(
  studentId: string,
  courseId: string,
  itemId: string,
  isGlobal: boolean,
  collegeId: string | null,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  const access = await resolveAccessibleLesson(studentId, courseId, itemId, { isGlobal, collegeId });
  if (!access) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Lesson access denied.' };
  }

  const sb = createAdminClient();
  const { error } = await sb
    .from('student_lesson_notes')
    .delete()
    .eq('student_id', studentId)
    .eq('item_id', access.item.id)
    .eq('master_course_id', access.course.id);

  if (error) {
    console.error('[EngagementService] deleteLessonNote error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to delete note.' };
  }

  return { success: true };
}

    .eq('item_id', access.item.id)

  if (!access) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: No active entitlement found.' };

  // 2. Insert Bookmark for the validated lesson

    .from('student_lesson_bookmarks')
    .insert({
      student_id: studentId,
      master_course_id: access.course.id,
      item_id: access.item.id,
      timestamp_seconds: timestampSeconds,
      label,
    })

/**
 * Delete a specific bookmark.

  studentId: string,
  bookmarkId: string,
  isGlobal: boolean,
  collegeId: string | null,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {

    .from('student_lesson_bookmarks')
    .select('id, master_course_id, item_id')

    .from('student_lesson_bookmarks')
    .delete()
    .eq('id', bookmarkId)
    .eq('student_id', studentId)
    .eq('item_id', access.item.id)
    .eq('master_course_id', access.course.id);

  if (error) {
    console.error('[EngagementService] deleteLessonBookmark error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to delete bookmark.' };
  }

  return { success: true };
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/services/student-entitlements-expanded.ts ---
import 'server-only';

import { createAdminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import type {
  EntitlementSourceType,
  MasterCoursesRow,
  MasterCourseItemsRow,
  MasterCourseModulesRow,
  VideoAssetsRow,
} from '@/types/database';

export interface ResolvedCourseAccess {
  master_course_id: string;
  master_course: MasterCoursesRow;
  source_entitlement_id: string;
  source_type: EntitlementSourceType | 'global_publish';
  status: string;
  valid_until?: string | null;
}

export interface StudentAccessContext {
  isGlobal: boolean;
  collegeId: string | null;
}

export interface ResolvedLessonAccess {
  entitlement: ResolvedCourseAccess | null;
  course: MasterCoursesRow;
  module: MasterCourseModulesRow;
  item: MasterCourseItemsRow;
  asset: VideoAssetsRow | null;
}

/**
 * Check if a student has access to a specific course.
 * Now simply checks if the course is published and visible to the student's audience.
 */
export async function validateStudentCourseAccess(
  _studentId: string,
  courseId: string,
  _context: StudentAccessContext,
): Promise<ResolvedCourseAccess | null> {
  void _studentId;
  void _context;
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  const query = sb
    .from('master_courses')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', courseId)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published');

  const { data: course, error } = await query.maybeSingle();

  if (error || !course) return null;

  return {
    master_course_id: course.id,
    master_course: course as MasterCoursesRow,
    source_entitlement_id: 'global-publish',
    source_type: 'b2b_college',
    status: 'active',
  };
}

/**
 * Get all Master Courses a student currently has access to.
 * Now simply returns all published courses visible to the student's audience.
 */
export async function getStudentAccessibleCourses(
  _studentId: string,
  _context?: StudentAccessContext,
): Promise<ResolvedCourseAccess[]> {
  void _studentId;
  void _context;
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  const query = sb
    .from('master_courses')
    .select('*')
    .eq('publish_status', 'published');

  const { data: courses, error } = await query;

  if (error || !courses) return [];

  return courses.map(course => ({
    master_course_id: course.id,
    master_course: course as MasterCoursesRow,
    source_entitlement_id: 'global-publish',
    source_type: 'b2b_college' as const,
    status: 'active',
  }));
}

export async function resolveAccessibleLesson(
  studentId: string,
  courseId: string,
  itemId: string,
  context: StudentAccessContext,
): Promise<ResolvedLessonAccess | null> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  const access = await validateStudentCourseAccess(studentId, courseId, context);
  if (!access) return null;

  const [{ data: course }, { data: item }] = await Promise.all([
    sb.from('master_courses').select('*').eq('id', courseId).maybeSingle(),
    sb.from('master_course_items')
      .select('*')
      .eq('id', itemId)
      .eq('master_course_id', courseId)
      .eq('publish_status', 'published')
      .maybeSingle(),
  ]);

  if (!course || !item) return null;

  const { data: module } = await sb
    .from('master_course_modules')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', item.module_id)
    .eq('master_course_id', courseId)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published')
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!module) return null;

  let asset: VideoAssetsRow | null = null;
  if (item.video_asset_id) {
    const { data: assetRow } = await sb
      .from('video_assets')
      .select('*')
      .eq('id', item.video_asset_id)
      .eq('master_course_id', courseId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (!assetRow) return null;

    const assetModuleId = assetRow.master_course_module_id ?? assetRow.module_id;
    if (assetModuleId && assetModuleId !== module.id) return null;
    asset = assetRow;
  }

  return {
    entitlement: null,
    course: course as MasterCoursesRow,
    module,
    item: item as MasterCourseItemsRow,
    asset,
  };
}

export async function resolveAccessibleVideoAsset(
  studentId: string,
  assetId: string,
  context: StudentAccessContext,
): Promise<ResolvedLessonAccess | null> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  const { data: asset } = await sb
    .from('video_assets')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', assetId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!asset) return null;

  const access = await validateStudentCourseAccess(studentId, asset.master_course_id, context);
  if (!access) return null;

  const assetModuleId = asset.master_course_module_id ?? asset.module_id;
  const { data: item } = await sb
    .from('master_course_items')
    .select('*')
    .eq('master_course_id', asset.master_course_id)
    .eq('video_asset_id', asset.id)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published')
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!item) return null;
  if (assetModuleId && item.module_id !== assetModuleId) return null;

  return resolveAccessibleLesson(studentId, asset.master_course_id, item.id, context);
}

export async function validateStudentAssetAccess(
  studentId: string,
  assetId: string,
  context: StudentAccessContext,
) {
  const resolved = await resolveAccessibleVideoAsset(studentId, assetId, context);
  return resolved?.entitlement ?? resolved ?? null;
}

export async function validateStudentItemAccess(
  studentId: string,
  itemId: string,
  context: StudentAccessContext,
) {
  const sb = createAdminClient();
  const { data: item, error: itemErr } = await sb
    .from('master_course_items')
    .select('master_course_id')
    .eq('id', itemId)
    .single();

  if (itemErr || !item) return null;

  const resolved = await resolveAccessibleLesson(studentId, item.master_course_id, itemId, context);
  return resolved?.entitlement ?? resolved ?? null;
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/services/student-entitlements.ts ---
import 'server-only';

/**
 * Student Entitlements Service (Phase 4).
 *
 * Centralized access-control layer that determines which Master Courses
 * a student can access. Supports B2B college, B2C direct, bundle,
 * subscription, and manual grants.
 *
 * All methods use the service-role client (bypasses RLS).
 * Callers must validate admin identity before invoking mutations.
 */

import { createAdminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import type {
  EntitlementSourceType,
  EntitlementStatus,
  StudentEntitlementsRow,
} from '@/types/database';

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface GrantEntitlementInput {
  student_id: string;
  master_course_id: string;
  source_type: EntitlementSourceType;
  college_id?: string;
  valid_from?: string;
  valid_until?: string | null;
  granted_by?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface EntitlementWithCourse extends StudentEntitlementsRow {
  master_courses?: {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    code: string;
    description: string | null;
    short_description: string | null;
    pillar: string | null;
    publish_status: string;
  };
}

// ─── Grant / Revoke ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Grant a student access to a Master Course.
 */
export async function grantEntitlement(
  input: GrantEntitlementInput,
): Promise<StudentEntitlementsRow> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from('student_entitlements')
    .insert({
      student_id: input.student_id,
      master_course_id: input.master_course_id,
      source_type: input.source_type,
      college_id: input.college_id ?? null,
      status: 'active' as EntitlementStatus,
      valid_from: input.valid_from ?? new Date().toISOString(),
      valid_until: input.valid_until ?? null,
      granted_by: input.granted_by ?? null,
      metadata: input.metadata ?? {},
    })
    .select('*')
    .single();

  if (error) throw new Error(`Failed to grant entitlement: ${error.message}`);
  return data as StudentEntitlementsRow;
}

/**
 * Revoke a student entitlement.
 */
export async function revokeEntitlement(
  entitlementId: string,
  revokedBy: string,
  reason?: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  const { error } = await sb
    .from('student_entitlements')
    .update({
      status: 'revoked' as EntitlementStatus,
      revoked_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      revoked_by: revokedBy,
      revoke_reason: reason ?? null,
    })
    .eq('id', entitlementId);

  if (error) throw new Error(`Failed to revoke entitlement: ${error.message}`);
}

// ─── Resolution / Validation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Validates that a course and its parent pillar are published and visible
 * to the given student type.
 */
export async function checkHierarchyVisibility(
  courseId: string,
  isGlobal: boolean,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  // 1. Fetch course details
  const { data: course } = await sb
    .from('master_courses')
    .select('pillar_id, publish_status, visible_to_college_students, visible_to_global_students')
    .eq('id', courseId)
    .single();

  if (!course || course.publish_status !== 'published') return false;
  if (!course.pillar_id) return false;
  
  const courseVisible = isGlobal ? course.visible_to_global_students : course.visible_to_college_students;
  if (!courseVisible) return false;

  // 2. Fetch pillar details
  const { data: pillar } = await sb
    .from('master_course_pillars')
    .select('publish_status, visible_to_college_students, visible_to_global_students')
    .eq('id', course.pillar_id)
    .single();

  if (!pillar || pillar.publish_status !== 'published') return false;

  const pillarVisible = isGlobal ? pillar.visible_to_global_students : pillar.visible_to_college_students;
  if (!pillarVisible) return false;

  return true;
}

/**
 * Get all active, non-expired entitlements for a student.
 */
export async function resolveStudentEntitlements(
  studentId: string,
): Promise<EntitlementWithCourse[]> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from('student_entitlements')
    .select(`
      *,
      master_courses (
        id, title, code, description, short_description, pillar, publish_status
      )
    `)
    .eq('student_id', studentId)
    .eq('status', 'active')
    .lte('valid_from', nowIso)
    .or('valid_until.is.null,valid_until.gt.' + nowIso);

  if (error) throw new Error(`Failed to resolve entitlements: ${error.message}`);
  return (data ?? []) as EntitlementWithCourse[];
}

/**
 * Check if a student has an active entitlement for a specific course.
 * Returns the entitlement row if valid, null otherwise.
 */
export async function validateStudentCourseAccess(
  studentId: string,
  courseId: string,
  isGlobal: boolean,
): Promise<StudentEntitlementsRow | null> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

  // Hierarchy Visibility Check
  const isVisible = await checkHierarchyVisibility(courseId, isGlobal);
  if (!isVisible) return null;

  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from('student_entitlements')
    .select('*')
    .eq('student_id', studentId)
    .eq('master_course_id', courseId)
    .eq('status', 'active')
    .lte('valid_from', nowIso)
    .or('valid_until.is.null,valid_until.gt.' + nowIso)
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (error) throw new Error(`Failed to validate course access: ${error.message}`);
  return data as StudentEntitlementsRow | null;
}

/**
 * Check if a student has access to a specific video asset.
 * Resolves asset → course → entitlement chain.
 */
export async function validateStudentAssetAccess(
  studentId: string,
  assetId: string,
  isGlobal: boolean,
): Promise<StudentEntitlementsRow | null> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  // Resolve the video asset's parent course
  const { data: asset, error: assetErr } = await sb
    .from('video_assets')
    .select('master_course_id')
    .eq('id', assetId)
    .single();

  if (assetErr || !asset) return null;

  return validateStudentCourseAccess(studentId, asset.master_course_id, isGlobal);
}

/**
 * Check if a student has access to a specific curriculum item.
 * Resolves item → course → entitlement chain.
 */
export async function validateStudentItemAccess(
  studentId: string,
  itemId: string,
  isGlobal: boolean,
): Promise<StudentEntitlementsRow | null> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  // Resolve the item's parent course
  const { data: item, error: itemErr } = await sb
    .from('master_course_items')
    .select('master_course_id')
    .eq('id', itemId)
    .single();

  if (itemErr || !item) return null;

  return validateStudentCourseAccess(studentId, item.master_course_id, isGlobal);
}

/**
 * Get all Master Courses a student currently has access to.
 */
export async function getStudentAccessibleCourses(
  studentId: string,
): Promise<EntitlementWithCourse[]> {
  return resolveStudentEntitlements(studentId);
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/services/student-progress.ts ---
import 'server-only';

/**
 * Student Progress Tracking Service (Phase 4).
 *
 * Handles video watch progress, session logging, resume playback,
 * and course-level completion aggregation.
 *
 * Completion threshold: 90% watched → auto-mark complete.
 * Progress sync: called every 15 seconds + on pause/ended/transition.
 */

import { createAdminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { resolveAccessibleLesson, resolveAccessibleVideoAsset, type StudentAccessContext } from '@/lib/services/student-entitlements-expanded';

const COMPLETION_THRESHOLD = 0.9;

// ─── Video Sessions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Start a new video watch session.
 * Returns the session ID for later ending the session.
 */
export async function startSession(
  studentId: string,
  videoAssetId: string,
  context: StudentAccessContext,
  itemId?: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();
  const access = await resolveAccessibleVideoAsset(studentId, videoAssetId, context);
  if (!access) {
    throw new Error('Unauthorized: Lesson access denied.');
  }

  if (itemId && access.item.id !== itemId) {
    throw new Error('Unauthorized: Video does not belong to the requested lesson.');
  }

  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from('student_video_sessions')
    .insert({
      student_id: studentId,
      video_asset_id: access.asset?.id ?? videoAssetId,
      item_id: access.item.id,
    })
    .select('id')
    .single();

  if (error) throw new Error(`Failed to start session: ${error.message}`);
  return data.id;
}

/**
 * End a video watch session with final duration.
 */
export async function endSession(
  studentId: string,
  sessionId: string,
  watchedDurationSeconds: number,
): Promise<void> {
  // Guard against invalid UUIDs (like "null" string) that might leak from client/serialization
  if (!sessionId || sessionId === 'null' || sessionId.length < 32) {
    return;
  }

  const sb = createAdminClient();

  const { error } = await sb
    .from('student_video_sessions')
    .update({
      ended_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      watched_duration_seconds: watchedDurationSeconds,
    })
    .eq('id', sessionId)
    .eq('student_id', studentId);

  if (error) throw new Error(`Failed to end session: ${error.message}`);
}

// ─── Progress Upsert ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Update watch progress for a curriculum item.
 * Uses upsert on the unique (student_id, item_id) constraint.
 */
export async function updateWatchProgress(input: {
  studentId: string;
  itemId: string;
  watchedSeconds: number;
  totalSeconds: number;
  lastPositionSeconds: number;
  entitlementId?: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  const { error } = await sb
    .from('student_progress')
    .upsert(
      {
        student_id: input.studentId,
        item_id: input.itemId,
        watched_seconds: input.watchedSeconds,
        total_seconds: input.totalSeconds,
        last_position_seconds: input.lastPositionSeconds,
        entitlement_id: input.entitlementId ?? null,
      },
      { onConflict: 'student_id,item_id' },
    );

  if (error) throw new Error(`Failed to update progress: ${error.message}`);
}

// ─── Completion ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Mark a curriculum item as completed.
 * Idempotent: does nothing if already completed.
 * Only marks complete if watchedSeconds / totalSeconds >= COMPLETION_THRESHOLD.
 */
export async function markCompleted(
  studentId: string,
  itemId: string,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  // Check current progress
  const { data: existing } = await sb
    .from('student_progress')
    .select('completed, watched_seconds, total_seconds')
    .eq('student_id', studentId)
    .eq('item_id', itemId)
    .maybeSingle();

  // Already completed — idempotent
  if (existing?.completed) return true;

  // Verify threshold
  if (!existing || existing.total_seconds === 0) return false;
  const ratio = existing.watched_seconds / existing.total_seconds;
  if (ratio < COMPLETION_THRESHOLD) return false;

  const { error } = await sb
    .from('student_progress')
    .update({
      completed: true,
      completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
    .eq('student_id', studentId)
    .eq('item_id', itemId);

  if (error) throw new Error(`Failed to mark completed: ${error.message}`);
  return true;
}

// ─── Combined Sync ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Combined progress sync — called every 15 seconds and on pause/ended/transition.
 * Updates progress and auto-marks complete if threshold met.
 */
export async function syncPlaybackProgress(input: {
  studentId: string;
  itemId: string;
  courseId: string;
  context: StudentAccessContext;
  lastPositionSeconds: number;
  watchedSeconds: number;
  totalSeconds: number;
  entitlementId?: string;
}): Promise<{ completed: boolean }> {
  const access = await resolveAccessibleLesson(
    input.studentId,
    input.courseId,
    input.itemId,
    input.context,
  );
  if (!access) {
    throw new Error('Unauthorized: Lesson access denied.');
  }

  // 1. Update raw progress
  await updateWatchProgress({
    studentId: input.studentId,
    itemId: access.item.id,
    watchedSeconds: input.watchedSeconds,
    totalSeconds: input.totalSeconds,
    lastPositionSeconds: input.lastPositionSeconds,
    entitlementId: input.entitlementId,
  });

  // 2. Check and mark completion
  const completed = await markCompleted(input.studentId, access.item.id);

  return { completed };
}

// ─── Resume ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Get the last playback position for resume.
 */
export async function getResumeTimestamp(
  studentId: string,
  courseId: string,
  itemId: string,
  context: StudentAccessContext,
): Promise<number> {
  const access = await resolveAccessibleLesson(studentId, courseId, itemId, context);
  if (!access) return 0;

  const sb = createAdminClient();

  const { data } = await sb
    .from('student_progress')
    .select('last_position_seconds')
    .eq('student_id', studentId)
    .eq('item_id', access.item.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  return data?.last_position_seconds ?? 0;
}

// ─── Course-level Aggregation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Get overall course progress: completed items / total items.
 */
export async function getCourseProgress(
  studentId: string,
  courseId: string,
): Promise<{ total: number; completed: number; percentage: number }> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  // Get all published items for this course
  const { data: items, error: itemsErr } = await sb
    .from('master_course_items')
    .select('id')
    .eq('master_course_id', courseId)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published');

  if (itemsErr) throw new Error(`Failed to get items: ${itemsErr.message}`);
  const total = items?.length ?? 0;
  if (total === 0) return { total: 0, completed: 0, percentage: 0 };

  const itemIds = items!.map((i) => i.id);

  // Get completed items for this student
  const { data: progress, error: progressErr } = await sb
    .from('student_progress')
    .select('item_id')
    .eq('student_id', studentId)
    .eq('completed', true)
    .in('item_id', itemIds);

  if (progressErr) throw new Error(`Failed to get progress: ${progressErr.message}`);
  const completed = progress?.length ?? 0;

  return {
    total,
    completed,
    percentage: Math.round((completed / total) * 100),
  };
}

/**
 * Get progress for all items in a course for a student.
 * Returns a map of itemId → progress row.
 */
export async function getItemProgressMap(
  studentId: string,
  courseId: string,
): Promise<Map<string, { watchedSeconds: number; totalSeconds: number; lastPositionSeconds: number; completed: boolean }>> {
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from('student_progress')
    .select(`
      item_id,
      watched_seconds,
      total_seconds,
      last_position_seconds,
      completed,
      master_course_items!inner ( master_course_id )
    `)
    .eq('student_id', studentId)
    .eq('master_course_items.master_course_id', courseId);

  if (error) throw new Error(`Failed to get item progress map: ${error.message}`);

  const map = new Map<string, { watchedSeconds: number; totalSeconds: number; lastPositionSeconds: number; completed: boolean }>();
  for (const row of data ?? []) {
    map.set(row.item_id, {
      watchedSeconds: row.watched_seconds,
      totalSeconds: row.total_seconds,
      lastPositionSeconds: row.last_position_seconds,
      completed: row.completed,
    });
  }

  return map;
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/services/student-resources.ts ---
import 'server-only';

/**
 * Student Resources Service (Phase 7).
 *
 * Handles fetching resources for courses and specific lessons.
 * Enforces entitlement and publishing status checks.
 */

import { createAdminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { resolveAccessibleLesson, validateStudentCourseAccess } from '@/lib/services/student-entitlements-expanded';
import type { LessonResourcesRow } from '@/types/database';

/**
 * List resources for a specific lesson (item).
 */
export async function listLessonResources(
  studentId: string,
  courseId: string,
  itemId: string,
  isGlobal: boolean,
  collegeId: string | null,
): Promise<LessonResourcesRow[]> {
  const access = await resolveAccessibleLesson(studentId, courseId, itemId, {
    isGlobal,
    collegeId,
  });
  if (!access) return [];

  const sb = createAdminClient();

  // 2. Fetch Resources for the validated item
  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from('lesson_resources')
    .select('*')
    .eq('master_course_id', access.course.id)
    .eq('item_id', access.item.id)
    .order('sort_order', { ascending: true });

  if (error) {
    console.error('[ResourcesService] Error fetching lesson resources:', error);
    return [];
  }

  return data || [];
}

/**
 * List all resources for a course (course-level resources).
 * Resources where item_id is null are considered course-level.
 */
export async function listCourseResources(
  studentId: string,
  courseId: string,
  isGlobal: boolean,
  collegeId: string | null,
): Promise<LessonResourcesRow[]> {
  const entitlement = await validateStudentCourseAccess(studentId, courseId, {
    isGlobal,
    collegeId,
  });
  if (!entitlement) return [];

  const sb = createAdminClient();

  // 2. Verify course is published
  const { data: course } = await sb
    .from('master_courses')
    .select('publish_status')
    .eq('id', courseId)
    .single();

  if (course?.publish_status !== 'published') return [];

  // 3. Fetch Resources (item_id is null)
  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from('lesson_resources')
    .select('*')
    .eq('master_course_id', courseId)
    .is('item_id', null)
    .order('sort_order', { ascending: true });

  if (error) {
    console.error('[ResourcesService] Error fetching course resources:', error);
    return [];
  }

  return data || [];
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/supabase/admin.ts ---
/**
 * Service-role Supabase client — bypasses all RLS policies.
 *
 * USE ONLY for:
 *   - Direct-learner B2C provisioning (membership, student row, non_partnered_students when needed)
 *   - Course payment operations (order intents, enrollment grants)
 *   - Phase 6 tiered runtime reads (after session + tenant checks; see `TIERED_RUNTIME_UNIFIED_READ`)
 *   - Platform settings reads (invite-status flow)
 *   - Unsubscribe token verification
 *
 * NEVER use for:
 *   - Tenant-scoped student queries where RLS should enforce isolation
 *   - Client-side code (server-only import guard prevents this)
 *
 * CALLER RESPONSIBILITY: Every consumer must enforce auth + tenant scoping.
 */
import 'server-only';
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

/** Server-only Supabase client with service role. Use only for ensure-profile repair (e.g. create student row when missing). */
export function createAdminClient() {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  const serviceRoleKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
  if (!url || !serviceRoleKey) {
    throw new Error(
      'Server configuration error.'
    );
  }
  return createClient(url, serviceRoleKey, {
    auth: {
      autoRefreshToken: false,
      persistSession: false,
    },
  });
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/supabase/client.ts ---
import { createBrowserClient } from '@supabase/ssr';
import { PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS, resolveSupabaseKey, resolveSupabaseUrl } from './cookie-options';

/**
 * Browser Supabase client. Session is stored only in httpOnly cookies (via @supabase/ssr).
 * We do NOT use localStorage for auth to reduce XSS risk; same cookies across tabs/restarts.
 */
export function createClient() {
  const url = resolveSupabaseUrl();
  const key = resolveSupabaseKey();
  return createBrowserClient(url, key, {
    cookieOptions: PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS,
  });
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/supabase/cookie-options.ts ---
/**
 * Shared cookie options for Supabase auth across browser, server, and middleware.
 * Use a unique storage key (name) so LMS does not share cookies with CollegeAdmin/SuperAdmin on the same domain.
 *
 * maxAge = 7 days. Matches Supabase's default refresh token lifetime.
 * Active users get indefinite sessions via automatic token refresh in middleware.
 * Idle sessions expire after 7 days, requiring re-authentication.
 */
export const PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS = {
  name: 'sb-lms-auth',
  path: '/',
  maxAge: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60,
  sameSite: 'lax' as const,
};

export function resolveSupabaseKey(): string {
  const key =
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ??
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_DEFAULT_KEY ??
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY;
  if (!key) {
    throw new Error(
      'Server configuration error.'
    );
  }
  return key;
}

export function resolveSupabaseUrl(): string {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  if (!url || !/^https:\/\/.+/i.test(url)) {
    throw new Error('Server configuration error.');
  }
  return url;
}

--- END FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/supabase/cookie-options.ts ---

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/supabase/middleware.ts ---
import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import {
  PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS,
  resolveSupabaseKey,
  resolveSupabaseUrl,
} from "./cookie-options";

/**
 * Creates a Supabase client for use in Next.js middleware.
 * Reads auth cookies from the incoming request and writes refreshed tokens
 * to the response so the browser and downstream Server Components see the same session.
 *
 * Call supabase.auth.getUser() (or getSession()) after creating this client to
 * trigger session load and optional token refresh; refreshed cookies are written via setAll.
 */
export function createMiddlewareClient(request: NextRequest) {
  const url = resolveSupabaseUrl();
  const key = resolveSupabaseKey();

  const response = NextResponse.next({ request });

  const supabase = createServerClient(url, key, {
    cookieOptions: PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS,
    cookies: {
      getAll() {
        return request.cookies.getAll();
      },
      setAll(cookiesToSet) {
        cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
          response.cookies.set(name, value, options),
        );
      },
    },
  });

  return { supabase, response };
}

export function hasAuthCookie(request: NextRequest): boolean {
  return request.cookies
    .getAll()
    .some((cookie) => cookie.name.startsWith(PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS.name));
}

--- END FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/supabase/middleware.ts ---

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/supabase/server.ts ---
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS, resolveSupabaseKey, resolveSupabaseUrl } from './cookie-options';

/** Server Supabase client; cookie-only session, same maxAge as client/middleware. */
export async function createClient() {
  const url = resolveSupabaseUrl();
  const key = resolveSupabaseKey();
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  return createServerClient(url, key, {
    cookieOptions: PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS,
    cookies: {
      getAll() {
        return cookieStore.getAll();
      },
      setAll(cookiesToSet) {
        try {
          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => cookieStore.set(name, value, options));
        } catch {
          // Next.js only allows cookie writes in Route Handlers/Server Actions. Ignore in render/redirect contexts.
        }
      },
    },
  });
}

/**
 * Cookie-less Supabase client for use inside `unstable_cache()`.
 * This avoids the "cookies() inside cache scope" error.
 * Only use this for queries that don't need authenticated access (e.g. public data reads).
 */
export function createPublicClient() {
  const url = resolveSupabaseUrl();
  const key = resolveSupabaseKey();
  return createServerClient(url, key, {
    cookieOptions: PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS,
    cookies: {
      getAll() { return []; },
      setAll() {},
    },
  });
}

--- END FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/supabase/server.ts ---

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/tenant/direct-learner-slug.ts ---
/**
 * Canonical **B2C direct-learner** tenant slugs — keep in sync with DB `get_direct_learner_college_id` / seed.
 *
 * **Not** the legacy `unknown` college (`slug === 'unknown'`): unknown uses `ChangeCollegeSection` /
 * `changeCollegeFromUnknown` (partner matching). Direct learners use `B2cSelfReportedCollegeSection` and
 * `non_partnered_students` for optional school text only.
 *
 * No `server-only` so client components can branch safely.
 */
export function isDirectLearnerCollegeSlug(slug: string): boolean {
  const s = slug.trim().toLowerCase();
  return s === 'direct-learners' || s === 'direct-learner';
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/tenant/get-tenant-branding-server.ts ---
/**
 * Server-only: fetch tenant branding from DB. Do not import from client components.
 */
import 'server-only';
import { cache } from 'react';
import { unstable_cache } from 'next/cache';
import { createPublicClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import type { TenantBranding } from '@/types/tenant';

const getTenantBrandingCached = unstable_cache(async (slug: string): Promise<TenantBranding | null> => {
  const supabase = createPublicClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('colleges')
    .select('id, name, slug, short_name, logo_url, primary_color, secondary_color')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .eq('status', 'active')
    .single();
  if (error || !data) return null;
  return {
    id: data.id,
    name: data.name,
    slug: data.slug,
    shortName: data.short_name,
    logoUrl: data.logo_url,
    primaryColor: data.primary_color,
    secondaryColor: data.secondary_color,
  };
}, ['lms-tenant-branding'], {
  revalidate: 300,
  tags: ['lms-tenant-branding'],
});

export const getTenantBrandingFromDb = cache(async function getTenantBrandingFromDb(slug: string): Promise<TenantBranding | null> {
  return getTenantBrandingCached(slug);
});

/** Async getTenantBranding for use in Server Components. */
export async function getTenantBranding(slug?: string | null): Promise<TenantBranding | null> {
  if (!slug || slug === 'default') return null;
  return getTenantBrandingFromDb(slug);
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/tenant/get-tenant.ts ---
import 'server-only';
import { cache } from 'react';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { getSession } from '@/lib/auth/session';

export interface CurrentTenant {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
  shortName: string | null;
  logoUrl: string | null;
  primaryColor: string | null;
  secondaryColor: string | null;
}

export interface CurrentUser {
  id: string;
  email: string | null;
  fullName: string | null;
  isActive: boolean;
}

export interface CurrentMembership {
  id: string;
  collegeId: string;
  role: 'college_admin' | 'student' | 'faculty_spoc';
  status: string;
}

export interface CurrentStudentRecord {
  id: string;
  student_code: string | null;
  year_or_semester: string | null;
  github_url: string | null;
  linkedin_url: string | null;
  resume_url: string | null;
  placement_ready_status: string | null;
  created_at: string;
}

/** Get college by slug for tenant resolution. Case-insensitive. Cached per request. */
export const getTenantBySlug = cache(async (slug: string): Promise<CurrentTenant | null> => {
  const normalizedSlug = slug.trim();
  if (!normalizedSlug) return null;

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('colleges')
    .select('id, name, slug, short_name, logo_url, primary_color, secondary_color')
    .ilike('slug', normalizedSlug)
    .eq('status', 'active')
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) {
    console.error('[tenant] getTenantBySlug', { slug: normalizedSlug, code: error.code, message: error.message });
    return null;
  }
  if (!data) return null;
  return {
    id: data.id,
    name: data.name,
    slug: data.slug,
    shortName: data.short_name,
    logoUrl: data.logo_url,
    primaryColor: data.primary_color,
    secondaryColor: data.secondary_color,
  };
});

/** Get current user and profile. Returns null if not authenticated. */
export const getCurrentUser = cache(async (): Promise<CurrentUser | null> => {
  const { session } = await getSession();
  if (!session?.user) return null;
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: profile, error } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .select('id, full_name, email, is_active')
    .eq('id', session.user.id)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) {
    console.error('[tenant] getCurrentUser profile', { userId: session.user.id, code: error.code, message: error.message });
    return {
      id: session.user.id,
      email: session.user.email ?? null,
      fullName: (session.user.user_metadata?.full_name as string) ?? null,
      isActive: true,
    };
  }
  if (!profile) {
    return {
      id: session.user.id,
      email: session.user.email ?? null,
      fullName: (session.user.user_metadata?.full_name as string) ?? null,
      isActive: true,
    };
  }
  return {
    id: profile.id,
    email: profile.email ?? session.user.email ?? null,
    fullName: profile.full_name ?? (session.user.user_metadata?.full_name as string) ?? null,
    isActive: profile.is_active,
  };
});

/** Get current user's active membership for a college (by college_id). */
export const getMembershipByCollegeId = cache(async (collegeId: string): Promise<CurrentMembership | null> => {
  const { session } = await getSession();
  if (!session?.user) return null;
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('college_memberships')
    .select('id, college_id, role, status')
    .eq('user_id', session.user.id)
    .eq('college_id', collegeId)
    .in('status', ['active', 'invited'])
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) {
    console.error('[tenant] getMembershipByCollegeId', { userId: session.user.id, collegeId, code: error.code, message: error.message });
    return null;
  }
  if (!data) return null;
  return {
    id: data.id,
    collegeId: data.college_id,
    role: data.role,
    status: data.status,
  };
});

/** Get current user's active membership for a college by slug. */
export const getMembershipBySlug = cache(async (collegeSlug: string): Promise<CurrentMembership | null> => {
  const tenant = await getTenantBySlug(collegeSlug);
  if (!tenant) return null;
  return getMembershipByCollegeId(tenant.id);
});

/** Get current user's student record for a college (by college_id). */
export const getStudentByCollegeId = cache(async (collegeId: string): Promise<CurrentStudentRecord | null> => {
  const { session } = await getSession();
  if (!session?.user) return null;
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('students')
    .select('id, student_code, year_or_semester, github_url, linkedin_url, resume_url, placement_ready_status, created_at')
    .eq('user_id', session.user.id)
    .eq('college_id', collegeId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) {
    console.error('[tenant] getStudentByCollegeId', { userId: session.user.id, collegeId, code: error.code, message: error.message });
    return null;
  }
  return data;
});

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product/lib/tpstreams/access-tokens.ts ---
import 'server-only';

/**
 * TPStreams Access Token service.
 *
 * Access tokens gate secure video playback. They must be generated server-side
 * and passed to the embed player. Never generate access tokens on the client.
 *
 * Covers:
 *   POST  /api/v1/<org>/assets/<asset_id>/access_tokens/
 *   GET   /api/v1/<org>/assets/<asset_id>/access_tokens/<code>/
 *   PATCH /api/v1/<org>/assets/<asset_id>/access_tokens/<code>/  (update TTL)
 */

import { tpPost, tpGet, tpPatch, getTpStreamsOrgId, orgPath } from './client';
import type {
  TpCreateAccessTokenRequest,
  TpUpdateAccessTokenRequest,
  TpAccessToken,
} from './types';

// ─── Create access token ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Generate an access token for secure video playback.
 *
 * SECURITY: This is a server-only operation. Never expose the TPStreams token
 * or call this endpoint from client-side code.
 *
 * Endpoint: POST /api/v1/<org>/assets/<asset_id>/access_tokens/
 *
 * @param assetId  The video asset to generate the token for.
 * @param options  Optional TTL, single-use, or watermark annotations.
 * @param orgId    Override default org ID from env.
 *
 * @example
 *   // Server action or Route Handler only:
 *   const token = await createAccessToken('yXrprYum2TS', {
 *     time_to_live: 3600,           // 1-hour token
 *     expires_after_first_usage: false,
 *   });
 *   // Pass token.code to the embed URL on the client
 */
export async function createAccessToken(
  assetId: string,
  options?: TpCreateAccessTokenRequest,
  orgId?: string,
): Promise<TpAccessToken> {
  const id = orgId ?? getTpStreamsOrgId();
  return tpPost<TpAccessToken>(
    `${orgPath(id)}/assets/${assetId}/access_tokens/`,
    options ?? {},
  );
}

// ─── Get access token detail ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Retrieve the details of an existing access token.
 *
 * Endpoint: GET /api/v1/<org>/assets/<asset_id>/access_tokens/<code>/
 *
 * @param assetId    The video asset.
 * @param tokenCode  The access token code (UUID).
 * @param orgId      Override default org ID.
 */
export async function getAccessToken(
  assetId: string,
  tokenCode: string,
  orgId?: string,
): Promise<TpAccessToken> {
  const id = orgId ?? getTpStreamsOrgId();
  return tpGet<TpAccessToken>(
    `${orgPath(id)}/assets/${assetId}/access_tokens/${tokenCode}/`,
  );
}

// ─── Update access token TTL ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Update the time-to-live (TTL) of an existing access token.
 *
 * Endpoint: PATCH /api/v1/<org>/assets/<asset_id>/access_tokens/<code>/
 *
 * @param assetId    The video asset.
 * @param tokenCode  The access token code (UUID).
 * @param request    { time_to_live: number } — new TTL in seconds.
 * @param orgId      Override default org ID.
 */
export async function updateAccessTokenTtl(
  assetId: string,
  tokenCode: string,
  request: TpUpdateAccessTokenRequest,
  orgId?: string,
): Promise<TpAccessToken> {
  const id = orgId ?? getTpStreamsOrgId();
  return tpPatch<TpAccessToken>(
    `${orgPath(id)}/assets/${assetId}/access_tokens/${tokenCode}/`,
    request,
  );
}

// ─── Helper: build embed URL from access token ────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Constructs the TPStreams embed URL given an org ID, asset ID, and token code.
 * Use this in Server Components or Route Handlers to pass a safe embed URL
 * to the TpStreamEmbedFrame client component.
 *
 * @param orgId      TPStreams organisation UUID.
 * @param assetId    TPStreams asset ID.
 * @param tokenCode  Access token code.
 */
export function buildEmbedUrl(
  orgId: string,
  assetId: string,
  tokenCode: string,
): string {
  return `https://app.tpstreams.com/embed/${orgId}/${assetId}/?access_token=${tokenCode}`;
}

/**
 * Convenience: generate an access token and return its embed URL in one call.
 *
 * Useful for Server Components rendering a video embed.
 *
 * @param assetId  The video asset.
 * @param options  Optional TTL / single-use options.
 * @param orgId    Override default org ID.
 */
export async function createEmbedToken(
  assetId: string,
  options?: TpCreateAccessTokenRequest,
  orgId?: string,
): Promise<{ token: TpAccessToken; embedUrl: string }> {
  const id = orgId ?? getTpStreamsOrgId();
  const token = await createAccessToken(assetId, options, id);
  const embedUrl = buildEmbedUrl(id, assetId, token.code);
  return { token, embedUrl };
}

import 'server-only';

/**
 * TPStreams Organisation & Asset services.
 *
 * Covers:
 *   GET  /api/v1/organizations/
 *   GET  /api/v1/<org>/assets/
 *   GET  /api/v1/<org>/assets/<asset_id>/
 *   POST /api/v1/<org>/assets/videos/
 *   POST /api/v1/<org>/assets/videos/bulk-create/

 */

import { tpGet, tpPost, getTpStreamsOrgId, orgPath } from './client';
import type {
  TpPaginatedResponse,
  TpOrganisation,
  TpAsset,
  TpAssetDetail,
  TpCreateVideoRequest,
  TpMoveAssetRequest,
  TpMoveAssetResponse,
  TpListAssetsParams,
  TpGetAssetDetailParams,
} from './types';

/**

 *
 * @param assetId  TPStreams asset ID.

  assetId: string,
  params?: TpGetAssetDetailParams,
  orgId?: string,

  const id = orgId ?? getTpStreamsOrgId();
  return tpGet<TpAssetDetail>(
    `${orgPath(id)}/assets/${assetId}/`,
    params as Record<string, string | number | boolean | undefined>,

// ─── Assets — create (single video) ──────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Upload/ingest a single video asset by URL.
 * Endpoint: POST /api/v1/<org>/assets/videos/
 *
 * @param request  Upload params (inputs + resolutions required).
 * @param orgId    Override org ID.
 */
export async function createVideo(
  request: TpCreateVideoRequest,
  orgId?: string,
): Promise<TpAsset> {
  const id = orgId ?? getTpStreamsOrgId();
  return tpPost<TpAsset>(`${orgPath(id)}/assets/videos/`, request);
}

// ─── Assets — bulk create ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Upload multiple video assets in a single request (max 50 per request).
 * Videos are considered unique by the combination of title + inputs[0].url.
 * Endpoint: POST /api/v1/<org>/assets/videos/bulk-create/
 *
 * @param requests  Array of upload params. Each item must be unique.
 * @param orgId     Override org ID.
 * @throws {TpStreamsApiError} 400 if duplicates detected, limit exceeded, or validation fails.
 */
export async function bulkCreateVideos(
  requests: TpCreateVideoRequest[],
  orgId?: string,
): Promise<TpAsset[]> {
  if (requests.length === 0) return [];
  if (requests.length > 50) {
    throw new Error(
      `bulkCreateVideos: maximum 50 videos per request, received ${requests.length}.`,
    );
  }
  const id = orgId ?? getTpStreamsOrgId();
  return tpPost<TpAsset[]>(`${orgPath(id)}/assets/videos/bulk-create/`, requests);
}

 * @param orgId    Override org ID.
 */
export async function moveAsset(
  assetId: string,
  request?: TpMoveAssetRequest,
  orgId?: string,
): Promise<TpMoveAssetResponse> {
  const id = orgId ?? getTpStreamsOrgId();
  return tpPost<TpMoveAssetResponse>(
    `${orgPath(id)}/assets/${assetId}/move/`,
    request ?? {},
  );
}
