import Link from 'next/link';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { requireCollegeAdmin } from '@/lib/auth/require-college-admin';
import { getPlacementProfileDetails } from '@/lib/services/placements';

const statusLabel: Record<string, string> = {
  not_ready: 'Not Ready',
  needs_improvement: 'Needs Improvement',
  interview_ready: 'Interview Ready',
  placed: 'Placed',
};

const statusVariant: Record<string, 'default' | 'secondary' | 'destructive' | 'outline'> = {
  not_ready: 'destructive',
  needs_improvement: 'secondary',
  interview_ready: 'default',
  placed: 'default',
};

export default async function PlacementProfileDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string; profileId: string }>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug, profileId } = await params;

  const { tenant } = await requireCollegeAdmin(collegeSlug);
  if (!tenant) notFound();

  const data = await getPlacementProfileDetails(profileId);
  if (!data) notFound();

  if (data.profile.college_id !== tenant.id) notFound();

  const { profile } = data;
  const studentName = profile.student?.full_name ?? 'Unknown';
  const studentEmail = profile.student?.email ?? '—';
  const backHref = `/c/${collegeSlug}/admin/placements`;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
        <Link href={backHref} className="text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">
          ← Placements
        </Link>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold">{studentName}</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{studentEmail}</p>
        </div>
        <Badge variant={statusVariant[profile.status] ?? 'secondary'} className="text-sm">
          {statusLabel[profile.status] ?? profile.status}
        </Badge>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Profile Information</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-3">
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">LinkedIn</p>
              <p className="font-medium">{profile.linkedin_url || '—'}</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">GitHub</p>
              <p className="font-medium">{profile.github_url || '—'}</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Notes</p>
              <p className="font-medium">{profile.notes || 'No notes'}</p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Resume Versions</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {data.resumeVersions.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">No resumes uploaded</p>
            ) : (
              <ul className="space-y-2">
                {data.resumeVersions.map((rv) => (
                  <li key={rv.id} className="text-sm p-2 border rounded">
                    Version {rv.version_number} - {rv.file_name}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Mock Interviews</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {data.mockInterviews.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">No mock interviews scheduled</p>
            ) : (
              <ul className="space-y-2">
                {data.mockInterviews.map((mi) => (
                  <li key={mi.id} className="text-sm p-2 border rounded">
                    {mi.interview_type} - {mi.status}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Job Applications</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {data.applications.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">No applications yet</p>
            ) : (
              <ul className="space-y-2">
                {data.applications.map((app) => (
                  <li key={app.id} className="text-sm p-2 border rounded">
                    {app.company_name} - {app.role_title} ({app.status})
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Offers</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {data.offers.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">No offers yet</p>
            ) : (
              <ul className="space-y-2">
                {data.offers.map((offer) => (
                  <li key={offer.id} className="text-sm p-2 border rounded">
                    {offer.company_name} - {offer.status}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { requireCollegeAdmin } from '@/lib/auth/require-college-admin';
import {
  getPlacementReadinessFunnel,
  getPlacementPendingReviewsCount,
  listPlacementProfilesWithStudents,
} from '@/lib/services/placements';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/shared/page-header';
import { Briefcase } from 'lucide-react';

export default async function PlacementsPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string }>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug } = await params;

  const { tenant } = await requireCollegeAdmin(collegeSlug);
  if (!tenant) notFound();

  const [funnel, pendingCount, profilesWithStudents] = await Promise.all([
    getPlacementReadinessFunnel(tenant.id),
    getPlacementPendingReviewsCount(tenant.id),
    listPlacementProfilesWithStudents(tenant.id),
  ]);

  const basePath = `/c/${collegeSlug}/admin/placements`;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="Placements"
        description="Track student placement readiness and progress."
      />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Total Profiles</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold">{profilesWithStudents.length}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Pending Reviews</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold">{pendingCount}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Interview Ready</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold">{funnel?.interview_ready_count ?? 0}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Student Placement Profiles</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {profilesWithStudents.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-10 text-center">
              <Briefcase className="h-8 w-8 mx-auto mb-3 text-muted-foreground/40" />
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">No placement profiles yet</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">Students will appear here once they start the placement process.</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="divide-y divide-border/50">
              {profilesWithStudents.slice(0, 20).map((profile) => (
                <Link
                  key={profile.id}
                  href={`${basePath}/${profile.id}`}
                  className="flex justify-between items-center py-3 hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors rounded-lg px-2 -mx-2"
                >
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <div>
                      <p className="font-medium">{profile.studentName ?? 'Unknown Student'}</p>
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{profile.studentEmail ?? '—'}</p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-sm capitalize px-2 py-1 rounded bg-muted">
                      {profile.status?.replace('_', ' ') ?? 'Unknown'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </Link>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { requireCollegeAdmin } from '@/lib/auth/require-college-admin';
import { getCollegeDashboardStats, listStudentsForCollege, listAdminsForCollege } from '@/lib/services/dashboard';
import { DbSectionPage } from '@/components/admin/db-section-page';
import { guardModulePage } from '@/lib/modules/guard-module-page';

export default async function ReportsPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string }>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug } = await params;
  const { tenant } = await requireCollegeAdmin(collegeSlug);

  if (!tenant) {
    return <DbSectionPage title="Reports" subtitle="Operational reporting" snapshot={null} />;
  }

  const guard = await guardModulePage(tenant.id, 'reports');
  if (guard.locked) return guard.node;

  const [stats, students, admins] = await Promise.all([
    getCollegeDashboardStats(tenant.id),
    listStudentsForCollege(tenant.id, 12),
    listAdminsForCollege(tenant.id, 8),
  ]);

  const snapshot = {
    collegeId: tenant.id,
    studentsCount: stats.studentsCount,
    adminsCount: stats.adminsCount,
    students,
    admins,
  };

  return <DbSectionPage title="Reports" subtitle="Operational reporting from live tenant records" snapshot={snapshot} />;
}

import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';

import { PageHeader } from '@/components/shared/page-header';

export default async function StudentsPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string }>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug } = await params;

  const { tenant } = await requireCollegeAdmin(collegeSlug);
  if (!tenant) notFound();

  const students = await listStudentsForCollege(tenant.id);

  return (

      <PageHeader
        title="Students"

        }
      />

      <Card className="glass-card border-0">
        <CardHeader className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-border/30">
          <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">Active Enrollments</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          {students.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-12 text-center text-muted-foreground italic flex flex-col items-center gap-2">

            </div>
          ) : (

                    <th className="text-left py-3 px-6">Email</th>
                    <th className="text-left py-3 px-6">Student Code</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-border/10">
                  {students.map((student) => (
                    <tr key={student.id} className="group hover:bg-primary/[0.02] transition-colors">
                      <td className="py-3 px-6">
                        <p className="font-semibold text-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">
                          {student.full_name ?? 'Unknown'}
                        </p>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-6 text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                        {student.email ?? '—'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-6 text-muted-foreground font-mono text-xs">
                        {student.student_code ?? '—'}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </PageContainer>
  );
}

/**

 *

 */

import { useParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client';
import { useTenant } from '@/providers/tenant-provider';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';

export default function CollegeAdminForgotPasswordPage() {
  const params = useParams();
  const { branding } = useTenant();
  const collegeSlug = typeof params?.collegeSlug === 'string' ? params.collegeSlug : '';
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const loginHref = useMemo(() => `/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/admin/login`, [collegeSlug]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSent(false);
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await fetch('/api/admin/auth-events', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ event: 'password_reset_requested', slug: collegeSlug, email }),
      }).catch(() => undefined);

      const supabase = createClient();
      const redirectTo = `${window.location.origin}/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/admin/reset-password`;
      const { error: resetError } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, { redirectTo });
      if (resetError) {
        setError(resetError.message);
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      setSent(true);
    } catch {
      setError('Something went wrong. Try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/30 p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm space-y-6 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-8 shadow-lg">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Reset password</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">College Admin · {branding.name}</p>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="email" className="text-sm font-medium">Email</label>
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(ev) => setEmail(ev.target.value)}
              required
              autoComplete="email"
              placeholder="admin@college.edu"
              className="h-10"
            />
          </div>

          {error && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}
          {sent && (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              If that email exists, a reset link has been sent. Please check your inbox.
            </p>
          )}

          <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-10" disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? 'Sending…' : 'Send reset link'}
          </Button>
        </form>

        <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <Link href={loginHref} className="underline-offset-4 hover:underline">Back to sign in</Link>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/app/c/[collegeSlug]/admin/layout.tsx ---
import React from 'react';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import { ClientLayout } from './client-layout';
import { getTenantBranding } from '@/lib/tenant/get-tenant-branding-server';

/**
 * Shared layout for all /c/[collegeSlug]/admin/* routes.
 * 
 * PERFORMANCE: Only fetches tenant branding here - needed for login page styling.
 * Protected data (user, features, modules) is fetched in the dashboard layout
 * AFTER auth is confirmed, avoiding unnecessary DB queries for public pages.
 */
export default async function AdminLayout({
  children,
  params,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  params: Promise<{ collegeSlug: string }>;
}) {
  const { collegeSlug } = await params;

  const branding = await getTenantBranding(collegeSlug);
  if (!branding) {
    notFound();
  }

  return (
    <ClientLayout
      collegeSlug={collegeSlug}
      initialBranding={branding}
    >
      {children}
    </ClientLayout>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/app/c/[collegeSlug]/admin/reset-password/page.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useParams, useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client';
import { useTenant } from '@/providers/tenant-provider';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';

export default function CollegeAdminResetPasswordPage() {
  const params = useParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const { branding } = useTenant();
  const collegeSlug = typeof params?.collegeSlug === 'string' ? params.collegeSlug : '';
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);

  const loginHref = useMemo(() => `/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/admin/login`, [collegeSlug]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function ensureRecoverySession() {
      setError(null);
      setReady(false);

      const supabase = createClient();
      const code = searchParams.get('code');

      try {
        if (code) {
          const { error: exchangeError } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);
          if (exchangeError) {
            if (!cancelled) setError('This reset link is invalid or expired. Please request a new one.');
            return;
          }
          if (!cancelled) {
            const url = new URL(window.location.href);
            url.searchParams.delete('code');
            url.searchParams.delete('type');
            window.history.replaceState({}, '', url.toString());
          }
        }

        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.hash) {
          const hashParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.hash.slice(1));
          const access_token = hashParams.get('access_token');
          const refresh_token = hashParams.get('refresh_token');
          if (access_token && refresh_token) {
            const { error: setSessionError } = await supabase.auth.setSession({ access_token, refresh_token });
            if (setSessionError) {
              if (!cancelled) setError('This reset link is invalid or expired. Please request a new one.');
              return;
            }
            if (!cancelled) {
              const url = new URL(window.location.href);
              url.hash = '';
              window.history.replaceState({}, '', url.toString());
            }
          }
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setReady(true);
      }
    }

    void ensureRecoverySession();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [searchParams]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    if (password.length < 8) {
      setError('Password must be at least 8 characters.');
      return;
    }
    if (password !== confirm) {
      setError('Passwords do not match.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const { data: sessionData } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      if (!sessionData.session) {
        setError('This reset link is invalid or expired. Please request a new one.');
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const { error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password });
      if (updateError) {
        setError(updateError.message);
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      router.push(`/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/admin/dashboard`);
    } catch {
      setError('Something went wrong. Try again.');
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/30 p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm space-y-6 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-8 shadow-lg">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Set a new password</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">College Admin · {branding.name}</p>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="password" className="text-sm font-medium">New password</label>
            <Input
              id="password"
              type="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(ev) => setPassword(ev.target.value)}
              required
              autoComplete="new-password"
              minLength={8}
              className="h-10"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="confirm" className="text-sm font-medium">Confirm password</label>
            <Input
              id="confirm"
              type="password"
              value={confirm}
              onChange={(ev) => setConfirm(ev.target.value)}
              required
              autoComplete="new-password"
              minLength={8}
              className="h-10"
            />
          </div>

          {error && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}

          <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-10" disabled={loading || !ready}>
            {!ready ? 'Preparing…' : loading ? 'Saving…' : 'Update password'}
          </Button>
        </form>

        <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <Link href={loginHref} className="underline-offset-4 hover:underline">Back to sign in</Link>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/app/forgot-password/page.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';

export default function CollegeAdminRootForgotPasswordPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [collegeSlug, setCollegeSlug] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const loginHref = useMemo(() => '/login', []);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSent(false);
    setLoading(true);

    const normalizedSlug = collegeSlug.trim().toLowerCase();
    const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!normalizedSlug) {
      setError('Please enter your college code.');
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    try {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const baseUrl =
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_COLLEGE_ADMIN_APP_URL ??
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ??
        window.location.origin;
      const redirectTo = `${baseUrl}/c/${encodeURIComponent(normalizedSlug)}/admin/reset-password`;

      const { error: resetError } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(normalizedEmail, { redirectTo });
      if (resetError) {
        setError(resetError.message);
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      setSent(true);
    } catch {
      setError('Something went wrong. Try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/30 p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm space-y-6 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-8 shadow-lg">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Reset password</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">College Admin</p>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="college" className="text-sm font-medium">College code</label>
            <Input
              id="college"
              value={collegeSlug}
              onChange={(ev) => setCollegeSlug(ev.target.value)}
              required
              placeholder="e.g. abc-college"
              className="h-10"
              autoComplete="organization"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="email" className="text-sm font-medium">Email</label>
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(ev) => setEmail(ev.target.value)}
              required
              autoComplete="email"
              placeholder="admin@college.edu"
              className="h-10"
            />
          </div>

          {error && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}
          {sent && (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              If that email exists, a reset link has been sent. Please check your inbox.
            </p>
          )}

          <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-10" disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? 'Sending…' : 'Send reset link'}
          </Button>
        </form>

        <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <Link href={loginHref} className="underline-offset-4 hover:underline">Back to sign in</Link>
          {' '}
          ·
          {' '}
          <button
            type="button"
            className="underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
            onClick={() => router.back()}
          >
            Go back
          </button>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/app/page.tsx ---
import { getSession } from '@/lib/auth/session';
import { redirectToAdminTenant } from '@/lib/auth/redirects';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';

export default async function HomePage() {
  const { session } = await getSession();

  if (session?.user) {
    // User is authenticated, redirect to their admin dashboard
    await redirectToAdminTenant('/dashboard');
  }

  // User is not authenticated, redirect to login
  redirect('/login');
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/app/unauthorized/page.tsx ---
import Link from "next/link";
import { ShieldAlert, ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";

export default function UnauthorizedPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: { reason?: string } }) {
    const reason = searchParams.reason;

    let message = "You do not have permission to access this area.";
    if (reason === "no_admin_membership") {
        message = "You are logged in, but you do not have an active College Admin or Faculty SPOC role.";
    } else if (reason === "invalid_tenant") {
        message = "Your account is associated with a college that could not be found or is inactive.";
    }

    return (
        <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-background p-4">
            <div className="max-w-md w-full text-center space-y-6">
                <div className="mx-auto w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-destructive/10 flex items-center justify-center">
                    <ShieldAlert className="w-8 h-8 text-destructive" />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                    <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">Access Denied</h1>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">{message}</p>
                </div>

                <div className="pt-4 flex justify-center">
                    <Link
                        href="/login"
                        className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 border border-input bg-background shadow-sm hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2"
                    >
                        <ArrowLeft className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                        Return to Login
                    </Link>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/components/admin/activity-feed-page.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useTenantPath } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant-path';
import type { ActivityEventRow } from '@/lib/activity/queries';

export function ActivityFeedPage({
  initialEvents = [],
  tenantName = null,
  eventCategories = [],
}: {
  initialEvents: ActivityEventRow[];
  tenantName: string | null;
  eventCategories: string[];
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const { section } = useTenantPath();
  const activityPath = section('activity');

  const [userId, setUserId] = useState(searchParams.get('userId') ?? '');
  const [eventName, setEventName] = useState(searchParams.get('eventName') ?? '');
  const [eventCategory, setEventCategory] = useState(searchParams.get('eventCategory') ?? '');
  const [from, setFrom] = useState(searchParams.get('from') ?? '');
  const [to, setTo] = useState(searchParams.get('to') ?? '');

  const applyFilters = () => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (userId) params.set('userId', userId);
    if (eventName) params.set('eventName', eventName);
    if (eventCategory) params.set('eventCategory', eventCategory);
    if (from) params.set('from', from);
    if (to) params.set('to', to);
    router.push(`${activityPath}?${params.toString()}`);
  };

  const clearFilters = () => {
    setUserId('');
    setEventName('');
    setEventCategory('');
    setFrom('');
    setTo('');
    router.push(activityPath);
  };

  if (tenantName === null && initialEvents.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Activity</h1>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">No active college membership found.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Activity</h1>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">Event feed for this tenant. Filter by user, event type, and date range.</p>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/30 p-4 space-y-3">
        <p className="text-sm font-medium">Filters</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3">
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">User ID</label>
            <Input placeholder="Actor user UUID" value={userId} onChange={(e) => setUserId(e.target.value)} className="h-9 text-sm" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">Event name</label>
            <Input placeholder="e.g. login_success" value={eventName} onChange={(e) => setEventName(e.target.value)} className="h-9 text-sm" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">Category</label>
            <Select value={eventCategory || "all"} onValueChange={(v) => setEventCategory(v === "all" ? "" : v)}>
              <SelectTrigger className={cn('w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 text-sm h-9')}>
                <SelectValue placeholder="All" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="all">All</SelectItem>
                {eventCategories.map((cat) => (
                  <SelectItem key={cat} value={cat}>{cat}</SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">From</label>
            <Input type="date" value={from} onChange={(e) => setFrom(e.target.value)} className="h-9 text-sm" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">To</label>
            <Input type="date" value={to} onChange={(e) => setTo(e.target.value)} className="h-9 text-sm" />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button size="sm" onClick={applyFilters}>Apply</Button>
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={clearFilters}>Clear</Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-4 min-w-0 overflow-x-auto">
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
               <TableHead className="w-20 sm:w-28">Time</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Event</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Category</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="w-24">Actor</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Role</TableHead>
               <TableHead className="max-w-[6rem] sm:max-w-[10rem]">Metadata</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {initialEvents.length === 0 ? (
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell colSpan={6} className="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8">
                  No activity events yet for this tenant.
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ) : (
              initialEvents.map((row) => (
                <TableRow key={row.id}>
                  <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">{new Date(row.created_at).toLocaleString()}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="font-medium">{row.event_name}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">{row.event_category}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{row.actor_user_id ? `${row.actor_user_id.slice(0, 8)}…` : '—'}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">{row.actor_role ?? '—'}</TableCell>
                   <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate max-w-[6rem] sm:max-w-[10rem]" title={JSON.stringify(row.metadata)}>
                    {Object.keys(row.metadata).length ? JSON.stringify(row.metadata).slice(0, 50) + '…' : '—'}
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))
            )}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import gsap from "gsap";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  ChartContainer,
  ChartTooltip,
  ChartTooltipContent,
  type ChartConfig,
} from "@/components/ui/chart";
import {
  AreaChart,
  Area,
  BarChart,
  Bar,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  CartesianGrid,
} from "recharts";
import {
  TrendingUp,
  Users,
  Award,
  BookOpen,
  AlertTriangle,
  Target,
  Mail,
  Clock,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

// ── Chart configs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const performanceConfig = {
  avgScore: { label: "Avg Score", color: "oklch(0.7 0.19 45)" },
  submissions: { label: "Submissions", color: "oklch(0.65 0.15 250)" },
} satisfies ChartConfig;

const courseCompletionConfig = {
  completion: { label: "Completion %", color: "oklch(0.7 0.19 45)" },
} satisfies ChartConfig;

const scoreDistConfig = {
  students: { label: "Students", color: "oklch(0.7 0.19 45)" },
} satisfies ChartConfig;

const placementConfig = {
  count: { label: "Students", color: "oklch(0.7 0.19 45)" },
} satisfies ChartConfig;

// ── KPI Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function KpiCard({
  label,
  value,
  suffix,
  icon: Icon,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  suffix: string;
  icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ref.current) return;
    const ctx = gsap.context(() => {
      const el = ref.current!;
      const obj = { val: 0 };
      gsap.to(obj, {
        val: value,
        duration: 1.4,
        ease: "power2.out",
        onUpdate() {
          el.textContent = `${Math.round(obj.val)}${suffix}`;
        },
      });
    });
    return () => ctx.revert();
  }, [value, suffix]);

  return (
    <Card className="glass-card border-0 shadow-lg">
      <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-xl bg-gradient-orange-soft flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
          <Icon className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-medium truncate">
            {label}
          </p>
          <span
            ref={ref}
            className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground tabular-nums"
          >
            0{suffix}
          </span>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

// ── Main Component ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface TrendDataPoint {

  completed_items: number;
}

interface AnalyticsContentProps {

    totalStudents: number;
    avgScore: number;

    placementRate: number;
    activeCourses: number;

  };

}

export function AnalyticsContent({
  kpis,

  contentUsage,
  placementPipeline,
  atRiskDetails = [],
}: AnalyticsContentProps) {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return;
    const ctx = gsap.context(() => {
      gsap.from(".analytics-card", {
        y: 30,
        opacity: 0,
        duration: 0.6,
        stagger: 0.08,
        ease: "power3.out",
      });
    }, containerRef);
    return () => ctx.revert();
  }, []);

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} className="space-y-6">
      {/* Hero KPIs */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4">
        <KpiCard
          label="Total Students"

          suffix=""
          icon={Users}
        />
        <KpiCard
          label="Avg Score"
          value={kpis.avgScore}
          suffix="%"
          icon={TrendingUp}
        />
        <KpiCard
          label="Completion Rate"
          value={kpis.completionRate}
          suffix="%"
          icon={Award}
        />
        <KpiCard
          label="Placement Rate"
          value={kpis.placementRate}
          suffix="%"
          icon={Target}
        />
        <KpiCard
          label="Active Courses"
          value={kpis.activeCourses}
          suffix=""
          icon={BookOpen}
        />
        <KpiCard
          label="At-Risk Students"
          value={kpis.atRiskStudents}
          suffix=""
          icon={AlertTriangle}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Performance Trend + Course Completion */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        <Card className="analytics-card glass-card border-0 shadow-lg">
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">
              Performance Trend
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <ChartContainer config={performanceConfig} className="h-[200px] sm:h-[260px] lg:h-[280px]">
              <AreaChart data={performanceTrend.length > 0 ? performanceTrend : []}>
                <defs>
                  <linearGradient
                    id="perfGrad"
                    x1="0"
                    y1="0"
                    x2="0"
                    y2="1"
                  >
                    <stop
                      offset="0%"
                      stopColor="oklch(0.7 0.19 45)"
                      stopOpacity={0.3}
                    />
                    <stop
                      offset="100%"
                      stopColor="oklch(0.7 0.19 45)"
                      stopOpacity={0.02}
                    />
                  </linearGradient>
                </defs>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="hsl(var(--border))" />
                <XAxis dataKey="week" tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
                <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
                <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
                <Area
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey="avgScore"
                  stroke="oklch(0.7 0.19 45)"
                  fill="url(#perfGrad)"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                />
                <Area
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey="submissions"
                  stroke="oklch(0.65 0.15 250)"
                  fill="transparent"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  strokeDasharray="4 4"
                />
              </AreaChart>
            </ChartContainer>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="analytics-card glass-card border-0 shadow-lg">
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">
              Course Completion Rates
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <ChartContainer config={courseCompletionConfig} className="h-[200px] sm:h-[260px] lg:h-[280px]">
              <BarChart data={contentUsage} layout="vertical">
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="hsl(var(--border))" />
                <XAxis type="number" tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
                <YAxis
                  dataKey="course"
                  type="category"
                  tick={{ fontSize: 10 }}
                  width={120}
                />
                <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
                <Bar
                  dataKey="completion"
                  fill="oklch(0.7 0.19 45)"
                  radius={[0, 4, 4, 0]}
                />
              </BarChart>
            </ChartContainer>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Score Distribution + Cohort Comparison */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        <Card className="analytics-card glass-card border-0 shadow-lg">
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">
              Score Distribution
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <ChartContainer config={scoreDistConfig} className="h-[200px] sm:h-[260px] lg:h-[280px]">
              <BarChart data={scoreDistribution}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="hsl(var(--border))" />
                <XAxis dataKey="range" tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
                <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
                <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
                <Bar
                  dataKey="students"
                  fill="oklch(0.7 0.19 45)"
                  radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]}
                />
              </BarChart>
            </ChartContainer>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="analytics-card glass-card border-0 shadow-lg">
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">
              Cohort Comparison
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-[200px] sm:h-[260px] lg:h-[280px] text-muted-foreground text-xs">
              <Users className="h-8 w-8 mb-2 opacity-20" />
              <p>Cohort comparison data will appear here.</p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Radar Chart + Weekly Engagement */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        <Card className="analytics-card glass-card border-0 shadow-lg">
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">
              Skill Readiness Radar
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-[220px] sm:h-[280px] lg:h-[300px] text-muted-foreground text-xs">
              <Target className="h-8 w-8 mb-2 opacity-20" />
              <p>Skill readiness insights coming soon.</p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="analytics-card glass-card border-0 shadow-lg">
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">
              Weekly Engagement
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
             <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-[220px] sm:h-[280px] lg:h-[300px] text-muted-foreground text-xs">
              <TrendingUp className="h-8 w-8 mb-2 opacity-20" />
              <p>Weekly engagement trends coming soon.</p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Placement Pipeline + At-Risk Trend */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        <Card className="analytics-card glass-card border-0 shadow-lg">
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">
              Placement Pipeline
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <ChartContainer config={placementConfig} className="h-[200px] sm:h-[260px] lg:h-[280px]">
              <BarChart data={placementPipeline}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="hsl(var(--border))" />
                <XAxis dataKey="stage" tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
                <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
                <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
                <Bar
                  dataKey="count"
                  fill="oklch(0.7 0.19 45)"
                  radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]}
                />
              </BarChart>
            </ChartContainer>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="analytics-card glass-card border-0 shadow-lg">
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">
              At-Risk & Recovery Trend
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
             <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-[200px] sm:h-[260px] lg:h-[280px] text-muted-foreground text-xs">
              <AlertTriangle className="h-8 w-8 mb-2 opacity-20" />
              <p>At-risk student monitoring coming soon.</p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* At-Risk Students Drilldown */}
      <Card className="analytics-card glass-card border-0 shadow-lg overflow-hidden">
        <CardHeader className="pb-2">
          <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 text-rose-500">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />
            At-Risk Students Drilldown
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow className="border-border/50 hover:bg-transparent">
                  <TableHead className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider pl-6">Student</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Risk Reason</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Last Active</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Avg Score</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-right pr-6">Progress</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {atRiskDetails.length > 0 ? (
                  atRiskDetails.map((student) => (
                    <TableRow key={student.student_id} className="border-border/30 hover:bg-white/5 group transition-colors">
                      <TableCell className="pl-6 py-4">
                        <div className="flex flex-col">
                          <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">{student.student_name}</span>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            <Mail className="h-3 w-3" />
                            {student.student_email}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Badge variant="outline" className={cn(
                          "text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-tighter",
                          student.risk_status.includes('Inactive') ? "border-rose-500/50 text-rose-500" :
                          student.risk_status.includes('Performance') ? "border-amber-500/50 text-amber-500" :
                          "border-zinc-500/50 text-zinc-400"
                        )}>
                          {student.risk_status}
                        </Badge>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          <Clock className="h-3 w-3" />
                          {student.last_active_at ? new Date(student.last_active_at).toLocaleDateString() : 'Never'}
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <span className={cn(
                          "text-sm font-mono font-bold",
                          (student.avg_score ?? 0) < 40 ? "text-rose-500" : "text-foreground"
                        )}>
                          {student.avg_score ? `${Math.round(student.avg_score)}%` : 'N/A'}
                        </span>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right pr-6">
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1.5">
                          <span className="text-sm font-mono font-bold">
                            {student.total_items ? Math.round((student.completed_items / student.total_items) * 100) : 0}%
                          </span>
                          <div className="w-20 h-1.5 bg-white/5 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                            <div 
                              className="h-full bg-primary transition-all duration-1000" 
                              style={{ width: `${student.total_items ? (student.completed_items / student.total_items) * 100 : 0}%` }} 
                            />
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableCell colSpan={5} className="h-40 text-center text-muted-foreground italic">
                      No at-risk students detected in this period.
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                )}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Lecture Completion */}
      <Card className="analytics-card glass-card border-0 shadow-lg">
        <CardHeader className="pb-2">
          <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">
            Lecture Completion by Course
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-[200px] sm:h-[260px] lg:h-[280px] text-muted-foreground text-xs">
            <BookOpen className="h-8 w-8 mb-2 opacity-20" />
            <p>Lecture completion analytics coming soon.</p>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

function safeNum(
  value: unknown,
  fallback: number | string = 0,
): number | string {
  if (value == null) return fallback;
  const n = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;
}

function getGreeting(): string {
  const h = new Date().getHours();
  if (h < 12) return "Good morning";
  if (h < 17) return "Good afternoon";
  return "Good evening";
}

const CHART_COLORS = [
  "oklch(0.7 0.19 45)",
  "oklch(0.55 0.02 260)",
  "oklch(0.65 0.2 45)",
  "oklch(0.75 0.15 85)",
];

const pipelineChartConfig = {
  count: {
    label: "Students",
    color: "oklch(0.7 0.19 45)",
  },
} satisfies ChartConfig;

const cohortChartConfig = {
  student_count: {
    label: "Students",
    color: "oklch(0.7 0.19 45)",
  },
} satisfies ChartConfig;

/* ── KPI Card ── */

const KPICard = ({
  label,
  value,
  trend,
  trendUp,
  valueRef,
  suffix = "",
  decimal = false,
  icon: Icon,
  iconColor,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number | string;
  trend?: string;
  trendUp?: boolean;
  valueRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLSpanElement | null>;
  suffix?: string;
  decimal?: boolean;
  icon?: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
  iconColor?: string;
}) => {
  const numericValue = typeof value === "number" ? value : parseFloat(String(value)) || 0;

  return (
    <div className="glass-card rounded-xl p-5 sm:p-6 group hover:border-primary/20 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/5 transition-all duration-300">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
        <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {trend && (
            <div
              className={cn(
                "inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold rounded-full px-2 py-0.5",
                trendUp
                  ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-500/10"
                  : "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 bg-amber-500/10",
              )}
            >
              {trendUp ? (
                <TrendingUp className="h-3 w-3" />
              ) : (
                <TrendingDown className="h-3 w-3" />
              )}
              {trend}
            </div>
          )}
          {Icon && (
            <div className={cn("w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center", iconColor || "bg-gradient-orange-soft")}>
              <Icon className={cn("h-4 w-4", iconColor ? "text-white" : "text-primary")} />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <span
        ref={valueRef}
        data-value={numericValue}
        data-suffix={suffix}
        data-decimal={String(decimal)}
        className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground leading-none font-mono"
      >
        {typeof value === "string" && isNaN(parseFloat(value))
          ? value
          : `${value}${suffix}`}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
};

/* ── Section Header ── */

const SectionHeader = ({
  title,
  subtitle,
  action,
}: {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  action?: React.ReactNode;
}) => (
  <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-border/30">
    <div>
      <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">{title}</h3>
      {subtitle && (
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{subtitle}</p>
      )}
    </div>
    {action}
  </div>
);

/* ── Progress Bar ── */

const ProgressMetric = ({
  label,
  value,
  max = 100,
  color = "bg-primary",
  barRef,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  max?: number;
  color?: string;
  barRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
}) => {
  const pct = max > 0 ? Math.round((value / max) * 100) : 0;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-sm text-foreground font-medium">{label}</span>
        <span className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground tabular-nums">{pct}%</span>
      </div>
      <div className="h-2 w-full bg-muted/60 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
        <div
          ref={barRef}
          className={cn("h-full rounded-full", color)}
          style={{ width: "0%" }}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/* ── Timeline Activity Item ── */

  title,

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">
            {title}
          </p>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground shrink-0 font-medium">{time}</span>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">{description}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ── Main Dashboard ── */

export function CollegeDashboardContent({
  snapshot,
  extendedData,
}: {
  snapshot: CurrentAdminCollegeSnapshot;
  extendedData: CollegeDashboardExtendedData;
}) {
  const { section } = useTenantPath();
  const greeting = getGreeting();

  const kpiVal1 = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const kpiVal2 = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const kpiVal3 = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const kpiVal4 = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const progressBar1 = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const progressBar2 = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const progressBar3 = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const progressBar4 = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const funnel = extendedData.placementFunnel;
  const totalProfiles =
    (funnel?.not_ready_count ?? 0) +
    (funnel?.needs_improvement_count ?? 0) +
    (funnel?.interview_ready_count ?? 0) +
    (funnel?.placed_count ?? 0);
  const readinessPct =
    totalProfiles > 0
      ? Math.round(
          (((funnel?.interview_ready_count ?? 0) +
            (funnel?.placed_count ?? 0)) /
            totalProfiles) *
            100,
        )
      : 0;
  const placementRate =
    totalProfiles > 0
      ? Math.round(((funnel?.placed_count ?? 0) / totalProfiles) * 100)
      : 0;
  const avgScore = extendedData.assessmentAnalytics?.average_score ?? 0;

  useEffect(() => {
    const ctx = gsap.context(() => {
      const counters = [kpiVal1, kpiVal2, kpiVal3, kpiVal4];
      counters.forEach((ref) => {
        if (!ref.current) return;
        const el = ref.current;
        const end = parseFloat(el.dataset.value ?? "0");
        const suffix = el.dataset.suffix ?? "";
        const isDecimal = el.dataset.decimal === "true";
        const obj = { val: 0 };
        gsap.to(obj, {
          val: end,
          duration: 1.4,
          ease: "power2.out",
          onUpdate() {
            el.textContent = isDecimal
              ? `${obj.val.toFixed(1)}${suffix}`
              : `${Math.round(obj.val)}${suffix}`;
          },
        });
      });

      const bars = [
        { ref: progressBar1, width: readinessPct },
        { ref: progressBar2, width: placementRate },
        { ref: progressBar3, width: Math.min(Number(avgScore), 100) },
        { ref: progressBar4, width: 72 },
      ];
      bars.forEach(({ ref, width }) => {
        if (!ref.current) return;
        gsap.fromTo(
          ref.current,
          { width: "0%" },
          { width: `${width}%`, duration: 1.2, ease: "power2.out", delay: 0.3 }
        );
      });
    });

    return () => ctx.revert();
  }, [readinessPct, placementRate, avgScore]);

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      {/* ── Gradient Mesh Background ── */}
      <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-gradient-mesh pointer-events-none -z-10" />

      <div className="relative space-y-6 sm:space-y-8">
      <PageHeader
        title="College Dashboard"
        description={`${greeting}, here is what's happening in your college today.`}
      />

      {/* ── KPI Grid ── */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-6 lg:grid-cols-4 lg:gap-8">
        <KPICard
          label="Total students"
          value={safeNum(snapshot.studentsCount) as number}
          valueRef={kpiVal1}
          icon={Users}
          iconColor="bg-blue-500"
        />
        <KPICard
          label="Active admins"
          value={safeNum(snapshot.adminsCount) as number}
          valueRef={kpiVal2}
          icon={ShieldCheck}
          iconColor="bg-emerald-500"
        />
        <KPICard
          label="Placement readiness"
          value={readinessPct}
          suffix="%"
          valueRef={kpiVal3}
          icon={Target}
          iconColor="bg-orange-500"
        />
        <KPICard
          label="Avg assessment score"
          value={Number(avgScore) || 0}
          decimal
          valueRef={kpiVal4}
          icon={Trophy}
          iconColor="bg-violet-500"
        />
      </div>

      {/* ── Quick Actions ── */}
      <Card className="glass-card border-0">
        <SectionHeader
          title="Quick actions"
          subtitle="Common administrative tasks"
        />
        <CardContent className="p-6">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3 sm:gap-5">
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              className="justify-start h-12 text-xs font-semibold glass-card border-0 hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground transition-all duration-300 rounded-xl"
              asChild
            >
              <Link href={section('/students')}>
                <UserPlus className="h-4 w-4 mr-2.5" /> Add student
              </Link>
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              className="justify-start h-12 text-xs font-semibold glass-card border-0 hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground transition-all duration-300 rounded-xl"
              asChild
            >
              <Link href={section('/reports')}>
                <FileBarChart className="h-4 w-4 mr-2.5" /> Generate report
              </Link>
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              className="justify-start h-12 text-xs font-semibold glass-card border-0 hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground transition-all duration-300 rounded-xl"
              asChild
            >
              <Link href={section('/placements')}>
                <Briefcase className="h-4 w-4 mr-2.5" /> View placements
              </Link>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* ── Operational Metrics ── */}
      <Card className="glass-card border-0">
        <SectionHeader
          title="Operational metrics"
          subtitle="Key performance indicators across your programme"
        />
        <CardContent className="p-6 space-y-5">
          <ProgressMetric
            label="Placement readiness"
            value={readinessPct}
            color="bg-gradient-orange"
            barRef={progressBar1}
          />
          <ProgressMetric
            label="Placement rate"
            value={placementRate}
            color="bg-emerald-500"
            barRef={progressBar2}
          />
          <ProgressMetric
            label="Avg assessment score"
            value={Number(avgScore) || 0}
            max={100}
            color="bg-blue-500"
            barRef={progressBar3}
          />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* ── Charts Row ── */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* At-Risk Watchlist */}
        <Card className="glass-card border-0 xl:col-span-2">
          <SectionHeader
            title="Students needing attention"
            subtitle="No activity in 14+ days"
            action={
              extendedData.atRiskStudents.length > 0 ? (
                <Badge
                  variant="outline"
                  className="bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border-amber-500/20 text-xs font-semibold"
                >
                  {extendedData.atRiskStudents.length} students
                </Badge>
              ) : undefined
            }
          />
          <CardContent className="p-6">
            {extendedData.atRiskStudents.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-14 text-center">
                <ShieldCheck className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground/40 mb-3" />
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-1">
                  All clear
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground max-w-[240px]">
                  All students are active and engaged.
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-border/40">
                      <th className="pb-3 px-2">Student / Course</th>
                      <th className="pb-3 px-2 text-right">Inactive</th>
                      <th className="pb-3 px-2 text-center w-28">Activity</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-border/20">
                    {extendedData.atRiskStudents.slice(0, 5).map((s, i) => (
                      <tr
                        key={i}

                      >
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-2">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-gradient-orange-soft flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-primary">
                                {s.student_id.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground group-hover/row:text-primary transition-colors">
                                {s.course_title}
                              </p>
                              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-mono mt-0.5">
                                ID: {s.student_id.slice(0, 8)}
                              </p>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-2 text-right">
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
                            <Clock className="h-3 w-3" />
                            {s.days_inactive}d
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-2">
                          <div className="flex justify-center gap-1">
                            {[...Array(5)].map((_, j) => (
                              <div
                                key={j}
                                className={cn(
                                  "w-2 h-2 rounded-[3px]",
                                  j < 2
                                    ? "bg-amber-500/40"
                                    : "bg-muted-foreground/10",
                                )}
                              />
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
                <Link
                  href={section('/students')}
                  className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-primary hover:text-primary/80 transition-colors py-3 border border-dashed border-primary/20 rounded-xl hover:bg-primary/5"
                >
                  View all students
                  <ArrowUpRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </Link>
              </div>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Placement Pipeline */}
        <Card className="glass-card border-0">
          <SectionHeader
            title="Placement pipeline"
            subtitle="Cohort journey overview"
          />
          <CardContent className="p-6">
            <div className="h-[260px]">
              <ChartContainer config={pipelineChartConfig} className="h-full w-full">
                <BarChart
                  data={[
                    { name: "Training", count: funnel?.not_ready_count ?? 0 },

export function DashboardExtendedCards({
  collegeSlug,
  students,
  admins,
  extendedData,
}: {
  collegeSlug: string;
  students: CurrentAdminCollegeSnapshot["students"];
  admins: CurrentAdminCollegeSnapshot["admins"];
  extendedData: CollegeDashboardExtendedData;
}) {
  const snapshot: CurrentAdminCollegeSnapshot = {
    collegeId: collegeSlug,
    studentsCount: students.length,
    adminsCount: admins.length,
    students,
    admins,
  };

  return (
    <CollegeDashboardContent snapshot={snapshot} extendedData={extendedData} />
  );
}

export function DbSectionPage({
  title,
  subtitle,
  snapshot,
}: {
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  snapshot: CurrentAdminCollegeSnapshot | null;
}) {
  if (!snapshot) {
    return (
      <PageContainer>
        <PageHeader title={title} description="No active college membership found." />
      </PageContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      <DbSectionPageShell
        title={title}
        subtitle={subtitle}
        studentsCount={snapshot.studentsCount}
        adminsCount={snapshot.adminsCount}
      />
      <DbSectionPageLists snapshot={snapshot} />
    </PageContainer>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/components/admin/protected-data-provider.tsx ---
"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useTenant } from "@/providers/tenant-provider";
import type { FeatureMap } from "@/lib/features/feature-access";
import type { TenantModuleAccessMap } from "@/lib/modules/module-access";
import { SidebarProvider, SidebarInset, SidebarTrigger } from "@/components/ui/sidebar";
import { Sidebar, MobileSidebar } from "@/components/dashboard/sidebar";
import { Header } from "@/components/dashboard/header";
import { Breadcrumbs } from "@/components/shared/breadcrumbs";
import { TooltipProvider } from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import type { MasterCoursePillarsRow } from "@/types/database";

interface ProtectedDataProviderProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  initialFeatures: FeatureMap;
  initialModuleAccess: TenantModuleAccessMap;
  assignedPillars?: MasterCoursePillarsRow[];
}

/**
 * Provides protected data to the admin shell after auth is confirmed.
 * Updates the tenant context with features and module access.
 */
export function ProtectedDataProvider({
  children,
  initialFeatures,
  initialModuleAccess,
  assignedPillars = [],
}: ProtectedDataProviderProps) {
  const { setFeatures, setModuleAccess } = useTenant();
  const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setFeatures(initialFeatures);
    setModuleAccess(initialModuleAccess);
  }, [initialFeatures, initialModuleAccess, setFeatures, setModuleAccess]);

  return (
    <TooltipProvider>
      <SidebarProvider>
        <Sidebar aria-label="Admin Navigation" assignedPillars={assignedPillars} />
        <MobileSidebar open={mobileOpen} onOpenChange={setMobileOpen} assignedPillars={assignedPillars} />
        <SidebarInset className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <div className="flex flex-col min-h-screen">
            <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 flex h-16 items-center gap-4 border-b border-border/40 bg-background/70 backdrop-blur-2xl px-4 lg:px-6">
              <SidebarTrigger className="lg:hidden" />
              <div className="flex-1">
                <Header />
              </div>
            </header>
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 lg:p-6 custom-scrollbar">
              <Breadcrumbs />
              {children}
            </div>
          </div>
        </SidebarInset>
      </SidebarProvider>
    </TooltipProvider>
  );
}

'use client'

import * as React from 'react'
import {
  BarChart,
  Bar,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  CartesianGrid,
  Tooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer
} from 'recharts'
import { PremiumCard } from './premium-card'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

interface ChartDataPoint {
  [key: string]: string | number
}

interface ChartWrapperProps {
  title: string
  subtitle?: string
  children: React.ReactNode
  className?: string
}

export function ChartWrapper({ title, subtitle, children, className }: ChartWrapperProps) {
  return (
    <PremiumCard className={cn('flex flex-col', className)}>
      <div className="border-b border-white/5 px-6 py-5">
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">{title}</h3>
        {subtitle && <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400 mt-1">{subtitle}</p>}
      </div>
      <div className="flex-1 p-6">
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
          {children as React.ReactElement}
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>
    </PremiumCard>
  )
}

export function AnalyticsBarChart({ data, xKey, yKey, title, valueFormatter }: { data: ChartDataPoint[]; xKey: string; yKey: string; title: string; valueFormatter?: (value: number) => string }) {
  return (
    <ChartWrapper title={title} className="min-h-[350px]">
      <BarChart data={data} margin={{ top: 10, right: 10, left: 0, bottom: 0 }}>
        <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.05)" vertical={false} />
        <XAxis dataKey={xKey} stroke="#71717a" fontSize={12} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} dy={10} />
        <YAxis stroke="#71717a" fontSize={12} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} dx={-10} tickFormatter={valueFormatter} />
        <Tooltip
          cursor={{ fill: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)' }}
          contentStyle={{ backgroundColor: '#0a0a0a', borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)', borderRadius: '8px', color: '#fff' }}
          itemStyle={{ color: '#fff' }}
        />
        <Bar dataKey={yKey} fill="#8b5cf6" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} />
      </BarChart>
    </ChartWrapper>
  )
}

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

export function DateRangeFilter({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  const [isActive, setIsActive] = React.useState(false)

  return (
    <div className={cn("flex items-center gap-2", className)}>
      <Button
        variant="outline"
        size="sm"
        className={cn(
          "h-9 justify-start text-left font-normal bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10 hover:bg-white/5",
          isActive ? "text-primary border-primary/50" : "text-zinc-400"
        )}
        onClick={() => setIsActive(!isActive)}
      >
        <CalendarIcon className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
        {isActive ? "Last 30 Days" : "Filter by date"}
      </Button>
      {isActive && (
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          className="h-9 px-2 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white"
          onClick={() => setIsActive(false)}
        >
          <X className="h-4 w-4" />
          <span className="sr-only">Clear</span>
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

import * as React from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

interface PremiumCardProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  glow?: boolean
  elevated?: boolean
}

export function PremiumCard({
  className,
  glow = false,
  elevated = false,
  children,
  ...props
}: PremiumCardProps) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        'relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-white/5 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl transition-all duration-300',
        elevated && 'shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)]',
        glow && 'hover:border-primary/50 hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(var(--primary),0.15)]',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/10 to-transparent" />
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}

export function KPIWidget({
  title,
  value,
  trend,
  trendLabel,
  icon: Icon,
  className
}: {
  title: string
  value: string | number
  trend?: number
  trendLabel?: string
  icon: React.ElementType
  className?: string
}) {
  const isPositive = trend && trend > 0
  const isNegative = trend && trend < 0

  return (
    <PremiumCard glow className={cn('p-6', className)}>
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
        <div>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider">{title}</p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white font-mono">{value}</p>
          
          {trend !== undefined && (
            <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span
                className={cn(
                  'inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium',
                  isPositive ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400' : 
                  isNegative ? 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400' : 'bg-zinc-500/10 text-zinc-400'
                )}
              >
                {isPositive ? '+' : ''}{trend}%
              </span>
              {trendLabel && <span className="text-xs text-zinc-500">{trendLabel}</span>}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-lg bg-primary/10 p-3 text-primary">
          <Icon className="h-5 w-5" />
        </div>
      </div>
    </PremiumCard>
  )
}
