"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import Image from "next/image";
import React, { useSyncExternalStore, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams, useParams } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Mail, Lock, Eye, EyeOff, Sun, Moon } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { LoginYouTubeStats } from "@/components/auth/login-youtube-stats";
import {
  AmritaAdminLogin,
  AMRITA_COLLEGE_SLUG,
} from "@/components/auth/amrita-admin-login";

const AUTH_THEME_KEY = "auth-page-theme";

let authThemeHydrated = false;

function subscribeAuthPageTheme(onStoreChange: () => void) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return () => {};
  const sync = () => {
    authThemeHydrated = true;
    onStoreChange();
  };
  queueMicrotask(sync);
  const onStorage = () => sync();
  window.addEventListener("storage", onStorage);
  window.addEventListener("auth-page-theme", onStorage);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener("storage", onStorage);
    window.removeEventListener("auth-page-theme", onStorage);
  };
}

function getAuthPageThemeSnapshot(): "light" | "dark" {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "dark";
  if (!authThemeHydrated) return "dark";
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(AUTH_THEME_KEY) as
      | "light"
      | "dark"
      | null;
    if (stored === "light" || stored === "dark") return stored;
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
  return "dark";
}

function getAuthPageThemeServerSnapshot(): "light" | "dark" {
  return "dark";
}

export type CollegeAdminAuthMode = "global" | "tenant";

function getCollegeAdminUrlErrorMessage(err: string | null): string | null {
  if (err === "account_disabled") return "This account is disabled.";
  if (err === "no_college_access") {
    return "No college admin access for this account. Sign in with credentials issued by your institution.";
  }
  return null;
}

/** OAuth callback / redirect query errors shared with the student login pattern. */
function getSharedAuthUrlErrorMessage(err: string | null): string | null {
  if (err === "network") {
    return "Could not reach the sign-in service (connection timed out). Check your internet, VPN, or firewall, then try again.";
  }
  if (err === "session") {
    return "Your sign-in session could not be completed. Please try again.";
  }
  return null;
}

  return (
    <div
      className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden"
      aria-hidden
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          "absolute inset-0",
          isDark
            ? "bg-gradient-to-b from-[#030303] via-[#080808] to-[#0a0a0a]"
            : "bg-gradient-to-b from-[#fffbf7] via-[#fff8f2] to-[#ffedd5]",
        )}
      />
      <div
        className={cn(
          "auth-bg-drift-slow absolute -left-[22%] -top-[18%] h-[min(520px,58vh)] w-[min(540px,92vw)] rounded-[48%] blur-[118px]",
          isDark ? "bg-[#E8541A]/[0.2]" : "bg-[#fb923c]/[0.32]",
        )}
      />
      <div
        className={cn(
          "auth-bg-drift-slower absolute -right-[18%] top-[12%] h-[min(460px,52vh)] w-[min(480px,88vw)] rounded-[42%] blur-[125px]",
          isDark ? "bg-[#c2410c]/[0.14]" : "bg-[#fdba74]/[0.45]",
        )}
      />
      <div
        className={cn(
          "auth-bg-drift-mid absolute left-[5%] bottom-[-5%] h-[min(380px,42vh)] w-[min(400px,78vw)] rounded-[50%] blur-[95px]",
          isDark ? "bg-[#1c1917]/[0.65]" : "bg-[#ffedd5]/[0.7]",
        )}
      />
      <div
        className={cn(
          "auth-bg-drift-slower absolute right-[8%] top-[42%] h-[200px] w-[300px] rounded-full blur-[88px]",
          isDark ? "bg-amber-600/[0.09]" : "bg-orange-200/[0.5]",
        )}
      />
      <div
        className={cn(
          "auth-bg-drift-mid absolute left-[38%] top-[52%] h-[160px] w-[260px] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full blur-[75px]",
          isDark ? "bg-[#E8541A]/[0.08]" : "bg-[#fed7aa]/[0.55]",
        )}
      />
      <div
        className={cn(
          "absolute inset-0 opacity-[0.3]",
          isDark
            ? "bg-[repeating-linear-gradient(125deg,transparent,transparent_3px,rgba(255,255,255,0.014)_3px,rgba(255,255,255,0.014)_4px)]"
            : "bg-[repeating-linear-gradient(125deg,transparent,transparent_3px,rgba(234,88,12,0.04)_3px,rgba(234,88,12,0.04)_4px)]",
        )}
      />
      <svg
        className={cn(
          "absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 h-[130%] w-[130%] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-40",
          isDark ? "text-[#E8541A]/[0.06]" : "text-orange-400/[0.08]",
        )}
        viewBox="0 0 100 100"
        preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"
      >
        <defs>
          <pattern
            id="auth-hex-mesh-admin"
            width="8"
            height="13.86"
            patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
            patternTransform="scale(0.45)"
          >
            <path
              d="M4 0 L8 2.31 L8 6.93 L4 9.24 L0 6.93 L0 2.31 Z"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="0.1"
            />
          </pattern>
        </defs>
        <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="url(#auth-hex-mesh-admin)" />
      </svg>
      <div
        className={cn(
          "absolute inset-0",
          isDark
            ? "bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_90%_80%_at_50%_45%,transparent_0%,rgba(0,0,0,0.62)_100%)]"
            : "bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_92%_82%_at_50%_38%,transparent_20%,rgba(255,251,247,0.75)_100%)]",
        )}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

export function CollegeAdminAuthScreen({
  mode,
  collegeSlug: collegeSlugFromPage,
}: {
  mode: CollegeAdminAuthMode;
  /** Server-passed slug so SSR matches the client (avoids hydration mismatch on tenant login). */
  collegeSlug?: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const params = useParams();
  const message = searchParams.get("message");

  const collegeSlug =
    mode === "tenant"
      ? collegeSlugFromPage ??
        (typeof params?.collegeSlug === "string" ? params.collegeSlug : "")
      : "";
  const qErr = searchParams.get("error");
  const sharedUrlError = getSharedAuthUrlErrorMessage(qErr);
  const adminUrlError = getCollegeAdminUrlErrorMessage(qErr);
  const fromUrlGeneric =
    qErr && !sharedUrlError && !adminUrlError
      ? "Sign-in failed. Please try again."
      : null;

  const theme = useSyncExternalStore(
    subscribeAuthPageTheme,
    getAuthPageThemeSnapshot,
    getAuthPageThemeServerSnapshot,
  );

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showLoginPassword, setShowLoginPassword] = useState(false);

  const [loginEmail, setLoginEmail] = useState("");
  const [loginPassword, setLoginPassword] = useState("");

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    const next = theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(AUTH_THEME_KEY, next);
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
    authThemeHydrated = true;
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("auth-page-theme"));
  };

  const isDark = theme === "dark";

  const handleLogin = async (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    const trimmedEmail = loginEmail.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!trimmedEmail || !loginPassword) {
      setError("Please enter email and password.");
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const startTime = performance.now();
      const supabase = createClient();
      const { error: signInError } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
        email: trimmedEmail,
        password: loginPassword,
      });
      if (signInError) {
        setError("Invalid email or password.");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
      if (!user) {
        setError("Login failed: Session not established.");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      type AdminAuthRpcRow = {
        allowed: boolean;
        error_code: string | null;
        college_slug: string | null;
        membership_id: string | null;
        membership_status: string | null;
      };

      const runAdminAuthRpc = async (slug: string | null) => {
        const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("resolve_admin_auth_context", {
          p_user_id: user.id,
          p_slug: slug,
        });
        if (error) {
          return { rpcError: error, row: null as AdminAuthRpcRow | null };
        }
        const row = (Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : data) as AdminAuthRpcRow | null;
        return { rpcError: null, row };
      };

      if (mode === "global") {
        const { rpcError, row: authRow } = await runAdminAuthRpc(null);
        if (rpcError) {
          setError("Could not verify access. Try again.");
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        if (!authRow) {
          setError("No access found.");
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        if (!authRow.allowed) {
          if (authRow.error_code === "account_disabled") {
            setError("Account is disabled.");
          } else if (authRow.error_code === "forbidden") {
            setError("Could not verify access. Try again.");
          } else {
            setError("No access found.");
          }
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        const resolvedSlug = authRow.college_slug;
        if (!resolvedSlug) {
          setError("Tenant not found.");
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        if (authRow.membership_status === "invited" && authRow.membership_id) {
          await supabase
            .from("college_memberships")
            .update({ status: "active" })
            .eq("id", authRow.membership_id)
            .eq("user_id", user.id)
            .eq("status", "invited");
        }
        const duration = performance.now() - startTime;
        if (duration > 200) {
          console.warn(
            `[auth/login] Root client-side login flow took ${Math.round(duration)}ms`,
          );
        }
        router.refresh();
        router.push("/auth/callback");
        return;
      }

      const { rpcError, row: authRow } = await runAdminAuthRpc(collegeSlug);
      if (rpcError) {
        setError("Could not verify access. Try again.");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      if (!authRow) {
        setError("Tenant not found.");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      if (!authRow.allowed) {
        if (authRow.error_code === "tenant_not_found") {
          setError("Tenant not found.");
        } else if (authRow.error_code === "account_disabled") {
          setError("Account is disabled.");
        } else if (authRow.error_code === "no_college_access") {
          const { data: profile } = await supabase
            .from("profiles")
            .select("global_role")
            .eq("id", user.id)
            .maybeSingle();
          if (profile?.global_role === "superadmin") {
            const { data: collegeRow } = await supabase
              .from("colleges")
              .select("slug")
              .ilike("slug", collegeSlug)
              .eq("status", "active")
              .maybeSingle();
            if (collegeRow?.slug) {
              const duration = performance.now() - startTime;
              if (duration > 200) {
                console.warn(
                  `[auth/login] Client-side login flow took ${Math.round(duration)}ms`,
                );
              }
              router.push(`/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeRow.slug)}/admin/dashboard`);
              return;
            }
          }
          setError(
            "No college admin access for this tenant. Use credentials issued for this college.",
          );
        } else if (authRow.error_code === "forbidden") {
          setError("Could not verify access. Try again.");
        } else {
          setError("No access found for this college.");
        }
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      const resolvedSlug = authRow.college_slug;
      if (!resolvedSlug) {
        setError("Tenant not found.");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      if (authRow.membership_status === "invited" && authRow.membership_id) {
        await supabase
          .from("college_memberships")
          .update({ status: "active" })
          .eq("id", authRow.membership_id)
          .eq("user_id", user.id)
          .eq("status", "invited");
      }
      const duration = performance.now() - startTime;
      if (duration > 200) {
        console.warn(
          `[auth/login] Client-side login flow took ${Math.round(duration)}ms`,
        );
      }
      router.refresh();
      router.push(`/auth/callback?slug=${encodeURIComponent(resolvedSlug)}`);
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      const isNetworkError =
        msg === "Failed to fetch" ||
        msg.includes("NetworkError") ||
        msg.includes("Load failed");
      setError(
        isNetworkError
          ? "Unable to reach the server. Check your network, restart the dev server, and try again."
          : "Invalid email or password.",
      );
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const displayError =
    error ?? sharedUrlError ?? adminUrlError ?? fromUrlGeneric;

  const inputClass = isDark
    ? "h-12 rounded-xl border border-[#E8541A]/25 bg-[#E8541A]/[0.07] text-zinc-100 shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_0_rgba(255,140,60,0.08)] backdrop-blur-xl placeholder:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:border-[#E8541A] focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#E8541A]/25"
    : "h-12 rounded-xl border border-orange-200/70 bg-orange-50/35 text-zinc-900 shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.85)] backdrop-blur-xl placeholder:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:border-[#E8541A] focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#E8541A]/25";

  const iconMuted = isDark ? "text-orange-200/50" : "text-orange-900/45";
  const mutedText = isDark ? "text-zinc-400" : "text-zinc-600";
  const headingText = isDark ? "text-white" : "text-zinc-900";
  const bgPage = isDark ? "bg-[#030303]" : "bg-[#fffbf7]";
  const forgotHref =
    mode === "tenant" && collegeSlug
      ? `/c/${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}/admin/forgot-password`
      : "/forgot-password";

  const handleGoogleSignIn = async () => {
    setError(null);
    if (mode !== "tenant" || !collegeSlug) return;
    try {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const redirectTo = `${window.location.origin}/auth/callback?slug=${encodeURIComponent(collegeSlug)}`;
      const { error: oauthError } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
        provider: "google",
        options: { redirectTo },
      });
      if (oauthError) setError(oauthError.message);
    } catch {
      setError("Could not start Google sign-in.");
    }
  };

  if (mode === "tenant" && collegeSlug === AMRITA_COLLEGE_SLUG) {
    return (
      <AmritaAdminLogin
        isDark={isDark}
        collegeSlug={collegeSlug}
        loginEmail={loginEmail}
        setLoginEmail={setLoginEmail}
        loginPassword={loginPassword}
        setLoginPassword={setLoginPassword}
        showLoginPassword={showLoginPassword}
        setShowLoginPassword={setShowLoginPassword}
        loading={loading}
        displayError={displayError}
        message={message}
        onSubmit={handleLogin}
        forgotHref={forgotHref}
        onGoogleSignIn={handleGoogleSignIn}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "relative min-h-screen",
        bgPage,
        isDark ? "text-zinc-100" : "text-zinc-900",
      )}
    >
      <AuthBackground isDark={isDark} />

      <div className="fixed right-4 top-4 z-50 sm:right-6 sm:top-6">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={toggleTheme}
          className={cn(
            "flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full border backdrop-blur-xl transition-colors",
            isDark
              ? "border-[#E8541A]/35 bg-[#E8541A]/[0.1] text-orange-100 hover:bg-[#E8541A]/[0.16]"
              : "border-orange-200/90 bg-orange-50/60 text-orange-950 shadow-sm hover:bg-orange-50/90",
          )}
          aria-label={isDark ? "Switch to light mode" : "Switch to dark mode"}
        >
          {isDark ? (
            <Sun className="h-[18px] w-[18px]" />
          ) : (
            <Moon className="h-[18px] w-[18px]" />
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-[1] flex min-h-screen flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 py-12 sm:px-6">
        <div className="w-full max-w-[420px]">
          <div className="mb-8 flex flex-col items-center text-center">
            {mode === "tenant" && (
              <p className="mb-3 rounded-full border border-[#E8541A]/25 bg-[#E8541A]/[0.08] px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#E8541A] backdrop-blur-sm">
                Admin portal
              </p>
            )}
            <div className="relative mb-6">
              <div
                className={cn(
                  "absolute inset-0 -m-6 rounded-full blur-2xl",
                  isDark ? "bg-[#E8541A]/15" : "bg-orange-400/15",
                )}
                aria-hidden
              />
              <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
                <div
                  className={cn(
                    "relative h-12 w-12 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl shadow-lg",
                    isDark
                      ? "ring-2 ring-[#E8541A]/30 shadow-black/30"
                      : "ring-2 ring-orange-200/90 shadow-orange-200/40",
                  )}
                >
                  <Image
                    src='/assets/logo-icon.png'
                    alt=""
                    width={48}
                    height={48}
                    className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                    priority
                  />
                </div>
                <span className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-2xl">
                  <span className={headingText}>NextGen </span>
                  <span className="bg-gradient-to-r from-[#E8541A] to-[#f97316] bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                    CTO
                  </span>
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <h1
              className={cn(
                "max-w-sm text-balance text-3xl font-bold leading-[1.15] tracking-tight sm:text-[1.85rem]",
                headingText,
              )}
            >
              Welcome back
            </h1>
            <p
              className={cn(
                "mt-6 text-[15px] font-normal leading-relaxed sm:text-base",
                mutedText,
              )}
            >
              {mode === "tenant"
                ? "Sign in with your admin credentials for this institution."
                : "Sign in to manage programs, students, and placements."}
            </p>
          </div>

          <LoginYouTubeStats isDark={isDark} />

          {message && !displayError && (
            <div className="mb-4 rounded-lg border border-[#E8541A]/30 bg-[#E8541A]/10 px-3 py-2.5 text-center text-sm font-medium text-[#c2410c] dark:text-[#ffb38a]">
              {message}
            </div>
          )}

          {displayError && (
            <div
              className={cn(
                "mb-4 rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-center text-sm font-medium",
                "border",
                isDark
                  ? "border-red-500/30 bg-red-950/50 text-red-300"
                  : "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700",
              )}
            >
              {displayError}
            </div>
          )}

          <form onSubmit={handleLogin} className="space-y-5">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label htmlFor="login-email" className="sr-only">
                Email
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <Mail
                  className={cn(
                    "pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2",
                    iconMuted,
                  )}
                />
                <Input
                  id="login-email"
                  type="email"
                  value={loginEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => setLoginEmail(e.target.value)}
                  required
                  placeholder={
                    mode === "tenant" ? "you@college.edu" : "admin@college.edu"
                  }
                  className={cn(inputClass, "pl-10")}
                  autoComplete="email"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label htmlFor="login-password" className="sr-only">
                Password
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <Lock
                  className={cn(
                    "pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2",
                    iconMuted,
                  )}
                />
                <Input
                  id="login-password"
                  type={showLoginPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                  value={loginPassword}
                  onChange={(e) => setLoginPassword(e.target.value)}
                  required
                  placeholder="Password"
                  className={cn(inputClass, "pl-10 pr-10")}
                  autoComplete="current-password"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className={cn(
                    "absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2",
                    iconMuted,
                    isDark
                      ? "hover:text-orange-200/90"
                      : "hover:text-orange-800",
                  )}
                  onClick={() => setShowLoginPassword((v) => !v)}
                  aria-label={
                    showLoginPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"
                  }
                >
                  {showLoginPassword ? (
                    <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" />
                  ) : (
                    <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="text-right">
              <Link
                href={forgotHref}
                className={cn(
                  "text-xs font-medium hover:text-[#E8541A]",
                  mutedText,
                )}
              >
                Forgot password?
              </Link>
            </div>

            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="h-12 w-full rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#E8541A] via-[#ea580c] to-[#7c2d12] text-[15px] font-semibold text-white shadow-lg shadow-orange-900/25 transition hover:brightness-[1.05] disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {loading ? "Please wait…" : "Continue"}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </div>

        <div className="pointer-events-none fixed bottom-5 left-5 z-[1] opacity-40 sm:bottom-6 sm:left-6">
          <div
            className={cn(
              "h-8 w-8 overflow-hidden rounded-full backdrop-blur-sm",
              isDark ? "ring-1 ring-[#E8541A]/25" : "ring-1 ring-orange-200/80",
            )}
          >
            <Image
              src='/assets/logo-icon.png'
              alt=""
              width={32}
              height={32}
              className="h-full w-full object-cover"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client'

import * as React from 'react'
import { useState } from 'react'
import Image from 'next/image'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { Eye, EyeOff, Loader2, Mail, Lock, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'

export type PortalType = 'superadmin' | 'college' | 'student'

export interface UnifiedLoginFormProps {
  portalType: PortalType
  title: string
  subtitle: string
  tenantLabel?: string
  heroTitle: string
  heroSubtitle: string
  heroImage?: string
  badgeLabel: string
  forgotPasswordHref?: string
  showGoogleAuth?: boolean
  onGoogleAuth?: () => void
  isLoading?: boolean
  error?: string | null
  onSubmit?: (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => void
  emailValue?: string
  onEmailChange?: (v: string) => void
  passwordValue?: string
  onPasswordChange?: (v: string) => void
  children?: React.ReactNode
}

export function UnifiedLoginForm({
  portalType,
  title,
  subtitle,
  tenantLabel,
  heroTitle,
  heroSubtitle,
  heroImage = '/images/auth-bg-placeholder.jpg',
  badgeLabel,
  forgotPasswordHref = '/forgot-password',
  showGoogleAuth = true,
  onGoogleAuth,
  isLoading = false,
  error = null,
  onSubmit,
  emailValue,
  onEmailChange,
  passwordValue,
  onPasswordChange,
  children
}: UnifiedLoginFormProps) {
  const [localShowPassword, setLocalShowPassword] = useState(false)
  const isSuperAdmin = portalType === 'superadmin'

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen w-full flex flex-col lg:flex-row bg-background dark:bg-slate-950 text-foreground transition-colors duration-300">
      {/* LEFT SIDE - BRANDING / VALUE SECTION */}
      <div className="hidden lg:flex flex-1 relative bg-slate-900 border-r border-border/50 overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-950/70 z-10" />
        {heroImage && (
          <Image
            src={heroImage}
            alt="Login background"
            fill
            className="object-cover mix-blend-overlay opacity-50"
            priority
          />
        )}
        
        <div className="absolute inset-0 z-20 flex flex-col justify-between p-12 lg:p-16 text-white">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className={`h-10 w-10 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg font-bold text-lg shadow-lg ${isSuperAdmin ? 'bg-slate-800 text-white' : 'bg-orange-600 shadow-orange-900/20'}`}>
              N
            </div>
            <span className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">NextGen CTO</span>
          </div>
          
          <div className="space-y-6 max-w-xl mb-8">
            {tenantLabel && (
              <div className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1 text-sm font-medium backdrop-blur-md">
                {tenantLabel}
              </div>
            )}
            <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl xl:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white leading-[1.1]">
              {heroTitle}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-lg text-slate-300 font-medium max-w-md">
              {heroSubtitle}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* RIGHT SIDE - LOGIN FORM */}
      <div className="flex-[1.2] lg:flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 sm:p-12 lg:p-24 relative bg-surface dark:bg-slate-900/50">
        <div className="lg:hidden absolute top-6 left-6 flex items-center space-x-2">
          <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded-md bg-orange-600 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-white text-sm shadow-sm">
            N
          </div>
          <span className="font-bold tracking-tight">NextGen CTO</span>
        </div>

        <div className="w-full max-w-sm xl:max-w-md space-y-8 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-500 fill-mode-both">
          {/* Form Header */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
              <div className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 dark:bg-orange-500/10 dark:border-orange-500/20 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400">
                {badgeLabel}
              </div>
              {tenantLabel && (
                <div className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:border-slate-700 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                  {tenantLabel}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight">{title}</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-medium">
              {subtitle}
            </p>
          </div>

          {error && (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive rounded-md bg-destructive/10 px-3 py-2 border border-destructive/20 animate-in fade-in">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}

          {children ? (
            children
          ) : (
            <>
              <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-6">
                <div className="space-y-5">
                  <div className="space-y-2 group">
                    <label htmlFor="email" className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground/80 flex items-center gap-2 px-0.5">
                      <Mail className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> EMAIL ADDRESS
                    </label>
                    <Input 
                      id="email"
                      name="email"
                      type="email" 
                      placeholder="name@example.com" 
                      autoComplete="username"
                      required
                      value={emailValue}
                      onChange={(e) => onEmailChange?.(e.target.value)}
                      className="h-14 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/50 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 focus-visible:ring-orange-500/30 focus-visible:border-orange-500 transition-all shadow-sm text-base rounded-xl"
                      disabled={isLoading}
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-2 group">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-0.5">
                      <label htmlFor="password" className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground/80 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> PASSWORD
                      </label>
                      {forgotPasswordHref && (
                        <Link href={forgotPasswordHref} className="text-sm font-bold text-orange-600 hover:text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-500 dark:hover:text-orange-400 transition-colors">
                          Forgot?
                        </Link>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="relative">
                      <Input 
                        id="password"
                        name="password"
                        type={localShowPassword ? "text" : "password"} 
                        placeholder="••••••••" 
                        autoComplete="current-password"
                        required
                        value={passwordValue}
                        onChange={(e) => onPasswordChange?.(e.target.value)}
                        className="h-14 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/50 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 focus-visible:ring-orange-500/30 focus-visible:border-orange-500 transition-all pr-12 shadow-sm text-base rounded-xl"
                        disabled={isLoading}
                      />
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setLocalShowPassword(!localShowPassword)}
                        className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors focus:outline-none p-1 rounded-md"
                        aria-label={localShowPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
                      >
                        {localShowPassword ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <Button 
                  type="submit" 
                  className={`w-full h-14 text-lg font-bold text-white shadow-lg transition-all rounded-xl active:scale-[0.98] ${
                    isSuperAdmin 
                      ? 'bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 shadow-slate-900/20' 
                      : 'bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-700 shadow-orange-600/30'
                    }`}
                  disabled={isLoading}
                >
                  {isLoading ? (
                    <>
                      <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-5 w-5 animate-spin" />
                      Authenticating...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                      Sign In <ArrowRight className="w-5 h-5 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" />
                    </span>
                  )}
                </Button>
              </form>

              {showGoogleAuth && (
                <>
                  <div className="relative pt-2">
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center pt-2">
                      <span className="w-full border-t border-border" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="relative flex justify-center text-xs uppercase">
                      <span className="bg-surface dark:bg-slate-900/50 px-3 text-muted-foreground tracking-wider font-semibold">
                        Or continue with
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <Button 
                    variant="outline" 
                    type="button" 
                    disabled={isLoading}
                    className="w-full h-14 text-lg font-bold shadow-sm border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/80 transition-all rounded-xl hover:scale-[1.01] active:scale-[0.99] flex items-center justify-center gap-3"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (onGoogleAuth) onGoogleAuth()
                      else window.location.href = '/api/auth/google'
                    }}
                  >
                    <svg className="h-6 w-6" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                      <path d="M22.56 12.25c0-.78-.07-1.53-.2-2.25H12v4.26h5.92c-.26 1.37-1.04 2.53-2.21 3.31v2.77h3.57c2.08-1.92 3.28-4.74 3.28-8.09z" fill="#4285F4"/>
                      <path d="M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.57-2.77c-.98.66-2.23 1.06-3.71 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84C3.99 20.53 7.7 23 12 23z" fill="#34A853"/>
                      <path d="M5.84 14.09c-.22-.66-.35-1.36-.35-2.09s.13-1.43.35-2.09V7.07H2.18C1.43 8.55 1 10.22 1 12s.43 3.45 1.18 4.93l3.66-2.84z" fill="#FBBC05"/>
                      <path d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06 0.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.07l3.66 2.84c0.87-2.6 3.3-4.53 6.16-4.53z" fill="#EA4335"/>
                    </svg>
                    Continue with Google
                  </Button>
                </>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/components/content/course-detail-view.tsx ---
'use client';

import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from '@/components/ui/accordion';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { PlayCircle, FileText, Link as LinkIcon, HelpCircle, Loader2, AlertCircle, FileDigit } from 'lucide-react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import type { AssignedCourseDetailData } from '@/lib/services/assigned-courses';

function formatDuration(seconds: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (!seconds) return '--:--';
  const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
  const s = seconds % 60;
  
  if (h > 0) {
    return `${h}:${m.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
  return `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function getItemIcon(itemType: string) {
  switch (itemType) {
    case 'video':
      return <PlayCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-500" />;
    case 'document':
    case 'note':
    case 'resource':
      return <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-500" />;
    case 'link':
      return <LinkIcon className="h-4 w-4 text-purple-500" />;
    case 'quiz_placeholder':
      return <HelpCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-500" />;
    case 'assignment_placeholder':
      return <FileDigit className="h-4 w-4 text-rose-500" />;
    default:
      return <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-500" />;
  }
}

export function CourseDetailView({ data }: { data: AssignedCourseDetailData }) {
  const { modules, items, videos } = data;

  if (modules.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="text-center py-12 text-muted-foreground border rounded-lg bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-900/50">
        <p>No modules available for this course yet.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Accordion type="multiple" className="space-y-4" defaultValue={[modules[0]?.id]}>
      {modules.map((module, mIndex) => {
        const moduleItems = items.filter((i) => i.module_id === module.id);
        
        return (
          <AccordionItem key={module.id} value={module.id} className="border rounded-lg bg-card overflow-hidden">
            <AccordionTrigger className="px-4 py-3 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50 transition-colors">
              <div className="flex flex-col items-start text-left gap-1">
                <div className="font-semibold text-base">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground font-mono text-xs mr-2 border px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-background">
                    M{mIndex + 1}
                  </span>
                  {module.title}
                </div>
                {module.description && (
                  <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-1 font-normal">
                    {module.description}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </AccordionTrigger>
            
            <AccordionContent className="pt-0 pb-0">
              <div className="border-t divide-y bg-slate-50/30 dark:bg-slate-900/20">
                {moduleItems.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground italic">
                    No lessons in this module.
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  moduleItems.map((item, iIndex) => {
                    const video = item.video_asset_id ? videos[item.video_asset_id] : null;
                    
                    return (
                      <div key={item.id} className="flex items-start gap-4 px-6 py-3 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors">
                        <div className="mt-1 shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center w-6 text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono">
                          {iIndex + 1}.
                        </div>
                        
                        <div className="mt-1 shrink-0">
                          {getItemIcon(item.item_type)}
                        </div>
                        
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                            <div>
                              <p className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground line-clamp-1" title={item.title}>
                                {item.title}
                              </p>
                              {item.description && (
                                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-1 mt-0.5" title={item.description}>
                                  {item.description}
                                </p>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            
                            <div className="shrink-0 flex items-center gap-2">
                              {item.is_preview && (
                                <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] text-amber-600 border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 dark:border-amber-900">
                                  Preview
                                </Badge>
                              )}
                              
                              <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] capitalize">
                                {item.item_type.replace('_', ' ')}
                              </Badge>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          
                          {/* Video Asset Metadata (if video type) */}
                          {item.item_type === 'video' && video && (
                            <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-3 text-xs">
                               {video.thumbnail_url && (
                                 <div className="h-8 w-14 shrink-0 rounded overflow-hidden bg-black/10">
                                   <Image
                                     src={video.thumbnail_url}
                                     alt="Thumbnail"
                                     width={56}
                                     height={32}
                                     className="object-cover"
                                   />
                                 </div>
                               )}
                              
                              <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                                <span className="font-mono text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                                  <PlayCircle className="h-3 w-3" />
                                  {formatDuration(item.duration_seconds || video.duration_seconds)}
                                </span>
                                
                                {video.processing_status === 'processing' && (
                                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                                    <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" /> Processing
                                  </span>
                                )}
                                {video.processing_status === 'error' && (
                                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
                                    <AlertCircle className="h-3 w-3" /> Error processing video
                                  </span>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          )}
                          
                          {item.item_type === 'video' && !video && item.video_asset_id && (
                            <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-600 flex items-center gap-1">
                              <AlertCircle className="h-3 w-3" /> Video asset not found in database
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </div>
            </AccordionContent>
          </AccordionItem>
        );
      })}
    </Accordion>
  );
}

"use client"

import React from "react"
import { BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid } from "recharts"
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card"
import {
    ChartContainer,
    ChartTooltip,
    ChartTooltipContent,
    type ChartConfig,

﻿"use client"

import React, { useState } from "react"
import {
    useReactTable,
    getCoreRowModel,
    getSortedRowModel,
    getPaginationRowModel,
    getFilteredRowModel,
    flexRender,
    type ColumnDef,
    type SortingState,
} from "@tanstack/react-table"
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table"
import { ArrowUpDown, CheckCircle2, XCircle, ChevronRight, Search } from "lucide-react"
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select"
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@/components/ui/avatar"
// [DEMO DATA] - The following mock implementations need to be swapped for real services.
import type { GitHubStudent } from "@/components/dashboard/types"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const columns: ColumnDef<GitHubStudent>[] = [
    {
        accessorKey: "name",
        header: ({ column }) => (
            <Button variant="ghost" className="px-0 font-bold text-xs uppercase" onClick={() => column.toggleSorting(column.getIsSorted() === "asc")}>
                Student Name
                <ArrowUpDown className="ml-2 h-3 w-3" />
            </Button>
        ),
        cell: ({ row }) => (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <Avatar className="h-8 w-8">
                    <AvatarFallback className="text-xs font-bold">{row.original.avatar}</AvatarFallback>
                </Avatar>
                <span className="font-semibold text-sm">{row.original.name}</span>
            </div>
        ),

    {
        accessorKey: "githubHandle",
        header: "GitHub Linked",

            return (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className={cn(
                        "size-2 rounded-full",
                        status === "linked" ? "bg-green-500" : status === "re-linking" ? "bg-yellow-500" : "bg-red-500"
                    )} />
                    <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{row.original.githubHandle}</span>
                </div>
            )
        },
    },
    {
        accessorKey: "totalRepos",
        meta: { className: "hidden md:table-cell" },
        header: ({ column }) => (
            <Button variant="ghost" className="px-0 font-bold text-xs uppercase" onClick={() => column.toggleSorting(column.getIsSorted() === "asc")}>
                Total Repos
                <ArrowUpDown className="ml-2 h-3 w-3" />
            </Button>
        ),
        cell: ({ row }) => <span className="font-medium">{row.original.totalRepos}</span>,
    },
    {
        accessorKey: "verifiedProjects",
        header: "Verified Projects",
        cell: ({ row }) => {
            const count = parseInt(row.original.verifiedProjects, 10)
            return (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="font-medium">{count}</span>
                    {count < 3 && (
                        <Badge variant="destructive" className="bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-500/20 text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0 border-none">

    {
        id: "actions",

                <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
        ),
    },
]

interface GitHubTableProps {
    data: GitHubStudent[]
}

export function GitHubTable({ data }: GitHubTableProps) {
    const [sorting, setSorting] = useState<SortingState>([])
    const [globalFilter, setGlobalFilter] = useState("")
    const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("all")

    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/incompatible-library
    const table = useReactTable({
        data,
        columns,
        state: { sorting, globalFilter },
        onSortingChange: setSorting,
        onGlobalFilterChange: setGlobalFilter,
        getCoreRowModel: getCoreRowModel(),
        getSortedRowModel: getSortedRowModel(),
        getPaginationRowModel: getPaginationRowModel(),
        getFilteredRowModel: getFilteredRowModel(),
        initialState: { pagination: { pageSize: 10 } },
    })

    return (
        <Card className="overflow-hidden">
            {/* Filters */}
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-border flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <Select value={statusFilter} onValueChange={setStatusFilter}>
                        <SelectTrigger className="bg-secondary border-none text-sm rounded-xl px-4 py-2 w-full sm:w-[160px]">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="All Statuses" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All Statuses</SelectItem>
                            <SelectItem value="meets">Meets KPI</SelectItem>
                            <SelectItem value="below">Below KPI</SelectItem>
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                    <div className="relative">
                        <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                        <Input
                            placeholder="Search students..."
                            value={globalFilter}
                            onChange={(e) => setGlobalFilter(e.target.value)}
                            className="pl-9 w-full sm:w-48 bg-secondary border-none rounded-xl h-9"
                        />
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    Showing <span className="font-bold text-foreground">{table.getFilteredRowModel().rows.length}</span> students
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Table */}
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                    {table.getHeaderGroups().map((headerGroup) => (
                        <TableRow key={headerGroup.id} className="bg-secondary/50">
                            {headerGroup.headers.map((header) => (
                                <TableHead key={header.id} className={cn("px-6 py-4 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider", header.column.columnDef.meta?.className)}>
                                    {header.isPlaceholder ? null : flexRender(header.column.columnDef.header, header.getContext())}
                                </TableHead>
                            ))}
                        </TableRow>
                    ))}
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                    {table.getRowModel().rows.map((row) => (
                        <TableRow key={row.id} className="hover:bg-secondary/30 transition-colors">
                            {row.getVisibleCells().map((cell) => (
                                <TableCell key={cell.id} className={cn("px-6 py-4", cell.column.columnDef.meta?.className)}>
                                    {flexRender(cell.column.columnDef.cell, cell.getContext())}
                                </TableCell>
                            ))}
                        </TableRow>
                    ))}
                </TableBody>
            </Table>
            </div>

            {/* Pagination */}
            <div className="p-4 border-t border-border flex items-center justify-between">
                <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => table.previousPage()} disabled={!table.getCanPreviousPage()}>
                    Previous
                </Button>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    {Array.from({ length: table.getPageCount() }, (_, i) => (
                        <Button
                            key={i}
                            variant={table.getState().pagination.pageIndex === i ? "default" : "ghost"}
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8 w-8 p-0"
                            onClick={() => table.setPageIndex(i)}
                        >
                            {i + 1}
                        </Button>
                    ))}
                </div>
                <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => table.nextPage()} disabled={!table.getCanNextPage()}>
                    Next
                </Button>
            </div>
        </Card>
    )
}

export default GitHubTable

"use client";

} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";

import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { pageMeta, getPageIdFromPath } from "@/data/page-meta";
import { SidebarTrigger } from "@/components/ui/sidebar";

export function Header() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme();
  const pageId = getPageIdFromPath(pathname);
  const meta = pageMeta[pageId] ?? { title: 'College Admin', subtitle: '' };

  async function handleLogout() {
    await logout("/admin/login");
  }


  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 flex h-16 items-center justify-between border-b border-border/40 bg-background/70 backdrop-blur-2xl supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-background/40 px-4 lg:px-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 sm:gap-6 min-w-0">
        <SidebarTrigger className="-ml-1 shrink-0 h-8 w-8 rounded-lg border border-border/30 glass-card hover:bg-primary/10 transition-all duration-300" />

        {/* Page title — header shows page context; pages render <h1> in content */}
        <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0">
          <span className="text-sm sm:text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground leading-none truncate">
            {meta.title}
          </span>
          {meta.subtitle && (
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate font-medium mt-0.5">
              {meta.subtitle}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Search — visual placeholder; command palette not yet implemented */}
      <div className="flex-1 max-w-lg mx-4 lg:mx-8 relative hidden md:block">
        <Search className="absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground/40" />
        <Input
          placeholder="Search students, courses, reports..."
          className="pl-11 pr-10 w-full bg-muted/20 border-border/30 rounded-full h-9 text-sm focus:bg-background focus:border-primary/30 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/10 transition-all duration-300"
        />
        <div className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 hidden lg:flex items-center gap-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground/40 font-medium bg-muted/40 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-border/30">
          <Command className="h-3 w-3" />
          <span>K</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 glass-card rounded-2xl p-1">
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon"
            className="h-8 w-8 rounded-xl text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-primary/10 transition-all duration-300"
            onClick={() => setTheme(theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark")}
          >
            <Sun className="h-4 w-4 rotate-0 scale-100 transition-all dark:-rotate-90 dark:scale-0" />

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/components/dashboard/kpi-card.tsx ---
"use client"

import React from "react"
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import {
    Users,
    Zap,
    Timer,
    ClipboardCheck,
    TrendingUp,
    TrendingDown,
    Clock,
    Code,
    ShieldCheck,
    Briefcase,
} from "lucide-react"

const iconMap: Record<string, React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>> = {
    Users,
    Zap,
    Timer,
    ClipboardCheck,
    Clock,
    Code,
    ShieldCheck,
    Briefcase,
}

const colorMap: Record<string, { bg: string; text: string; bar: string }> = {
    blue: { bg: "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/30", text: "text-blue-600", bar: "bg-blue-500" },
    orange: { bg: "bg-orange-50 dark:bg-orange-900/30", text: "text-primary", bar: "bg-primary" },
    purple: { bg: "bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-900/30", text: "text-purple-600", bar: "bg-purple-500" },
    emerald: { bg: "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-900/30", text: "text-emerald-600", bar: "bg-emerald-500" },
}

interface KpiCardProps {
    title: string
    value: string
    trend: string
    trendDirection: "up" | "down"
    progress: number
    target: string
    icon: string
    color: string
}

export function KpiCard({ title, value, trend, trendDirection, progress, target, icon, color }: KpiCardProps) {
    const Icon = iconMap[icon] || Users
    const colors = colorMap[color] || colorMap.blue

    return (
        <Card className="p-6 transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-md border-border/50 bg-card/50 backdrop-blur-sm">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-4">
                <div className={cn("p-2 rounded-lg", colors.bg, colors.text)}>
                    <Icon className="h-5 w-5" />
                </div>
                <span
                    className={cn(
                        "text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1",
                        trendDirection === "up" ? "text-emerald-500" : "text-rose-500"
                    )}
                >
                    {trendDirection === "up" ? (
                        <TrendingUp className="h-3 w-3" />
                    ) : (
                        <TrendingDown className="h-3 w-3" />
                    )}
                    {trend}
                </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm font-medium">{title}</p>
            <h3 className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground mt-1">{value}</h3>
            <div className="mt-4 h-1.5 w-full bg-secondary rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                <div className={cn("h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-1000", colors.bar)} style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} />
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] mt-2 text-muted-foreground uppercase font-bold">{target}</p>
        </Card>
    )
}

export default KpiCard

            const status = row.original.status
            return (
                <Badge variant={status === "complete" ? "success" : "warning"} className="gap-1.5 w-24 justify-center">
                    <span className={cn("size-1.5 rounded-full", status === "complete" ? "bg-green-500" : "bg-yellow-500")} />
                    {status === "complete" ? "Complete" : "Incomplete"}
                </Badge>
            )
        },
        filterFn: (row, id, value) => value === "all" || row.getValue(id) === value,
    },
]

interface LinkedInTableProps {
    data: LinkedInStudent[]
}

export function LinkedInTable({ data }: LinkedInTableProps) {
    const [sorting, setSorting] = useState<SortingState>([])
    const [globalFilter, setGlobalFilter] = useState("")
    const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("all")

    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/incompatible-library -- TanStack Table returns unstable refs; skip memoization
    const table = useReactTable({
        data,
        columns,
        state: { sorting, globalFilter },
        onSortingChange: setSorting,
        onGlobalFilterChange: setGlobalFilter,
        getCoreRowModel: getCoreRowModel(),
        getSortedRowModel: getSortedRowModel(),
        getPaginationRowModel: getPaginationRowModel(),
        getFilteredRowModel: getFilteredRowModel(),
        initialState: { pagination: { pageSize: 10 } },
    })

    return (
        <Card className="overflow-hidden">
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-border flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <Select
                        value={statusFilter}
                        onValueChange={(value) => {
                            setStatusFilter(value)
                            table.getColumn("status")?.setFilterValue(value)
                        }}
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger className="bg-secondary border-none text-sm rounded-xl px-4 py-2 w-full sm:w-[180px]">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="All Students" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All Students</SelectItem>
                            <SelectItem value="complete">Complete Profiles</SelectItem>
                            <SelectItem value="incomplete">Incomplete Profiles</SelectItem>
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                    <div className="relative">
                        <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                        <Input
                            placeholder="Search by name..."
                            value={globalFilter}
                            onChange={(e) => setGlobalFilter(e.target.value)}
                            className="pl-9 w-full sm:w-48 bg-secondary border-none rounded-xl h-9"
                        />
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    Needs Action: <span className="font-bold text-yellow-600">{data.filter(d => d.status === "incomplete").length}</span> students
                </div>
            </div>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                    {table.getHeaderGroups().map((headerGroup) => (
                        <TableRow key={headerGroup.id} className="bg-secondary/50">
                            {headerGroup.headers.map((header) => (
                                <TableHead key={header.id} className={cn("px-6 py-4 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider", header.id !== "name" && header.id !== "status" && "text-center", header.column.columnDef.meta?.className)}>
                                    {header.isPlaceholder ? null : flexRender(header.column.columnDef.header, header.getContext())}
                                </TableHead>
                            ))}
                        </TableRow>
                    ))}
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                    {table.getRowModel().rows.map((row) => (
                        <TableRow key={row.id} className="hover:bg-secondary/30 transition-colors">
                            {row.getVisibleCells().map((cell) => (
                                <TableCell key={cell.id} className={cn("px-6 py-4 border-b border-border/40", cell.column.columnDef.meta?.className)}>
                                    {flexRender(cell.column.columnDef.cell, cell.getContext())}
                                </TableCell>
                            ))}
                        </TableRow>
                    ))}
                </TableBody>
            </Table>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
                <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => table.previousPage()} disabled={!table.getCanPreviousPage()}>
                    Previous
                </Button>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    {Array.from({ length: table.getPageCount() }, (_, i) => (
                        <Button
                            key={i}
                            variant={table.getState().pagination.pageIndex === i ? "default" : "ghost"}
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8 w-8 p-0"
                            onClick={() => table.setPageIndex(i)}
                        >
                            {i + 1}
                        </Button>
                    ))}
                </div>
                <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => table.nextPage()} disabled={!table.getCanNextPage()}>
                    Next
                </Button>
            </div>
        </Card>
    )
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/components/dashboard/locked-module-appeal-modal.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { submitModuleAccessAppeal } from '@/lib/actions/module-appeal';
import type { ModuleId } from '@/lib/modules/module-registry';
import type { ModuleDefinition } from '@/lib/modules/module-registry';

export interface LockedModuleAppealModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  module: ModuleDefinition<ModuleId>;
  collegeId: string;
}

export function LockedModuleAppealModal({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  module,
  collegeId,
}: LockedModuleAppealModalProps) {
  const [subject, setSubject] = useState('');
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await submitModuleAccessAppeal(collegeId, module.id, subject.trim(), message.trim());
      if (result.ok) {
        setSuccess(true);
        setSubject('');
        setMessage('');
        setTimeout(() => {
          onOpenChange(false);
          setSuccess(false);
        }, 1500);
      } else {
        setError(result.error ?? 'Submission failed');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleOpenChange = (next: boolean) => {
    if (!next && !loading) {
      setError(null);
      setSuccess(false);
      setSubject('');
      setMessage('');
    }
    onOpenChange(next);
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Request access: {module.label}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            {module.lockedCopy?.message ?? 'This module is not available for your plan. You can request access and a Super Admin will review your appeal.'}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        {success ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-green-600 dark:text-green-400">Request submitted. We will review it shortly.</p>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            {error && (
              <p className="text-sm text-destructive" role="alert">
                {error}
              </p>
            )}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="appeal-subject">Subject</Label>
              <Input
                id="appeal-subject"
                value={subject}
                onChange={(e) => setSubject(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Short reason for request"
                required
                minLength={3}
                maxLength={200}
                disabled={loading}
                className="w-full"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="appeal-message">Message</Label>
              <Textarea
                id="appeal-message"
                value={message}
                onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Describe why you need access to this module..."
                required
                minLength={10}
                maxLength={2000}
                rows={4}
                disabled={loading}
                className="w-full resize-none"
              />
            </div>
            <DialogFooter>
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => handleOpenChange(false)} disabled={loading}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={loading}>
                {loading ? 'Submitting…' : 'Submit request'}
              </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </form>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

} from "@/lib/modules/module-access";

  getModuleRegistry,

} from "@/lib/modules/module-registry";
import { useTenant } from "@/providers/tenant-provider";

// Navigation structure matching approved design

const navGroups = [
  {
    title: "Overview",
    items: [
      { moduleId: "dashboard" as ModuleId, label: "Dashboard", icon: LayoutDashboard },
      { moduleId: "analytics" as ModuleId, label: "Analytics", icon: PieChart },
      { moduleId: "kpi_dashboard" as ModuleId, label: "KPI Dashboard", icon: BarChart3 },
      { moduleId: "program_overview" as ModuleId, label: "Program Overview", icon: LayoutList },

  {
    title: "Content",

      { moduleId: "mentorship_tracking" as ModuleId, label: "Mentorship", icon: Users },
    ],
  },
  {
    title: "Reports",
    items: [
      { moduleId: "reports" as ModuleId, label: "Reports", icon: FileBarChart },

      { moduleId: "admin_settings" as ModuleId, label: "Admin Settings", icon: Settings },
    ],
  },
