--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/lib/services/assigned-courses.ts ---
import { unstable_noStore as noStore } from 'next/cache';
import 'server-only';

import { createAdminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import type {
  MasterCourseItemsRow,
  MasterCourseModulesRow,
  MasterCoursePillarsRow,
  MasterCoursesRow,
  VideoAssetsRow,
} from '@/types/database';

export interface AssignedCourseListItem extends MasterCoursesRow {
  module_count: number;
  video_count: number;
  assignment_status: string;
}

export interface AssignedPillarGroup {
  pillar: MasterCoursePillarsRow;
  courses: AssignedCourseListItem[];
}

export interface AssignedCourseDetailData {
  course: MasterCoursesRow;
  pillar: MasterCoursePillarsRow;
  modules: MasterCourseModulesRow[];
  items: MasterCourseItemsRow[];
  videos: Record<string, VideoAssetsRow>;
}

async function getCourseStats(
  courseIds: string[],
): Promise<Map<string, { module_count: number; video_count: number }>> {
  const stats = new Map<string, { module_count: number; video_count: number }>();
  if (courseIds.length === 0) {
    return stats;
  }

  const sb = createAdminClient();
  const [{ data: modules }, { data: videos }] = await Promise.all([
    sb.from('master_course_modules').select('id, master_course_id').in('master_course_id', courseIds).eq('publish_status', 'published'),
    sb
      .from('video_assets')
      .select('id, master_course_id, master_course_module_id, sync_status')
      .in('master_course_id', courseIds)
      .eq('sync_status', 'active'),
  ]);

  for (const courseId of courseIds) {
    stats.set(courseId, { module_count: 0, video_count: 0 });
  }

  const validModuleIdsByCourse = new Map<string, Set<string>>();

  for (const moduleRow of modules ?? []) {
    const current = stats.get(moduleRow.master_course_id);
    if (current) {
      current.module_count += 1;
    }

    const ids = validModuleIdsByCourse.get(moduleRow.master_course_id) ?? new Set<string>();
    ids.add(moduleRow.id);
    validModuleIdsByCourse.set(moduleRow.master_course_id, ids);
  }

  for (const videoRow of videos ?? []) {
    const current = stats.get(videoRow.master_course_id);
    if (!current) {
      continue;
    }

    if (!videoRow.master_course_module_id) {
      current.video_count += 1;
      continue;
    }

    const validModuleIds = validModuleIdsByCourse.get(videoRow.master_course_id);
    if (validModuleIds?.has(videoRow.master_course_module_id)) {
      current.video_count += 1;
    }
  }

  return stats;
}

/**
 * List all globally published courses visible to college admins, grouped by pillar.
 */
export async function listAssignedCoursesForCollegeAdmin(
  _collegeId: string,
): Promise<AssignedPillarGroup[]> {
  noStore();
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  // 1. Fetch all published pillars
  const { data: pillars, error: pillarsError } = await sb
    .from('master_course_pillars')
    .select('*')
    .eq('publish_status', 'published')
    .order('sort_order', { ascending: true });

  if (pillarsError || !pillars) {
    return [];
  }

  // 2. Fetch all published courses
  const { data: courses, error: coursesError } = await sb
    .from('master_courses')
    .select('*')
    .eq('publish_status', 'published');

  if (coursesError || !courses) {
    return [];
  }

  // 3. Get stats for all courses
  const statsByCourseId = await getCourseStats(courses.map((c) => c.id));

  // 4. Group courses by pillar
  const pillarsById = new Map(pillars.map((p) => [p.id, p]));
  const groups = new Map<string, AssignedPillarGroup>();

  for (const course of courses) {
    if (!course.pillar_id || !pillarsById.has(course.pillar_id)) {
      continue;
    }

    const pillar = pillarsById.get(course.pillar_id)!;
    const stats = statsByCourseId.get(course.id) ?? { module_count: 0, video_count: 0 };
    
    if (!groups.has(pillar.id)) {
      groups.set(pillar.id, {
        pillar,
        courses: [],
      });
    }

    groups.get(pillar.id)!.courses.push({
      ...course,
      module_count: stats.module_count,
      video_count: stats.video_count,
      assignment_status: 'active',
    });
  }

  return Array.from(groups.values())
    .map((group) => ({
      ...group,
      courses: group.courses.sort((a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title)),
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.pillar.sort_order - b.pillar.sort_order || a.pillar.title.localeCompare(b.pillar.title));
}

/**
 * Get full details for a published course.
 */
export async function getAssignedCourseDetailForCollegeAdmin(
  _collegeId: string,
  courseId: string,
): Promise<AssignedCourseDetailData | null> {
  noStore();
  const sb = createAdminClient();

  const { data: course, error: courseError } = await sb
    .from('master_courses')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', courseId)
    .not('pillar_id', 'is', null)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published')
    .maybeSingle();

  if (courseError || !course || !course.pillar_id) {
    return null;
  }

  const { data: pillar, error: pillarError } = await sb
    .from('master_course_pillars')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', course.pillar_id)
    .eq('publish_status', 'published')
    .maybeSingle();

  if (pillarError || !pillar) {
    return null;
  }

  const [modulesRes, itemsRes] = await Promise.all([
    sb
      .from('master_course_modules')
      .select('*')
      .eq('master_course_id', courseId)
      .eq('publish_status', 'published')
      .order('sort_order', { ascending: true }),
    sb
      .from('master_course_items')
      .select('*')
      .eq('master_course_id', courseId)
      .eq('publish_status', 'published')
      .order('sort_order', { ascending: true }),
  ]);

  if (modulesRes.error || itemsRes.error) {
    return null;
  }

  const modules = modulesRes.data ?? [];
  const items = itemsRes.data ?? [];
  const moduleIds = new Set(modules.map((module) => module.id));

  const videoIds = items
    .filter((item) => item.video_asset_id)
    .map((item) => item.video_asset_id as string);

  const videos: Record<string, VideoAssetsRow> = {};

  if (videoIds.length > 0) {
    const { data: videoData, error: videoError } = await sb
      .from('video_assets')
      .select('*')
      .eq('master_course_id', courseId)
      .in('id', videoIds);

    if (!videoError && videoData) {
      for (const video of videoData) {
        if (
          video.master_course_module_id &&
          !moduleIds.has(video.master_course_module_id)
        ) {
          continue;
        }

        videos[video.id] = video;
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    course,
    pillar,
    modules,
    items,
    videos,
  };
}

import 'server-only';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

export interface AssignedContent {
  id: string;
  assigned_entity_type: 'variant' | 'bundle' | 'master_course';
  assigned_entity_id: string;
  start_date: string | null;
  end_date: string | null;
  status: string;
  created_at: string;
  
  // Expanded details
  entity_title: string;
  entity_code: string;
  publish_status: string;
}

export async function getCollegeAssignedContent(collegeId: string): Promise<AssignedContent[]> {
  const sb = await createClient();
  
  // Read assignments using service role or standard client?
  // We should use standard client. If RLS blocks it, we might need a bypass, 
  // but content_assignments should be readable by college admins if target_id = college_id.
  // Let's assume RLS allows it (it was set up in Phase 5 migration).
  const { data: assignments, error } = await sb
    .from('content_assignments')
    .select('*')
    .eq('assignment_type', 'college')
    .eq('target_id', collegeId)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

  if (error || !assignments) return [];

  const results: AssignedContent[] = [];

  for (const a of assignments) {
    let entity_title = 'Unknown Content';
    let entity_code = 'N/A';
    let publish_status = 'draft';

    if (a.assigned_entity_type === 'master_course') {
      const { data: mc } = await sb
        .from('master_courses')
        .select('title, code, publish_status')
        .eq('id', a.assigned_entity_id)
        .single();
      if (mc) {
        entity_title = mc.title;
        entity_code = mc.code;
        publish_status = mc.publish_status;
      }
    } else if (a.assigned_entity_type === 'variant') {
      const { data: v } = await sb
        .from('course_variants')
        .select('title, code, publish_status')
        .eq('id', a.assigned_entity_id)
        .single();
      if (v) {
        entity_title = v.title;
        entity_code = v.code;
        publish_status = v.publish_status;
      }
    } else if (a.assigned_entity_type === 'bundle') {
      const { data: b } = await sb
        .from('course_bundles')
        .select('title, code, publish_status')
        .eq('id', a.assigned_entity_id)
        .single();
      if (b) {
        entity_title = b.title;
        entity_code = b.code;
        publish_status = b.publish_status;
      }
    }

    results.push({
      id: a.id,
      assigned_entity_type: a.assigned_entity_type as 'variant' | 'bundle' | 'master_course',
      assigned_entity_id: a.assigned_entity_id,
      start_date: a.start_date,
      end_date: a.end_date,
      status: a.status,
      created_at: a.created_at,
      entity_title,
      entity_code,
      publish_status,
    });
  }

  return results;
}

/** Tenant-aware: stats for a single college. RLS restricts to college_admin's college. */
export async function getCollegeDashboardStats(collegeId: string): Promise<DashboardStats> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const [studentsRes, adminsRes] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from('students').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('college_id', collegeId),
    supabase
      .from('college_memberships')
      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('college_id', collegeId)
      .eq('role', 'college_admin')
      .eq('status', 'active'),
  ]);
  return {
    studentsCount: studentsRes.count ?? 0,
    adminsCount: adminsRes.count ?? 0,
  };

/** Tenant-aware: list students for a college with profile names. RLS restricts to college. */
export async function listStudentsForCollege(collegeId: string, limit = 50): Promise<StudentWithProfile[]> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: students, error: studentsError } = await supabase
    .from('students')
    .select('id, user_id, college_id, student_code')
    .eq('college_id', collegeId)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(limit);
  if (studentsError || !students?.length) return [];
  const userIds = [...new Set(students.map((s) => s.user_id))];
  const { data: profiles } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('id, full_name, email').in('id', userIds);
  const profileMap = new Map((profiles ?? []).map((p) => [p.id, p]));
  return students.map((s) => ({
    id: s.id,
    user_id: s.user_id,
    college_id: s.college_id,
    student_code: s.student_code,
    full_name: profileMap.get(s.user_id)?.full_name ?? null,
    email: profileMap.get(s.user_id)?.email ?? null,
  }));
}

/** Tenant-aware: list active admins for a college with profile names. */

  const { data: memberships, error: membershipsError } = await supabase
    .from('college_memberships')
    .select('id, user_id, college_id, role, status')
    .eq('college_id', collegeId)
    .eq('role', 'college_admin')
    .eq('status', 'active')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(limit);

  if (membershipsError || !memberships?.length) return [];

  const userIds = [...new Set(memberships.map((m) => m.user_id))];
  const { data: profiles } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('id, full_name, email').in('id', userIds);
  const profileMap = new Map((profiles ?? []).map((p) => [p.id, p]));

  return memberships.map((m) => ({
    id: m.id,
    user_id: m.user_id,
    college_id: m.college_id,
    role: m.role,
    status: m.status,
    full_name: profileMap.get(m.user_id)?.full_name ?? null,
    email: profileMap.get(m.user_id)?.email ?? null,
  }));
}

/** Resolve current admin's active college and return DB-backed dashboard snapshot. */
export async function getCurrentAdminCollegeSnapshot(
  studentLimit = 12,
  adminLimit = 8
): Promise<CurrentAdminCollegeSnapshot | null> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return null;

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: membership, error: membershipError } = await supabase
    .from('college_memberships')
    .select('college_id')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .in('role', ['college_admin', 'faculty_spoc'])
    .eq('status', 'active')
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (membershipError || !membership?.college_id) return null;

  const [stats, students, admins] = await Promise.all([
    getCollegeDashboardStats(membership.college_id),
    listStudentsForCollege(membership.college_id, studentLimit),
    listAdminsForCollege(membership.college_id, adminLimit),
  ]);

  return {
    collegeId: membership.college_id,
    studentsCount: stats.studentsCount,
    adminsCount: stats.adminsCount,
    students,
    admins,
  };
}

/** Tenant-aware: extended dashboard data for college (KPIs, cohort, course completion, placement, audit, at-risk). */
export async function getCollegeDashboardExtendedData(collegeId: string): Promise<CollegeDashboardExtendedData> {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const [
    kpisRow,
    funnel,
    pendingReviewsCount,
    auditData,
    atRiskData,
    cohortData,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from('mv_college_kpis').select('college_id, total_students, total_cohorts, lecture_completion_rate, total_lectures_completed, attendance_rate, average_assessment_score, assessment_completion_rate, total_assessments_completed, placement_ready_count, placed_count, pending_placement_review_count').eq('college_id', collegeId).maybeSingle(),
    getPlacementReadinessFunnel(collegeId),
    getPlacementPendingReviewsCount(collegeId),
    supabase.from('audit_logs').select('id, action, created_at').eq('college_id', collegeId).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(15),
    supabase.from('v_inactive_students_by_course').select('student_id, course_title, days_inactive').eq('college_id', collegeId).limit(20),
    supabase.from('students').select('cohort_id').eq('college_id', collegeId).not('cohort_id', 'is', null),
  ]);

  let notificationsData: { data: unknown[] | null } = { data: [] };
  try {
    const res = await supabase.from('notification_queue').select('id, notification_type, status, created_at').eq('tenant_id', collegeId).in('status', ['pending', 'failed']).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(10);
    notificationsData = res;
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.error('[dashboard] notification_queue failed', { collegeId, error: msg });
    notificationsData = { data: [], _degraded: true } as { data: unknown[] | null; _degraded?: boolean };
  }

  const kpis = kpisRow.data as Record<string, unknown> | null;
  const cohortCounts = new Map<string | null, number>();
  for (const row of cohortData.data ?? []) {
    const cid = (row as { cohort_id: string | null }).cohort_id;
    cohortCounts.set(cid, (cohortCounts.get(cid) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  const cohortPerformance = Array.from(cohortCounts.entries()).map(([cohort_id, student_count]) => ({ cohort_id, student_count }));

  return {
    collegeKpis: kpis
      ? {
          total_students: Number(kpis.total_students) ?? 0,
          total_cohorts: Number(kpis.total_cohorts) ?? 0,
          lecture_completion_rate: Number(kpis.lecture_completion_rate) ?? 0,
          attendance_rate: Number(kpis.attendance_rate) ?? 0,
          average_assessment_score: Number(kpis.average_assessment_score) ?? 0,
          assessment_completion_rate: Number(kpis.assessment_completion_rate) ?? 0,
          placement_ready_count: Number(kpis.placement_ready_count) ?? 0,
          placed_count: Number(kpis.placed_count) ?? 0,
          pending_placement_review_count: Number(kpis.pending_placement_review_count) ?? 0,
        }
      : null,
    cohortPerformance,

    lectureEngagement: kpis
      ? {
          lecture_completion_rate: Number(kpis.lecture_completion_rate) ?? 0,
          total_lectures_completed: Number(kpis.total_lectures_completed) ?? 0,
        }
      : null,
    assessmentAnalytics: kpis
      ? {
          average_score: Number(kpis.average_assessment_score) ?? 0,
          completion_rate: Number(kpis.assessment_completion_rate) ?? 0,
          total_submitted: Number(kpis.total_assessments_completed) ?? 0,
        }
      : null,
    placementFunnel: funnel
      ? {
          not_ready_count: funnel.not_ready_count ?? 0,
          needs_improvement_count: funnel.needs_improvement_count ?? 0,
          interview_ready_count: funnel.interview_ready_count ?? 0,
          placed_count: funnel.placed_count ?? 0,
          total_profiles: funnel.total_profiles ?? 0,
        }
      : null,
    pendingReviewsCount: pendingReviewsCount ?? 0,
    notifications: (notificationsData.data ?? []).map((n) => ({
      id: (n as { id: string }).id,
      notification_type: (n as { notification_type: string }).notification_type,
      status: (n as { status: string }).status,
      created_at: (n as { created_at: string }).created_at,
    })),
    recentActivity: (auditData.data ?? []).map((a) => ({
      id: (a as { id: string }).id,
      action: (a as { action: string }).action,
      created_at: (a as { created_at: string }).created_at,
    })),
    atRiskStudents: (atRiskData.data ?? []).map((r) => ({
      student_id: (r as { student_id: string }).student_id,
      course_title: (r as { course_title: string }).course_title,
      days_inactive: Number((r as { days_inactive: number }).days_inactive) ?? 0,
    })),
  };
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/lib/services/evaluation.ts ---
import 'server-only';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import type { 
  AssessmentResultRow 
} from '@/types/database';

export async function evaluateAttempt(attemptId: string): Promise<AssessmentResultRow | null> {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  // 1. Fetch Attempt and all associated Responses
  const { data: attempt } = await supabase
    .from('assessment_attempts')
    .select('*, assignment:assessment_assignments(assessment_id)')
    .eq('id', attemptId)
    .single();

  if (!attempt) throw new Error("Attempt not found");

  const assessmentId = (attempt.assignment as { assessment_id: string } | null)?.assessment_id;
  if (!assessmentId) throw new Error('Attempt has no assignment');

  const { data: responses } = await supabase
    .from('assessment_responses')
    .select('*')
    .eq('attempt_id', attemptId);

  // 2. Fetch full Assessment Structure to get correct answers and points
  const { data: assessment } = await supabase.from('assessments').select('passing_score').eq('id', assessmentId).single();
  const { data: sections } = await supabase.from('assessment_sections').select('id').eq('assessment_id', assessmentId);
  const { data: questions } = await supabase.from('assessment_questions').select('*').in('section_id', (sections ?? []).map(s => s.id));
  const { data: options } = await supabase.from('assessment_options').select('*').in('question_id', (questions ?? []).map(q => q.id));

  // 3. Compute the score!
  let totalScore = 0;
  let requiresManualEvaluation = false;

  for (const response of responses ?? []) {
    const question = questions?.find(q => q.id === response.question_id);
    if (!question) continue;

    if (question.type === 'single_select' || question.type === 'multi_select') {
      const correctOptionIds = (options ?? [])
        .filter(opt => opt.question_id === question.id && opt.is_correct)
        .map(opt => opt.id);

      const userSelectedOptionIds = response.selected_option_ids ?? [];

      // Check if exact match of arrays (ignoring order)
      const correctSet = new Set(correctOptionIds);
      const userSet = new Set(userSelectedOptionIds);

      const isExactMatch = correctSet.size === userSet.size && [...correctSet].every(val => userSet.has(val));

      if (isExactMatch) {
        // Auto-award points for correctly matched MCQ!
        totalScore += Number(question.points);
      }
    } else {
      // Anything else like subjective, short_answer or coding_ready
      // implies a human mentor must score it.
      requiresManualEvaluation = true;
    }
  }

  // 4. Create or update the Assessment Result row
  const passingScore = assessment?.passing_score ?? 0;
  const isPassing = !requiresManualEvaluation ? (totalScore >= passingScore) : null;
  const newStatus = requiresManualEvaluation ? 'pending_manual_eval' : 'evaluated';

  const { data: result, error } = await supabase
    .from('assessment_results')
    .upsert({
      attempt_id: attemptId,
      score: totalScore,
      is_passing: isPassing,
      status: newStatus
    }, { onConflict: 'attempt_id' })
    .select()
    .single();

  if (error) return null;
  return result as AssessmentResultRow;
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/lib/services/placements.ts ---
import 'server-only';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { logSecurityEvent } from '@/lib/security/audit';

export type PlacementStatus = 'not_ready' | 'needs_improvement' | 'interview_ready' | 'placed';

export interface PlacementProfileRow {
  id: string;
  student_id: string;
  college_id: string;
  status: PlacementStatus;
  skills_json: unknown;
  projects_json: unknown;
  linkedin_url: string | null;
  github_url: string | null;
  notes: string | null;
  updated_at: string;
  created_at: string;
}

export interface PlacementReadinessFunnelRow {
  college_id: string;
  not_ready_count: number;
  needs_improvement_count: number;
  interview_ready_count: number;
  placed_count: number;
  total_profiles: number;
}

/** List placement profiles for a college (admin view). */
export async function listPlacementProfiles(collegeId: string): Promise<PlacementProfileRow[]> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('placement_profiles')
    .select('id, student_id, college_id, status, skills_json, projects_json, linkedin_url, github_url, notes, updated_at, created_at')
    .eq('college_id', collegeId)
    .order('updated_at', { ascending: false });
  if (error) return [];
  return (data ?? []) as PlacementProfileRow[];
}

/** List placement profiles with student names for dashboard. */
export async function listPlacementProfilesWithStudents(collegeId: string) {
  const profiles = await listPlacementProfiles(collegeId);
  if (!profiles.length) return [];
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const studentIds = [...new Set(profiles.map((p) => p.student_id))];
  const { data: students } = await supabase.from('students').select('id, user_id').in('id', studentIds);
  const userIds = [...new Set((students ?? []).map((s) => s.user_id))];
  const { data: userProfiles } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('id, full_name, email').in('id', userIds);
  const userMap = new Map((userProfiles ?? []).map((u) => [u.id, u]));
  const studentMap = new Map((students ?? []).map((s) => [s.id, s]));
  return profiles.map((p) => {
    const s = studentMap.get(p.student_id);
    const u = s ? userMap.get(s.user_id) : null;
    return { ...p, studentName: u?.full_name ?? null, studentEmail: u?.email ?? null };
  });
}

/** Get placement profile by id with student info. */
export async function getPlacementProfile(profileId: string) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: profile, error: e1 } = await supabase
    .from('placement_profiles')
    .select('id, student_id, college_id, status, skills_json, projects_json, linkedin_url, github_url, notes, updated_at, created_at')
    .eq('id', profileId)
    .single();
  if (e1 || !profile) return null;
  const { data: student } = await supabase
    .from('students')
    .select('id, user_id')
    .eq('id', profile.student_id)
    .single();
  const userIds = student ? [student.user_id] : [];
  const { data: profiles } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('id, full_name, email').in('id', userIds);
  const user = profiles?.[0];
  return { ...profile, student: student ? { ...student, full_name: user?.full_name, email: user?.email } : null };
}

/** Get full placement profile details for admin: profile, student, resumes, reviews, mocks, applications, offers, documents, history. */
export async function getPlacementProfileDetails(profileId: string) {
  const profileData = await getPlacementProfile(profileId);
  if (!profileData) return null;
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const [resumeRes, linkedinRes, githubRes, readinessRes, mockRes, appsRes, offersRes, docsRes, historyRes] =
    await Promise.all([
      supabase.from('resume_versions').select('id, placement_profile_id, version_number, file_url, file_name, status, feedback, reviewed_at, reviewer_id, created_at').eq('placement_profile_id', profileId).order('created_at', { ascending: false }),
      supabase.from('linkedin_reviews').select('student_id, college_id, status, feedback, reviewed_at, reviewer_id').eq('student_id', profileData.student_id).eq('college_id', profileData.college_id).maybeSingle(),
      supabase.from('github_reviews').select('student_id, college_id, status, feedback, reviewed_at, reviewer_id').eq('student_id', profileData.student_id).eq('college_id', profileData.college_id).maybeSingle(),
      supabase.from('placement_readiness_reviews').select('id, placement_profile_id, reviewer_id, college_id, overall_status, feedback, reviewed_at').eq('placement_profile_id', profileId).order('reviewed_at', { ascending: false }),
      supabase.from('mock_interviews').select('id, student_id, college_id, scheduled_at, conducted_at, interview_type, outcome, status, feedback, interviewer_id').eq('student_id', profileData.student_id).eq('college_id', profileData.college_id).order('scheduled_at', { ascending: false }),
      supabase.from('student_applications').select('id, student_id, college_id, company_name, role, role_title, status, applied_at, source, notes, updated_at').eq('student_id', profileData.student_id).eq('college_id', profileData.college_id).order('updated_at', { ascending: false }),
      supabase.from('offers').select('id, student_id, college_id, application_id, company_name, role, amount, status, created_at').eq('student_id', profileData.student_id).eq('college_id', profileData.college_id).order('created_at', { ascending: false }),
      supabase.from('placement_documents').select('id, student_id, college_id, document_type, file_url, file_name, created_at').eq('student_id', profileData.student_id).eq('college_id', profileData.college_id).order('created_at', { ascending: false }),
      supabase.from('placement_status_history').select('id, placement_profile_id, from_status, to_status, changed_by, notes, changed_at').eq('placement_profile_id', profileId).order('changed_at', { ascending: false }),
    ]);
  const applicationIds = (appsRes.data ?? []).map((a: { id: string }) => a.id);
  type RoundRow = { application_id: string; round_number: number; round_type: string | null; outcome: string | null; scheduled_at: string | null };
  let rounds: { application_id: string; rounds: RoundRow[] }[] = [];
  if (applicationIds.length > 0) {
    const { data: roundsData } = await supabase.from('interview_rounds').select('id, application_id, round_number, round_type, outcome, scheduled_at, notes').in('application_id', applicationIds).order('round_number');
    const byApp = new Map<string, RoundRow[]>();
    for (const r of roundsData ?? []) {
      const row = r as RoundRow;
      const appId = row.application_id;
      if (!byApp.has(appId)) byApp.set(appId, []);
      byApp.get(appId)!.push(row);
    }
    rounds = applicationIds.map((id) => ({ application_id: id, rounds: byApp.get(id) ?? [] }));
  }
  return {
    profile: profileData,
    resumeVersions: resumeRes.data ?? [],
    linkedinReview: linkedinRes.data ?? null,
    githubReview: githubRes.data ?? null,
    readinessReviews: readinessRes.data ?? [],
    mockInterviews: mockRes.data ?? [],
    applications: appsRes.data ?? [],
    interviewRoundsByApplication: rounds,
    offers: offersRes.data ?? [],
    documents: docsRes.data ?? [],
    statusHistory: historyRes.data ?? [],
  };
}

/** Update placement profile status and record history. */
export async function updatePlacementStatus(
  profileId: string,
  toStatus: PlacementStatus,
  notes?: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: profile } = await supabase.from('placement_profiles').select('id, status, college_id').eq('id', profileId).single();
  if (!profile) return false;
  const fromStatus = profile.status as string | null;
  const { error: updateErr } = await supabase
    .from('placement_profiles')
    .update({ status: toStatus, notes: notes ?? undefined })
    .eq('id', profileId);
  if (updateErr) return false;
  const uid = (await supabase.auth.getUser()).data.user?.id ?? null;
  await supabase.from('placement_status_history').insert({
    placement_profile_id: profileId,
    from_status: fromStatus,
    to_status: toStatus,
    changed_by: uid,
    notes: notes ?? null,
  });
  if (profile.college_id) {
    await logSecurityEvent({
      action: 'placement_status_updated',
      resourceType: 'placement_profile',
      resourceId: profileId,
      collegeId: profile.college_id,
      payload: { from_status: fromStatus, to_status: toStatus, notes: notes ?? null },
    });
  }
  return true;
}

/** Get pending reviews count (resume, linkedin, github). */
export async function getPlacementPendingReviewsCount(collegeId: string): Promise<number> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data } = await supabase
    .from('v_placement_pending_reviews')
    .select('pending_resume, pending_linkedin, pending_github')
    .eq('college_id', collegeId);
  let count = 0;
  for (const row of data ?? []) {
    const r = row as { pending_resume?: number; pending_linkedin?: number; pending_github?: number };
    count += (r.pending_resume ?? 0) + (r.pending_linkedin ?? 0) + (r.pending_github ?? 0);
  }
  return count;
}

/** Create or update LinkedIn review. */
export async function upsertLinkedinReview(
  studentId: string,
  collegeId: string,
  input: { status: 'pending' | 'approved' | 'needs_improvement'; feedback?: string }
): Promise<boolean> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const uid = (await supabase.auth.getUser()).data.user?.id ?? null;
  const { error } = await supabase.from('linkedin_reviews').upsert(
    {
      student_id: studentId,
      college_id: collegeId,
      status: input.status,
      feedback: input.feedback ?? null,
      reviewed_at: input.status !== 'pending' ? new Date().toISOString() : null,
      reviewer_id: input.status !== 'pending' ? uid : null,
    },
    { onConflict: 'student_id,college_id' }
  );
  if (error) return false;
  if (input.status !== 'pending') {
    await logSecurityEvent({
      action: 'placement_linkedin_reviewed',
      resourceType: 'linkedin_review',
      resourceId: studentId,
      collegeId,
      payload: { status: input.status },
    });
  }
  return true;
}

/** Review a resume version. */
export async function reviewResumeVersion(
  versionId: string,
  input: { status: 'approved' | 'rejected'; feedback?: string }
): Promise<boolean> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const uid = (await supabase.auth.getUser()).data.user?.id ?? null;
  const { data: version } = await supabase.from('resume_versions').select('placement_profile_id').eq('id', versionId).single();
  if (!version) return false;
  const { data: profile } = await supabase.from('placement_profiles').select('college_id').eq('id', version.placement_profile_id).single();
  const collegeId = profile?.college_id ?? null;
  const { error } = await supabase
    .from('resume_versions')
    .update({
      status: input.status,
      feedback: input.feedback ?? null,
      reviewed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      reviewer_id: uid,
    })
    .eq('id', versionId);
  if (error) return false;
  if (collegeId) {
    await logSecurityEvent({
      action: 'placement_resume_reviewed',
      resourceType: 'resume_version',
      resourceId: versionId,
      collegeId,
      payload: { status: input.status, placement_profile_id: version.placement_profile_id },
    });
  }
  return true;
}

/** Record placement readiness review (and update profile status). */
export async function createPlacementReadinessReview(
  profileId: string,
  collegeId: string,
  input: { overall_status: PlacementStatus; feedback?: string }
): Promise<boolean> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const uid = (await supabase.auth.getUser()).data.user?.id;
  if (!uid) return false;
  const { error: insertErr } = await supabase.from('placement_readiness_reviews').insert({
    placement_profile_id: profileId,
    reviewer_id: uid,
    college_id: collegeId,
    overall_status: input.overall_status,
    feedback: input.feedback ?? null,
  });
  if (insertErr) return false;
  const ok = await updatePlacementStatus(profileId, input.overall_status, input.feedback ?? undefined);
  if (ok && collegeId) {
    await logSecurityEvent({
      action: 'placement_readiness_review_added',
      resourceType: 'placement_readiness_review',
      resourceId: profileId,
      collegeId,
      payload: { overall_status: input.overall_status },
    });
  }
  return ok;
}

const PLACEMENT_BUCKET = 'placement-docs';
const ALLOWED_TYPES = ['application/pdf', 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'];

/** Upload a file to placement-docs storage. Path: college_id/student_id/type/uuid.ext. Returns path or null. */
export async function uploadPlacementFile(
  collegeId: string,
  studentId: string,
  type: 'resume' | 'offer_letter' | 'placement_proof' | 'other',
  file: File
): Promise<string | null> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const ext = file.name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() || 'bin';
  const path = `${collegeId}/${studentId}/${type}/${crypto.randomUUID()}.${ext}`;
  const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();
  const { error } = await supabase.storage
    .from(PLACEMENT_BUCKET)
    .upload(path, buf, { contentType: ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type) ? file.type : 'application/octet-stream', upsert: false });
  if (error) return null;
  return path;
}

/** Create a signed URL for a placement doc path (for private bucket). */
export async function getPlacementDocSignedUrl(path: string, expiresIn = 3600): Promise<string | null> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.storage.from(PLACEMENT_BUCKET).createSignedUrl(path, expiresIn);
  if (error || !data?.signedUrl) return null;
  return data.signedUrl;
}

/** Create a new resume version (admin or after upload). */
export async function createResumeVersion(profileId: string, fileUrl: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: versions } = await supabase
    .from('resume_versions')
    .select('version_number')
    .eq('placement_profile_id', profileId)
    .order('version_number', { ascending: false })
    .limit(1);
  const nextVersion = (versions?.[0]?.version_number ?? 0) + 1;
  const { error } = await supabase.from('resume_versions').insert({
    placement_profile_id: profileId,
    file_url: fileUrl,
    version_number: nextVersion,
    status: 'pending',
  });
  return !error;
}

export async function createPlacementDocument(

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/lib/services/students.ts ---
import 'server-only';
import { createAdminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

export interface CreateStudentInput {
  college_id: string;
  email: string;
  full_name: string;
  password?: string | null;
  student_code?: string | null;
}

const ALREADY_REGISTERED_PATTERNS = [
  'already been registered',
  'already registered',
  'user already exists',
  'already exists',
];

function isAlreadyRegisteredError(message: string): boolean {
  const lower = message.toLowerCase();
  return ALREADY_REGISTERED_PATTERNS.some((p) => lower.includes(p));
}

function getLmsBaseUrl(): string {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_LMS_APP_URL ?? process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_LMS_BASE_URL ?? '';
  return url ? url.replace(/\/+$/, '') : '';
}

async function resolveExistingUserId(
  admin: ReturnType<typeof createAdminClient>,
  email: string
): Promise<string | null> {
  const { data: profile } = await admin.from('profiles').select('id').eq('email', email).maybeSingle();
  if (profile?.id) return profile.id;
  // Fallback: search auth users by email (paginated, not loading 1000 users)
  const { data: usersData } = await admin.auth.admin.listUsers({ page: 1, perPage: 10 });
  const existing = usersData?.users?.find((u) => u.email?.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());
  return existing?.id ?? null;
}

/**
 * Create a student login with email + password (College Admin flow).
 * Creates auth user, profile, college_memberships (active), and students row.
 */
export async function createStudentWithPassword(input: CreateStudentInput): Promise<{ user_id: string }> {
  const admin = createAdminClient();
  const email = input.email.trim().toLowerCase();
  const password = input.password?.trim() || null;

  const { data: college, error: collegeError } = await admin
    .from('colleges')
    .select('slug')
    .eq('id', input.college_id)
    .single();
  if (collegeError) throw new Error(collegeError.message);
  if (!college?.slug) throw new Error('College not found.');

  let userId: string | null = null;
  const membershipStatus: 'active' | 'invited' = password ? 'active' : 'invited';

  if (password) {
    if (password.length < 8) throw new Error('Password must be at least 8 characters.');
    const { data: userData, error: authError } = await admin.auth.admin.createUser({
      email,
      password,
      email_confirm: true,
      user_metadata: { full_name: input.full_name.trim(), college_id: input.college_id },
    });
    if (authError) {
      if (isAlreadyRegisteredError(authError.message)) {
        throw new Error('A user with this email already exists.');
      }
      throw new Error(authError.message);
    }
    if (!userData.user) throw new Error('Create user failed.');
    userId = userData.user.id;

    const { error: confirmError } = await admin.auth.admin.updateUserById(userId, { email_confirm: true });
    if (confirmError) throw new Error(confirmError.message);
  } else {
    const baseUrl = getLmsBaseUrl();
    if (!baseUrl) {
      throw new Error('Missing NEXT_PUBLIC_LMS_APP_URL (or NEXT_PUBLIC_LMS_BASE_URL) env.');
    }
    const redirectTo = `${baseUrl}/auth/set-password`;
    const { data: inviteData, error: inviteError } = await admin.auth.admin.inviteUserByEmail(email, {
      redirectTo,
      data: { full_name: input.full_name.trim(), college_id: input.college_id },
    });
    if (inviteError) {
      if (!isAlreadyRegisteredError(inviteError.message)) {
        throw new Error(inviteError.message);
      }
      const existingId = await resolveExistingUserId(admin, email);
      if (!existingId) {
        throw new Error('A user with this email already exists but could not be linked. Ask student to sign in once and retry.');
      }
      userId = existingId;
    } else {
      userId = inviteData?.user?.id ?? null;
    }
    if (!userId) throw new Error('Invite did not return a user.');
  }

  await admin.from('profiles').upsert(
    {
      id: userId,
      full_name: input.full_name.trim(),
      email,
      is_active: true,
    },
    { onConflict: 'id' }
  );

  const { error: memError } = await admin.from('college_memberships').insert({
    user_id: userId,
    college_id: input.college_id,
    role: 'student',
    status: membershipStatus,
  });
  if (memError) {
    if (memError.code === '23505') {
      throw new Error('This student is already added to this college.');
    }
    throw new Error(memError.message);
  }

  const { error: studentError } = await admin.from('students').insert({
    user_id: userId,
    college_id: input.college_id,
    student_code: input.student_code?.trim() || null,
  });
  if (studentError) {
    if (studentError.code === '23505') {
      throw new Error('This student is already added to this college.');
    }
    throw new Error(studentError.message);
  }

  return { user_id: userId };
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/lib/supabase/admin.ts ---
/**
 * Service-role Supabase client — bypasses all RLS policies.
 *
 * USE ONLY for:
 *   - Student creation/invite (requires admin.auth.admin API access)
 *   - Global course listing fallback (when RPC is unavailable)
 *
 * NEVER use for:
 *   - Tenant-scoped queries where RLS should enforce isolation
 *   - Client-side code (server-only import guard prevents this)
 *
 * CALLER RESPONSIBILITY: Every consumer must enforce auth + tenant scoping.
 */
import 'server-only';
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

/** Server-only Supabase client with service role for admin operations (e.g. inviteUserByEmail). */
export function createAdminClient() {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  const serviceRoleKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
  if (!url || !serviceRoleKey) {
    throw new Error(
      'Missing Supabase admin env: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY'
    );
  }
  return createClient(url, serviceRoleKey, {
    auth: {
      autoRefreshToken: false,
      persistSession: false,
    },
  });
}

import { createBrowserClient } from '@supabase/ssr';
import { PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS, resolveSupabaseKey, resolveSupabaseUrl } from './cookie-options';

/**
 * Browser Supabase client. Session stored only in httpOnly cookies (YouTube-style persistent session).
 */
export function createClient() {
  const url = resolveSupabaseUrl();
  const key = resolveSupabaseKey();
  return createBrowserClient(url, key, {
    cookieOptions: PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS,
  });
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/lib/supabase/cookie-options.ts ---
/**
 * Shared cookie options for Supabase auth across browser, server, and middleware.
 * Use a unique storage key (name) so CollegeAdmin does not share cookies with LMS/SuperAdmin on the same domain.
 *
 * maxAge = 7 days. Matches Supabase's default refresh token lifetime.
 * Active users get indefinite sessions via automatic token refresh in middleware.
 * Idle sessions expire after 7 days, requiring re-authentication.
 */
export const PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS = {
  name: 'sb-college-admin-auth',
  path: '/',
  maxAge: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60,
  sameSite: 'lax' as const,
};

export function resolveSupabaseKey(): string {
  const key =
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ??
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_DEFAULT_KEY ??
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY;
  if (!key) {
    throw new Error(
      'Missing Supabase env: one of NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY / NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_DEFAULT_KEY / NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY'
    );
  }
  return key;
}

export function resolveSupabaseUrl(): string {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  if (!url || !/^https:\/\/.+/i.test(url)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid or missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL. Expected an https URL.');
  }
  return url;
}

--- END FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/lib/supabase/cookie-options.ts ---

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/lib/supabase/middleware.ts ---
import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import {
  PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS,
  resolveSupabaseKey,
  resolveSupabaseUrl,
} from "./cookie-options";

/**
 * Creates a Supabase client for use in Next.js middleware.
 * Reads auth cookies from the incoming request and writes refreshed tokens
 * to the response so the browser and downstream Server Components see the same session.
 */
export function createMiddlewareClient(request: NextRequest) {
  const url = resolveSupabaseUrl();
  const key = resolveSupabaseKey();

  const response = NextResponse.next({ request });

  const supabase = createServerClient(url, key, {
    cookieOptions: PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS,
    cookies: {
      getAll() {
        return request.cookies.getAll();
      },
      setAll(cookiesToSet) {
        cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
          response.cookies.set(name, value, options),
        );
      },
    },
  });

  return { supabase, response };
}

/**
 * Runs at the start of each matching request: loads the Supabase session from
 * cookies and refreshes the access token if expired. Updated cookies are written to the response.
 */
export async function updateSession(
  request: NextRequest,
): Promise<NextResponse> {
  const hasAuthCookie = request.cookies
    .getAll()
    .some((c) => c.name.startsWith(PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS.name));
  if (!hasAuthCookie) {
    return NextResponse.next({ request });
  }

  const { supabase, response } = createMiddlewareClient(request);
  try {
    await supabase.auth.getUser();
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    const authError = error as { code?: string; message?: string };
    const isRefreshMissing =
      authError?.code === "refresh_token_not_found" ||
      authError?.message?.includes("Invalid Refresh Token");

    if (!isRefreshMissing) {
      throw error;
    }

    const requestCookies = request.cookies.getAll();
    for (const cookie of requestCookies) {
      if (cookie.name.startsWith(PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS.name)) {
        response.cookies.set(cookie.name, "", {
          path: "/",
          maxAge: 0,
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return response;
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/lib/supabase/server.ts ---
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS, resolveSupabaseKey, resolveSupabaseUrl } from './cookie-options';

/** Server Supabase client; cookie-only session, same maxAge as client/middleware. */
export async function createClient() {
  const url = resolveSupabaseUrl();
  const key = resolveSupabaseKey();
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  return createServerClient(url, key, {
    cookieOptions: PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS,
    cookies: {
      getAll() {
        return cookieStore.getAll();
      },
      setAll(cookiesToSet) {
        try {
          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => cookieStore.set(name, value, options));
        } catch {
          // Next.js only allows cookie writes in Route Handlers/Server Actions. Ignore in render/redirect contexts.
        }
      },
    },
  });
}

/**
 * Cookie-less Supabase client for use inside `unstable_cache()`.
 * This avoids the "cookies() inside cache scope" error.
 * Only use this for queries that don't need authenticated access (e.g. public data reads).
 */
export function createPublicClient() {
  const url = resolveSupabaseUrl();
  const key = resolveSupabaseKey();
  return createServerClient(url, key, {
    cookieOptions: PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS,
    cookies: {
      getAll() { return []; },
      setAll() {},
    },
  });
}

/**
 * Server-only: fetch tenant branding from DB. Do not import from client components.
 */
import 'server-only';
import { cache } from 'react';
import { unstable_cache } from 'next/cache';
import { createPublicClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import type { TenantBranding } from '@/types/tenant';

const getTenantBrandingCached = unstable_cache(async (slug: string): Promise<TenantBranding | null> => {
  const supabase = createPublicClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('colleges')
    .select('id, name, slug, short_name, logo_url, primary_color, secondary_color')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .eq('status', 'active')
    .single();
  if (error || !data) return null;
  return {
    id: data.id,
    name: data.name,
    slug: data.slug,
    shortName: data.short_name,
    logoUrl: data.logo_url,
    primaryColor: data.primary_color,
    secondaryColor: data.secondary_color,
    batchLabel: null,
    programLabel: null,
  };
}, ['tenant-branding'], {
  revalidate: 300,
  tags: ['tenant-branding'],
});

export const getTenantBrandingFromDb = cache(async function getTenantBrandingFromDb(slug: string): Promise<TenantBranding | null> {
  return getTenantBrandingCached(slug);
});

/** Async getTenantBranding for use in Server Components. */
export async function getTenantBranding(slug?: string | null): Promise<TenantBranding | null> {
  if (!slug || slug === 'default') return null;
  return getTenantBrandingFromDb(slug);
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/lib/tenant/get-tenant.ts ---
import { cache } from 'react';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { getSession } from '@/lib/auth/session';

export interface CurrentTenant {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
  shortName: string | null;
  logoUrl: string | null;
  primaryColor: string | null;
  secondaryColor: string | null;
}

export interface CurrentUser {
  id: string;
  email: string | null;
  fullName: string | null;
  isActive: boolean;
  globalRole: 'superadmin' | null;
}

export interface CurrentMembership {
  id: string;
  collegeId: string;
  role: 'college_admin' | 'student' | 'faculty_spoc' | 'mentor';
  status: string;
}

/** Get college by slug for tenant resolution. Case-insensitive. Cached per request. */
export const getTenantBySlug = cache(async (slug: string): Promise<CurrentTenant | null> => {
  const normalizedSlug = slug.trim();
  if (!normalizedSlug) return null;

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('colleges')
    .select('id, name, slug, short_name, logo_url, primary_color, secondary_color')
    .ilike('slug', normalizedSlug)
    .eq('status', 'active')
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) {
    console.error('[tenant] getTenantBySlug', { slug: normalizedSlug, code: error.code, message: error.message });
    return null;
  }
  if (!data) return null;
  return {
    id: data.id,
    name: data.name,
    slug: data.slug,
    shortName: data.short_name,
    logoUrl: data.logo_url,
    primaryColor: data.primary_color,
    secondaryColor: data.secondary_color,
  };
});

/** Get current user and profile. Returns null if not authenticated. */
export const getCurrentUser = cache(async (): Promise<CurrentUser | null> => {
  const { session } = await getSession();
  if (!session?.user) return null;
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: profile, error } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .select('id, full_name, email, is_active, global_role')
    .eq('id', session.user.id)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) {
    console.error('[tenant] getCurrentUser profile', { userId: session.user.id.slice(0, 8) + '…', code: error.code, message: error.message });
    return {
      id: session.user.id,
      email: session.user.email ?? null,
      fullName: (session.user.user_metadata?.full_name as string) ?? null,
      isActive: true,
      globalRole: null,
    };
  }
  if (!profile) {
    return {
      id: session.user.id,
      email: session.user.email ?? null,
      fullName: (session.user.user_metadata?.full_name as string) ?? null,
      isActive: true,
      globalRole: null,
    };
  }
  return {
    id: profile.id,
    email: profile.email ?? session.user.email ?? null,
    fullName: profile.full_name ?? (session.user.user_metadata?.full_name as string) ?? null,
    isActive: profile.is_active,
    globalRole: profile.global_role as 'superadmin' | null,
  };
});

/** Get current user's active membership for a college (by college_id). */
export const getMembershipByCollegeId = cache(async (collegeId: string): Promise<CurrentMembership | null> => {
  const { session } = await getSession();
  if (!session?.user) return null;
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('college_memberships')
    .select('id, college_id, role, status')
    .eq('user_id', session.user.id)
    .eq('college_id', collegeId)
    .in('status', ['active', 'invited'])
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) {
    console.error('[tenant] getMembershipByCollegeId', { userId: session.user.id.slice(0, 8) + '…', collegeId, code: error.code, message: error.message });
    return null;
  }
  if (!data) return null;
  return {
    id: data.id,
    collegeId: data.college_id,
    role: data.role,
    status: data.status,
  };
});

/** Get current user's active membership for a college by slug. */
export const getMembershipBySlug = cache(async (collegeSlug: string): Promise<CurrentMembership | null> => {
  const tenant = await getTenantBySlug(collegeSlug);
  if (!tenant) return null;
  return getMembershipByCollegeId(tenant.id);
});

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/lib/tpstreams/access-tokens.ts ---
import 'server-only';

/**
 * TPStreams Access Token service.
 *
 * Access tokens gate secure video playback. They must be generated server-side
 * and passed to the embed player. Never generate access tokens on the client.
 *
 * Covers:
 *   POST  /api/v1/<org>/assets/<asset_id>/access_tokens/
 *   GET   /api/v1/<org>/assets/<asset_id>/access_tokens/<code>/
 *   PATCH /api/v1/<org>/assets/<asset_id>/access_tokens/<code>/  (update TTL)
 */

import { tpPost, tpGet, tpPatch, getTpStreamsOrgId, orgPath } from './client';
import type {
  TpCreateAccessTokenRequest,
  TpUpdateAccessTokenRequest,
  TpAccessToken,
} from './types';

// ─── Create access token ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Generate an access token for secure video playback.
 *
 * SECURITY: This is a server-only operation. Never expose the TPStreams token
 * or call this endpoint from client-side code.
 *
 * Endpoint: POST /api/v1/<org>/assets/<asset_id>/access_tokens/
 *
 * @param assetId  The video asset to generate the token for.
 * @param options  Optional TTL, single-use, or watermark annotations.
 * @param orgId    Override default org ID from env.
 *
 * @example
 *   // Server action or Route Handler only:
 *   const token = await createAccessToken('yXrprYum2TS', {
 *     time_to_live: 3600,           // 1-hour token
 *     expires_after_first_usage: false,
 *   });
 *   // Pass token.code to the embed URL on the client
 */
export async function createAccessToken(
  assetId: string,
  options?: TpCreateAccessTokenRequest,
  orgId?: string,
): Promise<TpAccessToken> {
  const id = orgId ?? getTpStreamsOrgId();
  return tpPost<TpAccessToken>(
    `${orgPath(id)}/assets/${assetId}/access_tokens/`,
    options ?? {},
  );
}

// ─── Get access token detail ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Retrieve the details of an existing access token.
 *
 * Endpoint: GET /api/v1/<org>/assets/<asset_id>/access_tokens/<code>/
 *
 * @param assetId    The video asset.
 * @param tokenCode  The access token code (UUID).
 * @param orgId      Override default org ID.
 */
export async function getAccessToken(
  assetId: string,
  tokenCode: string,
  orgId?: string,
): Promise<TpAccessToken> {
  const id = orgId ?? getTpStreamsOrgId();
  return tpGet<TpAccessToken>(
    `${orgPath(id)}/assets/${assetId}/access_tokens/${tokenCode}/`,
  );
}

// ─── Update access token TTL ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Update the time-to-live (TTL) of an existing access token.
 *
 * Endpoint: PATCH /api/v1/<org>/assets/<asset_id>/access_tokens/<code>/
 *
 * @param assetId    The video asset.
 * @param tokenCode  The access token code (UUID).
 * @param request    { time_to_live: number } — new TTL in seconds.
 * @param orgId      Override default org ID.
 */
export async function updateAccessTokenTtl(
  assetId: string,
  tokenCode: string,
  request: TpUpdateAccessTokenRequest,
  orgId?: string,
): Promise<TpAccessToken> {
  const id = orgId ?? getTpStreamsOrgId();
  return tpPatch<TpAccessToken>(
    `${orgPath(id)}/assets/${assetId}/access_tokens/${tokenCode}/`,
    request,
  );
}

// ─── Helper: build embed URL from access token ────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Constructs the TPStreams embed URL given an org ID, asset ID, and token code.
 * Use this in Server Components or Route Handlers to pass a safe embed URL
 * to the TpStreamEmbedFrame client component.
 *
 * @param orgId      TPStreams organisation UUID.
 * @param assetId    TPStreams asset ID.
 * @param tokenCode  Access token code.
 */
export function buildEmbedUrl(
  orgId: string,
  assetId: string,
  tokenCode: string,
): string {
  return `https://app.tpstreams.com/embed/${orgId}/${assetId}/?access_token=${tokenCode}`;
}

/**
 * Convenience: generate an access token and return its embed URL in one call.
 *
 * Useful for Server Components rendering a video embed.
 *
 * @param assetId  The video asset.
 * @param options  Optional TTL / single-use options.
 * @param orgId    Override default org ID.
 */
export async function createEmbedToken(
  assetId: string,
  options?: TpCreateAccessTokenRequest,
  orgId?: string,
): Promise<{ token: TpAccessToken; embedUrl: string }> {
  const id = orgId ?? getTpStreamsOrgId();
  const token = await createAccessToken(assetId, options, id);
  const embedUrl = buildEmbedUrl(id, assetId, token.code);
  return { token, embedUrl };
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/lib/tpstreams/client.ts ---
import 'server-only';

/**
 * TPStreams HTTP Client — transport layer core.
 *
 * Reads credentials from environment at call-time (never at module load) so
 * that the module is safe to import in any server context without throwing on
 * missing env vars during the build phase.
 *
 * Preferred Environment Variables:
 *   TP_STREAMS_API_TOKEN      — API authentication token (Bearer value after "token ")
 *   ORGANISATION_ID           — Default organisation identifier
 *
 * Legacy/Alternative Environment Variables:
 *   TP_STREAMS_URL            — Alias for TP_STREAMS_API_TOKEN
 */

// ─── Constants ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const TPSTREAMS_BASE_URL = 'https://app.tpstreams.com';
export const TPSTREAMS_API_VERSION = 'v1';

/** Max retries for idempotent requests (GET). */
const MAX_RETRIES = 3;
/** Base wait before first retry (ms). Each retry doubles this. */
const RETRY_BASE_MS = 300;
/** HTTP status codes that are safe to retry. */
const RETRYABLE_STATUS = new Set([429, 500, 502, 503, 504]);

// ─── Env helpers (server-only, called at request time) ────────────────────────

/** Returns the TPStreams auth token from env. Throws if missing. */
export function getTpStreamsToken(): string {
  const token = process.env.TP_STREAMS_API_TOKEN ?? process.env.TP_STREAMS_URL;
  if (!token) {
    throw new TpStreamsConfigError(
      'TP_STREAMS_API_TOKEN (or TP_STREAMS_URL) is not set. Add it to your .env file.',
    );
  }
  return token;
}

/** Returns the default organisation ID from env. Throws if missing. */
export function getTpStreamsOrgId(): string {
  const orgId = process.env.ORGANISATION_ID;
  if (!orgId) {
    throw new TpStreamsConfigError(
      'ORGANISATION_ID is not set. Add it to your .env file.',
    );
  }
  return orgId;
}

/**
 * Check if TPStreams API is configured (env vars set).
 * Returns false if credentials are missing, preventing auth errors.
 */
export function isTpStreamsConfigured(): boolean {
  const hasToken = !!(process.env.TP_STREAMS_API_TOKEN ?? process.env.TP_STREAMS_URL);
  const hasOrgId = !!process.env.ORGANISATION_ID;
  return hasToken && hasOrgId;
}

// ─── Header builders ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Returns the Authorization header value. */
export function buildAuthHeader(): Record<string, string> {
  return { Authorization: `Token ${getTpStreamsToken()}` };
}

/** Returns headers for JSON requests. */
export function buildJsonHeaders(): Record<string, string> {
  return {
    ...buildAuthHeader(),
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    Accept: 'application/json',
    'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
  };
}

/** Returns headers for multipart/form-data (do NOT set Content-Type — let fetch set boundary). */
export function buildMultipartHeaders(): Record<string, string> {
  return {
    ...buildAuthHeader(),
    Accept: 'application/json',
  };
}

// ─── URL builders ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Constructs an absolute TPStreams API URL. */
export function buildUrl(path: string): string {
  // Normalise leading slash
  const normPath = path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`;
  return `${TPSTREAMS_BASE_URL}/api/${TPSTREAMS_API_VERSION}${normPath}`;
}

/** Builds the org-scoped path prefix. */
export function orgPath(orgId?: string): string {
  const id = orgId ?? getTpStreamsOrgId();
  return `/${id}`;
}

// ─── Error classes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Thrown when an env var required by the TPStreams client is missing. */
export class TpStreamsConfigError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'TpStreamsConfigError';
  }
}

/** Thrown when the TPStreams API returns a non-2xx response. */
export class TpStreamsApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public readonly status: number,
    public readonly statusText: string,
    public readonly body: unknown,
    public readonly endpoint: string,
  ) {
    super(`TPStreams API error ${status} on ${endpoint}: ${statusText}`);
    this.name = 'TpStreamsApiError';
  }
}

// ─── Logging hooks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type TpStreamsLogLevel = 'debug' | 'info' | 'warn' | 'error';

export interface TpStreamsLogEntry {
  level: TpStreamsLogLevel;
  message: string;
  endpoint: string;
  method: string;
  status?: number;
  durationMs?: number;
  attempt?: number;
  errorType?: string;
}

const LOG_PREFIX = '[TPStreams]';

export function tpLog(entry: TpStreamsLogEntry): void {
  const parts = [
    `${entry.method.toUpperCase()} ${entry.endpoint}`,
    entry.status !== undefined ? `status=${entry.status}` : null,
    entry.durationMs !== undefined ? `${entry.durationMs}ms` : null,
    entry.attempt !== undefined ? `attempt=${entry.attempt}` : null,
    entry.errorType ? `error=${entry.errorType}` : null,
    entry.message ? `msg="${entry.message}"` : null,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(' ');

  const line = `${LOG_PREFIX} ${parts}`;

  switch (entry.level) {
    case 'error':
      console.error(line);
      break;
    case 'warn':
      console.warn(line);
      break;
    case 'debug':
      if (process.env.TPSTREAMS_DEBUG === '1') console.debug(line);
      break;
    default:
      console.log(line);
  }
}

// ─── Retry helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

// ─── Core fetch wrapper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface TpFetchOptions {
  /** Endpoint path relative to base (e.g. "/org/assets/"). */
  endpoint: string;
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH';
  headers: Record<string, string>;
  /** JSON-serialisable body (used when sending JSON). */
  body?: unknown;
  /** Raw FormData body (used for multipart endpoints). */
  formData?: FormData;
  /** Override max retries (default: MAX_RETRIES for idempotent, 1 for POST). */
  maxRetries?: number;
  /** Additional query parameters. */
  params?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | undefined>;
}

export interface TpFetchResult<T> {
  data: T;
  status: number;
}

/**
 * Core fetch function with retry, logging, and error handling.
 * Never call this directly from business code — use the typed service methods.
 */
export async function tpFetch<T>(options: TpFetchOptions): Promise<TpFetchResult<T>> {
  const { endpoint, method, headers, body, formData, params } = options;

  // Build URL with query params
  const url = new URL(buildUrl(endpoint));
  if (params) {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
      if (v !== undefined) url.searchParams.set(k, String(v));
    }
  }

  // Determine retry budget: POST/PUT/PATCH = 1 attempt, idempotent = MAX_RETRIES
  const isIdempotent = method === 'GET';
  const maxRetries = options.maxRetries ?? (isIdempotent ? MAX_RETRIES : 1);

  let attempt = 0;
  let lastError: unknown;

  while (attempt < maxRetries) {
    attempt++;
    const t0 = Date.now();

    try {
      const fetchOptions: RequestInit & { cache?: RequestCache } = {
        method,
        headers,
        // Disable Next.js edge/server data cache for TPStreams responses
        cache: 'no-store' as RequestCache,
      };

      if (formData) {
        fetchOptions.body = formData;
      } else if (body !== undefined) {
        fetchOptions.body = JSON.stringify(body);
      }

      tpLog({
        level: 'debug',
        message: 'request',
        endpoint: url.pathname,
        method,
        attempt,
      });

      const response = await fetch(url.toString(), fetchOptions);
      const durationMs = Date.now() - t0;

      // 204 No Content — return empty object
      if (response.status === 204) {
        tpLog({ level: 'info', message: 'ok', endpoint: url.pathname, method, status: 204, durationMs });
        return { data: {} as T, status: 204 };
      }

      // Parse body
      let parsed: unknown;
      const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') ?? '';
      if (contentType.includes('application/json')) {
        parsed = await response.json();
      } else {
        parsed = await response.text();
      }

      if (!response.ok) {
        // Retry on transient errors
        if (RETRYABLE_STATUS.has(response.status) && attempt < maxRetries) {
          const backoff = RETRY_BASE_MS * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1);
          tpLog({
            level: 'warn',
            message: `retrying in ${backoff}ms`,
            endpoint: url.pathname,
            method,
            status: response.status,
            durationMs,
            attempt,
          });
          await sleep(backoff);
          continue;
        }

        tpLog({
          level: 'error',
          message: 'api error',
          endpoint: url.pathname,
          method,
          status: response.status,
          durationMs,
          attempt,
          errorType: 'TpStreamsApiError',
        });

        throw new TpStreamsApiError(response.status, response.statusText, parsed, url.pathname);
      }

      tpLog({
        level: 'info',
        message: 'ok',
        endpoint: url.pathname,
        method,
        status: response.status,
        durationMs,
        attempt,
      });

      return { data: parsed as T, status: response.status };
    } catch (err) {
      const durationMs = Date.now() - t0;
      lastError = err;

      // Re-throw API errors immediately (already retried above if retryable)
      if (err instanceof TpStreamsApiError || err instanceof TpStreamsConfigError) throw err;

      // Network errors — retry idempotent requests
      if (isIdempotent && attempt < maxRetries) {
        const backoff = RETRY_BASE_MS * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1);
        tpLog({
          level: 'warn',
          message: `network error, retrying in ${backoff}ms`,
          endpoint: url.pathname,
          method,
          durationMs,
          attempt,
          errorType: err instanceof Error ? err.name : 'UnknownError',
        });
        await sleep(backoff);
        continue;
      }

      tpLog({
        level: 'error',
        message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'unknown error',
        endpoint: url.pathname,
        method,
        durationMs,
        attempt,
        errorType: err instanceof Error ? err.name : 'UnknownError',
      });

      throw err;
    }
  }

  throw lastError;
}

// ─── Convenience wrappers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** GET with JSON response. */
export async function tpGet<T>(
  endpoint: string,
  params?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | undefined>,
): Promise<T> {
  const result = await tpFetch<T>({ endpoint, method: 'GET', headers: buildJsonHeaders(), params });
  return result.data;
}

/** POST with JSON body. Single attempt (not idempotent). */
export async function tpPost<T>(endpoint: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const result = await tpFetch<T>({ endpoint, method: 'POST', headers: buildJsonHeaders(), body });
  return result.data;
}

/** PUT with JSON body (full replacement). */
export async function tpPut<T>(endpoint: string, body: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const result = await tpFetch<T>({ endpoint, method: 'PUT', headers: buildJsonHeaders(), body });
  return result.data;
}

/** PATCH with JSON body (partial update). */
export async function tpPatch<T>(endpoint: string, body: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const result = await tpFetch<T>({ endpoint, method: 'PATCH', headers: buildJsonHeaders(), body });
  return result.data;
}

/** POST with multipart/form-data. Use for file upload endpoints. */
export async function tpPostForm<T>(endpoint: string, formData: FormData): Promise<T> {
  const result = await tpFetch<T>({
    endpoint,
    method: 'POST',
    headers: buildMultipartHeaders(),
    formData,
  });
  return result.data;
}

import 'server-only';

/**
 * TPStreams Webhook service.
 *
 * Webhooks notify your application when async events occur (e.g. video processing
 * complete, livestream status change). Configure the endpoint URL and a secret
 * token to verify authenticity (x-streams-token header).
 *
 * Covers:
 *   GET    /api/v1/<org>/webhooks/
 */

import { tpGet, getTpStreamsOrgId, orgPath } from './client';
import type {
  TpPaginatedResponse,
  TpWebhook,
} from './types';

// ─── List webhooks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * List all webhooks configured for the organisation.
 *
 * Endpoint: GET /api/v1/<org>/webhooks/
 *
 * @param orgId  Override default org ID.
 */
export async function listWebhooks(orgId?: string): Promise<TpPaginatedResponse<TpWebhook>> {
  const id = orgId ?? getTpStreamsOrgId();
  return tpGet<TpPaginatedResponse<TpWebhook>>(`${orgPath(id)}/webhooks/`);
}

// ─── Webhook event verification helper ───────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Verifies that an incoming webhook request is genuinely from TPStreams
 * by comparing the x-streams-token header against your stored secret.
 *
 * Use this in your Next.js webhook Route Handler:
 *
 * @example
 *   // app/api/webhooks/tpstreams/route.ts
 *   export async function POST(req: Request) {
 *     const isValid = verifyWebhookSecret(
 *       req.headers.get('x-streams-token'),
 *       process.env.TPSTREAMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET!,
 *     );
 *     if (!isValid) return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
 *     // ... handle event
 *   }
 *
 * @param receivedToken  Value of the x-streams-token request header.
 * @param storedSecret   The secret_token you configured when creating the webhook.
 */
export function verifyWebhookSecret(
  receivedToken: string | null,
  storedSecret: string,
): boolean {
  if (!receivedToken || !storedSecret) return false;
  // Constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks
  const a = Buffer.from(receivedToken);
  const b = Buffer.from(storedSecret);
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  let result = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    result |= a[i] ^ b[i];
  }
  return result === 0;
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/lib/validation/parse.ts ---
import type { ZodType } from 'zod';

/**
 * Parse data with a Zod schema; return either the parsed data or the first error message.
 * Use for form/API validation across the project.
 */
export function parseOrFirstError<T>(
  schema: ZodType<T>,
  data: unknown
): { ok: true; data: T } | { ok: false; error: string } {
  const result = schema.safeParse(data);
  if (result.success) return { ok: true, data: result.data };
  const first = result.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Invalid input.';
  return { ok: false, error: first };
}

/** Shared login form validation (email + password). */

  password: z.string().min(1, 'Password is required'),
});

export type LoginInput = z.infer<typeof loginSchema>;

import type { NextConfig } from 'next';

const isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';

const csp = [
    "default-src 'self'",
    `script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://vercel.live https://static.tpstreams.com https://checkout.razorpay.com https://cdn.razorpay.com https://checkout-static-next.razorpay.com${isDev ? " 'unsafe-eval'" : ''}`,
    `script-src-elem 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://vercel.live https://static.tpstreams.com https://checkout.razorpay.com https://cdn.razorpay.com https://checkout-static-next.razorpay.com`,
    "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://static.tpstreams.com",
    "img-src 'self' blob: data: https://i.postimg.cc https://d3tjsvjjvv1f4h.cloudfront.net https://*.cloudfront.net https://static.tpstreams.com https://*.wasabisys.com https://*.amazonaws.com",
    "font-src 'self'",
    "object-src 'none'",
    "base-uri 'self'",
    "form-action 'self'",
    "frame-src 'self' https://app.tpstreams.com https://api.razorpay.com https://checkout.razorpay.com",
    "frame-ancestors 'none'",
    "worker-src 'self' blob:",
    `connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co https://app.tpstreams.com https://*.tpstreams.com https://*.cloudfront.net https://*.wasabisys.com https://*.amazonaws.com https://api.razorpay.com https://checkout.razorpay.com https://cdn.razorpay.com https://checkout-static-next.razorpay.com${isDev ? ' ws://localhost:* http://localhost:*' : ''}`,
    "media-src 'self' blob: https://*.cloudfront.net https://*.tpstreams.com https://*.wasabisys.com https://*.amazonaws.com",
].join('; ');

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  images: {
    localPatterns: [
      {
        pathname: '/assets/**',
      },
    ],
    remotePatterns: [
      {
        protocol: 'https',
        hostname: 'i.postimg.cc',
        pathname: '/**',
      },
      {
        protocol: 'https',
        hostname: 'd3tjsvjjvv1f4h.cloudfront.net',
        pathname: '/**',
      },
    ],
  },
  turbopack: {
    root: __dirname,
  },
  experimental: {
    staleTimes: {
      dynamic: 30,
    },
  },
  async headers() {
    const isProd = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';
    const securityHeaders = [
      { key: 'X-DNS-Prefetch-Control', value: 'on' },
      { key: 'X-Frame-Options', value: 'DENY' },
      { key: 'X-Content-Type-Options', value: 'nosniff' },
      { key: 'Referrer-Policy', value: 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin' },
      { key: 'Permissions-Policy', value: 'camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), fullscreen=(), payment=(), browsing-topics=(), web-share=()' },
      { key: 'Content-Security-Policy', value: csp },
      { key: 'Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy', value: 'same-origin' },
      { key: 'Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy', value: 'same-origin' }
    ];

    if (isProd) {
      securityHeaders.push({
        key: 'Strict-Transport-Security',
        value: 'max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload',
      });
    }

    return [
      {
        source: '/(.*)',
        headers: securityHeaders,
      },
    ];
  },
  async redirects() {
    return [
      {
        source: '/c/:slug/admin/dashboard/:path+',
        destination: '/c/:slug/admin/:path*',
        permanent: true,
      },
    ];
  },
};

export default nextConfig;
