--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/providers/tenant-provider.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { createEmptyFeatureMap, normalizeFeatureMap, type FeatureMap } from '@/lib/features/feature-access';
import { buildTenantModuleAccess, type TenantModuleAccessMap } from '@/lib/modules/module-access';
import type { TenantBranding } from '@/types/tenant';
import { getTenantBrandingSync } from '@/lib/tenant/get-tenant-branding';

interface TenantContextValue {
  branding: TenantBranding;
  slug: string | null;
  features: FeatureMap;
  moduleAccess: TenantModuleAccessMap;
  setFeatures: (features: FeatureMap) => void;
  setModuleAccess: (moduleAccess: TenantModuleAccessMap) => void;
}

const TenantContext = createContext<TenantContextValue | null>(null);

const DEFAULT_BRANDING = getTenantBrandingSync(null);
const DEFAULT_FEATURES = createEmptyFeatureMap();
const DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS = buildTenantModuleAccess({ features: DEFAULT_FEATURES });

interface TenantProviderProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  slug?: string | null;
  initialBranding?: TenantBranding | null;
  initialFeatures?: FeatureMap | null;
  /** When provided, used as-is (server-computed with overlay). Otherwise built from initialFeatures only. */
  initialModuleAccess?: TenantModuleAccessMap | null;
}

export function TenantProvider({
  children,
  slug = null,
  initialBranding,
  initialFeatures,
  initialModuleAccess,
}: TenantProviderProps) {
  const branding = initialBranding ?? getTenantBrandingSync(slug ?? null);
  
  const [features, setFeaturesState] = useState<FeatureMap>(() => 
    normalizeFeatureMap(initialFeatures ?? DEFAULT_FEATURES)
  );
  
  const [moduleAccess, setModuleAccessState] = useState<TenantModuleAccessMap>(() => 
    initialModuleAccess ?? buildTenantModuleAccess({ features })
  );

  const setFeatures = useCallback((newFeatures: FeatureMap) => {
    setFeaturesState(normalizeFeatureMap(newFeatures));
  }, []);

  const setModuleAccess = useCallback((newModuleAccess: TenantModuleAccessMap) => {
    setModuleAccessState(newModuleAccess);
  }, []);

  const value: TenantContextValue = {
    branding,
    slug,
    features,
    moduleAccess,
    setFeatures,
    setModuleAccess,
  };

  return <TenantContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</TenantContext.Provider>;
}

export function useTenant(): TenantContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(TenantContext);
  if (!ctx) {
    return { 
      branding: DEFAULT_BRANDING, 
      slug: null, 
      features: DEFAULT_FEATURES, 
      moduleAccess: DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS,
      setFeatures: () => {},
      setModuleAccess: () => {},
    };
  }
  return ctx;
}

--- END FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/providers/tenant-provider.tsx ---

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/proxy.ts ---
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server';
import { createMiddlewareClient } from '@/lib/supabase/middleware';
import { PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS } from '@/lib/supabase/cookie-options';

/**
 * Routes that never require authentication.
 * Auth callbacks, password recovery, and login pages must be accessible
 * to unauthenticated users. Tenant-prefixed admin routes are included
 * because CollegeAdmin serves multiple tenants under /c/:collegeSlug/admin/.
 */
function isPublicRoute(pathname: string): boolean {
  return (
    pathname.startsWith('/login') ||
    pathname.startsWith('/forgot-password') ||
    pathname.startsWith('/reset-password') ||
    pathname.startsWith('/auth/callback') ||
    pathname.startsWith('/auth/set-password') ||
    /^\/c\/[^/]+\/admin\/login/.test(pathname) ||
    /^\/c\/[^/]+\/admin\/forgot-password/.test(pathname) ||
    /^\/c\/[^/]+\/admin\/reset-password/.test(pathname) ||
    pathname === '/'
  );
}

/**
 * Helper to check if request has any Supabase auth cookies.
 */
function hasAuthCookie(request: NextRequest): boolean {
  return request.cookies
    .getAll()
    .some((c) => c.name.startsWith(PERSISTENT_COOKIE_OPTIONS.name));
}

/**
 * Next.js middleware — runs on every request matching the config.matcher.
 *
 * Responsibilities:
 *   1. Refresh the Supabase session when an auth cookie is present
 *   2. Redirect unauthenticated users away from protected page routes
 *   3. Let API routes pass through so server-side guards handle authorization
 *
 * Authorization is NOT enforced here — server guards (requireCollegeAdmin) are
 * the source of truth for role / permission checks.
 */
export async function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
  const pathname = request.nextUrl.pathname;
  const isApiRoute = pathname.startsWith('/api');
  const publicRoute = isPublicRoute(pathname);

  // API routes: always pass through — server handlers enforce authorization.
  // Public page routes also pass through (no redirect).
  // Session refresh still runs below for authenticated callers.
  if (isApiRoute || publicRoute) {
    if (!hasAuthCookie(request)) {
      return NextResponse.next({ request });
    }
    const { supabase, response } = createMiddlewareClient(request);
    try {
      await supabase.auth.getUser();
    } catch {
      // Stale / invalid refresh token — clear auth cookies so the next
      // request starts clean instead of retrying the same bad token.
      for (const cookie of request.cookies.getAll()) {
        response.cookies.set(cookie.name, '', { path: '/', maxAge: 0 });
      }
    }
    return response;
  }

  // Protected page routes — require a valid session.
  if (!hasAuthCookie(request)) {
    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
    url.pathname = '/login';
    url.search = '';
    return NextResponse.redirect(url);
  }

  const { supabase, response } = createMiddlewareClient(request);

  try {
    const result = await supabase.auth.getUser();
    if (!result.data.user) {
      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
      url.pathname = '/login';
      url.search = '';
      return NextResponse.redirect(url);
    }
  } catch {
    // Invalid refresh token — clear cookies and redirect to login.
    for (const cookie of request.cookies.getAll()) {
      response.cookies.set(cookie.name, '', { path: '/', maxAge: 0 });
    }
    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
    url.pathname = '/login';
    url.search = '';
    return NextResponse.redirect(url);
  }

  return response;
}

export const config = {
  matcher: [
    /*
     * Match all request paths except for static assets and metadata files.
     *
     * Excluded:
     *   - _next/static  (webpack chunks, CSS)
     *   - _next/image   (image optimization endpoint)
     *   - favicon.ico, sitemap.xml, robots.txt
     *   - common image file extensions
     *
     * API routes ARE included so middleware can refresh expired sessions
     * for authenticated API callers. Server-side guards remain the
     * authorization source of truth.
     */
    '/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon\\.ico|.*\\.(?:svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp)$).*)',
  ],
};

--- END FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-college-admin/proxy.ts ---

# CollegeAdmin Portal

Institution-level administration console scoped to a single college tenant. Manages students, faculty, assigned content, placements, and assessments.

## Quick Start

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
# Opens on http://localhost:3001
```

### Other Scripts

```bash
npm run lint       # ESLint
npm run build      # Production build
npm run start      # Start production server
npx tsc --noEmit   # TypeScript check
```

## Environment Variables

Create a `.env` file with:

```env
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=<your-supabase-url>
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=<your-anon-key>
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=<your-service-role-key>
NEXT_PUBLIC_LMS_APP_URL=<your-lms-url>   # e.g., http://localhost:3002
```

## Architecture

### Tech Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router)
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Database**: Supabase (PostgreSQL + RLS)
- **Video CDN**: TPStreams
- **UI**: shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS

### Tenant Scoping

All routes are scoped under `/c/[collegeSlug]/admin/*`. The `requireCollegeAdmin` guard:
1. Resolves the tenant from the URL slug
2. Validates the authenticated user is a member of that college
3. Returns `{ tenant, user }` context

### Key Principles

- All mutations require SuperAdmin or CollegeAdmin auth
- No create/edit/delete on content — read-only view of SuperAdmin-provisioned content
- Student invite emails sent via Supabase Auth SMTP (SendGrid)
- Tenant guards on all `/c/[collegeSlug]/admin/*` pages

## Core Concepts

### Content Rendering

CollegeAdmin sees content that has been:
1. Assigned to the college via SuperAdmin's "Assign Pillar" action
2. Has `publish_status = 'published'`
3. Has `visible_to_college_admins = true`
4. Has an active `content_assignment` record

Content is grouped by real DB pillars (not fake/null pillars).

### Student Invite Flow

1. Admin enters student email in `/students`
2. `inviteStudent` action calls Supabase Auth "Invite user"
3. Student receives email with confirmation link
4. Student sets password and completes enrollment
5. If college has active assignments, entitlements are auto-generated

### SMTP Configuration

Invite emails are sent by **Supabase** using Auth SMTP. Configure SendGrid in:
**Supabase Dashboard → Authentication → SMTP**

```env
SENDGRID_SMTP_HOST=smtp.sendgrid.net
SENDGRID_SMTP_PORT=587
SENDGRID_USERNAME=apikey
SENDGRID_PASSWORD=<your-api-key>
```

## Key Pages

| Route | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `/c/[slug]/admin/dashboard` | Institution dashboard |
| `/c/[slug]/admin/students` | Student management + invite |
| `/c/[slug]/admin/content` | Assigned courses grouped by pillar |
| `/c/[slug]/admin/content/[id]` | Course curriculum (read-only) |
| `/c/[slug]/admin/assessments` | Assessment management |
| `/c/[slug]/admin/placements` | Placement tracking |
| `/c/[slug]/admin/settings` | Admin settings |

## Important Services

```typescript
import { listAssignedCoursesForCollegeAdmin } from '@/lib/services/assigned-courses'
import { getAssignedCourseDetailForCollegeAdmin } from '@/lib/services/assigned-courses'
import { listStudentsForCollegeAdmin } from '@/lib/services/students'
```

## Notes

- Login no longer requires entering a slug — tenant resolved from admin membership
- Content is **read-only** — no create/edit/delete controls exist
- Direct URL manipulation to access unassigned courses returns 404
- Pillar routes (`/technical-bootcamp`, `/ai-modern-development`, etc.) are read-only mirrors of `/content` grouped by pillar

import { getEmailProviderDiagnostics, sendInternalTestEmail } from '../lib/email';

function parseRecipientArg(argv: string[]): string | null {
  const toIndex = argv.indexOf('--to');
  if (toIndex === -1) return null;
  return argv[toIndex + 1] ?? null;
}

function isValidEmail(value: string): boolean {
  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value);
}

async function main() {
  const toRaw = parseRecipientArg(process.argv.slice(2));
  if (!toRaw) {
    console.error('Usage: npm run email:test -- --to someone@example.com');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const to = toRaw.trim();
  if (!isValidEmail(to)) {
    console.error('Invalid --to email address.');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const diagnostics = getEmailProviderDiagnostics();
  const result = await sendInternalTestEmail(to);

  console.log(`selectedProvider=${diagnostics.selectedProvider}`);
  console.log(`ready=${diagnostics.ready}`);
  console.log(`ok=${result.ok}`);
  if (result.messageId) console.log(`messageId=${result.messageId}`);
  if (!result.ok) {
    console.log(`errorCode=${result.errorCode ?? 'unknown'}`);
    console.log(`errorMessage=${result.errorMessage ?? 'Unknown error'}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(`email:test failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
  process.exit(1);
});

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/app/(app)/activity/page.tsx ---
import { listActivityEvents } from '@/lib/activity/queries';
import { listColleges } from '@/lib/services/colleges';
import { ACTIVITY_EVENT_CATEGORIES } from '@/lib/activity/event-types';
import nextDynamic from 'next/dynamic';

const ActivityPage = nextDynamic(
  () => import('@/components/pages/activity').then((m) => ({ default: m.ActivityPage })),
  { ssr: true }
);

export default async function ActivityRoute({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const params = await searchParams;
  const tenantId = typeof params.tenantId === 'string' ? params.tenantId : null;
  const userId = typeof params.userId === 'string' ? params.userId : null;
  const eventName = typeof params.eventName === 'string' ? params.eventName : null;
  const eventCategory = typeof params.eventCategory === 'string' ? params.eventCategory : null;
  let from: string | null = typeof params.from === 'string' ? params.from : null;
  let to: string | null = typeof params.to === 'string' ? params.to : null;
  if (from && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(from)) from = `${from}T00:00:00.000Z`;
  if (to && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(to)) to = `${to}T23:59:59.999Z`;

  const [events, colleges] = await Promise.all([
    listActivityEvents({
      tenantId: tenantId || undefined,
      userId: userId || undefined,
      eventName: eventName || undefined,
      eventCategory: eventCategory || undefined,
      from: from || undefined,
      to: to || undefined,
      limit: 200,
    }),
    listColleges(),
  ]);

  return (
    <ActivityPage
      initialEvents={events}
      colleges={colleges.map((c) => ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, slug: c.slug }))}
      eventCategories={ACTIVITY_EVENT_CATEGORIES.slice()}
    />
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/app/(app)/analytics-settings/actions.ts ---
'use server';

import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { requireSuperadminActionSafe } from '@/lib/auth/require-superadmin-action';
import { getAnalyticsSettings, saveAnalyticsSettings, updateAnalyticsSyncStatus } from '@/lib/services/analytics-settings';
import { consumeRateLimit } from '@/lib/security/rate-limit';
import { parseFormData } from '@/lib/validation/form-data';
import { runGA4Diagnostics, type GA4DiagnosticResult } from '@/lib/ga4/diagnostics';

const analyticsSettingsSchema = z.object({
  ga_enabled: z.coerce.boolean(),
  section_tracking_enabled: z.coerce.boolean(),
  cta_tracking_enabled: z.coerce.boolean(),
  form_tracking_enabled: z.coerce.boolean(),
  measurement_id: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .regex(/^$|^G-[A-Z0-9]{6,20}$/i, 'Measurement ID is invalid.')
    .transform((value) => value || null),
});

export async function saveAnalyticsSettingsAction(formData: FormData): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; error: string }> {
  const result = await requireSuperadminActionSafe();
  if (!result.ok) return result;
  const user = result.user;

  const limited = await consumeRateLimit({
    key: `save-analytics-settings:${user.id}`,
    limit: 20,
    windowMs: 10 * 60 * 1000,
  });
  if (!limited.ok) return { ok: false, error: `Too many requests. Retry in ${limited.retryAfterSeconds}s.` };

  const parsed = parseFormData(analyticsSettingsSchema, formData);
  if (!parsed.ok) return { ok: false, error: parsed.error };

  try {
    const current = await getAnalyticsSettings();
    await saveAnalyticsSettings({
      ...current,
      ga_enabled: parsed.data.ga_enabled,
      section_tracking_enabled: parsed.data.section_tracking_enabled,
      cta_tracking_enabled: parsed.data.cta_tracking_enabled,
      form_tracking_enabled: parsed.data.form_tracking_enabled,
      measurement_id: parsed.data.measurement_id,
    });
    revalidatePath('/analytics-settings');
    revalidatePath('/analytics');
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to save' };
  }
}

export async function syncAnalyticsNowAction(): Promise<{ ok: true; status: string } | { ok: false; error: string }> {
  const result = await requireSuperadminActionSafe();
  if (!result.ok) return result;
  const user = result.user;

  const limited = await consumeRateLimit({
    key: `sync-analytics-now:${user.id}`,
    limit: 5,
    windowMs: 10 * 60 * 1000,
  });
  if (!limited.ok) return { ok: false, error: `Too many requests. Retry in ${limited.retryAfterSeconds}s.` };

  const propertyId = process.env.GA4_PROPERTY_ID;
  const hasCredentials = Boolean(
    process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_JSON || process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  );

  try {
    if (!propertyId || !hasCredentials) {
      await updateAnalyticsSyncStatus('error');
      revalidatePath('/analytics-settings');
      return { ok: false, error: 'GA4 not configured. Set GA4_PROPERTY_ID and GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_JSON.' };
    }

    await updateAnalyticsSyncStatus('pending');
    revalidatePath('/analytics-settings');

    const { BetaAnalyticsDataClient } = await import('@google-analytics/data');
    const credentialsJson = process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_JSON;
    const credentials = credentialsJson ? JSON.parse(credentialsJson) : undefined;
    const client = new BetaAnalyticsDataClient(credentials ? { credentials } : {});

    await client.runReport({
      property: `properties/${propertyId}`,
      dateRanges: [{ startDate: 'yesterday', endDate: 'yesterday' }],
      dimensions: [{ name: 'date' }],
      metrics: [{ name: 'activeUsers' }],
      limit: 1,
    });

    await updateAnalyticsSyncStatus('ok');
    revalidatePath('/analytics-settings');
    return { ok: true, status: 'ok' };
  } catch (e) {
    await updateAnalyticsSyncStatus('error').catch(() => {});
    revalidatePath('/analytics-settings');
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'GA4 sync failed',
    };
  }
}

export async function runGA4DiagnosticsAction(): Promise<
  { ok: true; data: GA4DiagnosticResult } | { ok: false; error: string }
> {
  const result = await requireSuperadminActionSafe();
  if (!result.ok) return result;
  const user = result.user;

  const limited = await consumeRateLimit({
    key: `ga4-diagnostics:${user.id}`,
    limit: 5,
    windowMs: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });
  if (!limited.ok) return { ok: false, error: `Too many requests. Retry in ${limited.retryAfterSeconds}s.` };

  try {
    const data = await runGA4Diagnostics();
    return { ok: true, data };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Diagnostic failed unexpectedly.' };
  }
}

'use server';

import { requireSuperadminActionSafe } from '@/lib/auth/require-superadmin-action';
import { fetchGA4DashboardData, getDateRangeForPreset } from '@/lib/ga4/reporting';
import type { GA4DashboardData } from '@/lib/ga4/reporting';

export async function getAnalyticsReportAction(
  preset: 'today' | '7d' | '30d'
): Promise<{ ok: true; data: GA4DashboardData } | { ok: false; error: string }> {
  const result = await requireSuperadminActionSafe();
  if (!result.ok) return result;

  try {
    const dateRange = getDateRangeForPreset(preset);
    const data = await fetchGA4DashboardData(dateRange);
    return { ok: true, data };
  } catch (e) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to load analytics',
    };
  }
}

import { SuperAdminCollegeService } from '@/lib/superadmin/analytics/services/college'
import { KPIWidget, PremiumCard } from '@/components/analytics/premium-card'
import { AnalyticsBarChart } from '@/components/analytics/charts'
import { DateRangeFilter } from '@/components/analytics/filters'
import { Building, Users, GraduationCap, Link as LinkIcon } from 'lucide-react'

export const revalidate = 300

type SearchParams = Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>

function resolveDateFilters(searchParams: SearchParams): { startDate?: string; endDate?: string } {
  const range = typeof searchParams.range === 'string' ? searchParams.range : undefined
  if (!range || range === 'all') return {}
  const end = new Date()
  end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999)
  const start = new Date(end)
  if (range === 'today') {
    start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)
  } else if (range === '7d') {
    start.setDate(start.getDate() - 6)
    start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)
  } else if (range === '30d') {
    start.setDate(start.getDate() - 29)
    start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)
  } else {
    return {}
  }
  return {
    startDate: start.toISOString(),
    endDate: end.toISOString(),
  }
}

export default async function CollegesAnalyticsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams?: Promise<SearchParams>
}) {
  const resolvedSearchParams = (await searchParams) ?? {}
  const filters = resolveDateFilters(resolvedSearchParams)
  const colleges = await SuperAdminCollegeService.getCollegePerformance(filters)
  const topColleges = colleges.slice(0, 10)

  const chartData = topColleges.map(c => ({
    name: c.collegeName,
    students: c.activeStudents
  }))

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-end">
        <DateRangeFilter />
      </div>

      {colleges.length === 0 && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/30 p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          No college analytics found for this date range. Try <span className="font-medium text-foreground">All time</span> or verify rows in `student_entitlements`.
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <KPIWidget
          title="Partner Colleges"
          value={colleges.length}
          icon={Building}
          trend={5}
        />
        <KPIWidget
          title="Total B2B Students"
          value={colleges.reduce((sum, c) => sum + c.activeStudents, 0).toLocaleString()}
          icon={Users}
        />
        <KPIWidget
          title="Avg Entitlements/College"
          value={colleges.length ? Math.round(colleges.reduce((sum, c) => sum + c.totalEntitlements, 0) / colleges.length) : 0}
          icon={GraduationCap}
        />
        <KPIWidget
          title="Active Integrations"
          value={colleges.filter(c => c.activeStudents > 0).length}
          icon={LinkIcon}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-7">
        <div className="col-span-4">
          <AnalyticsBarChart
            title="Top Colleges by Active Students"
            data={chartData}
            xKey="name"
            yKey="students"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="col-span-3">
          <PremiumCard className="h-full p-6 overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white mb-4">College Breakdown</h3>
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto pr-2 space-y-4">
              {topColleges.map(c => (
                <div key={c.collegeId} className="flex justify-between items-center pb-2 border-b border-white/5 last:border-0">
                  <span className="text-zinc-300 truncate max-w-[150px]">{c.collegeName}</span>
                  <span className="text-white font-mono">{c.activeStudents}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </PremiumCard>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { SuperAdminContentService } from '@/lib/superadmin/analytics/services/content'
import { KPIWidget, PremiumCard } from '@/components/analytics/premium-card'
import { AnalyticsBarChart } from '@/components/analytics/charts'
import { DateRangeFilter } from '@/components/analytics/filters'
import { PlayCircle, Award, BarChart3, Clock } from 'lucide-react'

export const revalidate = 300

type SearchParams = Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>

function resolveDateFilters(searchParams: SearchParams): { startDate?: string; endDate?: string } {
  const range = typeof searchParams.range === 'string' ? searchParams.range : undefined
  if (!range || range === 'all') return {}
  const end = new Date()
  end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999)
  const start = new Date(end)
  if (range === 'today') {
    start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)
  } else if (range === '7d') {
    start.setDate(start.getDate() - 6)
    start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)
  } else if (range === '30d') {
    start.setDate(start.getDate() - 29)
    start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)
  } else {
    return {}
  }
  return {
    startDate: start.toISOString(),
    endDate: end.toISOString(),
  }
}

export default async function ContentAnalyticsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams?: Promise<SearchParams>
}) {
  const resolvedSearchParams = (await searchParams) ?? {}
  const filters = resolveDateFilters(resolvedSearchParams)
  const [performance, lowest] = await Promise.all([
    SuperAdminContentService.getTopPerformingContent(10, filters),
    SuperAdminContentService.getLowestCompletionContent(5, filters)
  ])

  const watchData = performance.map(p => ({
    name: p.itemTitle,
    watches: p.totalWatchedSeconds / 3600
  }))

  const completionData = performance.map(p => ({
    name: p.itemTitle,
    rate: Math.round(p.completionRate)
  }))
  const totalStarts = performance.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.studentsStarted, 0)
  const totalCompleted = performance.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.studentsCompleted, 0)
  const totalWatchedSeconds = performance.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.totalWatchedSeconds, 0)
  const globalCompletionRate = totalStarts > 0 ? (totalCompleted / totalStarts) * 100 : 0
  const avgWatchHoursPerStarter = totalStarts > 0 ? totalWatchedSeconds / 3600 / totalStarts : 0
  const hasAnyData = performance.length > 0

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-end">
        <DateRangeFilter />
      </div>

      {!hasAnyData && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/30 p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          No content analytics found for this date range. Try <span className="font-medium text-foreground">All time</span> or verify rows in `student_progress`.
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <KPIWidget
          title="Total Content Views"
          value={totalStarts.toLocaleString()}
          icon={PlayCircle}
        />
        <KPIWidget
          title="Global Completion Rate"
          value={`${globalCompletionRate.toFixed(1)}%`}
          icon={Award}
        />
        <KPIWidget
          title="Avg Watch Time"
          value={`${avgWatchHoursPerStarter.toFixed(1)}h`}
          icon={Clock}
        />
        <KPIWidget
          title="Active Modules"
          value={performance.length}
          icon={BarChart3}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
        <AnalyticsBarChart
          title="Top Content by Watch Time (Hours)"
          data={watchData}
          xKey="name"
          yKey="watches"
          formatterKey="hours-1dp"
        />
        
        <AnalyticsBarChart
          title="Highest Completion Rates (%)"
          data={completionData}
          xKey="name"
          yKey="rate"
          formatterKey="percent"
        />
      </div>

      <PremiumCard className="p-6">
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white mb-4">Content Needing Attention (Low Completion)</h3>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {lowest.map(l => (
            <div key={l.itemId} className="flex justify-between items-center pb-3 border-b border-white/5 last:border-0">
              <div>
                <p className="text-white font-medium">{l.itemTitle}</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">{l.studentsStarted} starts</p>
              </div>
              <div className="text-right">
                <p className="text-rose-400 font-mono">{l.completionRate.toFixed(1)}%</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </PremiumCard>
    </div>
  )
}

      )}

          icon={Users}

          icon={Building2}
        />
        <KPIWidget
          title="Expired Access"
          value={overview.expiredEntitlements.toLocaleString()}
          icon={XCircle}

import { SuperAdminOperationalService } from '@/lib/superadmin/analytics/services/operational'
import { KPIWidget, PremiumCard } from '@/components/analytics/premium-card'
import { AnalyticsPieChart } from '@/components/analytics/charts'
import { DateRangeFilter } from '@/components/analytics/filters'
import { Activity, AlertTriangle, RefreshCcw, Ticket } from 'lucide-react'

export const revalidate = 300

type SearchParams = Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>

function resolveDateFilters(searchParams: SearchParams): { startDate?: string; endDate?: string } {
  const range = typeof searchParams.range === 'string' ? searchParams.range : undefined
  if (!range || range === 'all') return {}
  const end = new Date()
  end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999)
  const start = new Date(end)
  if (range === 'today') {
    start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)
  } else if (range === '7d') {
    start.setDate(start.getDate() - 6)
    start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)
  } else if (range === '30d') {
    start.setDate(start.getDate() - 29)
    start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)
  } else {
    return {}
  }
  return {
    startDate: start.toISOString(),
    endDate: end.toISOString(),
  }
}

export default async function OperationsAnalyticsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams?: Promise<SearchParams>
}) {
  const resolvedSearchParams = (await searchParams) ?? {}
  const filters = resolveDateFilters(resolvedSearchParams)
  const ops = await SuperAdminOperationalService.getOperationalMetrics(filters)

  const webhookData = [
    { name: 'Success', value: ops.webhooks.success },
    { name: 'Failed', value: ops.webhooks.failed }
  ]
  const hasAnyData = ops.failedPayments > 0 || ops.refundEvents > 0 || ops.couponUsages > 0 || ops.webhooks.total > 0

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-end">
        <DateRangeFilter />
      </div>

      {!hasAnyData && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/30 p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          No operational events found for this date range. Try <span className="font-medium text-foreground">All time</span> or verify data in `payments`, `refund_events`, `coupon_usages`, and `webhook_audit_logs`.
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <KPIWidget
          title="Payment Failures"
          value={ops.failedPayments.toLocaleString()}
          icon={AlertTriangle}
          trend={-12}
          trendLabel="reduction"
        />
        <KPIWidget
          title="Refund Events"
          value={ops.refundEvents.toLocaleString()}
          icon={RefreshCcw}
        />
        <KPIWidget
          title="Coupons Used"
          value={ops.couponUsages.toLocaleString()}
          icon={Ticket}
          trend={24.5}
        />
        <KPIWidget
          title="Webhook Success Rate"
          value={ops.webhooks.total > 0 ? `${((ops.webhooks.success / ops.webhooks.total) * 100).toFixed(1)}%` : '100%'}
          icon={Activity}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
        <AnalyticsPieChart 
          title="Webhook Deliverability" 
          data={webhookData} 
          nameKey="name"
          dataKey="value"
        />

        <PremiumCard className="p-6 flex flex-col justify-center text-center">
          <div className="mx-auto mb-4 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 p-4 ring-1 ring-emerald-500/20">
            <Activity className="h-10 w-10 text-emerald-400" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-2">Systems Operational</h3>
          <p className="text-zinc-400 max-w-sm mx-auto text-sm">
            All core services, including payment gateways, webhook delivery, and entitlement provisioning are functioning normally.
          </p>
        </PremiumCard>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/app/(app)/appeals/actions.ts ---
'use server';

import { revalidateTag } from 'next/cache';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { requireSuperadminAction } from '@/lib/auth/require-superadmin-action';
import {
  listModuleAccessAppeals,
  updateModuleAccessAppeal,
  approveAndUnlock,
  type AppealStatus,
} from '@/lib/services/module-appeals';
import { consumeRateLimit } from '@/lib/security/rate-limit';

const appealFiltersSchema = z.object({
  collegeId: z.string().uuid('Invalid college id.').nullable().optional(),
  moduleKey: z.string().trim().max(100).nullable().optional(),
  status: z.enum(['pending', 'in_review', 'approved', 'rejected']).nullable().optional(),
  requesterRole: z.enum(['college_admin', 'student']).nullable().optional(),
});
const updateAppealSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string().uuid('Invalid appeal id.'),
  status: z.enum(['pending', 'in_review', 'approved', 'rejected']),
  response: z.string().trim().max(2000, 'Response is too long.').nullable().optional(),
});
const approveUnlockSchema = z.object({
  appealId: z.string().uuid('Invalid appeal id.'),
  unlockFor: z.enum(['college_admin', 'student', 'both']),
  response: z.string().trim().max(2000, 'Response is too long.').nullable().optional(),
});

export interface ListAppealsFilters {
  collegeId?: string | null;
  moduleKey?: string | null;
  status?: AppealStatus | null;
  requesterRole?: 'college_admin' | 'student' | null;
}

export async function listAppealsAction(filters: ListAppealsFilters = {}) {
  await requireSuperadminAction();
  const parsed = appealFiltersSchema.safeParse(filters);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    throw new Error(parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Invalid filters.');
  }
  return listModuleAccessAppeals(parsed.data);
}

export async function updateAppealStatusAction(
  id: string,
  status: AppealStatus,
  response?: string | null
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const user = await requireSuperadminAction();
    const limited = await consumeRateLimit({
      key: `update-appeal-status:${user.id}`,
      limit: 30,
      windowMs: 10 * 60 * 1000,
    });
    if (!limited.ok) return { ok: false, error: `Too many requests. Retry in ${limited.retryAfterSeconds}s.` };

    const parsed = updateAppealSchema.safeParse({ id, status, response });
    if (!parsed.success) return { ok: false, error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Invalid input.' };

    await updateModuleAccessAppeal(id, {
      status: parsed.data.status,
      super_admin_response: parsed.data.response ?? null,
      reviewedBy: user.id,
    });
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (e) {
    const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Update failed';
    if (message.includes('Unauthorized') || message.includes('Forbidden')) {
      return { ok: false, error: message };
    }
    return { ok: false, error: 'Update failed' };
  }
}

export async function approveAndUnlockAction(
  appealId: string,
  unlockFor: 'college_admin' | 'student' | 'both',
  response?: string | null
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const user = await requireSuperadminAction();
    const limited = await consumeRateLimit({
      key: `approve-unlock-appeal:${user.id}`,
      limit: 20,
      windowMs: 10 * 60 * 1000,
    });
    if (!limited.ok) return { ok: false, error: `Too many requests. Retry in ${limited.retryAfterSeconds}s.` };

    const parsed = approveUnlockSchema.safeParse({ appealId, unlockFor, response });
    if (!parsed.success) return { ok: false, error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Invalid input.' };

    await approveAndUnlock(parsed.data.appealId, parsed.data.unlockFor, user.id, parsed.data.response);
    revalidateTag('tenant-module-overlay', 'max');
    revalidateTag('student-module-access', 'max');
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (e) {
    const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Action failed';
    if (message.includes('Unauthorized') || message.includes('Forbidden')) {
      return { ok: false, error: message };
    }
    return { ok: false, error: 'Action failed' };
  }
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/app/(app)/assignments/actions.ts ---
'use server';

import { requireSuperadminActionSafe } from '@/lib/auth/require-superadmin-action';
import {
  createAssignment,
  revokeAssignment,
} from '@/lib/services/content-assignments';
import type { ContentAssignmentsRow } from '@/types/database';

export interface ActionResponse<T = unknown> {
  success: boolean;
  data?: T;
  error?: string;
}

export interface CreateAssignmentInput {
  assignment_type: 'college' | 'student';
  target_id: string;
  assigned_entity_type: 'variant' | 'bundle' | 'master_course';
  assigned_entity_id: string;
  start_date?: string;
  end_date?: string;
}

export async function createAssignmentAction(
  input: CreateAssignmentInput,
): Promise<ActionResponse<ContentAssignmentsRow>> {
  await requireSuperadminActionSafe();

  try {
    const { assignment } = await createAssignment({
      assignment_type: input.assignment_type,
      target_id: input.target_id,
      assigned_entity_type: input.assigned_entity_type,
      assigned_entity_id: input.assigned_entity_id,
      start_date: input.start_date,
      end_date: input.end_date,
    });

    return { success: true, data: assignment };
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    return { success: false, error: message };
  }
}

export async function revokeAssignmentAction(
  assignmentId: string,
): Promise<ActionResponse<void>> {
  await requireSuperadminActionSafe();

  try {
    await revokeAssignment(assignmentId);

    return { success: true };
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    return { success: false, error: message };
  }
}

export function AssignmentForm({ colleges, courses, variants, bundles }: AssignmentFormProps) {

  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');
  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState('');
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    assignment_type: 'college',
    target_id: '',
    assigned_entity_type: 'master_course',
    assigned_entity_id: '',
    start_date: '',
    end_date: '',
  });

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const result = await createAssignmentAction({
        assignment_type: formData.assignment_type as 'college' | 'student',
        target_id: formData.target_id,
        assigned_entity_type: formData.assigned_entity_type as 'variant' | 'bundle' | 'master_course',
        assigned_entity_id: formData.assigned_entity_id,
        start_date: formData.start_date || undefined,
        end_date: formData.end_date || undefined,
      });

      if (result.success && result.data) {
        setStatus('success');
        setStatusMessage('Assignment created! Student entitlements have been automatically generated.');
        setTimeout(() => router.push('/assignments'), 1500);
      } else {
        setStatus('error');
        setStatusMessage(result.error || 'Failed to create assignment');
      }
    } catch {
      setStatus('error');
      setStatusMessage('An unexpected error occurred');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      {status !== 'idle' && (
        <Card className={status === 'success' ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200' : 'bg-destructive/10 border-destructive/30'}>
          <CardContent className="pt-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              {status === 'success' ? (
                <CheckCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-emerald-600" />
              ) : (
                <AlertCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-destructive" />
              )}
              <p className={status === 'success' ? 'text-emerald-800 font-medium' : 'text-destructive font-medium'}>
                {statusMessage}
              </p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Assignment Details</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Select the target audience and content to assign. Entitlements will be auto-generated.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-6">
          {/* Assignment Type */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Assign To *</Label>
            <Select
              value={formData.assignment_type}
              onValueChange={(value) =>
                setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, assignment_type: value, target_id: '' }))
              }
            >
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue placeholder="Select target type" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="college">College (All Students)</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="student">Individual Student</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>

          {/* Target Selection */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Target *</Label>
            {formData.assignment_type === 'college' ? (
              <Select
                value={formData.target_id}
                onValueChange={(value) =>
                  setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, target_id: value }))
                }
              >
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Select a college" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {colleges.map((college) => (
                    <SelectItem key={college.id} value={college.id}>
                      {college.name} ({college.slug})
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            ) : (
              <Select
                value={formData.target_id}
                onValueChange={(value) =>
                  setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, target_id: value }))
                }
              >
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Enter student ID" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="manual">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">Enter student ID manually (feature coming soon)</span>
                  </SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Content Type */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Content Type *</Label>
            <Select
              value={formData.assigned_entity_type}
              onValueChange={(value) =>
                setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, assigned_entity_type: value, assigned_entity_id: '' }))
              }
            >
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue placeholder="Select content type" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="master_course">Master Course</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="variant">Course Variant</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="bundle">Course Bundle</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>

          {/* Content Selection */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Content *</Label>
            {formData.assigned_entity_type === 'master_course' && (
              <Select
                value={formData.assigned_entity_id}
                onValueChange={(value) =>
                  setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, assigned_entity_id: value }))
                }
              >
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Select a master course" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {courses.map((course) => (
                    <SelectItem key={course.id} value={course.id}>
                      {course.title} ({course.code})
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            )}

            {formData.assigned_entity_type === 'variant' && (
              <Select
                value={formData.assigned_entity_id}
                onValueChange={(value) =>
                  setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, assigned_entity_id: value }))
                }
              >
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Select a course variant" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {variants.map((variant) => (
                    <SelectItem key={variant.id} value={variant.id}>
                      {variant.title} ({variant.code})
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            )}

            {formData.assigned_entity_type === 'bundle' && (
              <Select
                value={formData.assigned_entity_id}
                onValueChange={(value) =>
                  setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, assigned_entity_id: value }))
                }
              >
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Select a course bundle" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {bundles.map((bundle) => (
                    <SelectItem key={bundle.id} value={bundle.id}>
                      {bundle.title} ({bundle.code})
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Date Range */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>Start Date (Optional)</Label>
              <Input
                type="date"
                value={formData.start_date ? formData.start_date.split('T')[0] : ''}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setFormData((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    start_date: e.target.value ? new Date(e.target.value).toISOString() : '',
                  }))
                }
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>End Date (Optional)</Label>
              <Input
                type="date"
                value={formData.end_date ? formData.end_date.split('T')[0] : ''}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setFormData((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    end_date: e.target.value ? new Date(e.target.value).toISOString() : '',
                  }))
                }
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Info Callout */}
          <Card className="bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/20 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800">
            <CardContent className="pt-6">
              <p className="text-sm text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-200">
                <strong>Auto-Entitlement:</strong> When you create this assignment, student entitlements will be automatically generated
                for all students in the target college (or the individual student). Entitlements resolve the content path
                (variant → course, or bundle → courses) automatically.
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          {/* Submit */}
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-3">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => router.back()}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting}>
              {isSubmitting && <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />}
              Create Assignment
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </form>
  );
}

function statusBadge(status: string) {
  switch (status) {
    case 'active':
      return <Badge className="bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-500/30 border">Active</Badge>;
    case 'scheduled':
      return <Badge className="bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-700 border-blue-500/30 border">Scheduled</Badge>;
    case 'expired':
      return <Badge className="bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 border-amber-500/30 border">Expired</Badge>;
    case 'revoked':
      return <Badge variant="destructive">Revoked</Badge>;
    default:
      return <Badge variant="secondary">{status}</Badge>;
  }
}

function assignmentTypeIcon(type: string) {
  switch (type) {
    case 'college':
      return <School className="h-4 w-4" />;
    case 'student':
      return <User className="h-4 w-4" />;
    default:
      return <Users className="h-4 w-4" />;
  }
}

    student: assignments.filter((a) => a.assignment_type === 'student').length,
  };

  return (

          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="text-3xl font-semibold">{stats.total}</CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">

'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

export default function AuditError({
  error,
  reset,
}: {
  error: Error & { digest?: string };
  reset: () => void;
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    console.error('[error]', error.message || error.digest || 'Unknown error');
  }, [error]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[240px] gap-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/20 p-8">
      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-destructive">Something went wrong loading audit logs.</p>
      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={reset}>
        Try again
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/app/(app)/audit/page.tsx ---
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { ShieldAlert } from 'lucide-react';

export default async function AuditDashboardPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  // Fetch from the vw_audit_dashboard we created in the migration
  const { data: auditLogs, error } = await supabase
    .from('vw_audit_dashboard')
    .select('*')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(50);

  type AuditLogRow = { id: string; created_at: string; severity: string; action: string; actor_email?: string; resource_type: string; college_name?: string; payload?: Record<string, unknown> };

  const getSeverityBadge = (severity: string) => {
    switch (severity) {
      case 'critical': return <Badge variant="destructive">Critical</Badge>;
      case 'warning': return <Badge variant="default" className="bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600 px-2">Warning</Badge>;
      default: return <Badge variant="secondary" className="px-2">Info</Badge>;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 p-6">

      <Card className="shadow-sm">
        <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center border-b pb-4">
          <ShieldAlert className="h-5 w-5 mr-2 text-indigo-500" />
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <CardTitle>Recent Activity</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Last 50 recorded system events</CardDescription>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="pt-4 p-0">
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow className="bg-muted/50">
                <TableHead className="w-[120px]">Timestamp</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Severity</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Action</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Actor</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Target</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[30%]">Metadata (Payload)</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {error ? (
                 <TableRow><TableCell colSpan={6} className="text-center text-destructive py-6">Could not load audit logs. Check database connection.</TableCell></TableRow>
              ) : (!auditLogs || auditLogs.length === 0) ? (
                <TableRow><TableCell colSpan={6} className="text-center text-muted-foreground py-6">No audit events recorded.</TableCell></TableRow>
              ) : (
                auditLogs.map((log: AuditLogRow) => (
                  <TableRow key={log.id} className="hover:bg-muted/30">
                    <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">
                      {new Date(log.created_at).toLocaleString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit'})}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>{getSeverityBadge(log.severity)}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="font-medium whitespace-nowrap">{log.action}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="max-w-[150px] truncate" title={log.actor_email || 'System'}>
                      {log.actor_email || <span className="text-muted-foreground italic">System</span>}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-sm">
                      <div className="truncate max-w-[150px] font-mono text-xs">{log.resource_type}</div>
                      <div className="truncate max-w-[150px] text-muted-foreground">{log.college_name || 'Global'}</div>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      <div className="max-w-[300px] truncate" title={log.payload ? JSON.stringify(log.payload) : ''}>
                        {log.payload ? JSON.stringify(log.payload) : '-'}
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))
              )}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

export function BundleContentPicker({ bundleId, existingItems }: BundleContentPickerProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; message: string } | null>(null);

  const [pillars, setPillars] = useState<PickerPillar[]>([]);
  const [selectedPillarId, setSelectedPillarId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [courses, setCourses] = useState<PickerCourse[]>([]);
  const [expandedCourseId, setExpandedCourseId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [courseVariants, setCourseVariants] = useState<PickerCourseVariant[]>([]);
  const [courseModules, setCourseModules] = useState<PickerCourseModule[]>([]);
  const [bundles, setBundles] = useState<PickerBundle[]>([]);
  const [loadingPillars, setLoadingPillars] = useState(true);
  const [loadingCourses, setLoadingCourses] = useState(false);
  const [loadingDetails, setLoadingDetails] = useState(false);
  const [selectedSourceBundleId, setSelectedSourceBundleId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [cart, setCart] = useState<CartItem[]>([]);

  const existingRefSet = useMemo(() => new Set(existingItems.map((i) => `${i.item_type}:${i.reference_id}`)), [existingItems]);
  const cartRefSet = useMemo(() => new Set(cart.map((c) => `${c.item_type}:${c.reference_id}`)), [cart]);

  const isAlreadyAdded = useCallback(
    (type: string, refId: string) => existingRefSet.has(`${type}:${refId}`) || cartRefSet.has(`${type}:${refId}`),
    [existingRefSet, cartRefSet],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchPillarsForBundlePicker().then((res) => {
      if ('pillars' in res) setPillars(res.pillars);
      setLoadingPillars(false);
    });
    fetchBundlesForBundlePicker(bundleId).then((res) => {
      if ('bundles' in res) setBundles(res.bundles);
    });
  }, [bundleId]);

  const handleImportBundleContents = useCallback(() => {
    if (!selectedSourceBundleId) return;
    startTransition(async () => {
      setFeedback(null);
      const result = await importBundleContentsAction(bundleId, selectedSourceBundleId);
      if (result.success && result.data) {
        setFeedback({
          type: 'success',
          message: `Imported ${result.data.importedItemCount} items from "${result.data.sourceBundleTitle}". Skipped ${result.data.skippedDuplicateCount} duplicates.`,
        });
        setSelectedSourceBundleId(null);
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: result.error ?? 'Failed to import bundle contents' });
      }
    });
  }, [bundleId, selectedSourceBundleId, router]);

  const handleSelectPillar = useCallback((pillarId: string) => {
    setSelectedPillarId(pillarId);
    setExpandedCourseId(null);
    setCourseVariants([]);
    setCourseModules([]);
    setLoadingCourses(true);
    fetchCoursesForPillar(pillarId).then((res) => {
      if ('courses' in res) setCourses(res.courses);
      setLoadingCourses(false);
    });
  }, []);

  const handleExpandCourse = useCallback((courseId: string) => {
    if (expandedCourseId === courseId) {
      setExpandedCourseId(null);
      return;
    }
    setExpandedCourseId(courseId);
    setLoadingDetails(true);
    fetchCourseDetailsForBundlePicker(courseId).then((res) => {
      if ('variants' in res) {
        setCourseVariants(res.variants);
        setCourseModules(res.modules);
      }
      setLoadingDetails(false);
    });
  }, [expandedCourseId]);

  const addToCart = useCallback((item: CartItem) => {
    setCart((prev) => {
      const key = `${item.item_type}:${item.reference_id}`;
      if (prev.some((c) => `${c.item_type}:${c.reference_id}` === key)) return prev;
      return [...prev, item];
    });
  }, []);

  const removeFromCart = useCallback((index: number) => {
    setCart((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  }, []);

  const handleSubmitCart = useCallback(() => {
    if (cart.length === 0) return;
    startTransition(async () => {
      setFeedback(null);
      const result = await addBundleItemsAction({
        bundle_id: bundleId,
        items: cart.map((c, i) => ({
          item_type: c.item_type,
          reference_id: c.reference_id,
          sort_order: existingItems.length + i,
        })),
      });

      if (result.success) {
        setFeedback({ type: 'success', message: `Added ${cart.length} item(s) to bundle.` });
        setCart([]);
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: result.error ?? 'Failed to add items' });
      }
    });
  }, [cart, bundleId, existingItems.length, router]);

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Plus className="h-5 w-5" />
              Add Content to Bundle
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription className="mt-1">
              Browse pillars, courses, variants, and items to compose this bundle.
            </CardDescription>
          </div>
          {cart.length > 0 && (
            <Button onClick={handleSubmitCart} disabled={isPending} size="sm">
              {isPending && <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />}
              <ShoppingCart className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              Add {cart.length} to Bundle
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-3">
        {feedback && (
          <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-sm p-3 rounded-md ${
            feedback.type === 'success'
              ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200'
              : 'bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border border-destructive/30'
          }`}>
            {feedback.type === 'success' ? <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" /> : <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />}
            {feedback.message}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Cart preview */}
        {cart.length > 0 && (
          <div className="border rounded-md p-3 bg-muted/30">
            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-2">
              Cart ({cart.length} item{cart.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''})
            </p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              {cart.map((c, i) => (
                <Badge key={i} variant="secondary" className="flex items-center gap-1 pr-1">
                  <TypeIcon type={c.item_type} />
                  <span className="max-w-[150px] truncate">{c.label}</span>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => removeFromCart(i)}
                    className="ml-0.5 rounded-full hover:bg-muted p-0.5"
                  >
                    <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                  </button>
                </Badge>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
          {/* Left column: Pillar list + Import Bundle */}
          <div className="space-y-3 md:col-span-1">
            {/* Pillar list */}
            <div className="border rounded-md">
              <div className="px-3 py-2 border-b bg-muted/30">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium">Pillars</p>
              </div>
              <ScrollArea className="h-[240px]">
                {loadingPillars ? (
                  <div className="flex justify-center py-8"><Loader2 className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" /></div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="p-1">
                    {pillars.map((p) => (
                      <button
                        key={p.id}
                        onClick={() => handleSelectPillar(p.id)}
                        className={`w-full text-left px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded text-sm flex items-center justify-between ${
                          selectedPillarId === p.id ? 'bg-primary/10 text-primary font-medium' : 'hover:bg-muted/50'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <span className="truncate">{p.title}</span>
                        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] ml-2 shrink-0">{p.course_count}</Badge>
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </ScrollArea>
            </div>

            {/* Import Bundle section */}
            <Collapsible>
              <CollapsibleTrigger asChild>
                <Button variant="outline" className="w-full justify-between text-xs">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Package className="h-3 w-3" />
                    Import from Bundle
                  </span>
                  <ChevronDown className="h-3 w-3" />
                </Button>
              </CollapsibleTrigger>
              <CollapsibleContent className="border rounded-md mt-2">
                <ScrollArea className="h-[160px]">
                  {bundles.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="text-center py-6 text-xs text-muted-foreground">No bundles available</div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="p-1">
                      {bundles.map((bundle) => {
                        const isSelected = selectedSourceBundleId === bundle.id;
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={bundle.id}
                            onClick={() => setSelectedSourceBundleId(isSelected ? null : bundle.id)}
                            className={`w-full text-left px-2 py-1.5 rounded text-xs flex items-center gap-1 ${
                              isSelected ? 'bg-primary/10 text-primary' : 'hover:bg-muted/50'
                            }`}
                          >
                            <Package className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" />
                            <span className="flex-1 truncate">{bundle.title}</span>
                            <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] shrink-0">{bundle.item_count}</Badge>
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </ScrollArea>
                {selectedSourceBundleId && (
                  <div className="p-2 border-t">
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                      This imports the selected bundle&apos;s contents. It does not create a nested bundle reference.
                    </p>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      className="w-full text-xs"
                      onClick={handleImportBundleContents}
                      disabled={isPending}
                    >
                      {isPending && <Loader2 className="mr-1 h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />}
                      Import contents
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </CollapsibleContent>
            </Collapsible>
          </div>

          {/* Courses list */}
          <div className="border rounded-md md:col-span-3">
            <div className="px-3 py-2 border-b bg-muted/30">
              <p className="text-xs font-medium">
                {selectedPillarId ? 'Courses' : 'Select a pillar'}
              </p>
            </div>
            <ScrollArea className="h-[300px]">
              {loadingCourses ? (
                <div className="flex justify-center py-8"><Loader2 className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" /></div>
              ) : !selectedPillarId ? (
                <div className="text-center py-8 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  Choose a pillar to browse courses.
                </div>
              ) : courses.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="text-center py-8 text-sm text-muted-foreground">No courses in this pillar.</div>
              ) : (
                <div className="p-1 space-y-0.5">
                  {courses.map((course) => {
                    const courseAdded = isAlreadyAdded('master_course', course.id);
                    const isExpanded = expandedCourseId === course.id;
                    return (
                      <div key={course.id}>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-1.5 rounded hover:bg-muted/50">
                          <button onClick={() => handleExpandCourse(course.id)} className="shrink-0">
                            {isExpanded ? <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4" /> : <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />}
                          </button>
                          <BookOpen className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                          <span className="flex-1 text-sm truncate">{course.title}</span>
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] shrink-0">{course.module_count} mod</Badge>
                          {courseAdded ? (
                            <Badge className="bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 text-[10px] border-0">Added</Badge>
                          ) : (
                            <Button
                              size="sm"
                              variant="ghost"
                              className="h-6 text-xs px-2"
                              onClick={() => addToCart({
                                item_type: 'master_course',
                                reference_id: course.id,
                                label: course.title,
                                sublabel: 'Full Course',
                              })}
                            >
                              <Plus className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" /> Course
                            </Button>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {isExpanded && (
                          <div className="ml-6 mb-2 space-y-1">
                            {loadingDetails ? (
                              <div className="py-3 flex justify-center"><Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" /></div>
                            ) : (
                              <>
                                {courseVariants.length > 0 && (
                                  <div className="space-y-0.5">
                                    <p className="text-[10px] font-medium text-muted-foreground px-2 pt-1">VARIANTS</p>
                                    {courseVariants.map((v) => {
                                      const vAdded = isAlreadyAdded('variant', v.id);
                                      return (
                                        <div key={v.id} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-muted/30 text-sm">
                                          <GitBranch className="h-3 w-3 text-purple-500 shrink-0" />
                                          <span className="flex-1 truncate">{v.title}</span>
                                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px]">{v.item_count} items</Badge>
                                          {vAdded ? (
                                            <Badge className="bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 text-[10px] border-0">Added</Badge>
                                          ) : (
                                            <Button
                                              size="sm"
                                              variant="ghost"
                                              className="h-6 text-xs px-2"
                                              onClick={() => addToCart({
                                                item_type: 'variant',
                                                reference_id: v.id,
                                                label: v.title,
                                                sublabel: 'Variant',
                                              })}
                                            >
                                              <Plus className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" /> Variant
                                            </Button>
                                          )}
                                        </div>
                                      );
                                    })}
                                    <Separator className="my-1" />
                                  </div>
                                )}

                                {courseModules.map((mod) => (
                                  <ModuleSection
                                    key={mod.id}
                                    mod={mod}
                                    isAlreadyAdded={isAlreadyAdded}
                                    addToCart={addToCart}
                                    courseName={courses.find((c) => c.id === expandedCourseId)?.title ?? ''}
                                  />
                                ))}
                              </>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
            </ScrollArea>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

function ModuleSection({
  mod,
  isAlreadyAdded,
  addToCart,
  courseName,
}: {
  mod: PickerCourseModule;
  isAlreadyAdded: (type: string, refId: string) => boolean;
  addToCart: (item: CartItem) => void;
  courseName: string;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <Collapsible open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <CollapsibleTrigger className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-muted/30 w-full text-left text-sm">
        {open ? <ChevronDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
        <Layers className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground" />
        <span className="flex-1 truncate font-medium">{mod.title}</span>
        <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">{mod.items.length}</Badge>
      </CollapsibleTrigger>
      <CollapsibleContent>
        <div className="ml-6 space-y-0.5 pb-1">
          {mod.items.map((item) => {
            const added = isAlreadyAdded('master_course_item', item.id);
            return (
              <div key={item.id} className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-sm ${
                added ? 'opacity-50' : 'hover:bg-muted/20'
              }`}>
                <ItemTypeIcon type={item.item_type} />
                <span className="flex-1 truncate">{item.title}</span>
                {item.duration_seconds != null && item.duration_seconds > 0 && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                    {Math.floor(item.duration_seconds / 60)}m
                  </span>
                )}
                {added ? (
                  <Badge className="bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 text-[10px] border-0">Added</Badge>
                ) : (
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="ghost"
                    className="h-5 text-[10px] px-1.5"
                    onClick={() => addToCart({
                      item_type: 'master_course_item',
                      reference_id: item.id,
                      label: item.title,
                      sublabel: `${courseName} / ${mod.title}`,
                    })}
                  >
                    <Plus className="h-3 w-3" />
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </CollapsibleContent>
    </Collapsible>
  );
}

function TypeIcon({ type }: { type: string }) {
  switch (type) {
    case 'master_course': return <BookOpen className="h-3 w-3 text-blue-500" />;
    case 'variant': return <GitBranch className="h-3 w-3 text-purple-500" />;
    default: return <FileText className="h-3 w-3 text-orange-500" />;
  }
}

function ItemTypeIcon({ type }: { type: string }) {
  switch (type) {
    case 'video': return <Video className="h-3 w-3 text-blue-400" />;
    case 'document': return <FileText className="h-3 w-3 text-orange-400" />;
    default: return <FileText className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground" />;
  }
}
