              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                {message && (
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-[#E8541A]/20 bg-[#E8541A]/0.05 p-2 text-center text-[10px] font-semibold text-[#c2410c] dark:text-[#ffb38a]">
                    {message}
                  </div>
                )}
                {displayError && (
                  <div className={cn("rounded-lg p-2 text-center text-[10px] font-semibold animate-shake", isDark ? "border-red-500/20 bg-red-950/10 text-red-400" : "border-red-100 bg-red-50 text-red-600")}>
                    {displayError}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-4">
                <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab} className="w-full">
                  <TabsList className="sr-only"><TabsTrigger value="login">Sign in</TabsTrigger></TabsList>
                  <TabsContent value="login" className="mt-0 outline-none">
                    <form onSubmit={handleLogin} className="space-y-4">
                      <div className="space-y-3 text-left">
                        <div className="space-y-1.5">
                          <label htmlFor="login-email" className={cn("text-xs font-semibold px-0.5", headingText)}>Email</label>
                          <Input id="login-email" type="email" value={loginEmail} onChange={(e) => setLoginEmail(e.target.value)} required placeholder="xyz@gmail.com" className={cn("h-11 rounded-lg border px-3 transition-all", isDark ? "border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-white" : "border-orange-100 bg-[#fcf8f1] text-zinc-900")} autoComplete="email" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="space-y-1.5">
                          <label htmlFor="login-password" className={cn("text-xs font-semibold px-0.5", headingText)}>Password</label>
                          <div className="relative group">
                            <Input id="login-password" type={showLoginPassword ? "text" : "password"} value={loginPassword} onChange={(e) => setLoginPassword(e.target.value)} required placeholder="Password" className={cn("h-11 rounded-lg border px-3 transition-all", isDark ? "border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-white" : "border-orange-100 bg-[#fcf8f1] text-zinc-900")} autoComplete="current-password" />
                            <button type="button" className={cn("absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2", iconMuted, "hover:text-[#E8541A] transition-colors")} onClick={() => setShowLoginPassword((v) => !v)}>
                              {showLoginPassword ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <Link href="/forgot-password" className="text-xs font-medium text-orange-800/80 hover:text-[#E8541A] transition-all">Forgot password?</Link>
                        <Link href="/signup" className="text-xs font-medium text-orange-800/80 hover:text-[#E8541A] transition-all font-bold">Sign Up</Link>
                      </div>

                      <Button type="submit" disabled={loading} className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-[#c2541a] hover:bg-[#a84414] text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-md transition-all active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-50">
                        {loading ? "Authenticating..." : "Sign In"}
                      </Button>
                    </form>
                  </TabsContent>
                </Tabs>

                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="relative">
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center"><span className="w-full border-t border-slate-100/50" /></div>
                    <div className="relative flex justify-center text-[10px] font-medium uppercase text-zinc-400">
                      <span className={cn("px-3", isDark ? "bg-[#0c0c0c]" : "bg-white")}>OR</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <Button type="button" variant="outline" className={cn("h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 font-medium transition-all", isDark && "border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-white hover:bg-white/10")} disabled={loading} onClick={handleGoogleContinue}>

                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

}

'use client'

import * as React from 'react'
import { useState } from 'react'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { Eye, EyeOff, Loader2, Mail, Lock, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'

export type PortalType = 'superadmin' | 'college' | 'student'

export interface UnifiedLoginFormProps {
  portalType: PortalType
  title: string
  subtitle: string
  tenantLabel?: string
  heroTitle: string
  heroSubtitle: string
  heroImage?: string
  badgeLabel: string
  forgotPasswordHref?: string
  showGoogleAuth?: boolean
  onGoogleAuth?: () => void
  isLoading?: boolean
  error?: string | null
  onSubmit?: (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => void
  emailValue?: string
  onEmailChange?: (v: string) => void
  passwordValue?: string
  onPasswordChange?: (v: string) => void
  children?: React.ReactNode
}

export function UnifiedLoginForm({
  portalType,
  title,
  subtitle,
  tenantLabel,
  heroTitle,
  heroSubtitle,
  heroImage,
  badgeLabel,
  forgotPasswordHref = '/forgot-password',
  showGoogleAuth = true,
  onGoogleAuth,
  isLoading = false,
  error = null,
  onSubmit,
  emailValue,
  onEmailChange,
  passwordValue,
  onPasswordChange,
  children
}: UnifiedLoginFormProps) {
  const [localShowPassword, setLocalShowPassword] = useState(false)
  const isSuperAdmin = portalType === 'superadmin'

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen w-full flex flex-col lg:flex-row bg-background dark:bg-slate-950 text-foreground transition-colors duration-300">

              N
            </div>
            <span className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">NextGen CTO</span>
          </div>
          
          <div className="space-y-6 max-w-xl mb-8">
            {tenantLabel && (

                {tenantLabel}
              </div>
            )}
            <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl xl:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white leading-[1.1]">
              {heroTitle}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-lg text-slate-300 font-medium max-w-md">
              {heroSubtitle}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* RIGHT SIDE - LOGIN FORM */}
      <div className="flex-[1.2] lg:flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 sm:p-12 lg:p-24 relative bg-surface dark:bg-slate-900/50">
        <div className="lg:hidden absolute top-6 left-6 flex items-center space-x-2">
          <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded-md bg-orange-600 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-white text-sm shadow-sm">
            N
          </div>
          <span className="font-bold tracking-tight">NextGen CTO</span>
        </div>

        <div className="w-full max-w-sm xl:max-w-md space-y-8">
          {/* Form Header */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
              <div className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 dark:bg-orange-500/10 dark:border-orange-500/20 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400">
                {badgeLabel}
              </div>
              {tenantLabel && (
                <div className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:border-slate-700 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                  {tenantLabel}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight">{title}</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-medium">
              {subtitle}
            </p>
          </div>

          {error && (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive rounded-md bg-destructive/10 px-3 py-2 border border-destructive/20 animate-in fade-in">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}

          {children ? (
            children
          ) : (
            <>
              <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-6">
                <div className="space-y-5">
                  <div className="space-y-2 group">
                    <label htmlFor="email" className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground/80 flex items-center gap-2 px-0.5">
                      <Mail className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> EMAIL ADDRESS
                    </label>
                    <Input 
                      id="email"
                      name="email"
                      type="email" 
                      placeholder="name@example.com" 
                      autoComplete="username"
                      required
                      value={emailValue}
                      onChange={(e) => onEmailChange?.(e.target.value)}
                      className="h-14 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/50 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 focus-visible:ring-orange-500/30 focus-visible:border-orange-500 transition-all shadow-sm text-base rounded-xl"
                      disabled={isLoading}
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-2 group">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-0.5">
                      <label htmlFor="password" className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground/80 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> PASSWORD
                      </label>
                      {forgotPasswordHref && (
                        <Link href={forgotPasswordHref} className="text-sm font-bold text-orange-600 hover:text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-500 dark:hover:text-orange-400 transition-colors">
                          Forgot?
                        </Link>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="relative">
                      <Input 
                        id="password"
                        name="password"
                        type={localShowPassword ? "text" : "password"} 
                        placeholder="••••••••" 
                        autoComplete="current-password"
                        required
                        value={passwordValue}
                        onChange={(e) => onPasswordChange?.(e.target.value)}
                        className="h-14 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/50 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 focus-visible:ring-orange-500/30 focus-visible:border-orange-500 transition-all pr-12 shadow-sm text-base rounded-xl"
                        disabled={isLoading}
                      />
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setLocalShowPassword(!localShowPassword)}
                        className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors focus:outline-none p-1 rounded-md"
                        aria-label={localShowPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
                      >
                        {localShowPassword ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <Button 
                  type="submit" 
                  className={`w-full h-14 text-lg font-bold text-white shadow-lg transition-all rounded-xl active:scale-[0.98] ${
                    isSuperAdmin 
                      ? 'bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 shadow-slate-900/20' 
                      : 'bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-700 shadow-orange-600/30'
                    }`}
                  disabled={isLoading}
                >
                  {isLoading ? (
                    <>
                      <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-5 w-5 animate-spin" />
                      Authenticating...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                      Sign In <ArrowRight className="w-5 h-5 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" />
                    </span>
                  )}
                </Button>
                <div className="text-center pt-2">
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                    Don&apos;t have an account?{' '}
                    <Link href="/signup" className="text-orange-600 hover:text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-500 dark:hover:text-orange-400 font-bold hover:underline">
                      Sign Up
                    </Link>
                  </p>
                </div>
              </form>

              {showGoogleAuth && (
                <>
                  <div className="relative pt-2">
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center pt-2">
                      <span className="w-full border-t border-border" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="relative flex justify-center text-xs uppercase">
                      <span className="bg-surface dark:bg-slate-900/50 px-3 text-muted-foreground tracking-wider font-semibold">
                        Or continue with
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <Button 
                    variant="outline" 
                    type="button" 
                    disabled={isLoading}
                    className="w-full h-14 text-lg font-bold shadow-sm border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/80 transition-all rounded-xl hover:scale-[1.01] active:scale-[0.99] flex items-center justify-center gap-3"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (onGoogleAuth) onGoogleAuth()
                      else window.location.href = '/api/auth/google'
                    }}
                  >
                    <svg className="h-6 w-6" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                      <path d="M22.56 12.25c0-.78-.07-1.53-.2-2.25H12v4.26h5.92c-.26 1.37-1.04 2.53-2.21 3.31v2.77h3.57c2.08-1.92 3.28-4.74 3.28-8.09z" fill="#4285F4"/>
                      <path d="M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.57-2.77c-.98.66-2.23 1.06-3.71 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84C3.99 20.53 7.7 23 12 23z" fill="#34A853"/>
                      <path d="M5.84 14.09c-.22-.66-.35-1.36-.35-2.09s.13-1.43.35-2.09V7.07H2.18C1.43 8.55 1 10.22 1 12s.43 3.45 1.18 4.93l3.66-2.84z" fill="#FBBC05"/>
                      <path d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06 0.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.07l3.66 2.84c0.87-2.6 3.3-4.53 6.16-4.53z" fill="#EA4335"/>
                    </svg>
                    Continue with Google

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/college-admin/commerce/coupon-input.tsx ---
'use client';

/**
 * CollegeAdmin Coupon Input — Institutional discount code application.
 * Used exclusively in the CollegeAdmin portal.
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Loader2, Tag, X, Check, Building2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface CollegeCouponValidationResult {
  valid: boolean;
  discountAmountMinor?: number;
  error?: string;
}

export interface CollegeCouponInputProps {
  orderAmountMinor: number;
  onValidate: (code: string, amountMinor: number) => Promise<CollegeCouponValidationResult>;
  onApplied?: (discountAmountMinor: number) => void;
}

// ─── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function CollegeCouponInput({
  orderAmountMinor,
  onValidate,
  onApplied,
}: CollegeCouponInputProps) {
  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
  const [validating, setValidating] = useState(false);
  const [appliedDiscount, setAppliedDiscount] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleApply = async () => {
    if (!code.trim()) return;
    setValidating(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const result = await onValidate(code.trim().toUpperCase(), orderAmountMinor);
      if (result.valid && result.discountAmountMinor) {
        setAppliedDiscount(result.discountAmountMinor);
        onApplied?.(result.discountAmountMinor);
        toast.success('Institutional discount applied!', {
          description: `College saves ₹${(result.discountAmountMinor / 100).toFixed(2)}!`,
        });
      } else {
        setError(result.error ?? 'Invalid institutional discount code');
        toast.error(result.error ?? 'Invalid code');
      }
    } catch {
      setError('Failed to validate code');
    } finally {
      setValidating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRemove = () => {
    setAppliedDiscount(null);
    setCode('');
    setError(null);
    onApplied?.(0);
  };

  if (appliedDiscount) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 border rounded-lg bg-blue-50/30 border-blue-200">
        <Check className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-600" />
        <div className="flex-1">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-blue-800 flex items-center gap-1">
            <Building2 className="h-3 w-3" />
            Institutional discount: {code}
          </p>
          <p className="text-xs text-blue-600">College saves ₹{(appliedDiscount / 100).toFixed(2)}</p>
        </div>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={handleRemove} className="h-6 w-6 p-0">
          <X className="h-3 w-3" />
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <details className="group">
      <summary className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors">
        <Tag className="h-4 w-4" />
        Institutional discount code?
      </summary>
      <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2">
        <Input
          value={code}
          onChange={(e) => { setCode(e.target.value); setError(null); }}
          placeholder="Enter institutional code"
          className="h-9"
          onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handleApply(); }}
        />
        <Button onClick={handleApply} disabled={validating || !code.trim()} size="sm" className="h-9">
          {validating ? <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" /> : 'Apply'}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {error && <p className="text-xs text-destructive mt-1">{error}</p>}
    </details>
  );
}

'use client';

/**
 * CollegeAdmin Order History Table — Institutional purchase history.
 * Used exclusively in the CollegeAdmin portal.
 */

import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Building2, Package } from 'lucide-react';

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface CollegeOrderRecord {
  id: string;
  entity_type: string;
  entity_id: string;
  total_amount_minor: number;
  currency: string;
  status: string;
  created_at: string;
  paid_at: string | null;
  provisioning_status?: 'pending' | 'provisioned' | 'failed';
}

export interface CollegeOrderHistoryTableProps {
  orders: CollegeOrderRecord[];
  isLoading?: boolean;
  onViewOrder?: (orderId: string) => void;
}

// ─── Utilities ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function formatINR(minorUnits: number): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', {
    style: 'currency',
    currency: 'INR',
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(minorUnits / 100);
}

function statusBadge(status: string) {
  const map: Record<string, { label: string; className: string }> = {
    paid: { label: 'Paid', className: 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-500/30' },
    pending: { label: 'Pending', className: 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-700 border-blue-500/30' },
    failed: { label: 'Failed', className: 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-700 border-red-500/30' },
    cancelled: { label: 'Cancelled', className: 'bg-gray-500/10 text-gray-700 border-gray-500/30' },
    refunded: { label: 'Refunded', className: 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 border-amber-500/30' },
  };
  const config = map[status] ?? { label: status, className: '' };
  return <Badge className={config.className}>{config.label}</Badge>;
}

function provisioningBadge(status?: string) {
  const map: Record<string, { label: string; className: string }> = {
    provisioned: { label: 'Provisioned', className: 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-500/30' },
    pending: { label: 'Pending', className: 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-700 border-blue-500/30' },
    failed: { label: 'Failed', className: 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-700 border-red-500/30' },
  };
  const config = map[status ?? ''] ?? { label: '—', className: 'text-muted-foreground' };
  return <Badge variant="outline" className={config.className}>{config.label}</Badge>;
}

// ─── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function CollegeOrderHistoryTable({
  orders,
  isLoading = false,
  onViewOrder,
}: CollegeOrderHistoryTableProps) {
  if (isLoading) {
    return <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">Loading purchase history...</div>;
  }

  if (orders.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="text-center py-12">
        <Building2 className="h-12 w-12 mx-auto text-muted-foreground mb-4" />
        <h3 className="text-lg font-medium">No purchases yet</h3>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
          Browse available packages to provision content for your college.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Table>
      <TableHeader>
        <TableRow>
          <TableHead>Order ID</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Package / Item</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Amount</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Purchase Date</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Provisioning</TableHead>
          <TableHead className="text-right">Actions</TableHead>
        </TableRow>
      </TableHeader>
      <TableBody>
        {orders.map((order) => (
          <TableRow key={order.id}>
            <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{order.id.substring(0, 12)}...</TableCell>
            <TableCell>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm">
                <Package className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground" />
                <span className="capitalize">{order.entity_type.replace('_', ' ')}</span>
              </div>
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell className="font-medium">{formatINR(order.total_amount_minor)}</TableCell>
            <TableCell>{statusBadge(order.status)}</TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {new Date(order.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell>
              {order.status === 'paid' ? provisioningBadge(order.provisioning_status) : '—'}
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-right">
              {onViewOrder && (
                <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => onViewOrder(order.id)}>
                  View
                </Button>
              )}
            </TableCell>
          </TableRow>
        ))}
      </TableBody>
    </Table>
  );
}

  orderId,

  actionText,
  secondaryActionHref,

  return (

  );
}

}

// ─── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function CollegePricingCard({
  title,
  description,
  priceMinor,
  originalPriceMinor,
  features = [],
  badge,
  isLoading = false,
  ctaText,
  onCtaClick,
}: CollegePricingCardProps) {
  const displayPrice = formatINR(priceMinor);
  const displayOriginal = originalPriceMinor ? formatINR(originalPriceMinor) : null;
  const discount = originalPriceMinor
    ? Math.round(((originalPriceMinor - priceMinor) / originalPriceMinor) * 100)
    : null;

  return (
    <Card className="relative transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-lg border-2">
      {badge && (
        <div className="absolute -top-3 right-4">
          <Badge className="bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600">{badge}</Badge>
        </div>
      )}

      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Building2 className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-600" />
          <CardTitle className="text-lg">{title}</CardTitle>
        </div>
        {description && (
          <CardDescription>{description}</CardDescription>
        )}
      </CardHeader>

      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        {/* Price */}
        <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
          <span className="text-3xl font-bold">{displayPrice}</span>
          {displayOriginal && (
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground line-through">
              {displayOriginal}
            </span>
          )}
          {discount && discount > 0 && (
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-blue-600 bg-blue-50">
              College saves {discount}%
            </Badge>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Features */}
        {features.length > 0 && (
          <ul className="space-y-2">
            {features.map((feature, i) => (
              <li key={i} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
                <Check className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-500 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">{feature}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </CardContent>

      <CardFooter>
        <Button
          onClick={onCtaClick}
          disabled={isLoading}
          className="w-full"
          size="lg"
        >
          {isLoading ? (
            <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            <Building2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
          )}
          {isLoading ? 'Processing...' : ctaText ?? `Purchase for College — ${displayPrice}`}
        </Button>
      </CardFooter>
    </Card>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/college-admin/commerce/purchase-button.tsx ---
'use client';

/**
 * CollegeAdmin Purchase Button — Institutional checkout button.
 * Used exclusively in the CollegeAdmin portal. Hardcodes source: "college_admin".
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Loader2, Lock, Building2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { useCollegeRazorpayCheckout, type CollegeRazorpaySuccessResponse } from '@/hooks/college-admin/use-college-razorpay-checkout';

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface CollegePurchaseButtonProps {
  entityType: 'course_variant' | 'course_bundle';
  entityId: string;
  entityName: string;
  entityDescription?: string;
  amountMinor: number;
  purchaserEmail: string;
  purchaserUserId?: string;
  couponCode?: string;
  collegeId?: string;
  onSuccess: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onFailure?: (error: Error) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  buttonText?: string;
}

// ─── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function CollegePurchaseButton({
  entityType,
  entityId,
  entityName,
  entityDescription,
  amountMinor,
  purchaserEmail,
  purchaserUserId,
  couponCode,
  collegeId,
  onSuccess,
  onFailure,
  disabled = false,
  buttonText,
}: CollegePurchaseButtonProps) {
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const { loading: scriptLoading, checkout } = useCollegeRazorpayCheckout();

  const handlePurchase = async () => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    try {
      const orderResponse = await fetch('/api/college-admin/orders', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          entity_type: entityType,
          entity_id: entityId,
          purchaser_email: purchaserEmail,
          purchaser_user_id: purchaserUserId,
          source: 'college_admin',
          coupon_code: couponCode,
          metadata: { entity_name: entityName, college_id: collegeId },
        }),
      });

      if (!orderResponse.ok) {
        const errorData = await orderResponse.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.error ?? 'Failed to create order');
      }

      const orderData = await orderResponse.json();

      await checkout({
        orderId: orderData.order_id,
        gatewayOrderId: orderData.gateway_order_id,
        razorpayKey: orderData.razorpay_key,
        amountMinor: orderData.amount_minor,
        currency: orderData.currency,
        entityName: entityName,
        entityDescription: entityDescription,
        purchaserEmail: purchaserEmail,
        onSuccess: async (response: CollegeRazorpaySuccessResponse) => {
          try {
            const verifyResponse = await fetch('/api/college-admin/payments/verify', {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({
                order_id: orderData.order_id,
                gateway_order_id: response.razorpay_order_id,
                gateway_payment_id: response.razorpay_payment_id,
                gateway_signature: response.razorpay_signature,
              }),
            });
            const verifyData = await verifyResponse.json();
            if (verifyData.success) {
              toast.success('Payment successful! Provisioning college access.', {
                description: `Order ${orderData.order_id.substring(0, 8)}...`,
              });
              await onSuccess();
            } else {
              throw new Error(verifyData.message ?? 'Verification failed');
            }
          } catch (error) {
            toast.error('Payment verification failed', {
              description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Contact support',
            });
            onFailure?.(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error('Verification failed'));
          }
        },
        onFailure: (error: Error) => {
          toast.error('Payment failed', { description: error.message });
          onFailure?.(error);
          setIsProcessing(false);
        },
        onDismiss: () => {
          toast.info('Checkout cancelled');
          setIsProcessing(false);
        },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unexpected error';
      toast.error('Failed to start checkout', { description: message });
      onFailure?.(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(message));
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const isLoading = isProcessing || scriptLoading;
  const displayPrice = `₹${(amountMinor / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
  const displayText = buttonText ?? (isLoading ? 'Processing...' : `Purchase — ${displayPrice}`);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
          <Building2 className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
          Institutional Purchase
        </Badge>
      </div>
      <Button onClick={handlePurchase} disabled={disabled || isLoading} className="w-full" size="lg">
        {isLoading ? (
          <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
        ) : (
          <Building2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
        )}
        {displayText}
      </Button>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <Lock className="h-3 w-3" />
        <span>Secure institutional payment via Razorpay</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/colleges/create-college-dialog.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { createCollegeAction } from '@/app/(app)/colleges/actions';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

function slugFromName(name: string): string {
  return name
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, '');
}

interface CreateCollegeDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}

export function CreateCollegeDialog({ open, onOpenChange }: CreateCollegeDialogProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [createStep, setCreateStep] = useState<1 | 2>(1);
  const [createPending, setCreatePending] = useState(false);
  const createFormRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement | null>(null);

  const handleCreateSubmit = async (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setCreatePending(true);

    const form = event.currentTarget;
    const formData = new FormData(form);
    const result = await createCollegeAction(formData);
    setCreatePending(false);

    if (!result.ok) {
      toast.error(result.error);
      return;
    }

    toast.success(`College created: ${result.slug}`);
    onOpenChange(false);
    setCreateStep(1);
    form.reset();
    router.refresh();
  };

  const handleNextCreateStep = () => {
    const form = createFormRef.current;
    if (!form) return;

    const nameInput = form.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('input[name="name"]');
    const slugInput = form.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('input[name="slug"]');
    if (!nameInput?.reportValidity()) return;
    if (!slugInput?.reportValidity()) return;
    setCreateStep(2);
  };

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(nextOpen) => {
        onOpenChange(nextOpen);
        if (!nextOpen) setCreateStep(1);
      }}
    >
      <DialogContent className='max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto'>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>New College</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <form ref={createFormRef} onSubmit={handleCreateSubmit} className='space-y-4'>
          <div className='flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
            <span className={cn('rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 border', createStep === 1 ? 'border-primary text-foreground' : 'border-border')}>1. College</span>
            <span className={cn('rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 border', createStep === 2 ? 'border-primary text-foreground' : 'border-border')}>2. Admin (optional)</span>
          </div>

          <div className={createStep === 1 ? 'space-y-4' : 'hidden'}>
            <div>
              <label className='mb-1 block text-xs font-medium'>Name</label>
              <Input
                name='name'
                required
                placeholder='College name'
                className='h-9'
                onChange={(event) => {
                  const slugEl = event.currentTarget.form?.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('input[name="slug"]');
                  if (slugEl && !slugEl.dataset.touched) slugEl.value = slugFromName(event.currentTarget.value);
                }}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className='mb-1 block text-xs font-medium'>Slug (URL)</label>
              <Input
                name='slug'
                required
                placeholder='college-slug'
                className='h-9 font-mono'
                onChange={(event) => {
                  event.currentTarget.dataset.touched = '1';
                }}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className='mb-1 block text-xs font-medium'>Short name (optional)</label>
              <Input name='short_name' placeholder='Short name' className='h-9' />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className='mb-1 block text-xs font-medium'>Status</label>
              <select
                name='status'
                className='w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm'
                defaultValue='active'
              >
                <option value='active'>Active</option>
                <option value='inactive'>Inactive</option>
                <option value='suspended'>Suspended</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className='mb-1 block text-xs font-medium'>Support email (optional)</label>
              <Input name='support_email' type='email' placeholder='support@college.edu' className='h-9' />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className='mb-1 block text-xs font-medium'>Support phone (optional)</label>
              <Input name='support_phone' placeholder='+1 234 567 8900' className='h-9' />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className={createStep === 2 ? 'rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/20 p-3 space-y-3' : 'hidden'}>
            <p className='text-xs font-semibold'>Optional: Create first college admin now</p>
            <Input name='admin_email' type='email' placeholder='admin@college.edu' className='h-9' />
            <Input name='admin_full_name' placeholder='Admin full name' className='h-9' />
            <Input name='admin_password' type='password' minLength={8} placeholder='Leave blank to generate invite link' className='h-9' />
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button type='button' variant='outline' onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            {createStep === 1 ? (
              <Button type='button' onClick={handleNextCreateStep}>
                Next
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Button type='button' variant='outline' onClick={() => setCreateStep(1)}>
                  Back
                </Button>
                <Button type='submit' disabled={createPending}>
                  {createPending ? 'Creating...' : 'Create'}
                </Button>
              </>
            )}
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';
import { PlacementOverviewRow, FeatureAdoptionRow } from '@/lib/services/dashboard';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';

interface AnalyticsArcsProps {
    placementOverview: PlacementOverviewRow[];
    featureAdoption: FeatureAdoptionRow[];
}

export function AnalyticsArcs({ placementOverview, featureAdoption }: AnalyticsArcsProps) {
    const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const arcRef = useRef<SVGCircleElement>(null);
    const percentRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
    const bar1Ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const bar2Ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const obj = useRef({ val: 0 });

    const totalStudents = placementOverview.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.total, 0);
    const readyStudents = placementOverview.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.interview_ready + curr.placed, 0);
    const globalPlacementRate = totalStudents > 0 ? Math.round((readyStudents / totalStudents) * 100) : 78;

    const avgAdoption = featureAdoption.length > 0
        ? Math.round((featureAdoption.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + (curr.enabled_count / curr.total_features), 0) / featureAdoption.length) * 100)
        : 85;

    useEffect(() => {
        const ctx = gsap.context(() => {
            const circ = 125.6;
            const offset = circ - (circ * globalPlacementRate) / 100;

            if (arcRef.current) {
                gsap.fromTo(arcRef.current,
                    { attr: { 'stroke-dashoffset': circ } },
                    { attr: { 'stroke-dashoffset': offset }, duration: 1.5, delay: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out' }
                );
            }

            obj.current.val = 0;
            gsap.to(obj.current, {
                val: globalPlacementRate,
                duration: 1.5,
                delay: 0.5,
                ease: 'power2.out',
                onUpdate: () => {
                    if (percentRef.current) {
                        percentRef.current.textContent = Math.round(obj.current.val) + '%';
                    }
                },
            });

            if (bar1Ref.current) {
                gsap.fromTo(bar1Ref.current,
                    { width: '0%' },
                    { width: '65%', duration: 1.5, delay: 0.5, ease: 'power2.out' }
                );
            }
            if (bar2Ref.current) {
                gsap.fromTo(bar2Ref.current,
                    { width: '0%' },
                    { width: `${avgAdoption}%`, duration: 1.5, delay: 0.7, ease: 'power2.out' }
                );
            }
        }, containerRef);

        return () => ctx.revert();
    }, [globalPlacementRate, avgAdoption]);

    return (
        <Card ref={containerRef} className="col-span-12 lg:col-span-4 border-border/40 min-h-[500px] flex flex-col">
            <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-border/30">
                <div>
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">Placement readiness</h3>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Student talent funnel</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <CardContent className="p-6 flex flex-col flex-1">
                {/* Arc SVG */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-8">
                    <div className="relative w-64 h-32 overflow-hidden">
                        <svg className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-64 h-64 -rotate-180" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
                            <circle
                                cx="50" cy="50" r="40"
                                fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
                                strokeWidth="12" strokeDasharray="125.6 125.6"
                                className="text-muted/20"
                            />
                            <circle
                                ref={arcRef}
                                cx="50" cy="50" r="40"
                                fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
                                strokeWidth="12" strokeDasharray="125.6 125.6"
                                strokeLinecap="round"
                                className="text-primary"
                            />
                        </svg>
                        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
                            <span ref={percentRef} className="text-5xl font-bold text-foreground tracking-tight">
                                0%
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[9px] uppercase font-medium text-muted-foreground tracking-widest mt-1">Global readiness</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* Progress bars */}
                <div className="space-y-5 mt-auto">
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">FAANG ready</span>
                            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-primary">65%</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="h-2 w-full bg-muted/40 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                            <div ref={bar1Ref} className="h-full bg-primary rounded-full" />
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">Feature adoption</span>
                            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-500">{avgAdoption}%</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="h-2 w-full bg-muted/40 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                            <div ref={bar2Ref} className="h-full bg-emerald-500 rounded-full" />
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </CardContent>
        </Card>
    );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/dashboard/colleges-galaxy.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';
import { CollegeWithCounts } from '@/lib/services/colleges';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from '@/components/ui/avatar';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';

interface CollegesGalaxyProps {
    colleges: CollegeWithCounts[];
}

export function CollegesGalaxy({ colleges }: CollegesGalaxyProps) {
    const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const nodesRef = useRef<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>([]);

    const displayColleges = colleges.slice(0, 8);

    const getOrbitalPosition = (index: number) => {
        const angle = (index * 360) / displayColleges.length;
        const radius = index % 2 === 0 ? 150 : 110;
        return {
            top: `calc(50% + ${radius * Math.sin((angle * Math.PI) / 180)}px)`,
            left: `calc(50% + ${radius * Math.cos((angle * Math.PI) / 180)}px)`,
        };
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        const ctx = gsap.context(() => {
            nodesRef.current.forEach((node, i) => {
                if (!node) return;
                gsap.fromTo(node,
                    { scale: 0, opacity: 0 },
                    {
                        scale: 1, opacity: 1,
                        duration: 0.5,
                        delay: 0.2 + i * 0.1,
                        ease: 'back.out(1.7)',
                    }
                );
            });
        }, containerRef);

        return () => ctx.revert();
    }, []);

    return (
        <Card ref={containerRef} className="col-span-12 border-border/40">
            <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-border/30">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">College clusters</h3>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{colleges.length} colleges on platform</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <CardContent className="relative flex items-center justify-center p-12 min-h-[450px] overflow-hidden">
                {/* College nodes */}
                {displayColleges.map((college, i) => {
                    const pos = getOrbitalPosition(i);
                    return (
                        <div
                            key={college.id}
                            ref={(el) => { nodesRef.current[i] = el; }}
                            className="absolute group z-10"
                            style={{ top: pos.top, left: pos.left, transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)' }}
                        >
                            <div className="relative">
                                <Avatar className="w-12 h-12 border-2 border-border/40 bg-background shadow-md group-hover:scale-110 group-hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300">
                                    <AvatarImage src={`/api/colleges/${college.slug}/logo`} alt={college.name} />
                                    <AvatarFallback className="bg-muted text-muted-foreground font-bold text-xs">
                                        {college.name.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
                                    </AvatarFallback>
                                </Avatar>

                                {/* Tooltip */}
                                <div className="absolute -bottom-10 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 whitespace-nowrap opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-all duration-200 bg-background/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-border/40 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg shadow-lg pointer-events-none z-20">
                                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-foreground">
                                        {college.name}
                                    </span>
                                    <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground ml-2 font-mono">
                                        {college.students_count?.toLocaleString()} S
                                    </span>
                                </div>

                                {/* Status indicator */}
                                <div className={cn(
                                    "absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-3 h-3 rounded-full border-2 border-background",
                                    college.status === 'active' ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-destructive"
                                )} />
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    );
                })}
            </CardContent>
        </Card>
    );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/dashboard/colleges-table.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useMemo, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { UserPlus, Pencil, Search, Building2, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/shared/status-badge';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import type { CollegeWithCounts } from '@/lib/services/colleges';

const FILTER_TABS = [
  { key: 'all', label: 'All' },
  { key: 'active', label: 'Active' },
  { key: 'inactive', label: 'Inactive' },
  { key: 'suspended', label: 'Suspended' },
] as const;

type FilterKey = (typeof FILTER_TABS)[number]['key'];

function formatDate(value: string): string {
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return '-';
  return date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
  });
}

interface CollegesTableProps {
  initialColleges: CollegeWithCounts[];
  onInvite?: (college: CollegeWithCounts) => void;
  onEdit?: (college: CollegeWithCounts) => void;
  onCreate?: () => void;
}

const DEFAULT_ON_INVITE = () => { };
const DEFAULT_ON_EDIT = () => { };
const DEFAULT_ON_CREATE = () => { };

export function CollegesTable({
  initialColleges,
  onInvite = DEFAULT_ON_INVITE,
  onEdit = DEFAULT_ON_EDIT,
  onCreate = DEFAULT_ON_CREATE,
}: CollegesTableProps) {
  const [colleges, setColleges] = useState<CollegeWithCounts[]>(initialColleges);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<FilterKey>('all');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    setColleges(initialColleges);
  }, [initialColleges]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return colleges.filter((college) => {
      if (filter !== 'all' && college.status !== filter) return false;
      if (!q) return true;
      return (
        college.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        college.slug.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (college.short_name ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    });
  }, [colleges, filter, search]);

  return (
    <Card className="col-span-12 min-w-0 glass-card border-0 overflow-hidden">
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-primary/[0.06] to-transparent px-6 py-4 border-b border-border/20">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Building2 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">Partner colleges</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Your active tenant infrastructure</CardDescription>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={onCreate} className="shrink-0 h-9 text-xs font-semibold px-4 shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/20 transition-all duration-300">
            <Building2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-2" />
            Add new college
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <CardContent className="p-6">
        <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex gap-1 p-1 bg-muted/30 rounded-xl border border-border/30">
            {FILTER_TABS.map((tab) => (
              <button
                key={tab.key}
                type="button"
                className={cn(
                  "px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition-all duration-200",
                  filter === tab.key
                    ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-md shadow-primary/20"
                    : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/50"
                )}
                onClick={() => setFilter(tab.key)}
              >
                {tab.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="relative max-w-[260px] w-full">
            <Search className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground/40" />
            <Input
              placeholder="Search colleges..."
              className="h-9 w-full bg-muted/20 border-border/30 text-xs placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50 focus:ring-primary/20 transition-all pl-10 pr-4 rounded-xl"
              value={search}
              onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto scrollbar-hide">
          <Table className="border-separate border-spacing-y-1.5 min-w-[840px]">
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow className="border-none hover:bg-transparent">
                <TableHead className="w-[20%] text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground/60 h-auto pb-3 px-2">College name</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[15%] text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground/60 h-auto pb-3 px-2">Identifier</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[10%] text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground/60 h-auto pb-3 px-2 text-center">Admins</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[10%] text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground/60 h-auto pb-3 px-2 text-center">Students</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[12%] text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground/60 h-auto pb-3 px-2">Onboarded</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[10%] text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground/60 h-auto pb-3 px-2">Status</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[23%] text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground/60 h-auto pb-3 text-right px-2">Actions</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {filtered.length === 0 ? (
                <TableRow className="border-none">
                  <TableCell colSpan={7} className="py-16 text-center bg-muted/15 rounded-xl">
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
                      <Building2 className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground/30" />
                      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground">No matching colleges found</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/60">Try adjusting your search or filters</p>
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ) : (
                filtered.map((college) => (
                  <TableRow key={college.id} className="border-none group/row relative">
                    <TableCell className="bg-muted/15 first:rounded-l-lg px-5 py-3 align-middle transition-colors group-hover/row:bg-primary/[0.04] relative">
                      <div className="absolute left-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[3px] h-0 group-hover/row:h-5 bg-primary rounded-r-full transition-all duration-200" />
                      <Link href={`/colleges/${college.id}`} className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground hover:text-primary transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        {college.name}
                        <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3 opacity-0 group-hover/row:opacity-100 transition-opacity shrink-0" />
                      </Link>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="bg-muted/15 px-3 py-3 align-middle transition-colors group-hover/row:bg-primary/[0.04]">
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold bg-muted/40 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-muted-foreground">
                        {college.slug}
                      </span>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="bg-muted/15 px-3 py-3 align-middle text-center transition-colors group-hover/row:bg-primary/[0.04]">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold font-mono tabular-nums">{college.admins_count ?? 0}</span>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="bg-muted/15 px-3 py-3 align-middle text-center transition-colors group-hover/row:bg-primary/[0.04]">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold font-mono tabular-nums">{college.students_count ?? 0}</span>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="bg-muted/15 px-3 py-3 align-middle transition-colors group-hover/row:bg-primary/[0.04]">
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-medium">{formatDate(college.created_at)}</span>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="bg-muted/15 px-3 py-3 align-middle transition-colors group-hover/row:bg-primary/[0.04]">
                      <StatusBadge status={college.status} />
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="bg-muted/15 last:rounded-r-lg px-5 py-3 align-middle text-right transition-colors group-hover/row:bg-primary/[0.04]">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="sm"
                          className="h-8 text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 transition-all rounded-lg"
                          onClick={() => onInvite(college)}
                        >
                          <UserPlus className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1.5" /> Invite
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon"
                          className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 transition-all rounded-lg"
                          aria-label={`Edit ${college.name}`}
                          onClick={() => onEdit(college)}
                        >
                          <Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))
              )}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </div>

}

'use client';

import React, { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';
import { EmailFailureRow } from '@/lib/services/dashboard';
import { AuditLogItem } from '@/lib/services/audit';
import { Shield } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';

interface CommandCenterLogsProps {
    emailFailures: EmailFailureRow[];
    recentAudit: AuditLogItem[];
}

export function CommandCenterLogs({ emailFailures, recentAudit }: CommandCenterLogsProps) {
    const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const card2Ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const card3Ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        const ctx = gsap.context(() => {
            if (card2Ref.current) {
                gsap.fromTo(card2Ref.current,
                    { opacity: 0, y: 20 },
                    { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.6, delay: 0.1, ease: 'power2.out' }
                );
            }
            if (card3Ref.current) {
                gsap.fromTo(card3Ref.current,
                    { opacity: 0, y: 20 },
                    { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.6, delay: 0.2, ease: 'power2.out' }
                );
            }
        }, containerRef);

        return () => ctx.revert();
    }, []);

    return (
        <div ref={containerRef} className="col-span-12 lg:col-span-8 space-y-5">


            {/* Audit Logs Card */}
            <Card ref={card2Ref} className="border-border/40 border-l-4 border-l-primary/40">
                <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-border/30">
                    <div>
                        <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">Recent infrastructure changes</CardTitle>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">System audit trail</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <CardContent className="p-6 space-y-3">
                    {recentAudit.slice(0, 3).map((log, i) => {
                        const userEmail = (log.payload?.user_email as string) || (log.actor_id?.substring(0, 8) || 'System');
                        const collegeName = (log.payload?.college_name as string) || 'Global';
                        return (
                            <div key={log.id || i} className="flex items-start gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg bg-muted/15 border border-border/20">
                                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-muted flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground">@</span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
                                        <span className="font-mono">{userEmail.split('@')[0]}</span>
                                    </p>
                                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{log.action}</p>
                                </div>
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/50 italic shrink-0">via {collegeName}</span>
                            </div>
                        );
                    })}
                    {recentAudit.length === 0 && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/50 italic tracking-widest uppercase text-center py-6">No recent activity detected</p>
                    )}
                </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* Email Failures Card */}
            <Card ref={card3Ref} className="border-border/40 border-l-4 border-l-muted">
                <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-border/30">
                    <div>
                        <CardTitle className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">Email failures</CardTitle>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Failed notification queue items</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <CardContent className="p-6">
                    <div className="space-y-2 max-h-40 overflow-y-auto">
                        {emailFailures.slice(0, 4).map((fail, i) => (
                            <div key={fail.id || i} className="flex justify-between items-center p-3 rounded-lg bg-muted/15 border border-border/20">
                                <span className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground truncate pr-3">{fail.recipient_email}</span>
                                <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] font-semibold bg-destructive/5 text-destructive border-destructive/20 shrink-0">
                                    {fail.last_error || 'SMTP TIMEOUT'}
                                </Badge>
                            </div>
                        ))}
                        {emailFailures.length === 0 && (
                            <div className="text-center py-8">
                                <Shield className="h-6 w-6 text-muted-foreground/30 mx-auto mb-2" />
                                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No communication failures</p>
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </div>
                </CardContent>
            </Card>
        </div>
    );
}

import type { SuperadminDashboardStats } from '@/lib/services/dashboard';

function dashboardGreeting(): string {
  const h = new Date().getHours();
  if (h < 12) return 'Good morning';
  if (h < 17) return 'Good afternoon';
  return 'Good evening';
}

function DashboardKpiHeroCard({
  greeting,
  stats,
}: {
  greeting: string;
  stats: SuperadminDashboardStats | null;
}) {
  const loading = stats === null;
  return (
    <div className="glass-card-strong rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-primary/[0.08] via-transparent to-blue-500/[0.04] pointer-events-none" />
      <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-64 h-64 bg-primary/5 rounded-full blur-3xl -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/4" />

      <div className="relative flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-6">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
            <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary animate-pulse" />
            <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-primary/70 uppercase tracking-widest">
              Platform Live
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-medium mb-1 min-h-[1.25rem]">
            {loading ? (
              <span className="inline-block h-4 w-36 max-w-full rounded-md bg-muted animate-pulse" aria-hidden />
            ) : (
              greeting
            )}
          </p>
          <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
            Platform Overview
          </h1>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6 md:gap-10">
          <div className="text-center">
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">Colleges</p>
            {loading ? (
              <div className="mx-auto mt-0.5 h-7 w-12 rounded-md bg-muted animate-pulse" aria-hidden />
            ) : (
              <p className="text-xl font-bold text-primary tabular-nums mt-0.5">{stats.activeColleges}</p>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="text-center">
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">Students</p>
            {loading ? (
              <div className="mx-auto mt-0.5 h-7 w-14 rounded-md bg-muted animate-pulse" aria-hidden />
            ) : (
              <p className="text-xl font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 tabular-nums mt-0.5">
                {stats.totalStudents.toLocaleString()}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="text-center">
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">Leads</p>
            {loading ? (
              <div className="mx-auto mt-0.5 h-7 w-10 rounded-md bg-muted animate-pulse" aria-hidden />
            ) : (
              <p className="text-xl font-bold text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400 tabular-nums mt-0.5">
                {stats.collegeLeads}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="text-center">
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">New this month</p>
            {loading ? (
              <div className="mx-auto mt-0.5 h-7 w-14 rounded-md bg-muted animate-pulse" aria-hidden />
            ) : (
              <p className="text-xl font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 tabular-nums mt-0.5">
                +{stats.newStudentsThisMonth}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Server-only Suspense fallback: LCP `h1` ships as HTML with no client JS. */
export function DashboardKpiHeroFallback() {
  return (
    <>

      <DashboardKpiHeroCard greeting="" stats={null} />
    </>
  );
}

  );
}

                <Link href="/bundles/create" prefetch>
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-pink-500/10 flex items-center justify-center mr-2.5 group-hover:bg-white/20">
                    <Package className="h-4 w-4 text-pink-500 group-hover:text-white" />
                  </div>
                  Create Bundle
                </Link>
              </Button>
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="justify-start h-14 text-xs font-semibold glass-card border-0 hover:bg-orange-500 hover:text-white hover:border-orange-500 transition-all duration-300 rounded-xl group" asChild>
                <Link href="/assignments/create" prefetch>
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-orange-500/10 flex items-center justify-center mr-2.5 group-hover:bg-white/20">
                    <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-orange-500 group-hover:text-white" />
                  </div>
                  Create Assignment
                </Link>
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {createOpen ? <CreateCollegeDialog open={createOpen} onOpenChange={setCreateOpen} /> : null}
      <PendingInvitesDialog open={invitesOpen} onOpenChange={setInvitesOpen} />
    </>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/dashboard/pending-invites-dialog.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Mail, Loader2, User } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { getPendingStudentInvitesAction, resendStudentInviteAction } from '@/app/(app)/students/actions';
import { type StudentListItem } from '@/lib/services/students';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';

interface PendingInvitesDialogProps {
    open: boolean;
    onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}

export function PendingInvitesDialog({ open, onOpenChange }: PendingInvitesDialogProps) {
    const [invites, setInvites] = useState<StudentListItem[]>([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [reminding, setReminding] = useState<string | null>(null);

    const fetchInvites = async () => {
        setLoading(true);
        const result = await getPendingStudentInvitesAction();
        if (result.ok) {
            setInvites(result.invites || []);
        } else {
            toast.error(result.error);
        }
        setLoading(false);
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        if (open) {
            const timer = setTimeout(() => {
                void fetchInvites();
            }, 0);
            return () => clearTimeout(timer);
        }
    }, [open]);

    const handleRemind = async (userId: string) => {
        setReminding(userId);
        const result = await resendStudentInviteAction(userId);
        if (result.ok) {
            toast.success('Reminder email sent successfully.');
        } else {
            toast.error(result.error);
        }
        setReminding(null);
    };

    return (
        <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
            <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[80vh] overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        Pending Student Invites
                        <Badge variant="secondary" className="ml-2 font-mono">
                            {invites.length}
                        </Badge>
                    </DialogTitle>
                </DialogHeader>

                <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto py-4 space-y-3">
                    {loading ? (
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 gap-3 opacity-60">
                            <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-primary" />
                            <p className="text-sm font-medium">Scanning for pending invites...</p>
                        </div>
                    ) : invites.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="text-center py-12 opacity-60">
                            <p className="text-sm font-medium">No pending student invites found.</p>
                        </div>
                    ) : (
                        invites.map((invite) => (
                            <div
                                key={invite.user_id}
                                className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl border border-border/50 bg-card/20 hover:bg-card/40 transition-colors group"
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                                        <User className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="min-w-0">
                                        <p className="text-sm font-bold truncate">{invite.full_name || 'Anonymous'}</p>
                                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">{invite.email}</p>
                                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1 flex-wrap">
                                            <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[9px] h-4 py-0 font-bold uppercase tracking-tighter">
                                                {invite.student_classification === 'direct_learner' ? 'B2C' : 'B2B'}
                                            </Badge>
                                            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[9px] h-4 py-0 font-medium max-w-[200px] truncate">
                                                {invite.college_display}
                                            </Badge>
                                            {invite.student_code && (
                                                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono opacity-60">#{invite.student_code}</span>
                                            )}
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <Button
                                    size="sm"
                                    variant="outline"
                                    className="h-8 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide gap-1.5 hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground transition-all shrink-0"
                                    disabled={reminding === invite.user_id}
                                    onClick={() => handleRemind(invite.user_id)}
                                >
                                    {reminding === invite.user_id ? (
                                        <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
                                    ) : (
                                        <Mail className="w-3 h-3" />
                                    )}
                                    {reminding === invite.user_id ? 'Sending...' : 'Remind'}
                                </Button>
                            </div>
                        ))
                    )}
                </div>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}
