--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/dashboard/stats-nebula.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';
import { SuperadminDashboardStats } from '@/lib/services/dashboard';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';

interface StatsNebulaProps {
    stats: SuperadminDashboardStats;
    pendingJobs?: number;
}

export function StatsNebula({ stats, pendingJobs = 24 }: StatsNebulaProps) {
    const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const centralRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const nodesRef = useRef<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>([]);

    useEffect(() => {
        const ctx = gsap.context(() => {
            if (centralRef.current) {
                gsap.fromTo(centralRef.current,
                    { scale: 0.7, opacity: 0 },
                    { scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.9, ease: 'back.out(1.5)' }
                );
            }

            nodesRef.current.forEach((node, i) => {
                if (!node) return;
                gsap.fromTo(node,
                    { opacity: 0, y: 20 },
                    {
                        opacity: 1, y: 0,
                        duration: 0.6,
                        delay: 0.3 + i * 0.15,
                        ease: 'power2.out',
                    }
                );
            });
        }, containerRef);

        return () => ctx.revert();
    }, []);

    const nodes = [
        { value: stats.totalStudents.toLocaleString(), label: 'Total Students' },
        { value: String(stats.activeColleges), label: 'Active Colleges' },
        { value: '$4.2M', label: 'Monthly Revenue' },
        { value: String(pendingJobs), label: 'Pending Jobs' },
    ];

    return (
        <Card ref={containerRef} className="w-full border-border/40 overflow-hidden">
            <CardContent className="p-8 flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-center gap-8">
                {/* Left: Central metric */}
                <div ref={centralRef} className="flex-shrink-0">
                    <div className="w-44 h-44 rounded-full border-2 border-border/40 flex items-center justify-center bg-card">
                        <div className="text-center">
                            <span className="block text-4xl font-bold text-foreground tracking-tight font-mono">
                                1.2M
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-muted-foreground font-medium mt-1 block">
                                System Capacity
                            </span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* Right: Stat cards grid */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 flex-1 w-full">
                    {nodes.map((node, i) => (
                        <div
                            key={node.label}
                            ref={(el) => { nodesRef.current[i] = el; }}
                            className="rounded-xl border border-border/30 bg-card p-5"
                        >
                            <span className="block text-2xl font-bold text-foreground tracking-tight font-mono">
                                {node.value}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-medium mt-1 block">
                                {node.label}
                            </span>
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </CardContent>
        </Card>
    );
}

    DropdownMenu,

export function Header() {
    const pathname = usePathname();
    const pageId = getPageIdFromPath(pathname);
    const meta = pageMeta[pageId] ?? { title: 'Super Admin', subtitle: '' };

    const handleSearch = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            toast.info(`Search: "${(e.target as HTMLInputElement).value}"`, {
                description: 'Results would appear here.',
            });
        }
    };

    const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(false);
    const [mobileSearch, setMobileSearch] = useState('');

    const handleMobileSearch = () => {
        if (mobileSearch.trim()) {
            toast.info(`Search: "${mobileSearch}"`, {
                description: 'Results would appear here.',
            });
            setSearchOpen(false);
            setMobileSearch('');
        }
    };

    return (
        <header className="mb-4 sm:mb-6 relative">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 sm:gap-4 flex-wrap sm:flex-nowrap">
                {/* ── Title ── */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 sm:gap-4 min-w-0">
                    <SidebarTrigger className="-ml-1 shrink-0 h-8 w-8 rounded-lg border border-border/30 glass-card hover:bg-primary/10 transition-all duration-300" />
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                        <h1 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground leading-none truncate">{meta.title}</h1>
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-medium truncate mt-0.5">{meta.subtitle}</p>
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* ── Utilities ── */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 justify-end flex-1">
                    {/* Mobile Search */}
                    <Sheet open={searchOpen} onOpenChange={setSearchOpen}>
                        <SheetTrigger asChild>
                            <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="md:hidden h-8 w-8 rounded-xl text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-primary/10 transition-all duration-300" aria-label="Search">
                                <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
                            </Button>
                        </SheetTrigger>
                        <SheetContent side="top" className="h-auto" showCloseButton>
                            <SheetHeader>
                                <SheetTitle>Search</SheetTitle>
                            </SheetHeader>
                            <div className="px-4 pb-4">

                                    placeholder="Search anything..."
                                    className="h-9 w-full rounded-full border-border/30 bg-muted/20 text-sm"
                                    value={mobileSearch}
                                    onChange={(e) => setMobileSearch(e.target.value)}
                                    onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handleMobileSearch(); }}
                                    autoFocus
                                />
                            </div>
                        </SheetContent>
                    </Sheet>

                    {/* Desktop Search */}
                    <div className="relative hidden md:flex items-center flex-1 max-w-lg ml-4 mr-2">

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/layout/sidebar.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { navigation, getPathFromPageId, type NavItem } from '@/data/navigation';
import {
  Sidebar as ShadcnSidebar,
  SidebarContent,
  SidebarFooter,
  SidebarGroup,
  SidebarHeader,
  SidebarMenu,
  SidebarMenuButton,
  SidebarMenuItem,
  SidebarMenuBadge,
  SidebarRail,
  useSidebar,
} from '@/components/ui/sidebar';
import type { SidebarMetrics } from '@/app/(app)/app-layout-client';

function formatMetric(value: number): string {
  if (value >= 1000) {
    const compact = value / 1000;
    return `${Number.isInteger(compact) ? compact.toFixed(0) : compact.toFixed(1)}k`;
  }
  return String(value);
}

function applyLiveBadges(items: NavItem[], metrics: SidebarMetrics): NavItem[] {
  return items.map((item) => {
    if (item.id === 'college-leads') return { ...item, badge: metrics.leads > 0 ? formatMetric(metrics.leads) : undefined };
    if (item.id === 'colleges') return { ...item, badge: metrics.colleges > 0 ? formatMetric(metrics.colleges) : undefined };
    if (item.id === 'students') return { ...item, badge: metrics.students > 0 ? formatMetric(metrics.students) : undefined };
    if (item.id === 'programs') return { ...item, badge: metrics.programs > 0 ? formatMetric(metrics.programs) : undefined };
    if (item.id === 'placements') return { ...item, badge: metrics.placements > 0 ? formatMetric(metrics.placements) : undefined };
    return item;
  });
}

export function Sidebar({ metrics }: { metrics: SidebarMetrics }) {
  const { state, setOpenMobile } = useSidebar();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const collapsed = state === 'collapsed';

  useEffect(() => {
    setOpenMobile(false);
  }, [pathname, setOpenMobile]);

  return (
                      <ShadcnSidebar collapsible="icon" className="border-r border-sidebar-border/50 bg-sidebar-background md:bg-sidebar-background/65 md:backdrop-blur-2xl">
      <SidebarHeader className="border-b border-sidebar-border/40 py-3 sm:py-3 pb-0 px-2 sm:px-3">
        <div className={cn('flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-2.5 px-0 sm:px-2', collapsed && 'justify-center px-0')}>
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-lg shadow-primary/20 overflow-hidden bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/10">
            <Image src="/assets/brand-logo.png" alt="NG" width={32} height={32} className="w-full h-full object-contain p-1" />
          </div>
          <div className={cn('min-w-0 flex-1 transition-opacity', collapsed && 'opacity-0 hidden')}>
            <div className="font-bold text-sm leading-tight truncate">NextGen CTO</div>
            <div className="text-xs text-sidebar-foreground truncate">Super admin</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </SidebarHeader>

      <SidebarContent className="px-2 sm:px-3 py-1.5 sm:py-2 scrollbar-hide">
        {navigation.map((group) => {
          const groupItems = group.title === 'College Management' ? applyLiveBadges(group.items, metrics) : group.items;

          return (
            <SidebarGroup key={group.title} className="mb-1.5 p-0">
              {!collapsed && (
                <div className="text-xs text-sidebar-foreground px-3 py-1 font-medium">
                  {group.title}
                </div>
              )}
              <SidebarMenu className="gap-0.5">
                {groupItems.map((item) => {
                  const href = getPathFromPageId(item.id);
                  // Dashboard uses exact match only to prevent false-positive active states
                  // on sub-routes. All other items use section match (exact + prefix).
                  const isDashboard = item.id === 'dashboard';
                  const isActive = isDashboard
                    ? pathname === href
                    : (pathname === href || pathname.startsWith(href + '/'));
                  const Icon = item.icon;

                  return (
                    <SidebarMenuItem key={item.id}>
                      <SidebarMenuButton
                        asChild
                        isActive={isActive}
                        tooltip={item.label}
                        className={cn(
                          'w-full relative flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer',
                          isActive
                            ? 'bg-primary/8 text-primary font-medium'
                            : 'text-sidebar-foreground hover:bg-sidebar-accent/40',
                          collapsed && 'justify-center px-0'
                        )}
                      >
                        <Link href={href}>
                          {isActive && (
                            <div className="absolute left-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[2.5px] h-4.5 bg-primary rounded-r-full" />
                          )}
                          <div
                            className={cn(
                              'w-5 h-5 rounded flex items-center justify-center shrink-0',
                              isActive
                                ? 'text-primary'
                                : 'text-sidebar-foreground/70'
                            )}
                          >
                            <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </div>
                          <span className={cn('text-[13px] font-medium truncate', collapsed && 'hidden')}>
                            {item.label}
                          </span>
                        </Link>
                      </SidebarMenuButton>
                      {!collapsed && item.badge && (
                        <SidebarMenuBadge className={cn('text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border', item.badgeVariant === 'primary' ? 'bg-sidebar-primary/20 border-sidebar-primary/30 text-sidebar-primary-foreground' : 'bg-sidebar-accent border-sidebar-border text-sidebar-foreground')}>
                          {item.badge}
                        </SidebarMenuBadge>
                      )}
                    </SidebarMenuItem>
                  );
                })}
              </SidebarMenu>
            </SidebarGroup>
          );
        })}
      </SidebarContent>
      <SidebarFooter />
      <SidebarRail />
    </ShadcnSidebar>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/layout/theme-toggle.tsx ---
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { Moon, Sun } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTheme } from 'next-themes';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export function ThemeToggle({ className }: { className?: string }) {
    const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme();
    const [mounted, setMounted] = React.useState(false);

    // Avoid hydration mismatch
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setMounted(true);
    }, []);

    if (!mounted) {
        return (
            <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className={cn('w-9 h-9 rounded-full', className)} disabled>
                <span className="sr-only">Toggle theme</span>
            </Button>
        );
    }

    return (
        <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon"
            className={cn(
                'w-9 h-9 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-primary/10 hover:text-primary',
                className
            )}
            onClick={() => setTheme(theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark')}
        >
            {theme === 'dark' ? (
                <Sun className="h-4 w-4 transition-all duration-300 rotate-0 scale-100" />
            ) : (
                <Moon className="h-4 w-4 transition-all duration-300 rotate-0 scale-100" />
            )}
            <span className="sr-only">Toggle theme</span>
        </Button>
    );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/lms/commerce/coupon-input.tsx ---
'use client';

/**
 * LMS Coupon Input — Student-facing coupon application.
 * Used exclusively in the LMS student portal checkout flow.
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Loader2, Tag, X, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface LmsCouponValidationResult {
  valid: boolean;
  discountAmountMinor?: number;
  error?: string;
}

export interface LmsCouponInputProps {
  orderAmountMinor: number;
  onValidate: (code: string, amountMinor: number) => Promise<LmsCouponValidationResult>;
  onApplied?: (discountAmountMinor: number) => void;
}

// ─── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function LmsCouponInput({
  orderAmountMinor,
  onValidate,
  onApplied,
}: LmsCouponInputProps) {
  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
  const [validating, setValidating] = useState(false);
  const [appliedDiscount, setAppliedDiscount] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleApply = async () => {
    if (!code.trim()) return;

    setValidating(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const result = await onValidate(code.trim(), orderAmountMinor);

      if (result.valid && result.discountAmountMinor) {
        setAppliedDiscount(result.discountAmountMinor);
        onApplied?.(result.discountAmountMinor);
        toast.success('Coupon applied!', {
          description: `You save ₹${(result.discountAmountMinor / 100).toFixed(2)}!`,
        });
      } else {
        setError(result.error ?? 'Invalid coupon code');
        toast.error(result.error ?? 'Invalid coupon code');
      }
    } catch {
      setError('Failed to validate coupon');
    } finally {
      setValidating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRemove = () => {
    setAppliedDiscount(null);
    setCode('');
    setError(null);
    onApplied?.(0);
  };

  if (appliedDiscount) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 border rounded-lg bg-emerald-50/30 border-emerald-200">
        <Check className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
        <div className="flex-1">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-emerald-800">
            Coupon applied: {code}
          </p>
          <p className="text-xs text-emerald-600">
            You save ₹{(appliedDiscount / 100).toFixed(2)}!
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={handleRemove} className="h-6 w-6 p-0">
          <X className="h-3 w-3" />
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <details className="group">
        <summary className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors">
          <Tag className="h-4 w-4" />
          Have a coupon code?
        </summary>

        <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2">
          <Input
            value={code}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setCode(e.target.value);
              setError(null);
            }}
            placeholder="Enter coupon code"
            className="h-9"
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter') handleApply();
            }}
          />
          <Button
            onClick={handleApply}
            disabled={validating || !code.trim()}
            size="sm"
            className="h-9"
          >
            {validating ? <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" /> : 'Apply'}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </details>

      {error && (
        <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{error}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

/**
 * LMS Pricing Card — Student-facing pricing component.
 * Used exclusively in the LMS student portal for course/variant pricing.
 */

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardFooter } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Check, Lock, BookOpen, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface LmsPricingCardProps {
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  priceMinor: number;
  originalPriceMinor?: number;
  currency?: string;
  features?: string[];
  badge?: string;
  isLoading?: boolean;
  isLocked?: boolean;
  ctaText?: string;
  onCtaClick?: () => void;
}

// ─── Utilities ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function formatINR(minorUnits: number): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', {
    style: 'currency',
    currency: 'INR',
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(minorUnits / 100);
}

// ─── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function LmsPricingCard({
  title,
  description,
  priceMinor,
  originalPriceMinor,
  features = [],
  badge,
  isLoading = false,
  isLocked = true,
  ctaText,
  onCtaClick,
}: LmsPricingCardProps) {
  const displayPrice = formatINR(priceMinor);
  const displayOriginal = originalPriceMinor ? formatINR(originalPriceMinor) : null;
  const discount = originalPriceMinor
    ? Math.round(((originalPriceMinor - priceMinor) / originalPriceMinor) * 100)
    : null;

  return (
    <Card className={cn(
      'relative transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-lg',
      isLocked && 'opacity-90',
    )}>
      {badge && (
        <div className="absolute -top-3 right-4">
          <Badge className="bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600">{badge}</Badge>
        </div>
      )}

      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <BookOpen className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground" />
          <CardTitle className="text-lg">{title}</CardTitle>
        </div>
        {description && (
          <CardDescription>{description}</CardDescription>
        )}
      </CardHeader>

      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        {/* Price */}
        <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
          <span className="text-3xl font-bold">{displayPrice}</span>
          {displayOriginal && (
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground line-through">
              {displayOriginal}
            </span>
          )}
          {discount && discount > 0 && (
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50">
              {discount}% off
            </Badge>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Features */}
        {features.length > 0 && (
          <ul className="space-y-2">
            {features.map((feature, i) => (
              <li key={i} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
                <Check className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-500 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">{feature}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </CardContent>

      <CardFooter className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <Button
          onClick={onCtaClick}
          disabled={isLoading}
          className="w-full"
          size="lg"
        >
          {isLoading ? (
            <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
          ) : isLocked ? (
            <Lock className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
          ) : (
            <BookOpen className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
          )}
          {isLoading ? 'Processing...' : ctaText ?? (isLocked ? `Enroll Now — ${displayPrice}` : 'Start Learning')}
        </Button>

        {isLocked && (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
            <Lock className="h-3 w-3" />
            Enroll to unlock this content
          </p>
        )}
      </CardFooter>
    </Card>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/lms/commerce/purchase-button.tsx ---
'use client';

/**
 * LMS Purchase Button — Student-facing checkout button.
 * Used exclusively in the LMS student portal.
 * Hardcodes source: "lms" — never exposes secrets.
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Loader2, Lock, CreditCard } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { useLmsRazorpayCheckout, type LmsRazorpaySuccessResponse } from '@/hooks/lms/use-lms-razorpay-checkout';

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface LmsPurchaseButtonProps {
  entityType: 'course_variant' | 'course_bundle';
  entityId: string;
  entityName: string;
  entityDescription?: string;
  amountMinor: number;
  purchaserName?: string;
  purchaserEmail?: string;
  purchaserUserId?: string;
  couponCode?: string;
  onSuccess: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onFailure?: (error: Error) => void;
  variant?: 'default' | 'outline' | 'secondary';
  size?: 'default' | 'sm' | 'lg';
  disabled?: boolean;
  buttonText?: string;
}

// ─── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function LmsPurchaseButton({
  entityType,
  entityId,
  entityName,
  entityDescription,
  amountMinor,
  purchaserName,
  purchaserEmail,
  purchaserUserId,
  couponCode,
  onSuccess,
  onFailure,
  variant = 'default',
  size = 'lg',
  disabled = false,
  buttonText,
}: LmsPurchaseButtonProps) {
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const { loading: scriptLoading, checkout } = useLmsRazorpayCheckout();

  const handlePurchase = async () => {
    setIsProcessing(true);

    try {
      // Step 1: Create order on server (server-side pricing)
      const orderResponse = await fetch('/api/lms/orders', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          entity_type: entityType,
          entity_id: entityId,
          purchaser_email: purchaserEmail,
          purchaser_name: purchaserName,
          purchaser_user_id: purchaserUserId,
          source: 'lms',
          coupon_code: couponCode,
          metadata: { entity_name: entityName },
        }),
      });

      if (!orderResponse.ok) {
        const errorData = await orderResponse.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.error ?? 'Failed to create order');
      }

      const orderData = await orderResponse.json();

      // Step 2: Open Razorpay checkout
      await checkout({
        orderId: orderData.order_id,
        gatewayOrderId: orderData.gateway_order_id,
        razorpayKey: orderData.razorpay_key,
        amountMinor: orderData.amount_minor,
        currency: orderData.currency,
        entityName: entityName,
        entityDescription: entityDescription,
        purchaserName: purchaserName,
        purchaserEmail: purchaserEmail,
        onSuccess: async (response: LmsRazorpaySuccessResponse) => {
          // Step 3: Verify payment on server
          try {
            const verifyResponse = await fetch('/api/lms/payments/verify', {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({
                order_id: orderData.order_id,
                gateway_order_id: response.razorpay_order_id,
                gateway_payment_id: response.razorpay_payment_id,
                gateway_signature: response.razorpay_signature,
              }),
            });

            const verifyData = await verifyResponse.json();

            if (verifyData.success) {
              toast.success('Payment successful! Content unlocked.', {
                description: `Order ${orderData.order_id.substring(0, 8)}...`,
              });
              await onSuccess();
            } else {
              throw new Error(verifyData.message ?? 'Payment verification failed');
            }
          } catch (error) {
            toast.error('Payment verification failed', {
              description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please contact support',
            });
            onFailure?.(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error('Verification failed'));
          }
        },
        onFailure: (error: Error) => {
          toast.error('Payment failed', { description: error.message });
          onFailure?.(error);
          setIsProcessing(false);
        },
        onDismiss: () => {
          toast.info('Checkout cancelled', {
            description: 'You can complete your purchase anytime',
          });
          setIsProcessing(false);
        },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'An unexpected error occurred';
      toast.error('Failed to start checkout', { description: message });
      onFailure?.(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(message));
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const isLoading = isProcessing || scriptLoading;
  const displayPrice = `₹${(amountMinor / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
  const displayText = buttonText ?? (isLoading ? 'Processing...' : `Enroll Now — ${displayPrice}`);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <Button
        onClick={handlePurchase}
        disabled={disabled || isLoading}
        variant={variant}
        size={size}
        className="w-full"
      >
        {isLoading ? (
          <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
        ) : (
          <CreditCard className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
        )}
        {displayText}
      </Button>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <Lock className="h-3 w-3" />
        <span>Secure payment via Razorpay</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/master-courses/assign-pillar-dialog.tsx ---
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Users, Loader2, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, Info, ShieldAlert, CheckCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { ScrollArea } from '@/components/ui/scroll-area';
import { assignPillarToCollegesAction, getPillarDiagnosticInfoAction } from '@/app/(app)/master-courses/actions';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import type { PillarAssignmentResult } from '@/lib/services/pillar-assignments';
import type { PillarDiagnosticInfo } from '@/lib/services/master-course-pillars';

interface College {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
}

interface AssignPillarDialogProps {
  pillarId: string;
  pillarTitle: string;
  trigger?: React.ReactNode;
}

export function AssignPillarDialog({ pillarId, pillarTitle, trigger }: AssignPillarDialogProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isPending, setIsPending] = useState(false);
  const [colleges, setColleges] = useState<College[]>([]);
  const [selectedCollegeIds, setSelectedCollegeIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [diagnostic, setDiagnostic] = useState<PillarDiagnosticInfo | null>(null);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<PillarAssignmentResult | null>(null);

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const [collegesRes, diagnosticRes] = await Promise.all([
        supabase.from('colleges').select('id, name, slug').eq('status', 'active').order('name'),
        getPillarDiagnosticInfoAction(pillarId)
      ]);
      
      if (collegesRes.error) throw collegesRes.error;
      setColleges(collegesRes.data || []);

      if (diagnosticRes.ok && diagnosticRes.data) {
        setDiagnostic(diagnosticRes.data as PillarDiagnosticInfo);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load data:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load required data');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [pillarId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      void loadData();
    } else {
      // Reset result when closing
      setResult(null);
    }
  }, [open, pillarId, loadData]);

  const toggleCollege = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedCollegeIds(prev => 
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter(i => i !== id) : [...prev, id]
    );
  };

  const selectAll = () => {
    setSelectedCollegeIds(colleges.map(c => c.id));
  };

  const deselectAll = () => {
    setSelectedCollegeIds([]);
  };

  async function handleSubmit() {
    if (selectedCollegeIds.length === 0) {
      toast.error('Please select at least one college');
      return;
    }

    setIsPending(true);
    try {
      const response = await assignPillarToCollegesAction(pillarId, selectedCollegeIds);
      if (response.ok && response.data) {
        setResult(response.data);
        toast.success('Pillar assignment process completed');
      } else {
        toast.error(response.error || 'Failed to assign pillar');
      }
    } catch {
      toast.error('An unexpected error occurred');
    } finally {
      setIsPending(false);
    }
  }

  const isPillarReady = diagnostic?.publish_status === 'published' && 
                       (diagnostic.visible_to_college_admins || diagnostic.visible_to_college_students);

  const eligibleCourses = diagnostic?.courses.filter(c => c.renderable_in_college_admin && c.renderable_in_student) || [];
  const skippedCourses = diagnostic?.courses.filter(c => !c.renderable_in_college_admin || !c.renderable_in_student) || [];

  if (result) {
    return (
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-md bg-card border-2 border-border/50 shadow-2xl rounded-xl">
          <DialogHeader className="space-y-3 pb-4 border-b border-border/50">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-600">
                <CheckCircle className="h-6 w-6" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <DialogTitle className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">Assignment Complete</DialogTitle>
                <DialogDescription className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                  {pillarTitle}
                </DialogDescription>
              </div>
            </div>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="py-4 space-y-4">
             <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-muted/30 border border-border/50">
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-tighter text-muted-foreground/60 mb-1">Colleges</p>
                  <p className="text-xl font-bold leading-none">{result.collegesProcessed}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-muted/30 border border-border/50">
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-tighter text-muted-foreground/60 mb-1">Eligible Courses</p>
                  <p className="text-xl font-bold leading-none">{result.coursesEligible}</p>
                </div>
             </div>

             <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm p-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/5 border border-emerald-500/10">
                   <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium">New Assignments</span>
                   <span className="font-bold text-emerald-700">{result.assignmentsCreated}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm p-2 rounded-lg bg-blue-500/5 border border-blue-500/10">
                   <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium">Already Existed</span>
                   <span className="font-bold text-blue-700">{result.alreadyExisting}</span>
                </div>
                {result.skippedCourses.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm p-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/5 border border-amber-500/10">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium">Courses Skipped</span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-amber-700">{result.skippedCourses.length}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
             </div>

             {result.failedColleges.length > 0 && (
               <div className="bg-destructive/5 border border-destructive/20 rounded-xl p-3 flex gap-2">
                 <ShieldAlert className="h-4 w-4 text-destructive shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                 <div>
                   <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-destructive">Failures Detected</p>
                   <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-destructive/80">
                     {result.failedColleges.length} colleges had issues. Check logs for details.
                   </p>
                 </div>
               </div>
             )}
          </div>

          <DialogFooter className="pt-4 border-t border-border/50">
            <Button onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className="w-full font-bold">
              Close
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        {trigger || (
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="gap-2">
            <Users className="h-4 w-4" />
            Assign Pillar
          </Button>
        )}
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-md bg-card border-2 border-border/50 shadow-2xl rounded-xl">
        <DialogHeader className="space-y-3 pb-4 border-b border-border/50">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center text-primary">
              <Users className="h-6 w-6" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <DialogTitle className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">Assign Pillar</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground line-clamp-1">
                {pillarTitle}
              </DialogDescription>
            </div>
          </div>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="py-4 space-y-4">
          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 space-y-4">
               <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-primary/40" />
               <p className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-widest">Analyzing Pillar...</p>
            </div>
          ) : !isPillarReady ? (
            <div className="bg-destructive/5 border border-destructive/20 py-6 px-4 rounded-xl flex gap-3">
              <ShieldAlert className="h-5 w-5 text-destructive shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-2 text-destructive">Pillar Not Ready</p>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold leading-relaxed text-destructive/80">
                  This pillar must be <strong>Published</strong> and have <strong>Visibility</strong> enabled for College Admins or Students before it can be assigned.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="bg-primary/5 border border-primary/10 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                   <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-tight text-primary/80">Assignment Preview</span>
                   </div>
                   <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-background/50 font-bold">{eligibleCourses.length} Courses eligible</Badge>
                </div>
                
                <p className="text-[11px] font-medium leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                   Assignments will be created for each eligible course. Entitlements will be automatically granted to all students of the selected colleges.
                </p>

                {skippedCourses.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="pt-2 mt-2 border-t border-primary/10">
                     <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700">
                        {skippedCourses.length} courses will be skipped (unpublished or hidden).
                     </p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {eligibleCourses.length === 0 && (
                <div className="bg-amber-500/5 border border-amber-500/20 p-3 rounded-xl flex gap-2">
                  <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-800">
                    No eligible courses found in this pillar. Assigning will have no effect.
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1">
                  <Label className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground/80">Select Target Colleges</Label>
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-7 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-tight" onClick={selectAll}>Select All</Button>
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-7 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-tight" onClick={deselectAll}>Deselect All</Button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <ScrollArea className="h-[200px] border-2 border-border/40 rounded-xl p-2 bg-background/50">
                  {colleges.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-full text-sm text-muted-foreground italic">
                      No active colleges found.
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      {colleges.map((college) => (
                        <div 
                          key={college.id}
                          className="flex items-center space-x-3 p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-primary/5 transition-colors cursor-pointer group"
                          onClick={() => toggleCollege(college.id)}
                        >
                          <Checkbox 
                            id={`college-${college.id}`}
                            checked={selectedCollegeIds.includes(college.id)}
                            onCheckedChange={() => toggleCollege(college.id)}
                            className="border-2 data-[state=checked]:bg-primary data-[state=checked]:border-primary"
                          />
                          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                            <Label 
                              htmlFor={`college-${college.id}`}
                              className="text-sm font-semibold cursor-pointer group-hover:text-primary transition-colors block truncate"
                            >
                              {college.name}
                            </Label>
                            <p className="text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground/60">{college.slug}</p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </ScrollArea>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>

        <DialogFooter className="pt-4 border-t border-border/50">
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} disabled={isPending} className="font-bold">
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button 
            onClick={handleSubmit} 
            disabled={isPending || selectedCollegeIds.length === 0 || !isPillarReady || eligibleCourses.length === 0}
            className="bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90 text-primary-foreground font-bold px-6 shadow-lg shadow-primary/20"
          >
            {isPending ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                Assigning...
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <CheckCircle2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                Assign to {selectedCollegeIds.length} Colleges
              </>
            )}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { Layers, MoreVertical } from 'lucide-react';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import { CreateCourseDialog } from './create-course-dialog';
import { DestructiveConfirmDialog } from './destructive-confirm-dialog';
import { RetryCourseSyncButton } from './retry-course-sync-button';
import { MoveCourseDialog } from './move-course-dialog';
import type { CourseDeleteImpact } from '@/lib/services/master-course-delete';
import type { MasterCourseWithStats } from '@/lib/services/master-courses';
import type { MasterCoursePillarStatsRow } from '@/types/database';
import { deleteCourseAction } from '@/app/(app)/master-courses/actions';

interface CourseCardActionsProps {
  course: MasterCourseWithStats;
  pillarId: string;

  allPillars?: MasterCoursePillarStatsRow[];
}

export function CourseCardActions({ course, pillarId, deleteImpact, allPillars = [] }: CourseCardActionsProps) {
  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}>
          <MoreVertical className="h-4 w-4" />
        </Button>
      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-48" onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}>
        <DropdownMenuLabel>Course Actions</DropdownMenuLabel>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuItem asChild className="cursor-pointer">
          <Link href={`/master-courses/pillars/${pillarId}/courses/${course.id}`}>

          </Link>
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        
        {allPillars.length > 1 && (
          <MoveCourseDialog
            courseId={course.id}
            courseTitle={course.title}
            currentPillarId={pillarId}
            pillars={allPillars}
          />
        )}
        
        <CreateCourseDialog 
          pillarId={pillarId} 
          course={course} 
          mode="menuitem"
        />
        
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        
        {course.tp_folder_status !== 'created' && (
          <DropdownMenuItem asChild className="cursor-pointer">
            <RetryCourseSyncButton 
              courseId={course.id} 
              pillarId={pillarId} 
              variant="ghost" 
              className="w-full justify-start h-auto p-0 font-normal px-2 py-1.5 hover:bg-transparent" 
            />
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        )}
        
        <DestructiveConfirmDialog
          title={`Delete course "${course.title}"?`}
          description="This revokes college assignments first, hides the course, and deletes TPStreams content only when no paid B2C history exists."
          confirmLabel={deleteImpact.archiveOnly ? 'Archive Course' : 'Delete Course'}
          pendingLabel={deleteImpact.archiveOnly ? 'Archiving course...' : 'Deleting course...'}
          acceptedConfirmations={['DELETE COURSE', course.title]}
          confirmationHint={`Type DELETE COURSE or the exact course title: ${course.title}`}
          impactStats={[
            { label: 'Modules', value: deleteImpact.moduleCount },
            { label: 'Videos', value: deleteImpact.videoCount },
            { label: 'College assignments', value: deleteImpact.assignmentCount },
            { label: 'Active B2B entitlements', value: deleteImpact.activeB2bEntitlementCount },
          ]}
          warnings={[
            deleteImpact.paidOrderCount > 0
              ? `Paid B2C history found (${deleteImpact.paidOrderCount} orders). This action will archive only and keep TPStreams assets intact.`
              : 'TPStreams course folder deletion will run only after access cleanup succeeds.',
            deleteImpact.activeB2cEntitlementCount > 0
              ? `${deleteImpact.activeB2cEntitlementCount} active B2C entitlements exist. History is preserved.`
              : 'Payment and order history are preserved.',
          ]}
          renderTrigger={(openDialog) => (
            <DropdownMenuItem
              className="cursor-pointer text-destructive focus:text-destructive"
              onSelect={(event) => {
                event.preventDefault();
                openDialog();
              }}
            >
              Delete Course
            </DropdownMenuItem>
          )}
          onConfirm={async (confirmationValue) => {
            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('pillar_id', pillarId);
            formData.append('course_id', course.id);
            formData.append('course_title', course.title);
            formData.append('confirmation', confirmationValue);
            return deleteCourseAction(formData);
          }}
        />
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/master-courses/course-visibility-toggles.tsx ---
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { ShieldAlert, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { updateCourseVisibilityAction } from '@/app/(app)/master-courses/actions';

interface CourseVisibilityTogglesProps {
  courseId: string;
  pillarId: string;
  initialVisibility: {
    visible_to_college_admins: boolean;
    visible_to_college_students: boolean;
    visible_to_global_students: boolean;
  };
  showGlobalStudents?: boolean;
  compact?: boolean;
}

export function CourseVisibilityToggles({
  courseId,
  pillarId,
  initialVisibility,
  showGlobalStudents = true,
  compact = false,
}: CourseVisibilityTogglesProps) {
  const [isPending, setIsPending] = useState(false);
  const [visibility, setVisibility] = useState(initialVisibility);
  const router = useRouter();

  async function handleToggle(key: keyof typeof initialVisibility, value: boolean) {
    const nextVisibility = { ...visibility, [key]: value };
    
    // Optimistic update
    setVisibility(nextVisibility);
    setIsPending(true);

    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('course_id', courseId);
    formData.append('pillar_id', pillarId);
    Object.entries(nextVisibility).forEach(([k, v]) => {
      formData.append(k, String(v));
    });

    try {
      const result = await updateCourseVisibilityAction(formData);
      if (result.ok) {
        toast.success('Course visibility updated');
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        toast.error(result.error ?? 'Failed to update visibility');
        // Revert on error
        setVisibility(visibility);
      }
    } catch {
      toast.error('An unexpected error occurred');
      setVisibility(visibility);
    } finally {
      setIsPending(false);
    }
  }

  const wrapperClassName = compact ? 'flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2' : 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-2';
  const rowClassName = compact
    ? 'flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-2 py-1.5 rounded bg-background border border-muted-foreground/10 min-w-[170px]'
    : 'flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-2 py-1.5 rounded bg-background border border-muted-foreground/10';
  const labelClassName = compact
    ? 'text-[11px] font-medium leading-none cursor-pointer'
    : 'text-[10px] font-medium leading-none cursor-pointer';
  const switchClassName = compact ? 'scale-75 origin-right' : 'scale-75 origin-right';

  return (
    <div className={wrapperClassName}>
      <div className={rowClassName}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          {visibility.visible_to_college_admins ? (
            <ShieldCheck className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-500" />
          ) : (
            <ShieldAlert className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground/40" />
          )}
          <Label className={labelClassName} htmlFor={`col-admin-c-${courseId}`}>
            College Admins
          </Label>
        </div>
        <Switch
          id={`col-admin-c-${courseId}`}
          checked={visibility.visible_to_college_admins}
          onCheckedChange={(checked) => handleToggle('visible_to_college_admins', checked)}
          disabled={isPending}
          size="sm"
          className={switchClassName}
        />
      </div>

      <div className={rowClassName}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          {visibility.visible_to_college_students ? (
            <ShieldCheck className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-500" />
          ) : (
            <ShieldAlert className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground/40" />
          )}
          <Label className={labelClassName} htmlFor={`col-student-c-${courseId}`}>
            College Students
          </Label>
        </div>
        <Switch
          id={`col-student-c-${courseId}`}
          checked={visibility.visible_to_college_students}
          onCheckedChange={(checked) => handleToggle('visible_to_college_students', checked)}
          disabled={isPending}
          size="sm"
          className={switchClassName}
        />
      </div>

      {showGlobalStudents && (
        <div className={rowClassName}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            {visibility.visible_to_global_students ? (
              <ShieldCheck className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-500" />
            ) : (
              <ShieldAlert className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground/40" />
            )}
            <Label className={labelClassName} htmlFor={`global-student-c-${courseId}`}>
              Global Std.
            </Label>
          </div>
          <Switch
            id={`global-student-c-${courseId}`}
            checked={visibility.visible_to_global_students}
            onCheckedChange={(checked) => handleToggle('visible_to_global_students', checked)}
            disabled={isPending}
            size="sm"
            className={switchClassName}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/master-courses/create-course-dialog.tsx ---
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Plus, Loader2, Info } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { DropdownMenuItem } from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import { createCourseInsidePillarAction, updateCourseInsidePillarAction } from '@/app/(app)/master-courses/actions';
import type { MasterCoursesRow, MasterCoursePublishStatus } from '@/types/database';

interface CreateCourseDialogProps {
  pillarId: string;
  course?: MasterCoursesRow;
  mode?: 'button' | 'menuitem';
}

/** Uppercase code: at least 2 chars, A–Z / 0–9 only (schema allows hyphens; we keep codes compact). */
function deriveCourseCodeFromTitle(title: string): string {
  const compact = title.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');
  if (compact.length >= 2) return compact.slice(0, 50);
  if (compact.length === 1) return `${compact}${compact}`;
  return 'MC';
}

/** URL slug: lowercase, at least 2 chars. */
function deriveSlugFromTitle(title: string): string {
  const safe = title
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
  if (safe.length >= 2) return safe.slice(0, 100);
  if (safe.length === 1) return `${safe}${safe}`;
  return 'course';
}

export function CreateCourseDialog({ pillarId, course, mode = 'button' }: CreateCourseDialogProps) {

  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isPending, setIsPending] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();
  const [codeEditedByUser, setCodeEditedByUser] = useState(false);
  const [slugEditedByUser, setSlugEditedByUser] = useState(false);

  const isEdit = !!course;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open && !isEdit) {
      setCodeEditedByUser(false);
      setSlugEditedByUser(false);
    }
  }, [open, isEdit]);

  // Form state
  const [values, setValues] = useState({
    title: course?.title || '',
    code: course?.code || '',
    slug: course?.slug || '',
    description: course?.description || '',
    short_description: course?.short_description || '',
    publish_status: course?.publish_status || 'draft',
    visible_to_college_admins: course?.visible_to_college_admins ?? false,
    visible_to_college_students: course?.visible_to_college_students ?? false,
    visible_to_global_students: course?.visible_to_global_students ?? false,
  });

  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  const handleTitleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const title = e.target.value;
    setValues((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      title,
      code: codeEditedByUser ? prev.code : deriveCourseCodeFromTitle(title),
      slug: slugEditedByUser ? prev.slug : deriveSlugFromTitle(title),
    }));
  };

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsPending(true);
    setErrors({});

    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('pillar_id', pillarId);
    if (isEdit) formData.append('course_id', course!.id);

    let code = values.code.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (code.length < 2 || !/^[A-Z0-9-]+$/.test(code)) {
      code = deriveCourseCodeFromTitle(values.title);
    }
    let slug = values.slug.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (slug.length < 2 || !/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(slug)) {
      slug = deriveSlugFromTitle(values.title);
    }

    const payload = { ...values, code, slug };

    Object.entries(payload).forEach(([key, value]) => {
      formData.append(key, String(value));
    });

    try {
      const result = isEdit 
        ? await updateCourseInsidePillarAction(formData)
        : await createCourseInsidePillarAction(formData);

      if (result.ok) {
        toast.success(isEdit ? 'Course updated' : 'Course created');
        setOpen(false);
        if (!isEdit) {
          setValues({
            title: '',
            code: '',
            slug: '',
            description: '',
            short_description: '',
            publish_status: 'draft',
            visible_to_college_admins: false,
            visible_to_college_students: false,
            visible_to_global_students: false,
          });
        }
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        toast.error(result.error ?? 'An error occurred');
      }
    } catch {
      toast.error('An unexpected error occurred');
    } finally {
      setIsPending(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        {mode === 'menuitem' ? (
          <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={(e) => e.preventDefault()} className="cursor-pointer">
            <Info className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
            Edit Metadata
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        ) : (
          <Button size="sm">
            <Plus className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
            Add Course
          </Button>
        )}
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto bg-card border-2 border-border/50 shadow-2xl rounded-xl">
        <DialogHeader className="space-y-3 pb-4 border-b border-border/50">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center text-primary">
              <Plus className="h-6 w-6" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <DialogTitle className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
                {isEdit ? 'Edit Master Course' : 'Create Master Course'}
              </DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                {isEdit 
                  ? 'Refine metadata and visibility settings for this academic course.' 
                  : 'Initialize a new course within this pillar and its associated TPStreams storage.'}
              </DialogDescription>
            </div>
          </div>
        </DialogHeader>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-8 py-6">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            <div className="col-span-2 space-y-2.5">
              <Label htmlFor="course-title" className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground/80 ml-1">Course Title</Label>
              <Input
                id="course-title"
                placeholder="e.g. Advanced React Patterns"
                className="h-12 bg-background border-2 border-border/40 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:border-primary/50 transition-all font-medium text-base"
                value={values.title}
                onChange={handleTitleChange}
                required
              />
              {errors.title && <p className="text-xs font-bold text-destructive mt-1.5 ml-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 before:content-[''] before:w-1 before:h-1 before:bg-destructive before:rounded-full">{errors.title}</p>}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              <Label htmlFor="course-code" className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground/80 ml-1">Reference Code</Label>
              <Input
                id="course-code"
                placeholder="REACT-ADV"
                className="h-11 bg-background border-2 border-border/40 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:border-primary/50 font-mono text-xs font-bold"
                value={values.code}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setCodeEditedByUser(true);
                  setValues((prev) => ({ ...prev, code: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }));
                }}
                required
                disabled={isEdit}
              />
              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground/60 uppercase tracking-tight ml-1">
                Internal unique code (min 2 characters). Auto-filled from the title; edit if needed.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              <Label htmlFor="course-slug" className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground/80 ml-1">URL Slug</Label>
              <Input
                id="course-slug"
                placeholder="react-advanced"
                className="h-11 bg-background border-2 border-border/40 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:border-primary/50 font-mono text-xs font-bold"
                value={values.slug}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setSlugEditedByUser(true);
                  setValues((prev) => ({ ...prev, slug: e.target.value }));
                }}
                required
              />
              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground/60 uppercase tracking-tight ml-1">Used in public application routing.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2.5">
            <Label htmlFor="course-short-desc" className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground/80 ml-1">Short Summary</Label>
            <Input
              id="course-short-desc"
              placeholder="Brief summary for display cards"
              className="h-11 bg-background border-2 border-border/40 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:border-primary/50 font-medium"
              value={values.short_description}
              onChange={(e) => setValues(prev => ({ ...prev, short_description: e.target.value }))}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2.5">
            <Label htmlFor="course-desc" className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground/80 ml-1">Curriculum Details</Label>
            <Textarea
              id="course-desc"
              placeholder="Detailed description of course objectives and outcomes..."
              className="bg-background border-2 border-border/40 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:border-primary/50 min-h-[120px] font-medium leading-relaxed resize-none"
              value={values.description}
              onChange={(e) => setValues(prev => ({ ...prev, description: e.target.value }))}
              rows={4}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-8">
            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              <Label className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground/80 ml-1">Publish Status</Label>
              <Select
                value={values.publish_status}
                onValueChange={(v) => setValues(prev => ({ ...prev, publish_status: v as MasterCoursePublishStatus }))}
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="h-11 bg-background border-2 border-border/40 focus:ring-primary font-bold">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Select status" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent className="bg-card border-2 border-border/50">
                  <SelectItem value="draft" className="font-bold py-2.5">Draft</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="published" className="font-bold py-2.5 text-primary">Published</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="unpublished" className="font-bold py-2.5">Unpublished</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-muted/30 p-6 rounded-2xl space-y-5 border-2 border-border/40">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <h4 className="text-sm font-black text-foreground uppercase tracking-widest">Visibility Context</h4>
              <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-muted-foreground/70 leading-normal">
                Determine which academic interfaces will list this course. Detailed content access is managed via assignments.
              </p>
            </div>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border-2 border-border/40 p-3 bg-background hover:border-primary/40 transition-all cursor-pointer group">
                <Label htmlFor="cvis-admins" className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-tight cursor-pointer group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">Admin Portal</Label>
                <Switch
                  id="cvis-admins"
                  checked={values.visible_to_college_admins}
                  onCheckedChange={(v) => setValues(prev => ({ ...prev, visible_to_college_admins: v }))}
                  size="sm"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border-2 border-border/40 p-3 bg-background hover:border-primary/40 transition-all cursor-pointer group">
                <Label htmlFor="cvis-students" className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-tight cursor-pointer group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">College Hub</Label>
                <Switch
                  id="cvis-students"
                  checked={values.visible_to_college_students}
                  onCheckedChange={(v) => setValues(prev => ({ ...prev, visible_to_college_students: v }))}
                  size="sm"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border-2 border-border/40 p-3 bg-background hover:border-primary/40 transition-all cursor-pointer group">
                <Label htmlFor="cvis-global" className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-tight cursor-pointer group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">Global Access</Label>
                <Switch
                  id="cvis-global"
                  checked={values.visible_to_global_students}
                  onCheckedChange={(v) => setValues(prev => ({ ...prev, visible_to_global_students: v }))}
                  size="sm"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter className="gap-3 sm:gap-0 pt-4 border-t border-border/50">
            <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} disabled={isPending} className="font-bold hover:bg-muted/50">
              Discard Changes
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={isPending} className="h-11 px-8 bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90 text-primary-foreground font-black uppercase tracking-widest shadow-xl shadow-primary/20 transition-all hover:translate-y-[-1px] active:translate-y-[0px]">
              {isPending && <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />}
              {isEdit ? 'Update Course' : 'Confirm & Create'}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
