'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { RefreshCw, Loader2, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { runFullSyncAction } from '@/app/(app)/master-courses/actions';
import type { TpSyncStats } from '@/lib/services/tpstreams-sync';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';

export function SyncTpStreamsButton({
  onSyncComplete
}: {
  onSyncComplete?: (unmatchedFolders: TpSyncStats['unmatchedFolderList']) => void;
}) {
  const [isPending, setIsPending] = useState(false);
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<TpSyncStats | null>(null);
  const router = useRouter();

  async function handleSync() {
    setIsPending(true);
    setResult(null);

    try {
      const response = await runFullSyncAction();
      if (response.ok && response.data) {
        setResult(response.data);
        toast.success(response.message || 'Sync completed successfully');
        if (onSyncComplete && response.data.unmatchedFolderList) {
          onSyncComplete(response.data.unmatchedFolderList);
        }
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        toast.error(response.error || 'Failed to sync with TPStreams');
      }
    } catch {
      toast.error('An unexpected error occurred during sync');
    } finally {
      setIsPending(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={setIsOpen}>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          className="border-primary/20 hover:bg-primary/5 hover:text-primary transition-all shadow-sm"
        >
          <RefreshCw className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
          Sync with TPStreams
        </Button>
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[425px] bg-card border-2 border-border/50 shadow-2xl rounded-xl">
        <DialogHeader className="space-y-3 pb-4 border-b border-border/50">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center text-primary">
              <RefreshCw className={`h-6 w-6 ${isPending ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <DialogTitle className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
                Sync with TPStreams
              </DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                Reconcile local database records with remote storage assets.
              </DialogDescription>
            </div>
          </div>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="py-6">
          {isPending ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-10 space-y-5">
              <Loader2 className="h-14 w-14 animate-spin text-primary opacity-80" />
              <div className="text-center space-y-1.5">
                <p className="text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-primary animate-pulse">Synchronizing</p>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground max-w-[200px] mx-auto leading-normal">
                  Fetching remote folders and validating asset hierarchy...
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : result ? (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-4 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/[0.03] border-2 border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-700 shadow-sm">
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-6 w-6" />
                <span className="text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-widest">Operation Success</span>
              </div>
              
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-muted/30 border-2 border-border/40 shadow-sm group hover:border-primary/20 transition-all">
                  <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest font-black text-muted-foreground/60 mb-1">Folders</p>
                  <p className="text-3xl font-black tracking-tighter text-foreground">{result.totalFolders}</p>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-2 text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground/70">
                    <span className="text-primary">{result.matchedFolders} matched</span>
                    <span>/</span>
                    <span>{result.unmatchedFolders} raw</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-muted/30 border-2 border-border/40 shadow-sm group hover:border-primary/20 transition-all">
                  <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest font-black text-muted-foreground/60 mb-1">Assets</p>
                  <p className="text-3xl font-black tracking-tighter text-foreground">{result.totalAssets}</p>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-2 text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground/70">
                    <span className="text-primary">{result.matchedAssets} matched</span>
                    <span>/</span>
                    <span>{result.unmatchedAssets} raw</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {(result.newLocalRows > 0 || result.updatedLocalRows > 0) && (
                <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-primary/[0.03] border-2 border-primary/20 shadow-sm">
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-primary mb-2.5">Database Delta</p>
                  <ul className="text-xs space-y-2 text-muted-foreground font-bold">
                    <li className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary" />
                      Created {result.newLocalRows} new video records
                    </li>
                    <li className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary" />
                      Updated {result.updatedLocalRows} existing entries
                    </li>
                  </ul>
                </div>
              )}

              {result.errors && result.errors.length > 0 && (
                <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-destructive/[0.03] border-2 border-destructive/20 text-destructive shadow-sm">
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
                    Conflict Log
                  </p>
                  <ul className="text-[10px] font-bold list-disc pl-4 space-y-1.5 opacity-80">
                    {result.errors.map((err: string, i: number) => (
                      <li key={i}>{err}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="bg-muted/30 p-5 rounded-xl border-2 border-border/40 shadow-inner">
              <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-foreground/70 mb-3">Synchronization Purpose</p>
              <ul className="text-xs space-y-3 text-muted-foreground font-bold">
                <li className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary shrink-0 mt-1" />
                  <span>Detection of structural changes made directly in TPStreams.</span>
                </li>
                <li className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary shrink-0 mt-1" />
                  <span>Update of video processing states and metadata durations.</span>
                </li>
                <li className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary shrink-0 mt-1" />
                  <span>Resolution of state drift between remote and local storage.</span>
                </li>
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <DialogFooter className="gap-3 pt-4 border-t border-border/50">
          {!result && (
            <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)} disabled={isPending} className="font-bold">
              Dismiss
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button 
            onClick={result ? () => setIsOpen(false) : handleSync} 
            disabled={isPending}
            className="h-11 px-8 bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90 text-primary-foreground font-black uppercase tracking-widest shadow-xl shadow-primary/20 transition-all"
          >
            {isPending ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                Syncing...
              </>
            ) : result ? (
              'Close Monitor'
            ) : (
              'Initiate Sync'
            )}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

'use client';

import { MoreHorizontal, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';

import { deleteVideoAssetAction } from '@/app/(app)/master-courses/actions';
import { DestructiveConfirmDialog } from '@/components/master-courses/destructive-confirm-dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import type { VideoDeleteImpact } from '@/lib/services/master-course-delete';

interface VideoDeleteActionProps {
  pillarId: string;
  courseId: string;
  moduleId: string;
  videoId: string;
  videoTitle: string;
  impact: VideoDeleteImpact;
}

export function VideoDeleteAction({
  pillarId,
  courseId,
  moduleId,
  videoId,
  videoTitle,
  impact,
}: VideoDeleteActionProps) {
  return (
    <DestructiveConfirmDialog
      title={`Delete video "${videoTitle}"?`}
      description="This removes the TPStreams asset through the existing project service and archives the local record."
      confirmLabel="Delete Video"
      pendingLabel="Deleting video..."
      impactStats={[
        { label: 'Referenced in curriculum', value: impact.isReferenced ? 'Yes' : 'No' },
      ]}
      warnings={[
        'This uses the existing official TPStreams asset delete function only.',
        'Payment and order history are preserved.',
      ]}
      renderTrigger={(openDialog, pending) => (
        <DropdownMenu>
          <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="icon"
              className="h-8 w-8"
              disabled={pending}
              onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
            >
              <MoreHorizontal className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
          </DropdownMenuTrigger>
          <DropdownMenuContent align="end" onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}>
            <DropdownMenuItem
              className="cursor-pointer text-destructive focus:text-destructive"
              onSelect={(event) => {
                event.preventDefault();
                openDialog();
              }}
            >
              <Trash2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              Delete Video
            </DropdownMenuItem>
          </DropdownMenuContent>
        </DropdownMenu>
      )}
      onConfirm={async () => {
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('pillar_id', pillarId);
        formData.append('course_id', courseId);
        formData.append('module_id', moduleId);
        formData.append('video_asset_id', videoId);
        return deleteVideoAssetAction(formData);
      }}
    />
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/pages/activity.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import type { ActivityEventRow } from '@/lib/activity/queries';

interface CollegeOption {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
}

export function ActivityPage({
  initialEvents = [],
  colleges = [],
  eventCategories = [],
}: {
  initialEvents: ActivityEventRow[];
  colleges: CollegeOption[];
  eventCategories: string[];
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const [tenantId, setTenantId] = useState(searchParams.get('tenantId') ?? '');
  const [userId, setUserId] = useState(searchParams.get('userId') ?? '');
  const [eventName, setEventName] = useState(searchParams.get('eventName') ?? '');
  const [eventCategory, setEventCategory] = useState(searchParams.get('eventCategory') ?? '');
  const [from, setFrom] = useState(searchParams.get('from') ?? '');
  const [to, setTo] = useState(searchParams.get('to') ?? '');

  const applyFilters = () => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (tenantId) params.set('tenantId', tenantId);
    if (userId) params.set('userId', userId);
    if (eventName) params.set('eventName', eventName);
    if (eventCategory) params.set('eventCategory', eventCategory);
    if (from) params.set('from', from);
    if (to) params.set('to', to);
    router.push(`/activity?${params.toString()}`);
  };

  const clearFilters = () => {
    setTenantId('');
    setUserId('');
    setEventName('');
    setEventCategory('');
    setFrom('');
    setTo('');
    router.push('/activity');
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/30 p-4 space-y-3">
        <p className="text-sm font-medium">Filters</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">Tenant</label>
            <Select value={tenantId} onValueChange={setTenantId}>
              <SelectTrigger className="w-full">
                <SelectValue placeholder="All" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {colleges.map((c) => (
                  <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}</SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">User ID</label>
            <Input
              placeholder="Actor user UUID"
              value={userId}
              onChange={(e) => setUserId(e.target.value)}
              className="h-9 text-sm"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">Event name</label>
            <Input
              placeholder="e.g. login_success"
              value={eventName}
              onChange={(e) => setEventName(e.target.value)}
              className="h-9 text-sm"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">Category</label>
            <Select value={eventCategory} onValueChange={setEventCategory}>
              <SelectTrigger className="w-full">
                <SelectValue placeholder="All" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {eventCategories.map((cat) => (
                  <SelectItem key={cat} value={cat}>{cat}</SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">From (ISO date)</label>
            <Input
              type="date"
              value={from}
              onChange={(e) => setFrom(e.target.value)}
              className="h-9 text-sm"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">To (ISO date)</label>
            <Input
              type="date"
              value={to}
              onChange={(e) => setTo(e.target.value)}
              className="h-9 text-sm"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button size="sm" onClick={applyFilters}>Apply</Button>
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={clearFilters}>Clear</Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-4 min-w-0 overflow-x-auto">
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead className="w-28">Time</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Event</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Category</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="w-24 hidden md:table-cell">Actor</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="hidden lg:table-cell">Role</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="hidden lg:table-cell">Entity</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="max-w-[12rem] hidden xl:table-cell">Metadata</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {initialEvents.length === 0 ? (
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell colSpan={7} className="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8">
                  No activity events yet. Events are recorded when users log in, admins are invited, feature flags change, etc.
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ) : (
              initialEvents.map((row) => (
                <TableRow key={row.id}>
                  <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">
                    {new Date(row.created_at).toLocaleString()}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="font-medium">{row.event_name}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground hidden md:table-cell">{row.event_category}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground hidden md:table-cell">
                    {row.actor_user_id ? `${row.actor_user_id.slice(0, 8)}…` : '—'}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground hidden lg:table-cell">{row.actor_role ?? '—'}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground hidden lg:table-cell">
                    {row.entity_type ?? '—'}
                    {row.entity_id ? ` · ${String(row.entity_id).slice(0, 8)}…` : ''}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate max-w-[12rem] hidden xl:table-cell" title={JSON.stringify(row.metadata)}>
                    {Object.keys(row.metadata).length ? JSON.stringify(row.metadata).slice(0, 60) + '…' : '—'}
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))
            )}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/pages/analytics-dashboard.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { getAnalyticsReportAction } from '@/app/(app)/analytics/actions';
import type { GA4DashboardData } from '@/lib/ga4/reporting';
import { Activity, ArrowDownRight, ArrowUpRight, Eye, FileWarning, Globe, Loader2, MousePointerClick, Target, Timer, TrendingUp, UserPlus, Users } from 'lucide-react';

type Preset = 'today' | '7d' | '30d';

export const AnalyticsDashboard = React.memo(function AnalyticsDashboard({
  initialData,
  initialError,
  ga4PropertyId,
}: {
  initialData: GA4DashboardData | null;
  initialError: string | null;
  ga4PropertyId: string | null;
}) {
  const [preset, setPreset] = useState<Preset>('7d');
  const [data, setData] = useState<GA4DashboardData | null>(initialData);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(initialError);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const load = async (p: Preset) => {
    setPreset(p);
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    const result = await getAnalyticsReportAction(p);
    setLoading(false);
    if (result.ok) setData(result.data);
    else setError(result.error);
  };

  const displayData = loading ? null : data;
  const notConfigured = displayData && !displayData.configured;
  const hasError = error || displayData?.error;

  const toLabel = (value: string): string => {
    if (!value) return '(not set)';
    const map: Record<string, string> = {
      hero: 'Hero',
      college_strip: 'College strip',
      program: 'Program',
      dashboard_preview: 'Dashboard preview',
      founders: 'Founders',
      youtube_stats: 'YouTube stats',
      testimonials: 'Testimonials',
      faq: 'FAQ',
      footer: 'Footer',
      sticky_cta: 'Sticky CTA',
      '/': 'Home',
      '/contact': 'Contact',
      '/student': 'Student',
      '/student-2': 'Student v2',
      '/about': 'About',
      '/careers': 'Careers',
      '/privacy': 'Privacy',
      '/terms': 'Terms',
      '/cookies': 'Cookies',
      '/corporate': 'Corporate',
      '/campus-2': 'Campus v2',
      '/login': 'Login',
    };
    return map[value] ?? value.replaceAll('_', ' ');
  };

  const formatCount = (value: number): string => value.toLocaleString('en-IN');

  const formatSeconds = (seconds: number): string => {
    if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds <= 0) return '0s';
    if (seconds >= 60) {
      const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
      const remaining = Math.round(seconds % 60);
      return `${minutes}m ${remaining}s`;
    }
    return `${Math.round(seconds)}s`;
  };

  const percentChange = (current: number, previous?: number | null): number | null => {
    if (previous === null || previous === undefined || previous === 0) return null;
    return ((current - previous) / previous) * 100;
  };

  const renderTrend = (current: number, previous?: number | null) => {
    const delta = percentChange(current, previous);
    if (delta === null) {
      return <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>No previous-period baseline</p>;
    }
    const isUp = delta >= 0;
    const Icon = isUp ? ArrowUpRight : ArrowDownRight;
    return (
      <p className={`text-xs flex items-center gap-1 ${isUp ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-rose-600'}`}>
        <Icon className='h-3 w-3' />
        {Math.abs(delta).toFixed(1)}% vs previous period
      </p>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className='space-y-8'>
      <div className='rounded-2xl border border-border bg-gradient-to-r from-background via-background to-muted/40 p-5 md:p-6'>
        <p className='text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-primary'>Landing Performance Dashboard</p>
        <h1 className='text-xl md:text-2xl font-semibold mt-1'>GA4 insights for lead generation and portal handoff</h1>
        <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-2'>
          Focus on winning routes, conversion drop-offs, CTA performance, and lead quality signals.
        </p>
        <div className='mt-3 inline-flex items-center rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-2 py-1 text-xs'>
          <span className='text-muted-foreground'>Current GA4 property:</span>
          <span className='ml-2 font-mono font-semibold text-foreground'>
            {ga4PropertyId ?? 'Not configured'}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className='flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2'>
        <span className='text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground'>Date range:</span>
        {(['today', '7d', '30d'] as const).map((p) => (
          <Button key={p} variant={preset === p ? 'default' : 'outline'} size='sm' onClick={() => load(p)} disabled={loading}>
            {p === 'today' ? 'Today' : p === '7d' ? 'Last 7 days' : 'Last 30 days'}
          </Button>
        ))}
        {loading && <Loader2 className='w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground' />}
      </div>

      {hasError && (
        <div className='rounded-lg border border-destructive/50 bg-destructive/10 p-4 text-sm text-destructive'>
          {error || displayData?.error}
        </div>
      )}

      {notConfigured && (
        <div className='rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/30 p-8 text-center text-muted-foreground'>
          <p className='font-medium'>GA4 not configured</p>
          <p className='mt-2 text-sm'>
            Set GA4_PROPERTY_ID and GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_JSON in environment, then go to Analytics Settings.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {displayData && displayData.configured && !displayData.error && (
        <>
          <div className='grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-8 gap-3'>
            <SummaryCard title='Active users' value={displayData.summary.activeUsers} icon={<Users className='w-4 h-4' />} helper='Users active in selected period' trend={renderTrend(displayData.summary.activeUsers, displayData.previousSummary?.activeUsers)} />
            <SummaryCard title='New users' value={displayData.topEvents.find((event) => event.eventName === 'first_visit')?.eventCount ?? 0} icon={<UserPlus className='w-4 h-4' />} helper='Estimated from first_visit events' />
            <SummaryCard title='Sessions' value={displayData.summary.sessions} icon={<Activity className='w-4 h-4' />} helper='All sessions across tracked routes' trend={renderTrend(displayData.summary.sessions, displayData.previousSummary?.sessions)} />
            <SummaryCard title='Engagement rate' value={`${displayData.summary.engagementRate.toFixed(1)}%`} icon={<TrendingUp className='w-4 h-4' />} helper='Share of engaged sessions' trend={renderTrend(displayData.summary.engagementRate, displayData.previousSummary?.engagementRate)} />
            <SummaryCard title='Avg engagement' value={formatSeconds(displayData.summary.averageSessionDuration)} icon={<Timer className='w-4 h-4' />} helper='Average session duration' trend={renderTrend(displayData.summary.averageSessionDuration, displayData.previousSummary?.averageSessionDuration)} />
            <SummaryCard title='Views' value={displayData.summary.screenPageViews} icon={<Eye className='w-4 h-4' />} helper='Total page views' trend={renderTrend(displayData.summary.screenPageViews, displayData.previousSummary?.screenPageViews)} />
            <SummaryCard title='CTA clicks' value={displayData.topEvents.find((event) => event.eventName === 'cta_click')?.eventCount ?? 0} icon={<MousePointerClick className='w-4 h-4' />} helper='All tracked CTA interactions' />
            <SummaryCard title='Leads' value={displayData.topEvents.find((event) => event.eventName === 'generate_lead')?.eventCount ?? 0} icon={<Target className='w-4 h-4' />} helper='generate_lead events' />
          </div>

          <SectionCard title='Route performance' subtitle='Compare `/`, `/student`, `/corporate`, `/contact` on traffic and conversion metrics.'>
            <div className='overflow-x-auto'>
              <table className='w-full text-sm'>
                <thead>
                  <tr className='text-muted-foreground border-b border-border'>
                    <th className='text-left py-2 pr-3'>Route</th>
                    <th className='text-right py-2 pr-3'>Views</th>
                    <th className='text-right py-2 pr-3'>Users</th>
                    <th className='text-right py-2 pr-3'>Engagement</th>
                    <th className='text-right py-2 pr-3'>CTA clicks</th>
                    <th className='text-right py-2 pr-3'>Form starts</th>
                    <th className='text-right py-2 pr-3'>Form submits</th>
                    <th className='text-right py-2'>Leads</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {displayData.landingRoutes.map((route) => (
                    <tr key={route.pagePath} className='border-b border-border/50'>
                      <td className='py-2 pr-3'>
                        <p className='font-medium'>{toLabel(route.pagePath)}</p>
                        <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono'>{route.pagePath}</p>
                      </td>
                      <td className='text-right py-2 pr-3'>{formatCount(route.views)}</td>
                      <td className='text-right py-2 pr-3'>{formatCount(route.activeUsers)}</td>
                      <td className='text-right py-2 pr-3'>{route.engagementRate.toFixed(1)}%</td>
                      <td className='text-right py-2 pr-3'>{formatCount(route.ctaClicks)}</td>
                      <td className='text-right py-2 pr-3'>{formatCount(route.formStarts)}</td>
                      <td className='text-right py-2 pr-3'>{formatCount(route.formSubmits)}</td>
                      <td className='text-right py-2'>{formatCount(route.leadEvents)}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </SectionCard>

          <div className='grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6'>
            <SectionCard title='Landing funnel' subtitle='Simple progression from awareness to lead conversion.'>
              {displayData.funnel.length === 0 ? (
                <SmartEmptyState title='No funnel events in selected period' description='Expected page_view, cta_click, form_start, form_submit, and generate_lead events.' />
              ) : (
                <div className='space-y-3'>
                  {displayData.funnel.map((step, index) => {
                    const prev = index === 0 ? step.count : displayData.funnel[index - 1].count;
                    const drop = prev > 0 ? ((prev - step.count) / prev) * 100 : 0;
                    return (
                      <div key={step.key} className='rounded-lg border border-border/70 p-3'>
                        <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
                          <p className='font-medium'>{step.label}</p>
                          <p className='font-semibold'>{formatCount(step.count)}</p>
                        </div>
                        {index > 0 && (
                          <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1'>
                            {drop > 0 ? `${drop.toFixed(1)}% drop from previous step` : 'No drop from previous step'}
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
            </SectionCard>

            <SectionCard title='Top pages' subtitle='Sorted by views with contribution percentage.'>
              {displayData.topPages.length === 0 ? (
                <SmartEmptyState title='No page-level view data yet' description='Expecting GA4 pagePath + screenPageViews rows.' />
              ) : (
                <div className='space-y-2'>
                  {displayData.topPages.map((row) => {
                    const ratio = displayData.summary.screenPageViews > 0
                      ? (row.views / displayData.summary.screenPageViews) * 100
                      : 0;
                    return (
                      <div key={row.pagePath} className='rounded-lg border border-border/70 p-3'>
                        <div className='flex justify-between items-center'>
                          <div>
                            <p className='font-medium'>{toLabel(row.pagePath)}</p>
                            <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono'>{row.pagePath}</p>
                          </div>
                          <p className='font-semibold'>{formatCount(row.views)}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div className='mt-2'>
                          <div className='h-2 rounded-full bg-muted overflow-hidden'>
                            <div className='h-2 bg-primary' style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, ratio)}%` }} />
                          </div>
                          <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1'>{ratio.toFixed(1)}% of total views</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
            </SectionCard>
          </div>

          <div className='grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6'>
            <SectionCard title='Business event groups' subtitle='Grouped as traffic, sections, CTA interactions, forms, and leads.'>
              {displayData.categorizedEvents.every((group) => group.totalCount === 0) ? (
                <SmartEmptyState title='No event distribution available' description='No topEvents found for this period.' />
              ) : (
                <div className='space-y-3'>
                  {displayData.categorizedEvents.map((group) => (
                    <div key={group.category} className='rounded-lg border border-border/70 p-3'>
                      <div className='flex justify-between items-center mb-2'>
                        <p className='font-medium'>{group.label}</p>
                        <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>{formatCount(group.totalCount)} events</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className='space-y-1'>
                        {group.events.slice(0, 4).map((event) => (
                          <div key={event.eventName} className='flex justify-between text-sm'>
                            <span>{event.label}</span>
                            <span className='text-muted-foreground'>{formatCount(event.count)}</span>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </SectionCard>

            <SectionCard title='Sections and CTAs' subtitle='Shows metadata quality and engagement by section/CTA labels.'>
              <div className='space-y-4'>
                <div>
                  <h4 className='text-sm font-medium mb-2'>Top CTA labels</h4>
                  {displayData.topCtas.length === 0 ? (
                    <SmartEmptyState
                      title='No CTA metadata found for this period'
                      description='GA4 is receiving cta_click events but cta_name is unavailable in this report payload.'
                      compact
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <div className='space-y-1'>
                      {displayData.topCtas.slice(0, 8).map((row) => (
                        <div key={row.ctaName} className='flex justify-between text-sm'>
                          <span>{toLabel(row.ctaName)}</span>
                          <span className='text-muted-foreground'>{formatCount(row.clicks)}</span>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div>
                  <h4 className='text-sm font-medium mb-2'>Top engaged sections</h4>
                  {displayData.sectionEngagement.length === 0 ? (
                    <SmartEmptyState
                      title='No section metadata found for this period'
                      description='Events may exist, but section_name is unavailable in current report payload.'
                      compact
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <div className='space-y-1'>
                      {displayData.sectionEngagement.slice(0, 8).map((row) => (
                        <div key={row.sectionName} className='flex justify-between text-sm'>
                          <span>{toLabel(row.sectionName)}</span>
                          <span className='text-muted-foreground'>{formatCount(row.count)}</span>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </SectionCard>
          </div>

          <div className='grid lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6'>
            <SectionCard title='Traffic sources' subtitle='Acquisition context; useful but secondary to conversion blocks.'>
              {displayData.topSources.length === 0 ? (
                <SmartEmptyState title='No traffic source data' description='Expected sessionSource/sessionMedium rows from GA4.' compact />
              ) : (
                <div className='space-y-1'>
                  {displayData.topSources.map((row, index) => (
                    <div key={`${row.source}-${row.medium}-${index}`} className='flex justify-between text-sm'>
                      <span>{row.source} / {row.medium || '(none)'}</span>
                      <span className='text-muted-foreground'>{formatCount(row.sessions)}</span>

              {displayData.topCountries.length === 0 ? (

              ) : (

                  {displayData.topCountries.map((row) => (

              )}

              {displayData.deviceBreakdown.length === 0 ? (

              ) : (

                  {displayData.deviceBreakdown.map((row) => (
                    <div key={row.deviceCategory} className='flex justify-between text-sm'>
                      <span className='capitalize'>{row.deviceCategory}</span>
                      <span className='text-muted-foreground'>{formatCount(row.sessions)} sessions</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </SectionCard>
          </div>

          {(displayData.diagnostics.length > 0 || displayData.topEvents.length > 0) && (
            <SectionCard title='Event diagnostics' subtitle='Explains missing parameters and keeps raw event visibility.' icon={<FileWarning className='h-4 w-4' />}>
              <div className='space-y-2'>
                {displayData.diagnostics.map((diagnostic) => (
                  <div key={diagnostic} className='rounded-md border border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 p-2 text-xs text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200'>
                    {diagnostic}
                  </div>
                ))}
                {displayData.topEvents.length === 0 ? (
                  <SmartEmptyState title='No GA4 events returned in this period' description='Event diagnostics require topEvents data to be present.' compact />
                ) : (
                  <div className='rounded-md border border-border/60 p-3'>
                    <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-2'>Top raw event names</p>
                    <div className='space-y-1'>
                      {displayData.topEvents.slice(0, 8).map((event) => (
                        <div key={event.eventName} className='flex justify-between text-sm'>
                          <span className='font-mono text-xs'>{event.eventName}</span>
                          <span className='text-muted-foreground'>{formatCount(event.eventCount)}</span>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </SectionCard>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

function SummaryCard({
  title,
  value,
  icon,
  helper,
  trend,
}: {
  title: string;
  value: number | string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  helper?: string;
  trend?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className='rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-4 space-y-1'>
      <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
        <p className='text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider'>{title}</p>
        <div className='text-muted-foreground'>{icon}</div>
      </div>
      <p className='text-xl font-semibold'>{value}</p>
      {helper && <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>{helper}</p>}
      {trend}
    </div>
  );
}

function SectionCard({
  title,
  subtitle,
  children,
  icon,
}: {
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className='rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-4 md:p-5'>
      <div className='mb-4'>
        <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
          {icon}
          <h3 className='text-base font-semibold'>{title}</h3>
        </div>
        <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1'>{subtitle}</p>
      </div>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

function SmartEmptyState({
  title,
  description,
  compact = false,
}: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  compact?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div className={`rounded-lg border border-border/70 bg-muted/40 text-muted-foreground ${compact ? 'p-3' : 'p-4'}`}>
      <p className='text-sm font-medium'>{title}</p>
      <p className='text-xs mt-1'>{description}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Save, RefreshCw, Loader2, Stethoscope, CheckCircle2, XCircle, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import type { AnalyticsSettings } from '@/lib/services/analytics-settings';
import { saveAnalyticsSettingsAction, syncAnalyticsNowAction, runGA4DiagnosticsAction } from '@/app/(app)/analytics-settings/actions';
import type { GA4DiagnosticResult, GA4DiagnosticCheck } from '@/lib/ga4/diagnostics';

export const AnalyticsSettingsPage = React.memo(function AnalyticsSettingsPage({
  initialSettings,
}: {
  initialSettings: AnalyticsSettings;
}) {
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [syncing, setSyncing] = useState(false);
  const [diagRunning, setDiagRunning] = useState(false);
  const [diagResult, setDiagResult] = useState<GA4DiagnosticResult | null>(null);
  const [diagError, setDiagError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setPending(true);
    const formData = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
    const result = await saveAnalyticsSettingsAction(formData);
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      toast.error(result.error);
      return;
    }
    toast.success('Analytics settings saved.');
  };

  const handleSync = async () => {
    setSyncing(true);
    const result = await syncAnalyticsNowAction();
    setSyncing(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      toast.error(result.error);
      return;
    }
    toast.success('GA4 connection verified.');
  };

  const handleDiagnostics = async () => {
    setDiagRunning(true);
    setDiagError(null);
    setDiagResult(null);
    const result = await runGA4DiagnosticsAction();
    setDiagRunning(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setDiagError(result.error);
      return;
    }
    setDiagResult(result.data);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <Button type="submit" size="sm" disabled={pending}>
            {pending ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1 animate-spin" /> : <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />}
            {pending ? 'Saving...' : 'Save'}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-4 space-y-4">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">Global toggle</h3>
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              name="ga_enabled"
              value="on"
              defaultChecked={initialSettings.ga_enabled}
              className="rounded border-input"
            />
            <input type="hidden" name="ga_enabled" value="off" />
            Enable GA4 tracking (landing page loads gtag and sends events)
          </label>

          <hr className="border-border" />

          <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">Feature toggles</h3>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                name="section_tracking_enabled"
                value="on"
                defaultChecked={initialSettings.section_tracking_enabled}
                className="rounded border-input"
              />
              <input type="hidden" name="section_tracking_enabled" value="off" />
              Section tracking (section_view, section_engaged)
            </label>
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                name="cta_tracking_enabled"
                value="on"
                defaultChecked={initialSettings.cta_tracking_enabled}
                className="rounded border-input"
              />
              <input type="hidden" name="cta_tracking_enabled" value="off" />
              CTA click tracking
            </label>
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                name="form_tracking_enabled"
                value="on"
                defaultChecked={initialSettings.form_tracking_enabled}
                className="rounded border-input"
              />
              <input type="hidden" name="form_tracking_enabled" value="off" />
              Form tracking (open, submit, success, failure)
            </label>
          </div>

          <hr className="border-border" />

          <div>
            <label className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground block mb-1.5">
              GA4 Measurement ID
            </label>
            <Input
              name="measurement_id"
              defaultValue={initialSettings.measurement_id ?? ''}
              placeholder="G-XXXXXXXXXX"
              className="max-w-md"
            />
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              From GA4 Admin → Data Streams → your web stream. When disabled above, landing page will not load this.
            </p>
          </div>
        </section>
      </form>

      <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-4 space-y-4">
        <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">Connection status</h3>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
          <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Status: <strong>{initialSettings.ga4_connection_status ?? 'Not checked'}</strong>
          </span>
          <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Last synced: {initialSettings.last_synced_at ? new Date(initialSettings.last_synced_at).toLocaleString() : 'Never'}
          </span>
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={handleSync} disabled={syncing}>
            {syncing ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1 animate-spin" /> : <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />}
            Sync now
          </Button>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Sync verifies GA4 Data API access (GA4_PROPERTY_ID + GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_JSON in env).
        </p>
      </section>

      {/* ── GA4 Diagnostics ── */}
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-4 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">GA4 Diagnostics</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
              Runs a comprehensive check: env vars → credentials → API client → test query.
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={handleDiagnostics} disabled={diagRunning}>
            {diagRunning ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1 animate-spin" /> : <Stethoscope className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />}
            {diagRunning ? 'Running...' : 'Run diagnostics'}
          </Button>
        </div>

        {diagError && (
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-destructive/50 bg-destructive/10 p-3 text-sm text-destructive">
            {diagError}
          </div>
        )}

        {diagResult && (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {diagResult.overallStatus === 'pass' && <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />}
              {diagResult.overallStatus === 'fail' && <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-destructive" />}
              {diagResult.overallStatus === 'partial' && <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500" />}
              <span className="font-semibold text-sm capitalize">{diagResult.overallStatus}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              {diagResult.checks.map((check: GA4DiagnosticCheck, i: number) => (
                <div key={i} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
                  {check.status === 'pass' && <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />}
                  {check.status === 'fail' && <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-destructive mt-0.5 shrink-0" />}
                  {check.status === 'warn' && <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />}
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-medium">{check.name}:</span>{' '}
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">{check.message}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {diagResult.sampleData && (
              <div className="rounded-lg bg-muted/30 p-3 text-xs font-mono space-y-1">
                <p className="font-semibold text-foreground">Sample data ({diagResult.sampleData.dateRange}):</p>
                <p>Rows returned: {diagResult.sampleData.rowCount}</p>
                {diagResult.sampleData.firstRow && (
                  <p>First row: {JSON.stringify(diagResult.sampleData.firstRow)}</p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
});

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/pages/appeals.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { listAppealsAction,
  updateAppealStatusAction,
  approveAndUnlockAction,
  type ListAppealsFilters,
} from '@/app/(app)/appeals/actions';
import type { ModuleAccessAppealRow } from '@/lib/services/module-appeals';
import { MODULE_ACCESS_LABELS } from '@/lib/modules/module-keys';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';

export function AppealsPage({
  initialAppeals,
  colleges,
}: {
  initialAppeals: ModuleAccessAppealRow[];
  colleges: import('@/lib/services/colleges').CollegeWithCounts[];
}) {
  const [appeals, setAppeals] = useState<ModuleAccessAppealRow[]>(initialAppeals);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<ListAppealsFilters>({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [responseText, setResponseText] = useState('');
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await listAppealsAction(filters);
      setAppeals(data);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to load');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [filters]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  const selected = selectedId ? appeals.find((a) => a.id === selectedId) : null;

  const handleStatus = async (id: string, status: 'in_review' | 'approved' | 'rejected') => {
    setActionLoading(id);
    setError(null);
    const result = await updateAppealStatusAction(id, status, responseText.trim() || undefined);
    if (result.ok) {
      setAppeals((prev) => prev.map((a) => (a.id === id ? { ...a, status, super_admin_response: responseText.trim() || null } : a)));
      setSelectedId(null);
      setResponseText('');
    } else {
      setError(result.error ?? 'Failed');
    }
    setActionLoading(null);
  };

  const handleApproveAndUnlock = async (id: string, unlockFor: 'college_admin' | 'student' | 'both') => {
    setActionLoading(id);
    setError(null);
    const result = await approveAndUnlockAction(id, unlockFor, responseText.trim() || undefined);
    if (result.ok) {
      setAppeals((prev) => prev.map((a) => (a.id === id ? { ...a, status: 'approved' as const, super_admin_response: responseText.trim() || null } : a)));
      setSelectedId(null);
      setResponseText('');
    } else {
      setError(result.error ?? 'Failed');
    }
    setActionLoading(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
        <Select
          value={filters.status ?? ''}
          onValueChange={(v) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, status: (v || null) as ListAppealsFilters['status'] }))}
        >
          <SelectTrigger>
            <SelectValue placeholder="All statuses" />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="pending">Pending</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="in_review">In review</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="approved">Approved</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="rejected">Rejected</SelectItem>
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        <Select
          value={filters.collegeId ?? ''}
          onValueChange={(v) => setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, collegeId: v || null }))}
        >
          <SelectTrigger>
            <SelectValue placeholder="All colleges" />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {colleges.map((c) => (
              <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}</SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={load} disabled={loading}>
          {loading ? 'Loading…' : 'Refresh'}
        </Button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-destructive/50 bg-destructive/10 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-destructive">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
        <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-background overflow-hidden">
          <div className="border-b border-border px-4 py-2 font-medium">Appeals</div>
          <ul className="max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
            {appeals.length === 0 ? (
              <li className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">No appeals found.</li>
            ) : (
              appeals.map((a) => (
                <li
                  key={a.id}
                  className={cn(
                    'border-b border-border px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:bg-muted/50',
                    selectedId === a.id && 'bg-muted'
                  )}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedId(a.id)}
                >
                  <div className="font-medium">{MODULE_ACCESS_LABELS[a.module_key as keyof typeof MODULE_ACCESS_LABELS] ?? a.module_key}</div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{a.subject} · {a.status} · {new Date(a.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</div>
                </li>
              ))
            )}
          </ul>
        </section>

        <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-4">
          {!selected ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Select an appeal to view and respond.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-semibold">{selected.subject}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {MODULE_ACCESS_LABELS[selected.module_key as keyof typeof MODULE_ACCESS_LABELS] ?? selected.module_key} · {selected.requester_role} · {selected.status}
                </p>
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap">{selected.message}</p>
              {selected.super_admin_response && (
                <div className="rounded bg-muted/50 p-2 text-sm">
                  <span className="font-medium">Your response:</span>
                  <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap mt-1">{selected.super_admin_response}</p>
                </div>
              )}
              {selected.status === 'pending' || selected.status === 'in_review' ? (
                <>
                  <div>
                    <label className="text-sm font-medium">Response (optional)</label>
                    <Textarea
                      className="mt-1 min-h-[80px]"
                      value={responseText}
                      onChange={(e) => setResponseText(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="Reply to the requester..."
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <Button size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={!!actionLoading} onClick={() => handleStatus(selected.id, 'in_review')}>
                      Mark in review
                    </Button>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={!!actionLoading} onClick={() => handleStatus(selected.id, 'rejected')}>
                      Reject
                    </Button>
                    <Button size="sm" disabled={!!actionLoading} onClick={() => handleApproveAndUnlock(selected.id, 'both')}>
                      Approve & unlock both
                    </Button>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" disabled={!!actionLoading} onClick={() => handleApproveAndUnlock(selected.id, selected.requester_role)}>
                      Approve & unlock for requester
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- FILE: nextgen-cto-lms-product-super-admin/components/pages/audit.tsx ---
'use client';

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Download, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import type { AuditLogItem } from '@/lib/services/audit';

export const AuditPage = React.memo(function AuditPage({
  initialLogs = [],
}: {
  initialLogs?: AuditLogItem[];
}) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (!search.trim()) return initialLogs;
    const q = search.toLowerCase();
    return initialLogs.filter(
      (l) =>
        l.action.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (l.resource_type?.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (l.resource_id?.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (l.actor_id?.toLowerCase().includes(q))
    );
  }, [initialLogs, search]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => toast.info('Export Logs (UI-only)')}>
            <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" /> Export Logs
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => toast.info('Advanced Search (UI-only)')}>
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" /> Advanced Search
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <Input
          placeholder="Search action / resource / actor…"
          className={cn('min-w-0 flex-1 max-w-48 h-8 text-xs sm:w-44')}
          value={search}
          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
        />
      </div>
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-4 min-w-0 overflow-x-auto">
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead className="w-24 hidden md:table-cell">Actor</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Action</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Resource</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="min-w-[6rem] sm:min-w-[10rem]">Time</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {filtered.length === 0 ? (
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell colSpan={4} className="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8">
                  {initialLogs.length === 0
                    ? 'No audit logs yet. Actions (create college, invite admin, invite student) are logged here.'
                    : 'No logs match the search.'}
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ) : (
              filtered.map((row) => (
                <TableRow key={row.id}>
                  <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground hidden md:table-cell">
                    {row.actor_id ? `${row.actor_id.slice(0, 8)}…` : '—'}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="font-medium">{row.action}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground hidden md:table-cell">
                    {row.resource_type ?? '—'}
                    {row.resource_id ? ` · ${row.resource_id.slice(0, 8)}…` : ''}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">
                    {new Date(row.created_at).toLocaleString()}
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))
            )}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
});

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { ConfirmDialog } from '@/components/shared/confirm-dialog';

import type { CollegeWithCounts } from '@/lib/services/colleges';
import type { UserListItem } from '@/lib/services/users';
import type { StudentListItem } from '@/lib/services/students';
import type { CohortRow } from '@/lib/services/cohorts';


import {
  deleteCollegeAction,
  deleteCollegeAdminAction,
  inviteCollegeAdminAction,
  updateCollegeAction,
} from '@/app/(app)/colleges/actions';
import {
  bulkInviteStudentsAction,
  deleteStudentAction,
  inviteStudentAction,
  removeStudentFromCollegeAction,
  updateStudentAction
} from '@/app/(app)/students/actions';

// ============================================================================
// Shell Component (Instant Render)
// ============================================================================
export function CollegeDetailShell({ college }: { college: CollegeWithCounts }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [editOpen, setEditOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleteCollegeOpen, setDeleteCollegeOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  const collegeAdminBaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_COLLEGE_ADMIN_APP_URL ?? '';
  const studentBaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_LMS_APP_URL ?? '';

  const buildTenantUrl = (baseUrl: string, path: string) => {
    if (!baseUrl) return path;
    try {
      return new URL(path, baseUrl).toString();
    } catch {
      return path;
    }
  };

  const collegeAdminLoginUrl = buildTenantUrl(collegeAdminBaseUrl, `/c/${college.slug}/admin/login`);
  const studentLoginUrl = buildTenantUrl(studentBaseUrl, `/c/${college.slug}/student/login`);

  const handleEditCollege = async (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setPending(true);
    const formData = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    formData.set('college_id', college.id);
    const result = await updateCollegeAction(formData);
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      toast.error(result.error);
      return;
    }
    toast.success('College updated.');
    setEditOpen(false);
    router.refresh();
  };

  const handleDeleteCollege = async () => {
    setPending(true);
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.set('college_id', college.id);
    const result = await deleteCollegeAction(formData);
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      toast.error(result.error);
      return;
    }
    toast.success(`College deleted. Removed ${result.deletedUsers} linked login credentials.`);
    router.push('/colleges');
    router.refresh();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-start justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <div>
            <CardTitle>{college.name}</CardTitle>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">Slug: {college.slug}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">Status: {college.status}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setEditOpen(true)}>Edit College</Button>
            <Button variant="destructive" onClick={() => setDeleteCollegeOpen(true)}>Delete College</Button>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-2 text-sm">
          <p>
            <strong>College Admin Login URL:</strong>{' '}
            <a className="underline text-primary break-all" href={collegeAdminLoginUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
              {collegeAdminLoginUrl}
            </a>
          </p>
          <p>
            <strong>Student Login URL:</strong>{' '}
            <a className="underline text-primary break-all" href={studentLoginUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
              {studentLoginUrl}
            </a>
          </p>
          <p className="text-xs text-destructive">
            Deleting this college will also delete linked student/admin login credentials for this tenant.
          </p>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Dialog open={editOpen} onOpenChange={setEditOpen}>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Edit College</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <form onSubmit={handleEditCollege} className="space-y-3">
            <Input name="name" defaultValue={college.name} required />
            <Input name="short_name" defaultValue={college.short_name ?? ''} placeholder="Short name" />
            <CollegeStatusSelect defaultValue={college.status} />
            <Input name="support_email" type="email" defaultValue={college.support_email || ''} placeholder="Support email" />
            <Input name="support_phone" defaultValue={college.support_phone || ''} placeholder="Support phone" />
            <DialogFooter>
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => setEditOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>{pending ? 'Saving...' : 'Save'}</Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </form>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={deleteCollegeOpen}
        onClose={() => setDeleteCollegeOpen(false)}
        title="Delete College"
        description="Are you sure you want to delete this college and remove all linked credentials? This is permanent."
        confirmLabel={pending ? 'Deleting...' : 'Delete College'}
        onConfirm={handleDeleteCollege}
      />
    </>
  );
}


// ============================================================================
// Admin Accounts Component
// ============================================================================
export function CollegeAdminsCard({
  collegeId,
  admins
}: {
  collegeId: string;
  admins: UserListItem[];
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [inviteAdminOpen, setInviteAdminOpen] = useState(false);
  const [adminToDelete, setAdminToDelete] = useState<UserListItem | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  const handleInviteAdmin = async (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setPending(true);
    const formData = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    formData.set('college_id', collegeId);
    const result = await inviteCollegeAdminAction(formData);
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      toast.error(result.error);
      return;
    }
    toast.success('College admin credentials created.');
    setInviteAdminOpen(false);
    event.currentTarget.reset();
    router.refresh();
  };

  const handleDeleteAdmin = async () => {
    if (!adminToDelete) return;
    setPending(true);
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.set('college_id', collegeId);
    formData.set('user_id', adminToDelete.user_id);
    const result = await deleteCollegeAdminAction(formData);
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      toast.error(result.error);
      return;
    }
    toast.success('College admin credentials deleted.');
    setAdminToDelete(null);
    router.refresh();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="flex flex-row gap-2 justify-between flex-wrap">
          <CardTitle>College Admin Accounts</CardTitle>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setInviteAdminOpen(true)}>Create College Admin</Button>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>Name</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Email</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="hidden sm:table-cell">Status</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[120px]">Actions</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {admins.length === 0 ? (
                <TableRow>
                  <TableCell colSpan={4} className="py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground">No admins yet.</TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ) : (
                admins.map((admin) => (
                  <TableRow key={admin.id}>
                    <TableCell>{admin.full_name ?? '-'}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="hidden sm:table-cell">{admin.email ?? '-'}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="hidden sm:table-cell">{admin.status}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Button
                        size="sm"
                        variant="destructive"
                        onClick={() => setAdminToDelete(admin)}
                        disabled={pending}
                      >
                        Delete
                      </Button>
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))
              )}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Dialog open={inviteAdminOpen} onOpenChange={setInviteAdminOpen}>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Create College Admin</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <form onSubmit={handleInviteAdmin} className="space-y-3">
            <Input name="email" type="email" required placeholder="admin@college.edu" />
            <Input name="full_name" required placeholder="Admin full name" />
            <Input name="password" type="password" required minLength={8} placeholder="Password" />
            <DialogFooter>
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => setInviteAdminOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>{pending ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Admin Login'}</Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </form>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
      
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={!!adminToDelete}
        onClose={() => setAdminToDelete(null)}
        title="Delete Admin"
        description={`Remove admin credentials for ${adminToDelete?.email}?`}
        confirmLabel={pending ? 'Deleting...' : 'Delete Admin'}
        onConfirm={handleDeleteAdmin}
      />
    </>
  );
}

// ============================================================================
// Students Component
